articleTitle: Do circularly polarized filaments exist?
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Filaments prepared by launching a focused beam (< 200µm) from vacuum to air exist only in linear polarization, in contrast to observations reporting filaments produced from a circularly polarized beam let to self-focus in air.

articleTitle: Femtosecond g(4) measurement by HBT interferometry of an upconversion based autocorrelation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and experimentally realize a compact semiconductor-based scheme for a femtosecond time-scale g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(4)</sup> measurement, based on a start-stop HBT interferometry of autocorrelation. The autocorrelation is performed by upconversion in a semiconductor quantum well structure.

articleTitle: Ultrafast pulse shaping and applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Programmable optical pulse shaping, allowing generation of nearly arbitrarily shaped ultrafast optical waveforms, is reviewed. After outlining the fundamentals, new directions in pulse shaping and selected applications are discussed.

articleTitle: Towards on-chip tunable nanolasers based on optomechanical zipper cavities
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Work towards semiconductor nanolasers at λ = 1.3 µm in optomechanically coupled one dimensional photonic-crystal cavities is presented. Optical mode spectroscopy and on-chip tuning capability based on capacitive actuation is developed. Experimental and theoretical results are presented.

articleTitle: Full field spectral domain Optical Coherence Tomography with improved extended depth of focus
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In Full field Optical Coherence Tomography (FFOCT) lateral resolution is achieved by high NA lenses. However, it decreases depth of focus (DOF). We incorporate interfering phase mask allowing to extend the DOF of a FFOCT.

articleTitle: Frequency modulation of high-order harmonics depending on the delay between two-color laser fields
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have observed periodical frequency modulation of high-order harmonics by changing the delay between the driving two-color laser fields, for the first time. The amplitude of the modulation has been up to ∼0.4 eV.

articleTitle: Fiber Amplification of 2 µm picoseconds pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ultrashort pulses were generated by a carbon nanotube mode-locked Tm fiber laser and subsequently amplified. Amplified pulses had an average power of 0.6 W, 2.6 kW peak power, and 13 nJ of energy

articleTitle: Evaluation of the electromagnetic hazard of intense THz pulses on neural cells
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an experimental study on the potential electromagnetic hazard of High field THz broadband pulse on healthy and degenerated neural tissue toward in vivo application of reflective THz time domain spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Two-photon photoemission can map femtosecond-lived unoccupied bulk states
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use a tunable 100-fs UV source to demonstrate angle-resolved two-photon photoemission band mapping of bound but unoccupied bulk bands, viz. Cu sp-band. The strong optical pumping overcomes the femtosecond lifetime of this bulk feature.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser-induced TiO2 nanostructures on titanium
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report formation of polarization-dependent nanostructures (nanolines, nanocircles) by high repetition-rate femtosecond laser pulses on titanium surface through a novel mechanism, converting Ti to TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. Arbitrarily large-area patterns are created by self-stitching of these patterns.

articleTitle: Novel multicore fibers for large-mode-areas and high beam quality
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A passive multicore fiber with a mode field area of 465 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at 1050 nm delivering virtually diffraction limited output beam quality and a few-mode multicore fiber are investigated and compared to suitable step-index fibers.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of hyperbolic wave vector surfaces in silver nanowire arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The two principal effective dielectric constants of silver nanowire arrays are directly derived from the angular dependence of the Fabry-Perot peaks in transmission measurements. The hyperbolic wave vector surface is mapped from the experimental data.

articleTitle: One telescope per pixel
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This paper presents ultra-efficient transmissive display technology based on telescopic pixel design. The backlight transmission efficiency was measured to be 36% compared to 5-10% achieved by LCD.

articleTitle: Experimental realisation of a mode-locked parabolic Raman fiber oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The generation of self-similar parabolic pulses (similaritons) has so far only been obtained in single-pass Raman amplifier configurations, or in rare-earth doped fiber lasers. We report here the first demonstration of a mode-locked parabolic pulse fiber laser, which can potentially be run at any wavelength using Raman gain. This new all-fiber ring similariton laser scheme (cf. Fig. 1) has been designed using a full theoretical model. The output similariton pulses have a true parabolic shape, a linear chirp and an energy of 22nJ.

articleTitle: Timing jitter characteristics of ultrashort optical pulse generator using Mach-Zehnder-modulator-based flat comb generator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on timing jitter characteristics of ultrashort pulse trains generated by a Mach-Zehnder-modulator-based flat comb generator. By phase noise measurements, the rms timing jitter of the pulse generator was estimated to be 70 fs.

articleTitle: A C2H2 frequency-stabilized laser diode with a linewidth of 4 kHz and its application to an optical phase-locked loop
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a narrow linewidth <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup>C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> frequency-stabilized laser diode with an FM-eliminated output. The frequency stability reached as high as 2.3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-11</sup> (τ=1 s). A low phase noise OPLL is demonstrated using this laser.

articleTitle: Integrated terahertz pulse generation and amplification in quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Terahertz pulse generation is demonstrated by a resonant femtosecond interband excitation of the miniband of a quantum-cascade-laser. The laser gain is subsequently used to amplify the terahertz pulse generated as it propagates through the cavity.

articleTitle: Low-power portable laser spectroscopic sensor for atmospheric CO2 monitoring
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a wireless, portable CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> sensor based on laser absorption spectroscopy. Allan variance for long run tests yielded Gaussian noise limited operation up to 100 seconds with ultimate minimum detection limit of 5.1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-7</sup>.

articleTitle: Azo-functionalized silk as a biocompatible material for low power holography and nonlinear optics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Azobenzene modified silk, a biocompatible material suitable for applications in biomedicine is shown to display photo-effects such as optically induced birefringence, suitability as a holographic recording material and photoinduction of surface relief features.

articleTitle: Cooling and trapping of neutral mercury atoms in a magneto-optical trap
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the trapping of mercury in a magneto-optical trap from the background vapor using the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> intercombination line. Up to (3.2 ± 0.3) × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6 202</sup>Hg-atoms have been captured at a density of (4.8 ± 1.4) × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sup> atoms/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>.

articleTitle: Planar terahertz metamaterial at cryogenic temperatures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical properties of planar thin-film metamaterials were measured at room and liquid nitrogen temperatures using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy. The higher charge mobility at low temperatures is shown to be a promising path towards low-loss metamaterials.

articleTitle: Functional imaging & monitoring of brain & breast with diffuse light
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Diffuse optical spectroscopy and tomography of tissue is finding unique clinical niches. I will describe representative brain and breast functional imaging and monitoring results to illustrate the workings of these new tissue diagnostics.

articleTitle: All-optical excitonic switch
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate experimental proof of principle for all-optical excitonic switches where light controls light using excitons as intermediate medium.

articleTitle: In-situ grating-damage detection and analysis for the 1.5-m grating compressor of the OMEGA EP kilojoule, petawatt-class short-pulse laser system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A grating-inspection system and damage-analysis method have been developed to measure in-situ laser-induced damage of a 1.5-m grating in the OMEGA EP pulse compressor during a 2.2-kJ energy ramp.

articleTitle: Self-assembled plasmonic nanoparticle clusters
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Polymer-coated gold nanoshells are assembled, using capillary forces, into packed clusters with tailored surface plasmon resonances. Separation between nanoshells is engineered to be ∼2nm. Strongly coupled resonances in nanoshell dimers and trimers are observed.

articleTitle: Large area multi-material plasmonic nanostructures fabricated by replica molding and mechanical sectioning
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the fabrication of plasmonic nanostructures (rings, split rings, and other structures) by a process involving molding by soft lithography, thin film deposition, and mechanical sectioning (nanoskiving). This unique process is highly parallelizable and allows for the fabrication of nanostructures of multiple materials in the same plane and very high aspect ratio structures. We characterize the optical properties of concentric gold rings fabricated by this process in the near- to mid-infrared by FDTD simulations and FTIR spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Light takes shape for biophotonics: New directions in trapping and cell transfection
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe applications of optically sculpting the incident field for applications in optical trapping and controlled cell transfection.

articleTitle: A high energy, high efficiency, resonantly pumped nanosecond-pulsed 1.6 µm Er∶YAG laser system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Limited gain in Er:YAG makes generation of energetic nanosecond pulses difficult. We describe a cavity-dumped oscillator, regenerative amplifier system designed to deliver 100 mJ, 20 nsec diffraction limited output pulses at 10W average power.

articleTitle: Fiber taper collection of photoluminescence at 1.54 µm from erbium doped silicon nitride photonic crystal cavities
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photoluminescence at 1.54 μm from Er-doped silicon nitride embedded in silicon photonic crystal cavities was extracted with 2.5× greater collection efficiency compared to free space emission, with loaded Q values of up to 98% of the intrinsic Q.

PACS Terms: (060.2310) Fiber optics and optical communications: Fiber optics

articleTitle: Ultra-thin ultra-smooth and low-loss silver and silver-silica composite films for superlensing applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a method to fabricate ultra-thin ultra-smooth and low-loss silver and silver-silica composite films using a germanium wetting layer and a rapid post-annealing treatment. Such achievement satisfies both the demands for superlenses and hyperlenses.

articleTitle: Ultrafast laser inscribed Tm3+: Germanate glass waveguide laser at 1.9 µm
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report guiding, lasing action and performance characterization at around 1.9 μm from an ultrafast laser inscribed channel waveguide in a Tm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped fluorogermanate glass.

PACS Terms: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Mode-locking of a Cr2+: ZnSe laser using a PPLN nonlinear mirror: theoretical modelling and cavity design
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We numerically investigate the use of a PPLN nonlinear mirror to achieve pulsed operation of a Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>:ZnSe laser. We discuss the effect of various parameters on the laser dynamics (CW, Q-switched and/or mode-locked operation).

articleTitle: Carrier envelope offset frequency of a 10 GHz etalon-stabilized comb source
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report CEO frequency measurements of a 10 GHz harmonically modelocked, etalon stabilized comb source using a multi-heterodyne beating technique. Also, preliminary results from an attempt at f-2f self referencing measurement are presented.

articleTitle: High power femtosecond laser system for intracavity high harmonic generation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a high power (>6.5 Watts) Ti:sapphire based frequency comb producing ~25 μJ pulses at 50MHz inside a fs enhancement cavity. The system is used to generate intracavity high harmonics below 62 nm.

articleTitle: Integrated mid-infrared chalcogenide glass waveguide and quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use an additive solution-casting process to fabricate chalcogenide glass planar waveguides specifically for the mid-IR, and directly integrate the waveguides on-chip with an existing QCL.

articleTitle: Entanglement-enhanced measurement of a completely unknown phase
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a method for achieving phase measurements with accuracy beyond the standard quantum limit using entangled states. A sophisticated feedback scheme means that no initial estimate of the phase is required.

articleTitle: Ultra-short cavity distributed Bragg reflector Er-doped fiber laser for temperature-insensitive bending measurement
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a bending sensor by measuring the beat frequency shift of a DBR fiber laser. The polarization beat frequency of the DBR laser exhibits high sensitivity to fiber bending while immune to temperature change.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared single-photon detection using superconducting nanowires integrated with nano-antennae
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present some major challenges of mid-infrared superconducting nanowire single-photon detector technology and our device design with nano-antenna integration to address these challenges.

articleTitle: Calibration of a high harmonic spectrometer by laser induced plasma emission
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a method that allows for a convenient switching between high harmonic generation and accurate calibration of the vacuum ultraviolet spectrometer used to analyze the harmonic spectrum.

articleTitle: Dispersion-free 2-D confined terahertz pulses propagation in gap waveguide formed by two cylindrical surfaces
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate undistorted two-dimensionally-confined THz pulse propagation in a 5-cm-long waveguide formed by two metallic cylindrical surfaces. A simple theoretical model explains experimental results. The possibility of using the waveguide in sensing application was tested.

articleTitle: Coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering microscopy using a single-pass picoseconds supercontinuum-seeded optical parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigated a coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering microscopy with a single-pass picoseconds supercontinuum-seeded optical parametric amplifier (SCOPA). Our SCOPA system is substantially simpler because the pump and Stokes lasers are automatically overlapped.

PACS Terms: (300.6230) Spectroscopy: Spectroscopy, coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering

articleTitle: Reflection of subdiffusive light from 3D disordered photonic crystals
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Two different transport regimes of light are observed in the same medium and are explained by the scaling theory of localization. Our results constitute the first demonstration of continuous renormalization of the optical diffusion coefficient.

articleTitle: Simultaneous spectral broadening and amplification of a laser pulse in a glass plate
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated a novel method of simultaneous spectral broadening and amplification of a laser pulse in a glass plate. A proof-of-principle experiment improved both the spectrum and the energy by a factor of about three.

articleTitle: Dispersion tailoring in dual slot waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Dual slot waveguides incorporate a sub-core in the slot, so that the guided beam is confined two-dimensionally. The modification enlarges the room for tailoring dispersive properties and birefringence. Both zero-dispersion and constant-dispersion points are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Nonequilibrium quantum dynamics in optomechanical systems
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We discuss the dynamics of optical modes coupled to vibrating nanostructures. Examples include the shuttling of photons in a cavity containing a vibrating membrane, and a single atom coupled to a membrane via the cavity.

articleTitle: Patterning of metal electrode on flexible substrate using laser transfer method
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Through incorporating with the technique of rapid polydimethysiloxane (PDMS) lift-off, this study reports on a new laser transfer method that is applicable to printing metallic thin film on a flexible substrate. Aluminum line patterns, with line widths of 40 and 100 μm and deposited on poly(ethylene terephthalate) (PET) substrate, are presented. The patterned film is demonstrated to be a good conductor, with resistivity of 2.95×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> Ω-cm, and with very good adhesion strength through the scotch-tape test.

articleTitle: Observation of thermal occupation of room-temperature J-aggregate microcavity exciton-polaritons
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a measurement of the lower-branch exciton-polariton occupation in room-temperature J-aggregate microcavity devices under low-density steady-state excitation. The observed occupation follows a Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution at T=300K, indicating efficient polariton relaxation, necessary for achieving lasing.

articleTitle: Field perturbations due to strong coupling and modal confinement in SOI arrayed waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a method of rescaling the basis set used in coupled mode theory for constructing the mode profiles of silicon-on-insulator strongly coupled arrayed waveguides. We show that due to strong coupling the decay constants of the supermodes fanout, and can become spatially varying due to the vertical confinement of the mode. Further, we show that in strongly coupled arrayed waveguides the field peaks are no longer centered within their dielectric boundaries.

articleTitle: Broadband THz lasing from a photon-phonon quantum cascade structure emitting from 2.8 to 4.1 THz.
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Laser emission over a broad range of frequencies from 2.8 to 4.1 THz is reported from a two-quantum well, photon-phonon cascade structure. Internal quantum efficiencies reaching 43% are evaluated at 10 K. Maximum operating temperatures of 125 K are reported, with peak optical powers in excess of 30 mW from a double-metal ridge waveguide. The laser operates in both polarities, showing laser action in reverse bias up to a temperature of 90 K.

articleTitle: Enhanced waveguide nonlinearity and mechanical robustness in hybrid As2Se3-PMMA Microtapers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the fabrication of an As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Se<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> microtaper with a protective polymer cladding. The 7 cm long microtaper provides an ultrahigh nonlinearity of γ=45 W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> whereas the polymer cladding provides mechanical strength to the device.

articleTitle: The effect of the longitudinal electric field and tensor susceptibility on the effective nonlinear parameter for silicon nanowire waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show the significant impact of the longitudinal electric field component and full tensor susceptibility on the effective nonlinear parameter in subwavelength silicon nanowire waveguides. Inclusion of these effects is necessary for satisfactory wire modeling.

articleTitle: Symmetrically-coupled SOAs exhibit optical bistability
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An optical switch based-on two electrically coupled SOAs is demonstrated. Experiments show switching frequencies in MHz range with 4 dB contrast ratio. The performance can be improved up to GHz range employing photonic integrated devices.

articleTitle: Enhanced transduction of polymer photonic crystal band-edge lasers via additional layer deposition
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the concept of enhanced transduction for polymer photonic crystal lasers by deposition of an additional polymer layer with selective gas response. We report a significant increase in sensitivity to changes in gas concentration.

articleTitle: Generation of a comb of vacuum squeezing over 2.4GHz for multiplexed communication
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the measurement of a “squeezing comb”, the time-resolved homodyne detection of the first twelve vacuum squeezing sidebands of an optical parametric oscillator, and propose its use as a multiplexed quantum communications channel.

articleTitle: Polarity-controlled visible/IR electroluminescence in Si-nanocrystal/Si light-emitting diodes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the demonstration of room-temperature two-color Si-nanocrystal/Si light-emitting diodes, which emit infrared light from silicon and visible emission from the Si-nanocrystal film when Si substrate is forward and reverse biased, respectively.

articleTitle: Polarisation effects on Anderson localisation in the presence of metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have derived an elegant and effective equation to characterise the Anderson localisation length in one-dimensional systems that may contain metamaterials and have undertaken a comprehensive study, uncovering a number of striking polarisation effects.

articleTitle: Ultra-low RF linewidth in a quantum dot mode-locked laser under external optical feedback stabilization
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The effect of external optical feedback on quantum dot two-section passively mode-locked lasers is investigated. The RF linewidth narrows down from 8 KHz in the free-running situation to a very low value of 350 Hz.

articleTitle: Homodyne locking of a squeezer
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Homodyne locking is a new approach to frequency-locking an OPO-based squeezed-vacuum source and its driving laser. It is cheap, easy to implement, subsequent measurements are automatically phase-locked, and it is uniquely a sub-QNL frequency discriminator.

articleTitle: Ultra low power electro-optic modulator on silicon: Towards direct logic driven silicon modulators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate ultra-low switching energy (9.4 fJ/bit), ultra-low swing voltage (150 mV peak-peak) electro-optic modulation in a 2.5 μm radius silicon ring modulator. These results can enable direct logic driven silicon modulators.

articleTitle: Yb-doped sesquioxide thin disk lasers exceeding 300 W of output power in continuous-wave operation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on VBG-diode-pumped Yb:Lu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, Yb:Sc<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, and Yb:LuScO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> thin disk lasers delivering more than 250 W of output power at optical-to-optical efficiencies up to 73%. 140 W of fundamental-mode output power were obtained with Yb:Lu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>.

articleTitle: Broadband continuous wavelength conversion of 10-Gb/s data in silicon waveguides spanning S-, C-, and L-bands
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate broadband continuous wavelength conversion of 10-Gb/s data across 100 nm using four-wave mixing in dispersion-engineered silicon waveguides. Error-free operation and constant 2-dB power penalties are experimentally obtained for all examined probe-idler separations.

articleTitle: Switching from nonlinear beam focusing to defocusing in periodic structures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally the transition of nonlinear beam focusing to defocusing by varying the modulation depth of a periodic system. The observed effect illustrates the fundamental crossover when the periodic system changes properties to homogeneous.

articleTitle: A pointed look at light at the nanoscale
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The subwavelength structure of light fields can be controlled with nanostructures. We map these fields, observe polarization singularities in the electric fieldis and, for the first time, visualize the magnetic component of light.

articleTitle: Contra-directional coupling between TE and TM modes in asymmetric photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Coupling between the fundamental TE- and TM-like modes in a photonic crystal waveguide is investigated. Coupling is achieved by introducing transverse and vertical asymmetries into the periodic guiding layer. Polarization-insensitive narrow-band filtering behavior is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Intracavity diamond Raman lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A synthetic diamond crystal was used inside a Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser cavity as a Raman gain medium. A maximum average power of 230 mW at 1240 nm was measured.

articleTitle: Single-shot detection and on-line control of carrier phase drifts of mid-IR pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a new scheme for single-shot characterization of the absolute-phase jitter of mid-IR pulses. The system detects phase drifts of self-phase stabilized sources; a control scheme compensating long-term drifts is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Positive and negative mechanical Kerr nonlinearities in periodically-patterned silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We design periodic silicon waveguides with mechanical Kerr coefficients of positive or negative sign. The mechanical Kerr coefficient is >3 orders of magnitude larger than the Kerr coefficient of silicon for suspended lengths ~30 μm.

articleTitle: Attosecond pulse generation in noble gases in the presence of extreme high intensity THz pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High harmonic generation by a strong laser pulse in the presence of a THz pulse is simulated. Consequent spectral extension for different laser wavelengths, and the temporal chirp of the synthesized attosecond pulses are studied.

articleTitle: Generation of sub 7-fs pulses at 800 nm from a degenerate Optical Parametric Amplifier
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We generate 800-nm, sub-7-fs pulses from a degenerate Optical Parametric Amplifier pumped by the second harmonic of a Ti:sapphire system and seeded by supercontinuum generated by a near IR OPA pumped by the same source.

articleTitle: Multipoint mesh sensing system with self-healing functionality
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A self-healing multipoint mesh sensing system is proposed by arranging the wavelengths of FBG sensors corresponding to the FSR of an AWG with three 2×2 optical switches in remote nodes to construct the healing links.

articleTitle: All-fiber single optical frequency generation from an Er-doped fiber frequency comb
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an all-fiber-based apparatus built to generate near-infrared frequencies directly from an Er-doped fiber frequency comb. The amplified final output signal yields a frequency stability of 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−15</sup> with a linewidth less than 1 Hz.

articleTitle: Chiral THz metamaterial with tunable optical activity
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Tunable optical activity in chiral metamaterials is demonstrated in simulation and shows actively tunable giant polarization rotation over a wide frequency band.

articleTitle: Sub micron fs inscribed volume Bragg gratings in fused silica
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present femtosecond induced volume Bragg gratings (VBGs) using a phase mask technique. For the first time we could realize reflecting VBGs in fused silica with a high period stability and periods down to 537.5nm.

articleTitle: Optomechanical protein switch
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate photomechanical actuation by measuring the variation of the diffracted excitation light source.

articleTitle: Simultaneous two-channel wavelength conversion of 40-Gbit/s DPSK WDM signals without additional pumps
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate simultaneous two-channel wavelength conversion of 40-Gbit/s RZ-DPSK WDM signals using four-wave mixing (FWM) in a highly nonlinear fiber (HNLF) without additional pumps. A power penalty of <;1 dB is observed as channel spacing varies from 200 GHz to 1 THz.

articleTitle: LO-phonon scattering of cavity polaritons in an electroluminescent device
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Emission of longitudinal optical phonons between the upper and the lower polariton branches has been observed in an intersubband electroluminescent device, operating in the strong coupling regime.

articleTitle: Single-shot complex-field characterization of ultrafast optical waveforms with MHZ measurement update rates
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Balanced spectral interferometry is combined with dispersion-induced frequency-to-time mapping to achieve single-shot full (amplitude and phase) characterization of dynamical THz-bandwidth optical signals over sub-nanosecond time windows at unprecedented measurement update rates of nearly 20 MHz.

articleTitle: 15-fs multicolor laser pulses generation using cascaded four-wave mixing with chirped pulses incidence
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: With the use of negatively chirped and positively chirped incident pulses, as short as 15 fs multicolor pulses were obtained in a fused silica glass using cascaded four-wave mixing technique.

articleTitle: Secure optical transmission in single-user channel using encrypted wireless CDMA codes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose to use encrypted wireless CDMA codes to transmit data securely through an optical single-user channel. Our experiment successfully transmits data at 1.56Gb/s with a BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>, below FEC limit.

articleTitle: Historical perspective of nonlinear optics and its applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Summary form only given. Nonlinear optics in the past 60 years has been full of excitement and created tremendous impact in many disciplines. New laser technology has been the prime motive force behind the advances of the field.

articleTitle: Spiral propagation of two collapsing beams
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate spiral propagation of two beams intersecting with a small angle in Kerr media. Through the balance of attractive and centrifugal forces, we observe rotations up to 14° by operating at zero relative phase.

articleTitle: Bistable wavelength switching in a two-section quantum-dot mode-locked diode laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate the wavelength-switching dynamics of a bistable two-section quantum-dot diode laser. The switching time between the two stable wavelengths is about 150 ps, which corresponds to two round trips in the laser.

articleTitle: Multi-photon ablation of biological samples with custom-built femtosecond fiber laser-microscope system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A femtosecond laser-microscope system is custom-built for ablation of cells and tissue at 1030 nm. Fiber lasers offer important advantages for nanosurgery, including superior robustness, lower-cost and nearly complete control over pulse train pattern.

articleTitle: Broad waveguide QED system on a chip
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a slot waveguide provides a broad-band, loss-free platform suitable for applications in quantum optics. The strong coupling between light quanta and quantum emitter can be achieved with Purcell factor larger than 200.

articleTitle: Advanced optical fibers for geophysical sensing applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Growth in fiber optic sensing in the geophysical sector, predominantly in downhole oil and gas applications, has spurred refinement of optical fibers primarily to endure the harsh high temperature, hydrogen-rich well environment. This paper reviews advanced sensing fiber design and field performance under these conditions, as well as some new fiber and waveguide designs for enhanced sensor functionality and performance.

articleTitle: Energy scaling of few-cycle pulse compression in hollow fibers using circular polarization
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that few-cycle pulse compression in statically filled hollow fibers can be scaled in energy using circular polarization. This technique could be useful for upgrading pressure gradient devices while preserving stable conditions of operation.

articleTitle: Gas sensing with a sub-micron tapered fibre embedded in hydrophobic aerogel
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Tapered fibres with waist diameters down to 0.7 μm embedded in hydrophobic aerogel are demonstrated as evanescent-field gas sensors. The porous aerogel is permeable to gases but protects the sub-micron fibre from contamination and damage.

articleTitle: Quasi-planar optics: computing light propagation and scattering in planar waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed a new mode matching technique capable of accurate numerical computation of wave coupling in arrays of planar structures. The algorithm is illustrated on several examples of plasmonic and volumetric waveguides.

articleTitle: High power 245 nm deep UV LEDs
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report large area, 245 nm to 250 nm deep UV LEDs with output power more than 5 mW in CW operation and above 30 mW for 200 μs pulses at 10 % duty cycle.

articleTitle: Spin squeezing via quantum non-demolition measurements in cold 87Rb atomic ensemble
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate spin squeezing of a magnetically sensitive coherent spin-state in an ensemble of ~ 6.5 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> cold <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb atoms. Quantum non-demolition measurements achieved a spin-noise reduction by 2.9(<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+1.3</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1.0</sup>) dB compared to the initial projection noise level.

articleTitle: Numerical study of THz propagation in curved parallel-plate waveguides via the lowest-order transverse-electric (TE1) mode
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We numerically model the TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>-mode propagation of terahertz radiation inside a parallel-plate waveguide with curved plates. We show that a slight curvature can result in better mode confinement, without sacrificing its favorable dispersive properties.

articleTitle: Characterization of emission lifetime of nitrogen-vacancy centres in nanodiamonds
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that the lifetime of nitrogen vacancy emitters can be increased by incorporating nano-diamonds into opals and the lifetime variance may be reduced by placing them on the surface of opals.

articleTitle: Time domain SPE/SPD and DPSK data modulation using single phase modulator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel scheme using single phase modulator for simultaneous generating and decoding of time domain spectral phase encoded signal and DPSK data modulation is proposed and experimentally demonstrated for five 16-chip, 40GHz/chip optical code patterns.

articleTitle: Split band edge resonance in a 2 dimensional square lattice structure
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We find for the first time the split band edge resonance in a two-dimensional photonic crystal. Its Q factor is much higher than that of the regular band edge mode in the same structure.

articleTitle: New concepts in spoof surface plasmon polariton metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: New approaches to create high-confinement surface waveguides based on spoof surface plasmon polaritons in the infrared part of the spectrum will be presented, focusing on structures with improved trade-off between bandwidth and confinement.

articleTitle: Dispersion variation of a thulium-doped stretched-pulse fiber laser with spectral filtering
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on stretched-pulse operation of a thulium-doped fiber laser with spectral filtering emitting at 1.98 μm. Cavity dispersion was varied from -0.044 ps<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to 0.049 ps<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The experimental results are compared with numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Experimental realization of perfect infrared absorber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Low-absorbing materials can be made strongly absorbing by utilizing plasmonic metamaterials. We propose and experimentally validate the concept of a plasmonic MetaMirror which improves energy absorption efficiency by an order of magnitude.

articleTitle: Experimental study of pulse evolution in a 30-fs mode-locked Yb-fiber oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have investigated the pulse evolution in a 30-fs Yb-doped mode-locked oscillator experimentally. We found that the nonlinear-phase shift plays an important role for the passive third-order dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Sub-wavelength plasmon solitons in 1D arrays of coupled metallic nanowires
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first theoretical study of sub-wavelength plasmon solitons formed in arrays of metallic nanowires. We demonstrate that the plasmonic arrays support unstaggered and staggered solitons, which can be effectively excited from Gaussian beams.

articleTitle: Observation of second harmonic generation induced by pure spin currents in semiconductors
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate second harmonic generation induced by pure spin currents in semiconductors, and show that this effect can be used for the direct, noninvasive, and nondestructive detection of pure spin currents.

articleTitle: Quantum well saturable absorber mirror with electrical control of modulation depth
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A saturable absorber mirror comprizing InGaAs/GaAs quantum wells incorporated into a p-i-n structure is demonstrated. Its modulation depth can be reduced from 4.25 % to 1.63 % by applying reverse bias voltage in the range 0-1 V.

articleTitle: Tuning mechanisms in optofluidics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Novel functionalities have been developed through the fusion of optics and microfluidics. We categorize the different possible tuning mechanisms in optofluidics and describe the recent examples in each category.

PACS Terms: (000.3110) Instruments, apparatus, and components common to the sciences

articleTitle: Proposal for an on-demand source of indistinguishable single photons from a single quantum dot - cavity system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a new scheme for the on-demand-generation of indistinguishable single-photons using adiabatic Raman passage through the Autler-Townes doublet, generated from a resonant field applied between the biexciton and exciton states in a quantum dot.

articleTitle: True random number generator based on the phase noise of laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a true random number generator with the high generation rate of 80 Mbit/s, based on the measurement of the phase noise of a single mode vertical cavity surface emitting laser (VCSEL).

articleTitle: A terahertz plastic wire based evanescent field sensor for high sensitivity liquid detection
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A highly sensitive detection method based on the evanescent wave of a terahertz subwavelength plastic wire was demonstrated for liquid sensing. A 20 ppm melamine alcohol solution is successfully identified with refractive-index sensitivity of 0.01.

articleTitle: Prism-pair interferometer for precise refractive index measurement using spectral lamp radiation with simultaneous wavelength calibration
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed a prism-pair interferometer which measures precise refractive index of glasses while ensuring the SI-traceability of a lamp wavelength. The measurement result agrees with manufacture's value within 1 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>.

articleTitle: Effective area scaling of the multifilament fiber core
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Multifilament fiber core (MFC) design enables low NA fiber using high index materials. We study the scaling of MFC effective area using an effective step-index model. MFC fiber mixes step index and multicore fibers properties.

articleTitle: Adaptive optics for direct writing in three-dimensional nano-fabrication
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Aberrations affect the focal spot quality in direct laser write applications when focusing through a refractive index mismatch. We develop adaptive optics to correct aberrations and demonstrate improved fabrication depth in several substrates.

articleTitle: Angle-resolved thz time domain reflection spectroscopy of rough surfaces
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The use of a fiber-coupled terahertz TDS system offers new possibilities for angle-resolved reflection spectroscopy. We put the focus especially on angle-resolved scattering from roughened surfaces of both dielectric and metallic surfaces.

articleTitle: Stretch-tuneable dielectric mirrors and microcavities
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Flexible DBRs are fabricated by floating and stacking >20 bilayers of PDMS and PSPI. Stretchable microcavities between two DBRs are subsequently created with Q>60. These structures have applications as stress-strain sensors, stretch-tuneable lasers and LEDs.

articleTitle: Band gaps in amorphous photonic lattices
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present, theoretically and experimentally, amorphous photonic lattices exhibiting band gap and negative effective mass, yet lacking Bragg diffraction. Here, bands comprise of Anderson states, but defect states residing in the gap are always more localized.

articleTitle: Quasi-passive and reconfigurable node for optical access network
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a quasi-passive reconfigurable power/wavelength distribution device for optical access network. It can adapt to deployment condition and optimize the energy consumption. Novel tri-state non-volatile optical switches are designed in this device to preserve the semi-passive operation.

PACS Terms: (060.1810) Buffers, couplers, routers, switches, and multiplexers

articleTitle: Efficient method for estimating random errors in optical constants measured with THz-TDS
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose practical models for standard deviations in intensity and phase spectra of electric field measured with THz-TDS, which makes possible to estimate random errors in the optical constants from single measurement of a sample.

articleTitle: Optimization of Synchronized single-photon frequency upconversion by temporal and spectral control
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Single photons at 1.04 μm were converted to the visible region by sum-frequency generation with a synchronized pumping beam at 1.55 μm and the maximum detection efficiency was reached 27.6%.

articleTitle: Threshold lasing modes of a random laser: from the localised to the ballistic regime
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use the rigorous multipole method to calculate lasing and quasi-bound states from localised to diffusive regimes and show these coincide in the former regime but differ in the latter.

articleTitle: Free-standing silicon ring resonator for low power optical bistability
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate low power optical bistability in a free-standing silicon ring resonator. The transmission exhibits hysteresis for 80 μW pump power, which is over an order of magnitude lower than similar unreleased ring resonators.

articleTitle: 3D AFM characterization of the edge roughness of silicon high Q resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Nanophotonic resonators are very sensitive to sidewall roughness. We investigate in detail the sidewall roughness, correlation length and fractal roughness exponent for high Q silicon resonators using a 3D AFM.

articleTitle: The guided-mode phonon-polariton in suspended waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using Raman scattering measurements in suspended semiconductor waveguides coupled with finite-element analysis, we elucidate the properties of the guided-mode phonon-polariton, which plays a critical role in many current terahertz generation approaches.

articleTitle: Low power optical interconnect at 10 Gbps with high efficiency 1060nm VCSEL
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed a high speed, low power optical interconnect system using a high efficiency 1060 nm VCSEL. Clear eye diagrams are recorded at 10 Gbps with lower than 2 mA bias and 150 mVp-p modulation voltage.

articleTitle: Nonlinearity-controlled reshaping and anomalous diffraction of Airy beams
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Two-dimensional Airy beams controlled with self-focusing and self-defocusing nonlinearities exhibit unexpected behavior in free-space and scattering media, including stagnation and anomalous diffraction, and resistance to vibration and distortion, solely depending on the initial control.

articleTitle: Carbon nanotubes in a photonic metamaterial: Giant ultrafast nonlinearity through plasmon-exciton coupling
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that a combination of carbon nanotubes with metamaterial offers a new paradigm for the development of a media with exceptionally strong ultrafast near-infrared nonlinear optical response which can be controlled by metamaterial design.

articleTitle: Nonlinear THz spectroscopy on the dielectric thin films
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Anharmonicity in the soft-mode potential of quantum-paraelectric SrTiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> thin films has been directly observed with strong terahertz wave generated from a LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> single crystal. Hardening of the soft-mode resonance has been detected.

articleTitle: Anomalous temperature dependence of exciton absorption in a mixed-type GaAs quantum well
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Experimental studies of excitons in mixed-type quantum wells reveal surprisingly that in the presence of relatively low densities of trions and two-dimensional electron gases, the exciton absorption can increase significantly with increasing temperature.

articleTitle: A pump-resonant signal-resonant optical parametric oscillator for spectroscopic breath analysis
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on an idler octave-spanning (1.6 - 3.5 μm) cw titanium-sapphire pump-resonant signal-resonant optical parametric oscillator delivering 10 to 50 mW, for multi-species trace gas sensing based on cavity ring down spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Experimental realization of sub-wavelength plasmonic slot waveguides and couplers on Silicon-on-Insulator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Sub-wavelength plasmonic slot waveguides and broadband couplers were monolithically integrated with Si waveguides on SOI. Plasmonic waveguide propagation length of 6λ was achieved along with a 30% coupling efficiency between the Si and plasmonic waveguides.

articleTitle: Resonance fluorescence of single molecules assisted by plasmonic structure
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: When molecules are resonantly excited by enhanced near field of silver nanostrips, through a balance between field enhancement and decay modification, Mollow triplet of fluorescence and antibunching of emission photons are found.

articleTitle: Tunable optical forces and mode beating in coupled nano-mechanical beam waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We analyze the effect of spatial mode beating on optical forces in coupled waveguide resonators. Continuous sign and amplitude change is achieved through optical phase tuning. Competing force components are decomposed via optical mode expansion.

articleTitle: Reduced threshold and high temperature operation in single-mode ring cavity surface emitting quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Reduced threshold currents and high temperature operation in surface emitting quantum cascade lasers are demonstrated by using ring-based cavities. The devices exhibit robust and tunable single-mode operation as well as low divergence symmetric beams.

articleTitle: Optofluidic synthesis of magnetic microparticles with structural colors
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present optofluidic synthesis of magnetic microparticles showing structural color property. We also demonstrate fabrication of complex magnetic microparticles having multiple subdomains with different color patterns.

articleTitle: Efficient on-chip phonon-photon translation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose, analyze, design, and take the first experimental steps towards the demonstration of an on-chip device capable of converting photons to phonons, and vice versa, in a nearly quantum-limited setting.

articleTitle: Multi-color laser oscillation in a waterproof Pr3+-doped fluoro-aluminate glass fiber pumped by GaN laser diode
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We successfully drew a Pr-doped optical fiber of a waterproof fluoro-aluminate glass in an AlF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-YF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-PbF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> system with low loss (0.1 dB/m) and demonstrated multi-color laser oscillation pumped by a 442.6-nm GaN laser diode.

articleTitle: Recovery of polaritonic stop-band in pressed polycrystalline CaF2 powder
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have demonstrated recovery of polaritonic stop-band in pressed polycrystalline CaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> powder. Due to small sizes of CaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> particles, we have observed evidence of severe damping of polaritonic waves at particle surfaces.

articleTitle: Bidirectional CATV/FTTH transport systems based on a RSOA
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A bidirectional down-link CATV/fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) and up-link FTTH transport system is proposed. By employing -1 side-mode injection-locked and optoelectronic feedback techniques in our system, brilliant performances are experimentally observed in both downstream and upstream transmissions.

articleTitle: High-throughput microfluidics and ultrafast optics for in vivo compound/genetic discoveries
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed microfluidic and ultrafast optical technologies that enable high-throughput whole-animal neural regeneration studies. These technologies allow automated and rapid manipulation and non-invasive immobilization of C. elegans for sub-cellular resolution two-photon imaging and femtosecond-laser nanosurgery.

articleTitle: Oxidized Silicon-On-Insulator (OxSOI) from bulk silicon: a new photonic platform
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a bulk silicon alternative to SOI, using Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> masking and oxidation techniques. We show waveguide losses of 2.92 dB/cm with a process compatible with the front-end of a typical CMOS fabrication line.

PACS Terms: (220.4241) Optical design and fabrication: Nanostructure fabrication

articleTitle: Magnetic interaction at optical frequencies in InP-based waveguide device combined with metamaterial
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed a waveguide optical device combined with left-handed materials consisting of minute split-ring resonators. The device can operate as a 1.5-μm-band all-optical switch, making use of magnetic resonance between the resonators and light.

articleTitle: Time gating of high order harmonics for the generation of continuous XUV spectra with multicycle driving pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A continuous XUV spectrum was obtained by high-order harmonic generation driven by a multicycle, 15-fs driving pulse. The gating technique for XUV emission is based on a polarization tailoring of the driving electric field.

articleTitle: Lasing action of a surface emitting organic photonic crystal laser of rectangular lattice fabricated by double nanoimprint lithography process
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A surface emitting organic thin-film band-edge blue laser of photonic crystals (PhCs) with rectangular lattice were fabricated by double nanoimprint lithography process. The dual-wavelength lasing characteristics, including lasing thresholds, polarization and far-field pattern, are presented.

articleTitle: Power scaling of widely-tunable monochromatic THz pulses based on difference-frequency generation in a pair of stacked GaP plates
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By stacking two GaP plates, we have improved the THz peak power from 433 W to 1.36 kW based on difference-frequency generation, corresponding to an enhancement by two orders of magnitude over the previous result.

articleTitle: 0.4 µJ, sub-10-fs pulses from a MHz-NOPA
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a non-collinear optical parametric amplifier (NOPA) delivering sub-10-fs pulses with 420 nJ of pulse energy. The system is driven by pulse trains at 1-MHz repetition rate from an amplified Yb:KYW oscillator with cavity-dumping.

articleTitle: Cryogenically cooled cw-pumped double-pass Ti:sapphire amplifier emitting µJ pulse energies
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A double pass cw-pumped Ti:sapphire amplifier delivering 1.6μJ pulses at 1 MHz is presented. Furthermore a simple analytical model for the amplifier is deduced and concepts for further energy scaling are explored.

articleTitle: Novel technique for mode selection in a large-mode-area fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel method for selectively exciting a single-spatial-mode (fundamental or higher-order) in a high-power multi-mode fiber laser resonator is presented. Preliminary results for a cladding-pumped Tm-doped silica fiber laser are discussed.

articleTitle: Table-top extreme ultraviolet laser aerial imaging of lithographic masks
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first at-wavelength line edge roughness measurements of patterned EUV lithography masks realized using a table-top aerial imaging system based on a table-top λ = 13.2 laser.

articleTitle: Time-lens based synchronizer and retimer for 10 Gb/s Ethernet packets with up to ±1MHz frequency offset
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a time-lens based all-optical 10 Gb/s frame synchronizer and retimer. Our scheme can work with a 4096-bit frame, with frequency offset up to 1MHz, which is demonstrated by experimental results.

articleTitle: Optical black hole: Design and performance
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We discuss the design of a realistic optical black hole (OBH) using the exact frequency domain solutions for TM and TE waves. The design includes thin separating layers between the absorbing core and the metamaterial shell. The overall objective is to develop an on-line simulation tool, which could help to design experimentally realizable OBH with a continuous radius-dependent index. Example structures working at 1.5 μm are presented and analyzed.

articleTitle: Excitation wavelength dependence of time-resolved photoluminescence in deep-UV MQW LEDs on bulk AlN
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photoluminescence lifetimes of nearly dislocation free high Al content AlGaN MQW LEDs on bulk AlN are presented as a function of temperature and excitation power for both direct photo-excitation of the wells and barriers.

articleTitle: Multipoint microfluidic detection using an integrated zone plate array
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using a microfabricated zone plate array, we demonstrate detection of fluorescent beads at 12 locations along a serpentine microfluidic channel. Cross-correlations of the signals along the channel enable velocity dispersion measurements.

articleTitle: Non-equilibrium LO and TO phonon generation by electron transport in terahertz quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the experimental observation of non-equilibrium longitudinal and transverse optical phonons populations associated with electron transport in resonant-phonon THz quantum-cascade lasers and compare the results with the outcome of Monte Carlo simulations.

articleTitle: Airy plasmon: a non-diffracting surface wave
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a new class of non-diffracting surface plasmons: the Airy plasmon. The self bending and self healing behavior of these solutions is analyzed. Schemes for experimental realization and potential applications are discussed.

articleTitle: Scaling of high harmonic generation efficiencies with 400-nm and 800-nm driver pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Scaling of high order harmonic generation (HHG) efficiency with drive-wavelengths is investigated using 800-nm and 400-nm pulses. We demonstrate good agreement with a recently established model for HHG taking laser and material parameters into account.

articleTitle: High-brightness from unstable resonator mid-IR semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe high-brightness, broad area midinfrared semiconductor lasers. The laser structures incorporated 14 type-II quantum wells imbedded in thick waveguide/absorber regions composed of InGaAsSb. The optically pumped devices achieved higher brightness operation as unstable facets. For a 4 mm UR operating at λ = 4.7μm and at 35 × threshold the device was observed to be diffraction limited. In comparison a standard Fabry-Perot laser was many times diffraction limited.

articleTitle: High throughput photoporation of mammalian cells using Microfluidic Cell Delivery
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photoporation (optical injection) of mammalian cells using a tightly focused femtosecond laser beam is demonstrated within a microfluidic chip, providing delivery of cells to the beam and thus automating the system for high cell throughput.

articleTitle: Isolated sub-50-as pulse generation by direct optimization of two-color laser fields using the genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By optimizing two-color laser fields using genetic algorithm where the duration of the generated high-harmonic pulse is directly taken as a target function, we show that an isolated 40 attosecond pulse is created.

articleTitle: 1.16 µs continuously tunable optical delay of a 100-Gb/s DQPSK signal using wavelength conversion and chromatic dispersion in an HNLF
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a tunable optical delay element using wavelength conversion in a highly nonlinear fiber, dispersion compensating fiber, and optical phase conjugation. A continuous delay of up to 1.16-μs equaling >55,000 symbols at 50 Gb/s, for 100 Gb/s NRZ-DQPSK and 50 Gb/s NRZ-DPSK modulation formats, is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Formation, sprinkling, trapping and annihilation of pulses in passively mode-locked fiber lasers with modulated noise
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Injection of modulated noise into mode-locked fiber lasers provides rich pulses formation and sprinkling effects with trapping and annihilation centers in the cavity. The lightning experiment demonstration is accompanied by statistical light-mode dynamics analysis.

articleTitle: Study of polarization properties of light emitted from tensile strained InGaN/AlInN quantum well
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This paper discusses the optical polarization anisotropic of a c-plane InGaN/AlInN quantum well under the tensile strain. The calculation results indicate that with particular In composition of AlInN alloy for the tensile strain, it is possible to reduce the quantum-confined Stark effect and make an out-planed polarized light source for edge emitting laser diodes or light emitting diodes.

articleTitle: Supermode noise spur suppression and frequency comb generation in a 100 MHz semiconductor-based Theta cavity laser using an intra-cavity Fabry-Perot etalon
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A Fabry-Perot etalon is inserted into a semiconductor-based laser cavity operating at the chirped pulse amplification regime. The laser output exhibits supermode noise spur suppression and a semiconductor-based optical frequency comb is generated.

articleTitle: Chalcogenide microporous fibers for nonlinear applications in mid-infrared
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A new type of microstructured fiber for mid-IR is introduced. The chalcogenide microporous fiber allows extensive dispersion engineering that enables red-shifting the zero-dispersion point in the vicinity of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser lines and ultra-flat dispersion windows.

articleTitle: Lensfree polarization microscopy on a chip using incoherent digital holography
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an on-chip polarization microscope based on incoherent lensfree holography. Placed between two polarizers, a birefringent sample creates in-line holograms that can be digitally reconstructed to create lensfree polarization images over a large field-of-view.

articleTitle: Extreme light infrastructure (ELI): Physics and lasers at the ultra-intense frontier
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: ELI has been put on the European Roadmap for Research infrastructures by the European Strategy Forum on Research Infrastructures (ESFRI). It will be the first Paneuropean Infrastructure utilizing an ultra-intense laser with a peak-power of 200 PW for interaction experiments with electric field strength well above the PV/m (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup> V/m ). With the high focused intensity (above 4 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">24</sup>W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) it will be possible to enter the ultra-relativistic regime when protons are accelerated to nearly the speed of light at a distance in the order of the wavelength of the driving extreme light. Fundamental physics phenomena can be investigated for the first time including nonlinear vacuum interaction and pair generation. ELI intermediate beam lines with peak-powers in the few PW range but higher repetition rates (10 Hz) will enable scientific and societal including medical applications based on laser particle acceleration (proton therapy) and x-ray generation. The photonuclear facility will explore nuclei with hard x-ray and gamma-ray photons produced by high intensity interaction with matter. The Attosecond science laser driver with its high repetition rate (1 kHz) and high average power (>1 kW, 5-10fs) opens the way to ultrafast investigations in different scientific and technological areas with time resolutions in the Attosecond and may by even faster (zeptosecond) time domains using very brilliant VUV-light and x-rays generated by harmonics from gases or solids.

articleTitle: Spatial spectral interferometer for frequency resolved angle of arrival estimation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Spatial-spectral materials are utilized to record the phase and power spectra of microwave signals. Spectral phase mapping via readout of a fiber interferometer enables precise frequency resolved time delay and angle of arrival estimation.

PACS Terms: (070.1170) Fourier optics and signal processing; Analog optical signal processing

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of the longitudinal offset technique for the apodization of coupled resonator optical waveguide devices
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this paper, an experimental demonstration of the apodization of coupled resonator optical waveguide (CROW) devices through the longitudinal offset technique is presented for a 3 racetracks CROW device and compared against the uniform case.

articleTitle: Low loss amorphous silicon microstructured optical fiber with large mode area behavior
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A low loss silicon microstructured optical fiber that is dual moded and exhibits large mode area guidance properties is presented. The fiber was fabricated using a high pressure chemical fluid deposition technique to deposit low loss amorphous silicon into the holes of a pure silica hollow core photonic bandgap fiber. The resulting fiber has a core diameter of 9 μm but a small core-cladding index contrast that significantly suppresses the number of supported modes.

articleTitle: Experimental and theoretical demonstration of wavelength conversion of 10 Gb/s RZ-OOK in a Si nanowire via XPM
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present all-optical wavelength conversion (WC) of 10 Gb/s RZ-OOK data in a Si nanowire waveguide via cross-phase-modulation (XPM). The WC mechanism is analytically modeled and shown to be scalable to 40 Gb/s RZ-OOK data.

articleTitle: Image transmission through self-defocusing photonic lattices
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that self-defocusing photonic lattices support various shapes of soliton states (such as Y-shape and H-shape) which remain robust during propagation. Based on this finding, we propose to transmit images through these self-defocusing photonic lattices.

articleTitle: Non-lithographic patterning and metal-assisted chemical etching for manufacturing of tunable light-emitting silicon nanowire arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a top-down fabrication method that involves the combination of superionic-solid-state-stamping (S4) patterning with metal-assisted-chemical-etching (MacEtch), to produce silicon nanowire arrays with defined geometry and optical properties in a manufacturable fashion.

articleTitle: All fiber high energy, high power picosecond laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on 83W, 14μJ, 5.9MHz, 30ps MOPA fiber laser based on an Yb modelocked fiber oscillator and a rod-type LMA amplifier. By frequency tripling, this configuration can generate up to 20W of UV.

articleTitle: Room-temperature operation of λ≈3.7µm Ga0.47In0.53As/ Al0.48In0.52As quantum cascade laser sources
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report room-temperature operation of λ≈3.7μm lattice-matched InGaAs/AlInAs/InP quantum cascade lasers based on frequency doubling with ~2mW/W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> conversion efficiencies. Similar devices based on 1% strain-compensated materials can operate at λ=3-3.7μm.

articleTitle: Over 500 mW laser-diode pumped green laser using optical contact Nd∶YVO4/periodically poled MgO∶LiNbO3 crystal
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
