abstract: 504 mW continuous-wave green laser was achieved for the first time via an optical contact Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>/periodically poled MgO:LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> (Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>/PPMgLN) crystal with electrical-to-optical efficiency of 9.3%. It is designed for high bright laser display.

articleTitle: Modulation-bandwidth enhancement by stimulated Raman scattering in quantum dash lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The bandwidth of quantum-dash lasers under optical injection modulation is sharply enhanced when the injection photons are ~33 meV more energetic than the laser emission. This new bandwidth-enhancement mechanism is attributable to stimulated Raman scattering.

articleTitle: Intensity invariance of strong-field two-photon absorption
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally and theoretically the intensity-invariant scaling formula of coherent control of two-photon absorption as a function of pulse-shape parameters of ultrafast laser field in the strong-interaction regime.

articleTitle: Slow-light enhanced self-phase modulation, three-photon absorption and free-carriers in photonic crystals: experiment and theory
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate experimental results and analytical formulation of slow-light-enhanced self-phase modulation limited only by three-photon absorption. We present nonlinear figure-of-merits on three-photon-limited ultrafast switching, and critical intensities for free-carrier effects in photonic crystals.

articleTitle: Time-domain demonstrations of slow-light in multi-coupled photonic crystal cavities
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate tunable temporal delays in coherently-coupled multi-cavity photonic crystals, in analogue to EIT. We report deterministic control of the group delay, up to 7' the single cavity lifetime, in our CMOS-fabricated chip.

articleTitle: Electrically controlling beam pattern of THz quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An electrically controlled beam pattern technique for semi-insulating surface plasmon terahertz quantum cascade is presented. The near field and far field measurements confirm that the lasing THz beam is maneuvered by 25° in emission angle, when the current density changes from 1.9 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to 2.3 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Characterization of CsLiB6O10 crystals grown in dry atmosphere
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We attempted the growth of CsLiB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub> in dry atmosphere. Devices fabricated from dry-grown crystal had demonstrated 1 week of continuous operation without shifting the crystal at the output power of 100 mW at 199 nm.

articleTitle: Octave spanning 50∶50 beam splitting via interrupted STIRAP
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on octave spanning 50:50 beam splitting via an interrupted stimulated Raman adiabatic passage in femtosecond laser written waveguides. The device is spatially and spectrally characterized by utilizing color center fluorescence at several excitation wavelengths.

articleTitle: Photonic band-gap evolution from polycrystalline to amorphous photonic structures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We map out a transition from polycrystalline to amorphous photonic structures with decreasing short-range order. The photonic band gap decreases once the individual domains of ordered structure become too small for the gap formation.

articleTitle: Monolayer graphene saturable absorber for bulk laser mode-locking
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Monolayer graphene was synthesized and used to develop novel saturable absorbers for bulk solid-state laser mode-locking. The graphene mode-locked Cr:forsterite laser delivers stable 130-fs pulses at 1.25 μ with output powers up to 230 mW.

articleTitle: Second harmonic generation from AlGaAs high contrast gratings
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Strong second harmonic generation (SHG) is obtained from AlGaAs-based high contrast gratings for the first time. We show that SHG depends on the grating design and its orientation relative to the crystal axes.

articleTitle: Quantum Cascade laser for elastic-backscattering LIDAR measurement
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an experimental demonstration for an elastic-backscattering LIDAR system measurement using a Quantum Cascade laser (QCL). The laser emits a peak power of above 13W at 80K and with a wavelength of 4.5μm.

articleTitle: Modelocked integrated external-cavity surface emitting laser (MIXSEL) with output power up to 660 mW and repetition rate up to 10 GHz
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an advanced MIXSEL, a VECSEL with integrated saturable absorber. Improved thermal management by substrate removal substantially increased the power. The novel antiresonant design is growth-error tolerant, enables shorter pulses and higher repetition rates.

articleTitle: Measuring and exploiting the transmission matrix in optics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a method to measure the transmission matrix of a complex medium. This matrix exhibits statistical properties in good agreement with random matrix theory and allows light focusing and imaging through the random medium.

articleTitle: Ultrafast, element-specific, demagnetization dynamics probed using coherent high harmonic beams
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High harmonics from a tabletop laser are used to probe ultrafast demagnetization of a compound material (Permalloy) with elemental selectivity. We achieve the highest time resolution, element-specific, measurements to date at 50fs.

articleTitle: Zero-dispersion slow light in hollow waveguide with high-contrast grating
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Zero-dispersion slow light can be seen in a hollow waveguide using high-contrast grating in wide spectral range. A zero-dispersion group index of 7 can be obtained with propagation loss of below 1dB/mm and 15nm-optical bandwidth.

articleTitle: Photon blockade in circuit quantum electrodynamics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photon-photon interactions mediated by a qubit are realized in a microwave resonator and result in the blockaded transmission of photons. Transmission measurements versus source bandwidth reveal a photon staircase, a signature of a photon blockade.

articleTitle: Investigation of efficiency droop in blue InGaN/GaN light-emitting diodes with different well widths
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Temperature-dependent electroluminescence efficiency of blue light-emitting diodes with different well widths is investigated. The efficiency droop phenomenon for LEDs at low temperature is dependent with electron overflow and non-uniform hole distribution within MQW region.

articleTitle: Label-free detection in a lab-on-a-chip with a three- dimensional Mach-Zehnder Interferometer
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A Mach-Zehnder refractive index sensor is inscribed in a microfluidic lab-on-a-chip by exploiting the unique three-dimensional capabilities of femtosecond laser fabrication. This enables high sensitivity and spatially resolved label-free detection of biomolecules.

articleTitle: Generation of high energy sub 50 fs, vacuum UV pulses by noncollinear FWM in argon
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using noncollinear difference-frequency four-wave-mixing between the fundamental and third-harmonic of an amplified Ti:sapphire laser in argon, sub-50-fs VUV pulses with more than 2.5-μJ at 160-nm are generated.

articleTitle: Optical linear bullets with hydrogen-like symmetries
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a new class of propagation invariant spatiotemporal wavepackets. The evolution of these light orbitals is here considered theoretically. Archimedean photonic lattices can be generated through the concept of spherical superposition of optical wavefronts.

articleTitle: Fano resonances in high-Tc superconducting metamaterial
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a millimeter-wave range metamaterial fabricated from cuprate superconductor. Two complementary metamaterial structures have been studied, which exhibit Fano resonances emerging from the collective excitation of interacting magnetic and electric dipole modes.

articleTitle: Suppression of free carrier absorption in multi-slot silicon light emission devices
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Free carrier absorption is the major obstacle towards achieving optical gain in Er-doped nc-Si. We experimentally demonstrated the suppression of free carrier absorption by multi-slot waveguide. The experimental results agree well with our theoretical calculations.

articleTitle: Mode control of 1.3 ∞m wavelength coupled VCSEL arrays by cavity structuring
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Mode control in wafer-fused 1.3μm wavelength coupled-VCSEL arrays is achieved by cavity structuring and investigated by spectrally resolved near- and far-field measurements. Improved mode discrimination is attained by combining index- and gain-patterning.

articleTitle: Implementation of a non-deterministic optical noiseless amplifier
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Quantum Physics imposes that any phase independent amplification introduces excess noise. Nevertheless this limitation could be ignored with conditioning. We report fully characterization with homodyne tomography of a non-deterministic noiseless amplification of a coherent state.

articleTitle: Cladding modes analysis of photonics crystal fiber for refractive index sensors using Finite Element method
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed a Finite Element package to analyze cladding mode field extensions into the air-holes of photonics crystal fiber for refractive index sensing. Our analysis could determine the most sensitive cladding mode for liquid sensing.

articleTitle: Aerogel package for fused fibre couplers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Fused fibre couplers were encapsulated in hydrophobic aerogel. This provides an epoxy-free all-silica package that is low-loss, waterproof, supports the whole coupler waist and is stable up to 250°C.

articleTitle: Coherent fiber combining by digital holography
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present and demonstrate a technique for coherent beam combining of fibre amplifiers using phase conjugation by digital holography. The method is also applied to realize beam correction on multimode and multicore fibers.

articleTitle: Absorption enhancement and light trapping regimes in thin-film silicon solar cells with a photonic pattern
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By patterning thin-film silicon solar cells with a periodic etching in addition to an antireflection coating, we increase the short-circuit current up to 36.5%. The pattern and the coating are investigated to recognise different coupling regimes.

articleTitle: Spectral amplitude and phase measurement of ultrafast pulses using all-optical differential tomography
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an all-optical method for characterizing ultrafast pulses by differential tomography, using four-wave mixing. The technique is used to measure dispersion for various lengths of silica fiber.

articleTitle: Förster energy transfer to a spirooxazine photochromic molecule through one- and two-photon absorption
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Förster resonance energy transfer from a two-photon absorber to a photochromic spirooxazine are investigated by one- and two-photon absorption. Upon energy transfer, fluorescence of the donor is quenched while that of the photochromic is enhanced.

articleTitle: Anisotropy of hot electron effective mass in n-doped InGaAs revealed by nonlinear THz-pump/THz-probe spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study ultrafast hot electron transport in n-doped InGaAs using polarization-sensitive nonlinear THz-pump/THz-probe spectroscopy. We observe an anisotropic effective mass for hot electrons due to the nonparabolicity of the conduction band.

articleTitle: Near-band-edge resonant excitation of coherent phonons in carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In contrast to the previously-studied coherent phonons excited through high-energy (E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">22</sub>) transitions, the redial breathing modes show comparable intensities between v = +1 and -1 nanotubes.

articleTitle: Spectral dependence of spatially-incoherent modulation instability
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first experimental study of spatially-incoherent modulation instability for different spectral distributions. Characteristic behavior depends sensitively on the underlying profiles. The setup and results introduce a new experimental degree-of-freedom into nonlinear statistical optics.

articleTitle: An integrated single cell optofluidic platform based on phototransistor optoelectronic tweezers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a novel single cell manipulation platform based on phototransistor optoelectronic tweezers. This new platform integrates the functionalities of phOET for parallel cell manipulation in highly conductive culture media with a commercial microfluidic device.

articleTitle: Applications in precision machining - factors in ns/ps choice
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: As the need for precision machining has grown, especially, to enable advances in smaller, faster, lower power consumption micro-electronics products, so have the capabilities in industrial lasers capable of high precision machining. One of the most important application decisions is related to the choice of ns regime or ps regime lasers. The appeal for higher precision, lower HAZ (heat affected zone) as well as layer selectivity offers new capability. We will cover key aspects of ns vs. ps choice and examples of good fit for each in key micro-electronics applications.

articleTitle: Sparse terahertz arrays with adaptive image reconstruction
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate sparse THz array imaging with an adaptive reconstruction technique. Image artifacts are reduced by over 20 dB with a 56 × 56 element array spanning a 76 × 76 mm aperture.

articleTitle: Transparent high-data-rate optical transmission through broadband hitless bypass switches for chip-scale optical networks
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate 10-Gb/s optical data channels through broadband hitless switches, with open eye-diagrams and error-free operation (BERs less than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup>). Both through- and drop-ports are measured in the hitless operation for transparent chip-scale optical networks.

articleTitle: Label-free optofluidic biosensing in microplate, microfluidic, and spot-based affinity capture assays
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photonic crystal reflectance filters are co-fabricated/integrated with microfluidic channels on plastic substrates. Using the kinetic reaction rate constants measured, sensitivity limits and kinetic signal acquisition for label-free biosensing within various assay formats are studied.

articleTitle: System design guidelines when utilizing chirp-inducing wavelength converters in a fiber transmission system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We simulate an arbitrary chirp waveform generator to explore the fiber transmission performance of the output of chirp-inducing devices. Various chirp regimes are considered to find the optimum chirp profile for a post-compensated fiber link. If a chirp profile has a peak on the signal edges, ±5 ps/nm residual dispersion on a 40 Gb/s RZ signal results in ~2 dB higher power penalty compared to a chirp peak located at the center of the pulse. With higher launch power, a single chirp peak on leading or trailing edge achieves ~2 dB lower minimum power penalty (at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> BER) compared to the profile with a chirp peak at pulse center.

articleTitle: A compact, moveable, microchip-based system for high repetition rate production of Bose-Einstein condensates
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a compact, moveable system for producing Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs) on an integrated microchip. The system occupies 0.4 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> and operates as fast as 0.3 Hz. Condensates of 1.9 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> atoms in <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb have been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Green light emitting diodes with high internal quantum efficiency InGaN/GaN self-organized quantum dots grown by RF-Plasma Assisted Molecular Beam Epitaxy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Self-Organized green InGaN/GaN quantum dots with high internal quantum efficiency have been grown by RF-Plasma Assisted Molecular Beam Epitaxy. Green light emitting diodes based on these dots were fabricated and electroluminescence spectra were measured.

articleTitle: Strong optomechanical coupling in slot-type photonic crystal cavities: theory
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated a strong optomechanical coupling in a high-quality factor (Q) air-slot mode-gap photonic crystal cavity with ultrasmall mode volume, with a coupling length L~2.9μm. Optomechanical coupling lengths with different slot gaps and lengths were also compared.

articleTitle: Photonic topological crystals: transport, curvature, and geometric potential
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the first experimental realization of topological crystals, solely formed by a geometric potential of an undulated slab waveguide. Transport mechanisms like Bloch oscillations and Zener tunneling are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Synchronized dual-frequency pulses from Q-switched compact Nd∶YLF laser cavities
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Based on a novel configuration of a dual-frequency laser system constructed from a Nd:YLF crystal, we have synchronized Q-switched laser pulses at 1047 nm and 1053 nm.

articleTitle: Ultra-low noise microwave generation using femtosecond lasers and applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on our fiber-based mode-locked laser approach to the generation of ultra-low noise microwave signals, and its use for frequency metrology. We make use of two erbium fiber mode-locked lasers phase locked to a common ultra stable laser source to generate an 11.55 GHz signal with a relative phase noise of −111 dBc/Hz at 1 Hz from the carrier. The corresponding residual frequency instability is below 2.3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−16</sup> at 1s and about 4×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−19</sup> at 6.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> s [1]. For a single fiber system, we demonstrate absolute stability about 3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−15</sup> between 1 s and 10 s when locked to an ultra-stable optical cavity and after dissemination over amplitude-modulation fiber link for a few hundred meters. The microwave signal from the fiber system is subsequently used to perform Ramsey spectroscopy in a state-of-the-art Cesium fountain [2]. The resulting clock system exhibits a stability of 3.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−14</sup> τ- limited by projection noise. These experiments demonstrate the potentiality of ultra-high-performance, robust and long term operations fiber-based frequency combs for operational-level tasks in time and frequency metrology using microwave signals.

articleTitle: Multi-octave-spanning laser harmonics for ultrafast waveform synthesis
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The second to the fifth harmonics of a fundamental frequency are generated in a lithium tantalate crystal by cascaded quasi-phase-matched frequency mixing. These harmonics can be used to synthesize a train of periodic sub-femtosecond pulses.

articleTitle: A film-type saturable absorber with p3ht-incorporated single-wall carbon nanotubes coated on polyamide and its application to a femtosecond fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a film-type SWNT/P3HT (poly-3-hexylthiophene) saturable absorber coated on polyamide, in which the saturable absorption effect can be controlled with the number of films. A 113-fs, 42-MHz pulse was successfully generated with two films.

articleTitle: Narrow-linewidth, single-mode, partial reflector external cavity quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A simple external-cavity quantum cascade laser utilizing optical feedback from a partial reflector is reported. Using a ~9.6μm QCL and off-the-shelf optics we demonstrate single-mode continuous tuning of 2.46cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> with ~40mW power and ~2.5MHz linewidth.

articleTitle: Plasmonic interference and coherence in metallic nanostructures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A general discussion of radiative interference processes in plasmonic nanostructures is presented. It will be shown that the interference between subradiant and superradiant plasmon modes can induce pronounced Fano resonances it the optical spectra.

articleTitle: Compact femtosecond laser system with 2 mJ output
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 2-mJ, 600-fs, 1047-nm pulses at a 250-Hz rate from a compact, Yb -doped crystal CPA laser system were achieved. We combine a positive-dispersion-regime oscillator, regenerative amplifier and a hybrid stretcher/compressor based on chirped volume Bragg gratings.

articleTitle: Characterization of pump-induced refractive index changes observed in Nd3+ and Yb3+ doped laser materials
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The refractive index changes which can be induced in pumped Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> and Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> doped laser materials have been measured using two pump-probe techniques. Transient signal analysis allows to discriminate electronic and thermal contributions.

articleTitle: CMOS-compatible temperature insensitive silicon microring resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a new class of resonant silicon optical devices which are passively temperature compensated based on tailoring optical mode confinement in waveguides. We demonstrate their operation over a wide temperature range of 80 degrees.

articleTitle: Metamaterial based broadband engineering of quantum dot spontaneous emission
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the broadband (~ 25 nm) enhancement of radiative decay rate of colloidal quantum dots by exploiting the hyperbolic dispersion of a one-dimensional nonmagnetic metamaterial structure.

articleTitle: Numerical evidence of exalted nonreciprocal dichroic propagation in a waveguide-coupled magnetoplasmonic chain of ferromagnetic metal stripes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Patterning the metal layer of a ferromagnetic metal-clad III-V waveguide into a chain of coupled magnetoplasmonic nanostripes enhances optical non-reciprocity by two orders. Simulations show how non-reciprocal magnetoplasmonic chain modes couple resonantly to the waveguide.

articleTitle: Formation of coherent longitudinal optical phonon and plasmon coupling modes in semiconductors
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We directly observe the formation of coherent longitudinal optical phonon and plasmon coupling modes in GaAs (100) with time-resolved second-harmonic generation. Quantum interference between coherent LO phonon and photoexcited plasma continuum can be identified near zero delay time. The asymmetric spectral line shape resolved in time-frequency domain is ascribed to the effect of Fano resonance.

articleTitle: Optical models of the big bang and non-trivial space-time metrics based on metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optics of metamaterials is shown to provide table top models of non-trivial space-time metrics, such as the “two times physics” in (2+2) dimensions. An optical analogue of the Big Bang-like event is presented during which a (2+1) Minkowski space-time is created together with large number of particles populating this space-time.

articleTitle: Broadband regenerative amplification in the millijoule regime for sub-100fs based on Yb∶CaF2
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a diode-pumped regenerative amplifier based on Yb:CaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, delivering 1.8mJ pulses at 100 Hz with a spectral bandwidth of 16 nm, able to produce sub-100 fs pulse duration.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal analysis of ultrashort pulses by statistical signatures of frequency converted needle beams
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A technique for temporally diagnosing extremely short pulses based on key statistical signatures of shape functions of nondiffracting needle beams after nonlinear conversion is proposed theoretically. With arrays of separated subbeams, spatial resolution is achievable.

articleTitle: Open-path high sensitivity atmospheric ammonia sensing with a 9 µm quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We develop a ground-based, non-cryogenic, open-path quantum cascade laser ammonia sensor operating at 9.06μm for high sensitivity atmospheric measurements. A cylindrical mirror multi-pass optical cell and wavelength modulation spectroscopy allow for pptv detection limits.

articleTitle: Data traffic grooming/exchange of a single 10-Gbit/s TDM tributary channel between two pol-muxed 80-Gbit/s DPSK channels
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report tributary channel data traffic grooming/exchange of pol-muxed DPSK signal based on Kerr-induced nonlinear polarization rotation. 8 tributary channel data grooming between two pol-muxed 80-Gbit/s DPSK channels is demonstrated with a penalty of <;4 dB.

articleTitle: Nonlinear recovery of diffused images by seeded instability
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We develop a method to filter and amplify diffused images by using spatial nonlinearity to seed instability. We observe the increase of image contrast and enhancement of signal resolution in noisy environments.

articleTitle: Circularly-polarized light emission from semiconductor planar chiral photonic crystals
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Circular anisotropy of vacuum filed modes is induced in on-waveguide semiconductor chiral photonic crystals. Quantum dots embedded in the waveguide layer emit circularly polarized light with 25% of circular degree of polarization.

articleTitle: Impact of high-order surface plasmon modes of metal nanoparticles on emission enhancement
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We consider the impact of high-order surface plasmon modes supported by the metal nanoparticles on the efficiency enhancement of optical emission. We show that for a given emitter with certain original radiative efficiency, placing the emitter too close to the metal sphere does not always produce additional enhancement. Thus our model provides analytical treatment of the luminescence quenching and can be used to optimize both nanoparticle size and its separation from the emitter to yield maximum enhancement factor.

articleTitle: Raman amplification at 800 nm in single-mode fiber for biological sensing and imaging
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first experimental demonstration of Raman amplification in a fiber at wavelengths near 800 nm and propose its application to fast real-time optical sensing and imaging in this technologically important band.

articleTitle: Fabrication of gold-platinum nanoparticles by intense, femtosecond laser irradiation of aqueous solution
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Gold-platinum alloy nanoparticles were fabricated by high-intensity femtosecond laser irradiation of mixed aqueous solutions of auric and platinum ions with different mixing ratios.

articleTitle: A trace gas sensor at ppb sensitivity based on multiple line integration spectroscopy techniques
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that employing integrated absorption of multiple lines or summation of the absolute values of the wavelength modulation spectroscopy signals, sensitivities of ppb can be achieved for the detection of trace gases.

articleTitle: Excitation of gap plasmonic waveguides by nano antennas
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the excitation of plasmonic gap waveguides by nano antennas. The excitation is shown to be both spatially and spectrally dependent which can potentially be used for the selective excitation of plasmonic nanostructures.

articleTitle: Enhanced resolution in nonlinear microscopy using the LP02 mode of an optical fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: It is demonstrated that the lateral resolution of a non-linear scanning multi-photon microscope can be improved significantly by using the light from an LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">02</sub> mode instead of a Gaussian-like beam.

articleTitle: Wavefront control by digital holography in an Yb-doped multi-core fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate wavefront control of an Yb-doped multi-core fiber amplifier using phase conjugation by digital holography. A gain of 23 dB is demonstrated with a pulsed laser at 1064 nm.

articleTitle: Carrier envelope offset stabilization of an optical parametric oscillator without f-2f self-referencing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Signal pulses from a femtosecond optical parametric oscillator were carrier-envelope-offset stabilized for ~10 minutes with a bandwidth of <;2 kHz and a cumulative phase error over 1 second of 2.05 radians, without f-2f self-referencing.

articleTitle: 170 Gbit/s transmission in Al2O3:Er3+ integrated amplifiers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Transmission of a 170 Gbit/s signal at 1550 nm was demonstrated in an integrated erbium-doped waveguide amplifier. Open eye diagrams and no power penalty were observed with the amplifier in the transmission system.

articleTitle: Optical measurement of nanomechanical motion with an imprecision at the standard quantum limit
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ultra-high Q optical microresonators allow measuring nanomechanical motion with unprecedented sensitivity. For the first time, we reach a measurement imprecision at the standard quantum limit which has been a long sought-after goal for nanomechanical oscillators.

articleTitle: Multi-photon excited UV luminescence of ZnO nanorods after irradiation with few-nJ femtosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Highly efficient two-photon-absorption induced defect-level-emission-free UV luminescence of ZnO nanorods grown by vapor phase transport was demonstrated with sub-20 fs, few-nJ pulses extracted from a Ti:sapphire laser oscillator. Potential applications in phototherapy are discussed.

articleTitle: Reduction of the efficiency droop effect of a light-emitting diode through surface plasmon coupling
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The efficiency droop effect of a light-emitting diode is significantly reduced through the coherent coupling of its emitting quantum wells with the surface plasmons generated on the fabricated Ag structure on the device top surface.

articleTitle: Anisotropic terahertz conductivity of one-dimensional electrons in single-walled carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Terahertz time-domain spectroscopy of a highly-aligned single-walled carbon nanotube film reveals strongly anisotropic responses. The deduced complex dynamic conductivity clearly showed a non-Drude-like frequency dependence, with the real part showing a peak at ~ 4 THz.

PACS Terms: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Sextuple frequency millimeter signal generation for radio-over-fiber (RoF) using dual drive mach-zehnder modulator (DDMZM) and SOA
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A sextuple frequency millimeter wave signal generation for RoF using a DDMZM and an SOA has been proposed and demonstrated via simulation. A study on the effect of SOA parameters on RoF is presented.

articleTitle: Broadband gain from “continuum-to-bound” Quantum Cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A Quantum Cascade laser design based on “continuum-to-bound” transitions with several strongly coupled upper laser states is demonstrated, which enables external cavity tuning over 190 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> in pulsed mode operation at 0°C.

articleTitle: Nanostructuring: A route for understanding interaction phenomena and enhancing materials performance
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Engineering materials in the nanoscale is an attractive route to either improve properties or achieve new responses. Examples will be given for promoting/preventing transfer energy mechanisms or enhancing optical responses or rare-earth ion related photoluminescence.

articleTitle: Cyanine dyes with exceptional third-order nonlinear optical figures-of-merit for all-optical switching
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A molecular design strategy that involves favorable control of one- and two-photon absorption resonances to produce exceptional nonlinear optical figures-of-merit for all-optical switching has been realized in a series of cyanines dyes.

articleTitle: High-speed and low driving voltage LiNbO3 optical switch composed of new structure
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Authors realized the optical switch satisfying high-speed response (<;10 nsec), polarization independent operation and low driving voltage of 3 volt by constructing a new structure on LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> substrate for the first time in the world.

articleTitle: Time-lens for sub-picosecond optical pulse measurement on a chip
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate temporal imaging of optical signals with sub-picosecond time features based on four wave mixing temporal-to-frequency domain conversion in a CMOS compatible, high index glass waveguide.

articleTitle: Sensitive detection of heavy metals in water using microchip Laser Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A diode pumped Cr,Nd:YAG microchip laser with 4 μJ pulse energy and multi-kilohertz repetition rate is demonstrated suitable for high sensitivity Laser-Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy detection of trace heavy metals in water using an electroplating sampling technique.

articleTitle: Broadband terahertz wave remote sensing using coherent manipulation of fluorescence from asymmetrically ionized gases
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an “all-opticall” technique of broadband terahertz wave remote sensing by coherently manipulation of fluorescence from asymmetrically ionized gases. Coherent THz wave detection at a distance of 10 meters has been demonstrated.

PACS Terms: (040.2235) Far infrared or terahertz (300.2530) Fluorescence, laser-induced

articleTitle: Spatial resolution enhancement by external phase modulation in long-length FBG sensing system based on synthesis of optical coherence function
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: External phase modulation is newly combined with the synthesis of optical coherence function for improvement of spatial resolution in distributed sensing system using a long-length fiber Bragg grating. The spatial resolution is improved from previously-reported 9.8 mm to 4.0 mm.

articleTitle: Long-term repetition-frequency stabilization of all-normal-dispersion Yb-doped fiber laser to the cesium standard
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Repetition-frequency stabilization of a Yb-doped fiber laser to the Cesium standard is reported. Laser amplitude and phase noise is characterized. Performance is limited to 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-14</sup> at 100000 averaging time by intrinsic stability of the Cs-standard.

articleTitle: Diffraction based biosensing with porous silicon
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a highly sensitive porous silicon diffraction grating for biosensing applications. The gratings are fabricated using a cost-effective, high-throughput stamping technique. Small molecule detection is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Simplified hollow-core photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A simplified design inspired from kagome-lattice fiber reduced to one layer of air-holes was proposed demonstrating the anti-resonant core guiding capability. Two large low-loss windows were measured (minimum attenuation <;0.2 dB/m) with acceptable infrared bend losses.

articleTitle: Sensitive and simple frequency comb Fourier transform spectrometer with a multipass cell
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Multipass cells offer a simple manner to enhance the sensitivity of dual-comb Fourier transform spectrometer. 1.5 μm spectra spanning 125 nm and exhibiting a noise-equivalent absorption coefficient of 4·10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-½</sup> are recorded within 63 μs.

articleTitle: Achromatic circular polarization generation for ultra-intense lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Generating circular polarization for ultra-intense lasers requires solutions beyond traditional transmissive waveplates which have insufficient bandwidth and pose nonlinear phase (B-integral) problems. We demonstrate a reflective design employing 3 metallic mirrors to generate circular polarization.

articleTitle: Timing and Carrier-Envelope phase properties of optical parametric generation driven by femtosecond pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate, both numerically and experimentally, the optical parametric generation (OPG) process driven by femtosecond pulses in second-order nonlinear crystals. We discuss on the absolute phase and time fluctuations of the OPG beam.

articleTitle: Development of a quantum cascade laser-based sensor for non-invasive CO2 monitoring
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel device is proposed for the non-invasive measurement of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> utilizing reflectance of the skin surface by a mid-infrared quantum cascade laser. We demonstrate CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> detection in a polymer at levels of biological importance.

articleTitle: Titania-clad microresonators on SOI with athermal performance
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose the use of titanium dioxide as cladding material to reduce the temperature sensitivity of silicon-based microresonators. The advantages of using titanium dioxide over the conventional alternatives are discussed, and experimental results are presented.

articleTitle: Optimized pulsed orange generation in a diode-pumped Nd∶YVO4 laser using monolithically cascaded PPLN electro-optic Q-switches
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on an efficient intracavity sum-frequency generator in a dual-wavelength Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser optimized with monolithically cascaded PPLN electro-optic Q-switches. >480-W peak-power orange 593-nm light was obtained with this system at 4.8-W diode pump power.

articleTitle: Richtmyer-Meshkov instability in nonlinear optics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an all-optical Richtmyer-Meshkov instability, in which a shock wave is incident on an intensity interface. Intensity fingering and shear-generated vortices are observed for both 1D and 2D shock-wave impulses.

articleTitle: Mode-locking build-up measurements: probing the mode-locking-mechanisms in vertical-external-cavity surface-emitting lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The pulse evolution from onset to steady state in a mode-locked vertical-external-cavity surface-emitting laser producing femtosecond and picosecond pulses was studied. A 40-times reduction in pulse shortening rate from picosecond to femtosecond regime was observed.

articleTitle: High harmonic transient grating spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a unique pump-probe scheme for high harmonic spectroscopy, which is sensitive to weak excitations and provides spectral information without the need for a VUV spectrometer.

articleTitle: Dual-color fluorescence cross correlation spectroscopy on an integrated optofluidic chip
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the detection and discrimination of different sized nanobeads on an integrated optofluidic chip by dual-color fluorescence correlation spectroscopy. Singly and doubly labeled nanobeads can be further identified by cross correlation spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Complete characterization of single attosecond pulses by the modified spectral phase interferometry with an all-optical apparatus
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the complete characterization of single attosecond pulses by the modified cSPIDER method with a frequency-dependent spectral shear. The validity of this method shows no cprinciple limitation of characterizing arbitrary short single attosecond pulses.

articleTitle: Proportional-integral control for wavelength stabilization of a synchronously-pumped optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a rigorous method for the wavelength stabilization of a synchronously-pumped optical parametric oscillator using proportional-integral control. With wavelength stabilization active, the relative intensity noise is limited only by that of the pump laser.

articleTitle: Opto-elastic anisotropy in stretched polymer photonic crystals
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using a new technique for single-domain shear-ordering of elastomeric photonic crystals we demonstrate novel opto-elastic properties. Tensile stress experiments demonstrate coupled mechanical and optical anisotropy, producing striking colour tuning depending on the stretch direction.

articleTitle: Observation of coherent G-mode phonon oscillations in few-layer epitaxial graphene films
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Coherent G-mode phonon oscillations in few-layer graphene films were generated using ultrafast pump-probe spectroscopy. The frequency and the decay time were different depending on the thickness of the graphene layers.

PACS Terms: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Optofluidic sieving with flow-through plasmonic nanohole arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Sieving potential and resulting improved analyte collection in flow-through nanohole array sensors is compared to planar SPR sensing. At typical flow rates, full analyte collection, reaction limited transport and attomolar critical concentrations can be achieved.

articleTitle: Surface texturing of dental implant surfaces with an ultrafast fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Controlled modification of implant surfaces using femtosecond, picosecond and nanosecond pulses from home-built all-fiber-integrated lasers is demonstrated. Picosecond and femtosecond pulses offer superior control over the surface texture. Increasing cell attachment to surface is discussed.

articleTitle: Compact GaAs electro-optic (EO) modulator with ultra low switching voltage and large bandwidth enabled by transparent conducting (TC) bridge electrodes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a compact GaAs EO modulator structure with ultra low switching voltage (~0.5V) and large modulation bandwidth (f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3dBo</sub> ≈ 50GHz), enabled by transparent conducting (TC) material as bridge electrodes.

articleTitle: Ultra-stable 18 mJ Ti:Sa amplifier system with tunable central wavelength, bandwidth and pulse duration
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an ultrastable high-power laser system providing transform-limited 20-to-100 fs pulses at a tunable central wavelength. Subsequent frequency-conversion provides wavelength-tunable second and third harmonic radiation with up to 3.7 mJ.

articleTitle: High-power, fiber-laser-pumped picosecond optical parametric oscillator for the near- to mid-infrared
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a high-power picosecond optical parametric oscillator synchronously pumped by a Yb fiber laser. The oscillator provides a total average power of 9.58 W at 60% extraction efficiency in a TEM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub> spatial beam profile.

articleTitle: Probing ultrafast carrier-carrier scattering dynamics in epitaxial graphene
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Saturable absorption of graphene was experimentally and theoretically investigated in femtosecond time regime with the z-scan technique. The initial ultrafast carrier relaxation time was determined to be ~8(±3) fs. Such ultrafast dynamics is far beyond the time resolution of other ultrafast techniques with typical hundred fs laser pulses. Our results strongly suggest that graphene is an excellent atomic layer saturable absorber.

articleTitle: Pulse compression of a high power modelocked thin disk oscillator using a rod-type fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a simple nonlinear compression setup based on a 70-μm diameter rod-type fiber amplifier seeded by a 12-W, 1.1-ps Yb:YAG modelocked thin-disk laser. We generate 55 W of compressed sub-100-fs pulses at 11.6 MHz.

articleTitle: Holographic fabrication of three-dimensional Penrose-type photonic quasi-crystal using a lab-made phase mask
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Penrose-type photonic quasi-periodic crystals are fabricated through 5 or 6 beam holographic lithography using a lab-made phase mask. The quasi-crystal structure is confirmed through diffraction patterns showing ten-fold symmetry.

articleTitle: Terahertz emission of magnesium doped indium nitride
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Significant THz power enhancement and polarity reversal were observed from Mg-doped InN. The carrier concentration-dependent THz polarity reversal reflects the interplay between the surface-electric-field and the photo-Dember field for THz emission from InN:Mg.

articleTitle: Nanovoid plasmonic-enhanced low-cost photovoltaics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Gold and silver nanovoid structures generate localised plasmon modes which are harnessed to enhance organic and amorphous silicon solar cell performance. Higher absorption at plasmonic resonant wavelengths indicates significant potential for enhanced photocurrent and efficiency.

articleTitle: Second harmonic generation of picosecond pulses at 530 nm in bulk PPLN at variable repetition rates
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Green picosecond pulses with peak powers of more than 4W are generated by second harmonic generation in bulk PPLN. These power levels exceed all previous electrically triggerable green picosecond sources by an order of magnitude.

articleTitle: Nanobore PCF maintaining cylindrically polarized modes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A nanoscale hole placed centrally in the core of a PCF breaks the degeneracy between radially and azimuthally polarized modes, causing a large splitting in phase velocity, group velocity and dispersion.

articleTitle: Nonlinear beam reflection by negative defects in photonic lattices
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate both theoretically and experimentally that a nonlinear beam can be reflected by a negative defect in photonic lattices if the incident angle is below a threshold. This phenomenon can be used to control beam propagation in photonic lattices.

articleTitle: Latest developments in Er3+∶YAG fiber-shaped crystalline rod lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Resonant total-internal-reflection diode pumping of Q-switched 1.64 μm Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:YAG laser with a crystalline fiber-like geometry is reported with ~10 W in cw-mode and 2.8 mJ in Q-switched mode.

articleTitle: Model-based THz imaging for 2D reflection-mode geometry
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate 2D reflection-mode THz imaging with model-based reconstruction. A substantial improvement in the reconstruction of objects is obtained via the model-based algorithm compared to the time-reversal algorithm.

articleTitle: Photon localization in an atom-waveguide system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In a coupled atom-waveguide system, we show the vacuum Rabi oscillation and a bound polariton state near the lower cut-off frequency, which reveal the strong coupling between a discrete atomic state and a photonic continuum.

articleTitle: Weak exciton-photon coupling of PbS nanocrystals in air-slot mode-gap Si photonic crystal nanocavities in the near-infrared
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate micro-photoluminescence measurements of PbS nanocrystals coupled to air-slot mode-gap photonic crystal nanocavities with Q~15,000 and V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub> ~0.02 (λ/n<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">air</sub>)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. The ultrahigh Q/V ratios are critical for applications in cavity QED, nonlinear optics and sensing.

articleTitle: Demonstration of photonically assisted RF waveform generation with 1-nanosecond update time
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photonically assisted RF arbitrary waveform generation with 1-ns update time is demonstrated utilizing a commercial tunable DBR laser to affect frequency modulation of the optical frequency comb carrier in conjunction with line-by-line pulse shaping.

articleTitle: Absorption enhancement of an amorphous Si solar cell through localized surface plasmon-induced scattering with metal nanoparticles
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Absorption enhancement of an amorphous Si solar cell is numerically demonstrated by placing metal nanoparticles on the device top, including periodical and non-periodical distributions, to induce localized surface plasmon for effectively generating forward scattering.

articleTitle: Electric-field-induced coherent control in a semiconductor
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A static electric field enables 1 + 2-photon coherent control of the photoexcited carrier population in semiconductors. A theory based on the Franz-Keldysh effect is compared to results of an experiment in (100) GaAs.

articleTitle: Silicon waveguide based 320 Gbit/s optical sampling
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A silicon waveguide-based ultra-fast optical sampling system is successfully demonstrated using a free-running fiber laser with a carbon nanotube-based mode-locker as the sampling source. A clear eye-diagram of a 320 Gbit/s data signal is obtained.

articleTitle: Spatial photon correlations in multiple scattering media
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first angle-resolved measurements of spatial photon correlations that are induced by multiple scattering of light. The correlation relates multiple scattered photons at different spatial positions and depends on incident photon fluctuations.

articleTitle: Feasibility study of cryogenic Yb: YAG zig-zag active-mirror laser for ten-kilowatts
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a new compact high power laser system using zig-zag optical path based on the cryogenic Yb:YAG total-reflection active-mirror laser for ten-kilowatts. The thermal analyses of the laser have also been discussed.

articleTitle: Form-birefringent metal and its plasmonic anisotropy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We constructed a form-birefringent metal exhibiting different polarizabilities along different optical axes and its supported optical anisotropy of surface plasmon waves. The generated plasmonic index ellipsoid existing in reciprocal lattice space has been directly mapped.

articleTitle: Theory of stimulated optical emission dynamics in conjugated polymers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a microscopic many-particle theory of intense ultrafast optical pulse propagation in conjugated polymers. For a polyfluorene film rich amplified spontaneous emission dynamics and significant pulse reshaping is found.

articleTitle: Efficient planar single-mode fiber-to-chip coupler based on two-stage adiabatic evolution
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel planar two-stage adiabatic single-mode fiber-to-chip coupler design is presented. The combination of rib and inverse tapers allows to make it 2-2.5 times shorter than state-of-the art inverse taper-based couplers with similar conversion efficiency.

articleTitle: Al2O3:Nd3+ waveguide amplifiers for Use in optical backplanes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>:Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> channel waveguide amplifiers with various lengths and Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> concentrations were fabricated. Internal net gain at 845-940 nm was investigated and a maximum 3 dB gain at 880 nm was obtained.

articleTitle: Reversing the weak quantum measurement for a photonic qubit
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the conditional reversal of a weak quantum measurement on a photonic qubit. The state recovery fidelity, determined by quantum process tomography, is shown to be over 94% for partial-collapse strength up to 0.9. We also experimentally study information gain due to the weak measurement and discuss the role of the reversing operation as an information erasure.

articleTitle: A nano-scale light-driven plasmonic motor
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that a nano-scale plasmonic motor can generate a large and controllable torque. As demonstration, we rotate a dielectric particle which is 4,000 times larger in volume than the motor.

articleTitle: Photoluminescence emission in deep ultraviolet region from GaN/ALN asymmetric-coupled quantum wells
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Deep ultraviolet photoluminescence peaks up to 5.1 eV with dramatically improved intensities are observed in GaN/AlN asymmetric-coupled quantum wells, due to recombination of electrons in AlN coupling barriers with heavy holes in GaN quantum wells.

articleTitle: Solitons in two-dimensional binary superlattices
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on soliton formation in laserwritten two-dimensional binary waveguide lattices. Even for small index contrasts between the sublattices, soliton intensity profiles and power thresholds strongly depend on whether “deep” or “shallow” channels are excited.

articleTitle: Low chromatic dispersion of ±16 ps/(nm·km) over a 550-nm wavelength range using a strip/slot hybrid silicon waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a dispersion-flattened silicon waveguide that exhibits a flat and near-zero dispersion within ±16 ps/nm/km over a 550-nm wavelength range. Averaged dispersion can be shifted from negative to positive with almost the same flatness.

articleTitle: Quantum interference measurement for realizing a polarization-based quantum relay at 1550 nm
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We observed quantum interference using two polarization-entangled photon pairs at 1550 nm, created in two periodically poled lithium niobate waveguides. Using four-fold coincidences, a visibility of 75% was observed without subtracting accidental coincidences.

articleTitle: Suppression of intermodulation distortion (IMD) in coherent system using polymeric dual parallel Mach-Zehnder modulators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A linearized dual parallel Mach-Zehnder modulator (DPMZM) based on a new electro-optic (EO) polymer is fabricated, and experimentally demonstrated to suppress the third-order intermodulation distortion (IMD3) in a coherent analog fiber optic link. A total 30dB cancellation of the IMD3 was achieved.

articleTitle: Mode locking with minimum nonlinearity using inverse-gain output couplers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Broadband laser mode-locking is demonstrated at greatly reduced modelocking strength with an output coupler that compensates for gain filtering. The concept is demonstrated with a <;8 fs Ti:sapphire laser showing dramatically improved stability and beam quality.

articleTitle: Kilowatt-level peak power monolithic fiber amplifier for single-mode, narrow linewidth 100 ns pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have achieved a peak power of 1.2 kW for 105 ns pulses with transform-limited linewidth by using a SM 25 μm core phosphate fiber in the power amplifier stage of a monolithic MOPA system.

articleTitle: Generation of CPA seed pulses by direct phase modulation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A 10.5-kHz train of 2.5-ns optical pulses with 1.15-nm bandwidth centered at 1053-nm suitable for seeding chirped-pulse amplification is produced in a programmable, all-fiber system through direct phase modulation.

articleTitle: Zero-dark current operation of a metal-graphene-metal photodetector at 10 Gbit/s data rate
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate detection of an optical bit stream at 10 GBit/s data rate using a novel metal-graphene-metal photodetector. Utilizing an asymmetric metallization scheme allows zero-dark current operation, despite the fact that graphene is a semi-metal.

articleTitle: Geometrical tuning of nanoscale split-ring resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate the capacitance tuning of nanoscale split-ring resonators. An LC-model predicts a simple dependence of resonance frequency on slit aspect ratio. Experimental and numerical data follow the predictions of the LC-model.

articleTitle: Electro-modulation of plasmonic and photonic-metamaterial structures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By applying voltages of about 1V to usual metal nanostructures via an aqueous electrolyte, we demonstrate reversible modulation of plasmonic resonances by as much as 14 THz. Gold split-ring resonators serve as an example.

articleTitle: Coherent-feedback formulation of continuous quantum error correction protocols
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose an approach to continuous-time quantum error correction based on the coherent feedback of optical probes that naturally utilizes photonic device physics to implement a stationary and `on-chip' protected quantum memory.

articleTitle: Subwavelength confinement of THz radiation in tapered plasmonic slot waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally characterize the confinement of terahertz radiation in tapered slot waveguides. Both the transverse and axial field components exhibit strong lateral confinement. An antisymmetric axial field distribution is observed across the output gap.

articleTitle: Bistability and nonreciprocity in nonlinear disordered media
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study wave transmission through a nonlinear random medium and predict a novel effect resulting from an interplay of nonlinearity and disorder. We reveal that nonlinearity leads to bistable and nonreciprocal transmission properties of the localized modes.

articleTitle: Self-guided operation of green-pumped singly resonant CW OPO based on Bulk MgO:PPLN
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the self-guided operation of a singly resonant, thermally loaded CW OPO and its improved characteristics of mode quality and stability in the case of a MgO:PPLN crystal pumped at 532 nm.

articleTitle: 10Gbps wavelength converter by distributed feedback laser with Bragg wavelength detuned layer
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Two-section distributed feedback (TS-DFB) laser with Bragg-wavelength-detuned layer applied as a 10Gbps wavelength converter with high extinction ratio (ER) is demonstrated experimentally, matched to the numerical result.

articleTitle: Holographically encoded microparticles - a flexible multiplex platform for bioassay applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Glass filaments containing digital holographic codes are ideal substrates for multiplexed bioreactions. We describe a multiplex assay platform that provides for many hundreds of unique probes in a single well of a standard 96-well microplate.

articleTitle: Characterization of SOI microrings using IR imaging
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a non-invasive diagnostic method of quantitative infrared (IR) imaging, applied here to a series cascade of microring resonators fabricated in silicon-on-insulator. The IR images contain information on the otherwise inaccessible individual through-ports and the resonators themselves, providing coupling, loss and intensity-enhancement parameters for the individual rings.

articleTitle: Compact and portable multiline UV & visible Raman lasers in hydrogen-filled HC-PCF
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present two compact multi-line Raman-lasers based on two types of HC-PCF photonic microcells. Each discrete component of the laser exhibits high spectral power density and narrow linewidth for forensics and biomedical applications.

articleTitle: Time-resolved picosecond pure-rotational coherent anti-Stokes Raman spectroscopy for thermometry and species concentration in flames
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Time-resolved picosecond pure-rotational coherent anti-Stokes Raman spectroscopy is demonstrated for thermometry and species concentration determination in flames. Time-delaying the probe pulse enables successful suppression of unwanted signals. A theoretical model is under development.

articleTitle: 3D-orientation of single molecules in an optical λ/2-microresonator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present here a tunable microresonator which can be used to modify the optical properties of single quantum emitters. The 3D-orientation and position of a single molecule is determined with a radially polarized laser beam.

articleTitle: High repetition rate 5 GW peak power fiber laser pumped few-cycle OPCPA with CEP control
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a 96 kHz repetition rate sub-10 fs, optical parametric chirped pulse amplifier system with 6.7 W average power and >5 GW peak power. Furthermore the oscillator is CEP stabilized and the CEP of the amplified pulses is measured.

articleTitle: Optical control of neural activity with amorphous silicon light addressable electrodes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an optically addressed electrical stimulation device for neuron control with single cell resolution and millisecond temporal resolution. This system allows dynamic study of interconnected neural network at single neuron level.

articleTitle: Contact printing of quantum dot light emitting diode on silicon probe tip
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel quantum dot based LED is fabricated directly on a micromachined silicon probe. Monolayers of quantum dots are precisely deposited at the probe tip through microcontact printing and electrically excited to show successful electroluminescence.

articleTitle: Controlling Anderson localization in disordered photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We prove Anderson localization in the slow-light regime of a photonic crystal waveguide by measuring the ensemble-averaged localization length which is controlled by the dispersion of the disordered photonic crystal waveguide.

articleTitle: Controlling cascade third-order and fifth-order nonlinear optical processes via atomic coherence
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally investigate the effects of cascade third-order and fifth-order nonlinear optical processes in a four-level atomic system. The relative strengths of these high-order nonlinear optical processes can be manipulated by controlling the atomic coherence.

articleTitle: Thermo-optically tunable photonic crystal light modulator utilizing cut-off effect
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present design, fabrication and characterization of thermo-optically tunable photonic crystal light modulator. Thermo-optic effect of silicon was utilized to change refractive index of silicon and photonic band dispersion to realize tunable photonic crystal devices.

articleTitle: Optical coherence tomography for non-destructive investigation of silicon integrated-circuits
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the development of an ultra-high-resolution high-dynamic-range infrared optical coherence tomography imaging system for the novel purpose of sub-surface inspection of silicon integrated-circuits. Examples of substrate thickness profiling and device feature inspection are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Terahertz bandwidths extending to 100 THz from a two-color-photoinduced air plasma
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the generation of terahertz pulses with a continuous bandwidth up to 100 THz from a plasma with sub-20-fs two-color femtosecond excitation, and demonstrate its potential for spectroscopic measurements.

articleTitle: Radiative decay engineering in strongly anisotropic bilayers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a metamaterial device that exhibits a broadband singularity in the photonic density of states and negative refraction. These resonant and non-resonant effects allow control over decay rates using a planar nanoscale structure.

articleTitle: Tunable pulse width, short pulse high power green laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the demonstration of a short pulse high power IR (98 W) and green (43 W) laser with 50 ps pulse-width, 700 MHz repetition-rate and near-diffraction limited beam quality (M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> <; 1.1). The pulse-width was electro-optically tunable from 10 ps to 50 ps.

articleTitle: Planar electro-optofluidic chip: Integration of nanopore with optofluidics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the integration of two ultra-sensitive technologies - ARROW waveguides and solid-state nanopore - in a planar electro-optofluidic platform. The functionality of the chip is demonstrated using concurrent electrical and optical detection of fluorescent nanospheres.

articleTitle: Measurement of γ in photonic crystal fibers by the induced grating autocorrelation technique
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The induced grating autocorrelation technique was used to measure γ in short lengths of solid-core photonic crystal fibers (SC-PCFs): a 35-cm highly nonlinear PCF and two large mode area PCFs of lengths 4.5-m and 4.9-m.

articleTitle: Experimental implementation of optimum unambiguous and maximum-confidence discrimination of two single photon mixed states
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce experimental implementations of optimum unambiguous and maximum-confidence discrimination of two mixed states. Linear optics and polarization states of single photons from a true single-photon source based on a semiconductor quantum dot are utilized.

articleTitle: Photodarkening and photobleaching of Yb-doped fibers by laser diodes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photodarkening and photobleaching of Yb-doped germanosilicate and aluminosilicate fibers have been studied. We show violet laser diodes (407nm) can efficiently bleach photodarkening even with low-intensity cladding-irradiation. Coirradiation of pumping and bleaching lights was also investigated.

articleTitle: Study of SWCNT diameter influence on mode-locked Erbium-doped fiber laser performance
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This paper presents a study about output bandwidth maximization in Erbium-doped fiber lasers, by using thin films incorporating Carbon Nanotubes (CNT) with diameters of 0.8 and 1.0 nm, with several films transmittance values and different total cavity dispersion. Best result was achieved with 1.0 nm CNT generating a maximum bandwidth of 5.7 nm when films transmittance is 37%.

articleTitle: Evolution of beaming pattern in corrugated mid-IR plasmonic structures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We consider the formation of highly directional beams from a subwavelength aperture surrounded by surface corrugations through a high-index superstrate and show that the beaming pattern strongly depends on the distance to the aperture.

articleTitle: Nitrogen-vacancy centers optically coupled to hybrid microcavities
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical coupling between nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in single-crystal diamond and hybrid gallium phosphide microcavities is demonstrated. NV photoluminescence coupled into microcavities modes with Q > 25000, and mode volumes as small as 18(λ/n<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GaP</sub>)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> are observed.

articleTitle: Auto-stabilization of ring lasers based on whispering gallery mode resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a stabilized ring laser using a whispering gallery mode resonator. Experiments using microspheres with quality (Q) factors of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> show lasing linewidths down to 170 kHz, limited by the resolution of the measurement.

articleTitle: Broadband photonic arbitrary waveform generation using a frequency agile laser at 1.5µm
