publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use a pulse-compression chirp-transform algorithm to generate broadband photonic arbitrary waveforms. A phase-locked loop frequency agile laser provides the needed broadband frequency scans. The experiment operates at the telecom wavelength of 1.5μm.

articleTitle: Excitonic switches operating at around 100 K
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on experimental proof of principle for the operation of excitonic switches at temperatures around 100 K. The devices include the exciton optoelectronic transistor, the excitonic bridge modulator, and the excitonic pinch-off modulator.

articleTitle: Stable, 17.5 W, optimally-output-coupled, Yb-fiber-pumped mid-infrared optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report stable, continuous-wave, mid-infrared optical-parametric-oscillator based on MgO:PPLN, pumped by Yb-fiber-laser, generating total power of 17.5W at 61% extraction efficiency, in TEM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub>(M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup><sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Idier</sub> <;1.24,M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup><sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Signal</sub><;1.24) spatial mode with peak-peak idler power stability of 5% over 14 hours.

articleTitle: Internal field measurements of finite length 1-D form-birefringent periodic structures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report measurements of internal field intensity distribution over 1-D form-birefringent periodic structures of finite length. Field distributions and field enhancement are verified but at significantly reduced strength attributed to small but finite material loss.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional Fourier-transform spectroscopy of potassium vapor
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Various two-dimensional Fourier-transform spectra of potassium vapor have been obtained to show coherent interactions and isolate Raman-like coherences. The experimental results agree well with numerical calculation based on optical Bloch equations.

articleTitle: Carrier transport in dye-sensitized ZnO and TiO2 nanoparticles: What can we learn from ultrafast terahertz spectra?
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We used time-resolved spectroscopies in terahertz and visible ranges complemented with Monte-Carlo simulations to assess the connection between ultrafast charge injection and formation and transport of mobile charge carriers in dye-sensitized nano-structured semiconductors.

articleTitle: High-Q polymeric microcavities
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the fabrication of high-Q microresonators made of poly(methyl methacrylate) (PMMA) with a conical shape due to a thermal reflow step. The cavity quality factor is above 2-10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> in the 1300 nm wavelength range.

articleTitle: Surface enhanced Raman study of the interaction of PEDOT:PSS with silver and gold nanoparticles
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Surface enhanced Raman spectroscopy is used to characterize the interaction of PEDOT:PSS, a polymer blend widely used as a hole-transporting electrode coating in organic polymer photovoltaic cells, with plasmonically active metal nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Double self-compression of femtosecond pulses in filaments
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We discuss pulse-splitting-isolation cycles as the origin of pulse self-compression in filaments. These cycles can be cascaded in a single gas-filled cell, giving rise to tenfold compression. XFROG spectrograms provide experimental evidence for double self-compression.

articleTitle: Liquid crystal tunable photonic crystal dye laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a dye-doped liquid crystal laser using a photonic crystal cavity. An applied electric field to the liquid crystal provides wavelength tunability. The photonic crystal enhances resonant interaction with the gain medium.

articleTitle: Terahertz surface waves on a split-ring-based metamaterial film
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present experimental and numerical investigations on the excitation and dispersion characteristics of resonant terahertz surface waves on thin metamaterial films. An intuitive model is introduced which describes the material as a thin slab waveguide.

articleTitle: Optical double to single sideband modulation converter for radio-over-fiber systems based on injection-locked fabry-peròt lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a double-to-single sideband converter based on an injection-locked semiconductor laser. By this technique a 64-QAM 54 Mb/s OFDM signal at 6 GHz is transmitted successfully over 80 km SMF avoiding penalties associated to fading.

articleTitle: 1.7 µm wavelength tunable supercontinuum source for optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High resolution and high penetration depth OCT is demonstrated with Gaussian shaped, center wavelength tunable, 230 nm wide bandwidth, high power supercontinuum at 1.65-1.73 μm wavelengths region using ultrashort pulse fiber laser based system.

articleTitle: CEP-locked three-color parametric system for “perfect wave” synthesis
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The relative and absolute phases of femtosecond 1.03-μm pump, 1.55-μm signal and 3.09-μm idler pulses are stabilized paving the way for the generation of optimized driver-waveforms for higher-order-harmonic generation and electron impulsive momentum transfer.

articleTitle: Plasma-mirror-cleaned high-contrast few-cycle relativistic-intensity light pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A plasma mirror is shown to enhance the intensity contrast of 8fs multiterawatt light pulses by 2.5 orders of magnitude, while keeping the pulse duration unchanged. High reflectivity and improved near-field beam quality are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional electronic beam steering in coherently-coupled vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate two-dimensional electronic beam steering using only the in-phase mode of a vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser (VCSEL) array. The steering is highly-controllable, and the interference visibility is typically very high.

articleTitle: Power scaling of coherent blue light source based on frequency tripling inside adhesive-free bond composite Nd∶YAG laser cavity
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Based on effective third-harmonic generation in two-section dual-period periodically-poled KTP crystal being placed inside the cavity of adhesive-free bond composite Nd:YAG laser, we generated coherent blue light with output power reaching 200 mW.

articleTitle: Single-cycle multi-THz transients with electric fields exceeding 10 MV/cm
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Broadband parametric amplification of 1.3-μm pulses in GaSe crystals provides intense single-cycle idler transients covering the 1-60 THz window with peak amplitudes above 10 MV/cm. Electro-optic sampling directly monitors the field of the phase-stable waveforms.

articleTitle: Anti-guided Bragg reflection waveguide diode lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel edge-emitting Bragg reflection waveguide laser with a low index core is demonstrated. Single transverse mode operation is observed with typical thresholds below 250 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and propagation losses of 11.4 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: 100 nm metallic checkerboard by wafer-scale nanoimprint and its application in surface enhanced Raman spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A wafer-scale (~4 inch) 100 nm nano-checkerboard structure was fabricated. The fabrication combines multiple nanoimprint lithography, 3-D patterning and self-aligned etching. Transmission/reflection resonance at ~750 nm and Raman enhancement of ~ 4.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> were achieved.

articleTitle: Faraday Rotation Spectroscopic sensing of oxygen using static magnetic fields and balanced photodetection
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe the development of a Faraday Rotation Spectroscopic trace-gas sensor for quantification of molecular oxygen. Static magnetic field and balanced detection of polarization rotation is proposed for high precision and ultra-low power operation.

articleTitle: Hybrid diode-microresonator laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a new technology allowing on-chip integration of a micro-resonator and its energy source for fundamental studies and commercial applications. As a proof-of-concept we demonstrate four-wave mixing and Raman lines.

articleTitle: High bandwidth, ultra-low power all optical modulation with a nano-fiber embedded in Rb vapor
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report all-optical modulation at 2 GHz with 19 atto-joules, using a tapered nano-fiber embedded in Rb vapor. The switching energy is a record low value for modulation at this speed, requiring only 75 photons.

articleTitle: Ultrafast control of polariton stimulated scattering in semiconductor microcavities
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report high-speed electronic control of ultrafast polariton amplification in a semiconductor microcavity. A >90% reduction of the parametric scattering gain is obtained by tuning the intracavity electric field to turn on inter-well resonant tunneling.

PACS Terms: 190.2640 Nonlinear optics: Stimulated scattering, modulation, etc.
320.7130 Ultrafast optics: Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Modulation cancellation method for detection of molecules with unresolved absorption bands
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel spectroscopic technique was applied to detection of hydrazine vapor using two wide stripe diode lasers and a variation of QEPAS. Modulating lasers with 180 degrees phase shift resulted in >100 times background reduction.

articleTitle: Subharmonic synchronization of two-color laser pulses for stimulated Raman scattering microscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We successfully demonstrate low-jitter synchronization of a 38-MHz Yb-fiber oscillator to a 76-MHz Ti:sapphire oscillator with a two-photon detector and an intra-cavity electro-optic modulator for sensitive lock-in detection of stimulated Raman signal in biological microscopy.

articleTitle: Simultaneous measurements of H2O and CO2 isotope ratios using 2.73 µm laser spectrometer
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Simultaneous measurements of water and CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> isotopologue ratios were performed using laser absorption spectroscopy in combination with Kalman filtering at 2.73 μm. The isotopic compositions of eH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O and eCO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in breath gas were analyzed.

articleTitle: Simulation, design, and characterization of electrically-pumped VECSELs for future passive modelocking
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An ultrafast electrically-pumped VECSEL design requires an acceptable trade-off in cw output power. Validating our design guidelines and simulations 120 mW cw output power are generated. Homogenous current injection is even achieved for large devices.

articleTitle: Liquid lens approaches for simultaneous standard and extended depth of field imaging
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A tunable acoustic gradient lens is shown to provide depth-of-field switching at kilohertz rates in a nonlinear microscope. We demonstrate two modulation strategies; fast varifocus scanning during each pixel and pseudo-Bessel beam excitation.

articleTitle: High quantum efficiency of Nd3+-doped ZBLAN glass under sunlight excitation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The quantum efficiency of Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped ZBLAN glass under sunlight excitation was measured as more than 70 %, which would be due to the low loss in the VIS-UV region and phonon energy of the glass.

articleTitle: Optical spectroscopy of Bi containing semiconductors
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The novel semiconductor material Ga(AsBi) is investigated by the time-resolved photoluminescence as function of lattice temperature, excitation density, and excitation energy. Disorder and localization effects are found to strongly influence the spectra and the dynamics.

articleTitle: Fundamental limit of nanophotonic light-trapping in solar cells
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use a rigorous electromagnetic approach to develop a light-trapping theory, which reveals that the standard limit developed by Yablonovitch can be substantially surpassed in nanophotonic regimes, opening new avenues for highly efficient solar cells.

articleTitle: Plasmon-enhanced high-order harmonic generation in the vicinity of metal nanostructures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We simulate high-order harmonic generation by low-intensity pulses using plasmon field enhancement near metallic nanostructures and develop a formalism which includes the influence of the metal surface on the HHG process.

articleTitle: Optical bullet trains via modulation instability in nonlocal solitons
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a feasible approach to obtaining dense light-bullets trains in nonlocal nonlinear dielectrics, such as nematic liquid crystals, thanks to the interplay between local and nonlocal nonlinearities and the temporal modulation instability.

articleTitle: Nd:GdVO4 laser passively mode-locked by cascaded nonlinearity in periodically-poled lithium tantalate
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: PPMgSLT is used for mode-locking of a diode-pumped Nd:GdVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser by intracavity SHG. Stable and self-starting operation is observed achieving output powers of up to 4.7 W and pulse durations as short as 3.2 ps.

articleTitle: On-chip nanoplasmonic-nanofluidic biosensors overcoming mass transport limitations
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a novel hybrid platform merging label free nanoplasmonic sensing with actively controlled nanofluidic surface delivery to overcome mass transport limitations. We show 14-fold improvement in mass transport rate constants appearing in the exponentials.

articleTitle: Acousto-plasmonic coupling in engineered metal nanocomposites
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This work shows the production of self-assembled elongated nano-objects embedded in an oxide host oriented perpendicular to the substrate and their acousto-plasmonic dynamics. Electromagnetic “hot spots” are created that activate anomalous Raman vibrational modes.

articleTitle: Photoluminescence quenching due to relocation of electrons in GaN/AlN asymmetric-coupled quantum wells
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have observed dramatic photoluminescence quenching caused by relocation of photogenerated electrons under large internal electric fields, inherent in GaN/AlN asymmetric-coupled quantum wells.

articleTitle: High-bandwidth optical MCM: FPGA with optical I/O on waveguide-integrated SLC
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an FPGA with 12-channel optical I/O on waveguide-integrated surface laminar circuit, highly-integrated optical multi-chip module. Each transmitter channel operates at data rate over 6 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Efficient Ho:LuLiF4 laser in-band pumped by a Tm fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A Ho:LuLiF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser with an output power of 5.4W and slope efficiency of 76% at 2.1mm in-band pumped by a Tm fiber laser at 1.94mm is reported. Strategies for further increasing output power are considered.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a temporally and spatially high quality petawatt-class laser system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the demonstration of over 30-J of uncompressed broadband energy, indicating the potential peak power in excess of 500-TW with high temporal-contrast around 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sup> and a flat-toped spatial-profile with an ~80% filling factor.

articleTitle: Laser - ion acceleration in the laser transparency regime
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Experiments on lasExperiments on laser-induced ion acceleration from ultra-thin (nm) foil targets reveal a dramatic increase in the conversion efficiency and the acceleration of C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6+</sup> ions in a phase stable way by the laser radiation pressure.er-induced ion acceleration from ultra-thin (nm) foil targets reveal a dramatic increase in the conversion efficiency and the acceleration of C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6+</sup> ions in a phase stable way by the laser radiation pressure.

articleTitle: Ultrafast measurements of thermal transport in Graphene
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present results from measurements of ultrafast thermal transport in Graphene. We find that on picosecond time scales and 5-20 micron length scales hot carriers, instead of the phonons, are the dominant carriers of thermal energy. The thermal transport is found to be diffusive with a diffusivity of ~500 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/s.

PACS Terms: 320.7130 Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: From order to chaos with a spin a twist
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Laboratory techniques to manipulate and observe ultracold atoms make these an attractive platform for testing new ideas in quantum control and measurement. Over the last decade we have revisited the tensor interaction between light fields and multilevel atoms, and have developed a theoretical framework suited for applications in quantum control and measurement. One important finding is that the combined action of a light shift and magnetic field on an atomic ground state can be used to implement a non-linear Hamiltonian for a hyperfine spin, and that its action can lead to nonlinear spin dynamics such as wavepacket collapse and revival. Using concepts from classical control theory it is straightforward to show that this Hamiltonian is sufficiently general for full control of an arbitrarily large spin. On this foundation we have developed a new protocol for quantum state reconstruction, based on continuous weak measurement of a spin observable during carefully designed coherent evolution. We have further used our tools for control and state reconstruction to implement and verify protocols for optimal control of Cs hyperfine spins, showing that an initial fiducial state can be transformed into any desired target state with a fidelity in the 80-90% range.

articleTitle: Power scaling of an Yb∶YCOB thin disk laser to 101 W cw and initial modelocking experiments
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The >25-nm broad emission bandwidth of Yb:YCOB is highly attractive for femtosecond lasers. We confirm its suitability for high-power thin disk operation by cw-multimode power scaling to 100 W and present intial low-power modelocking results.

articleTitle: Optofluidic three-dimensional self-assembly of vertically patterned microstructures using railed microfluidics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate optofluidic three-dimensional (3D) vertical self-assembly of two-dimensionally patterned microstructures using railed microfluidics. 3D railed assembly method is easy and fast vertical heterogeneous patterning and assembly technique.

articleTitle: Non-reciprocal Raman gain in suspended-core and nanowire silica optical fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The Raman gain in suspended-core and nanowire silica optical fibers significantly depends on the relative propagation directions of the pump and Stokes waves, enabling applications for nonreciprocal components.

articleTitle: Photonic generation of square waveform based on fiber optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate photonic generation of square waveform using fiber optical parametric oscillator without the external signal source. Stable square waveform pulse train at the repetition rate of 1.133 GHz is achieved.

articleTitle: Noise contribution of semiconductor optical amplifier based photonic phase shifters
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an analytical model to calculate the signal to noise ratio of a slow light based microwave phase shifter that uses semiconductor optical amplifiers. The model includes dynamic noise effects and is confirmed experimentally.

articleTitle: Lasing from localized modes in deterministic aperiodic nanostructures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate lasing in two-dimensional deterministic aperiodic nanostructures with optical pumping. The lasing modes are strongly localized within the structures. Such lasers combine the advantages of both photonic crystal lasers and random lasers.

articleTitle: MeV proton beams generated by 3 mJ ultrafast laser pulses at 0.5 kHz
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Well-collimated proton beams are generated from bulk glass along the target normal direction by tightly focused 3mJ ultrafast laser pulses at intensities of 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup>W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at 0.5kHz. Spectral measurements indicate maximum proton energy is around 0.5MeV.

articleTitle: Stable photonic crystal fiber sensor for ultra-high temperature measurements
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed a stable photonic crystal fiber sensor for ultra-high temperature measurements (up to 1000°C). We show that the sensor head needs a long thermal annealing to achieve a stable functionality level.

articleTitle: Phonon-induced asymmetry in vacuum Rabi doublet for coupled quantum dot-cavity system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally observed theoretically-predicted, phonon-induced asymmetry in vacuum Rabi doublet spectra for a coupled quantum dot-cavity system in the resonance. Asymmetry is also observed in the intensity of the off-resonant cavity mode emissions.

articleTitle: Single-defect photonic crystal cavity laser fabricated by a combined lithography of laser holography and focused ion beam
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: InP-based square-lattice photonic crystal laser with a single air-hole defect was fabricated by a combined lithography of laser holography and focused ion beam, which enables the large scale and high throughput fabrication of PC-based devices.

articleTitle: Fluorescence correlation spectroscopy in an optical trap
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have combined optical trapping and fluorescence correlation spectroscopy (FCS) to determine the trapping energy and concentration of nanoparticles in suspension by analyzing the elongated dwell time and enhanced concentration in the optical trap.

articleTitle: Planar, high numerical-aperture lens using sub-wavelength high contrast grating
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Planar lenses using sub-wavelength high contrast grating are investigated. By designing the phase of the grating, high numerical aperture lenses can be achieved, with small spherical aberration and low insertion loss.

articleTitle: High-bit-rate pump-probe experiments on bundled single-walled carbon nanotubes for 1.55µm telecom signal regeneration
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Single-walled carbon nanotubes (SWNT) based saturable absorber (SA) are investigated by two-color pump-probe experiments at 10GHz excitation repetition rate within the telecom wavelength range 1.51-1.55μm. Results show that SWNT based SA exhibit a great potential for high-bit-rate optical regeneration.

articleTitle: Determination of dispersion and nonlinear coefficients of photonic crystal fibers by degenerated FWM method
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By using degenerated four wave mixing (FWM) method and counting the efficiency of the newly created frequency, we easily obtained dispersion, dispersion slope and nonlinear coefficients by fitting the experimental data with several well-known functions.

articleTitle: Control of thermal radiation by intersubband transitions in quantum wells and two-dimensional photonic crystals
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have achieved a very narrow band and strong thermal radiation peak in a design wavelength by using intersubband transitions in quantum wells and two-dimensional photonic crystals.

articleTitle: High-Q SiO2-clad silicon photonic crystal microcavities for ultra-low energy switching
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We outline the development of a SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-embedded silicon photonic crystal microcavity with Q above 10,000, which forms the basis for a CMOS-compatible electro-optic modulator with switching energy below 0.1 fJ/bit.

articleTitle: 32 ps-45 W to 12 ps-15 W spatial-hole-burning-free Nd∶YVO4 oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a high-average-power 888 nm diode-pumped passively mode-locked TEM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub> Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> oscillator with adjustable pulse durations. From 45 to 15 W output power, we produced corresponding 32 to 12 ps long pulses without spatial hole burning.

articleTitle: Imaging the 3D scattering pattern of plasmonic nanoantennas by heterodyne numerical holography
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical nanoantennas are studied by full field heterodyne numerical holography in total internal reflection. After a spectroscopic characterization, the 3D scattering pattern of gold nanodisc chains was measured for wavelengths in and out of resonance.

articleTitle: Innovative combined sensing and imaging approaches in biophotonics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using simple fiber-optic based approaches, we have developed some advanced biophotonics and nanobiophotonics combined imaging and sensing techniques that can be exploited for high-resolution bioimaging and biosensing at cellular, intracellular and bulk tissue level.

articleTitle: Transient emission of the ‘off’ state of blinking quantum dots is not governed by auger recombination dynamics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Blinking in colloidal nanocrystals is studied through photon counting from single nanocrystals. Size independent `off' state dynamics are observed in contrast to predictions by prevailing models which attribute `dark' states to Auger recombination assisted quenching.

PACS Terms: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Phase-locked arrays of surface-emitting terahertz quantum-cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report single-mode operation of phase-locked arrays of surface-emitting distributed-feedback terahertz quantum-cascade lasers. Carefully-designed phase-sector locks lasers in-phase, creating tighter beam-patterns along the phased-array direction (FWHM ≈10°). This method allows beam-steering applications at terahertz frequencies.

articleTitle: Selectively filled photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a new technique to fill arbitrary patterns of a photonic crystal fiber selectively with high nonlinear liquids. Thus we can create waveguides and waveguide arrays with tailored dispersion, nonlinearity, and spatial arrangement.

articleTitle: Characterization of Nd-doped polymer waveguide amplifiers near 1060 and 870 nm
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-complex-doped polymer channel waveguide amplifiers with various lengths and Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> concentrations were fabricated by a simple procedure. Internal net gain of 5.7 dB/cm at 1064 nm and 2.0 dB/cm at 873 nm was obtained.

articleTitle: Fiber length optimization in a dispersion compensated fiber optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Sub-50 fs pulses with linear chirp at 969.4nm are generated using a synchronously-pumped fiber optical parametric oscillator where the suitable fiber length is chosen to compensate the dispersion from optical components inside of the cavity.

articleTitle: Extreme nonlinear optical regime supported by metamaterials: beam transverse power flow reversing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We consider specific metamaterials hosting a novel extreme nonlinear regime where the linear and nonlinear dielectric responses are comparable, a regime supporting peculiar beams whose power flow direction reverses its sign along the transverse profile.

articleTitle: Sensing characteristics of chemical agents by using liquid crystal-based chemical and biological sensors
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This paper reports the design of a microstructure comprising an interdigitated capacitance structure for the detection of vapor-phase analytes based on nematic liquid crystal (NLC) sensor. The NLC sensor is tested by using demethyl-methylphosphonate (DMMP) detection to change the orientational response of the liquid crystal molecules and demonstrated by the optical monitoring as well as the capacitive monitoring. Finally, vapor-phase analyte concentrations down to the parts-per-billion (ppb) level have been tested.

articleTitle: Vis-IR optical switching/ modulation based on the electrically- activated phase transition of VO2 thin films
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on fabrication and preliminary characterization of novel optical switches based on phase transition VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> thin films. The electrically-induced VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> phase transition leads to radical changes in material's optical properties, which may be further implemented in fast modulators for short-pulsed lasers applications.

articleTitle: Quantum efficiency enhancement optimization in colloidal semiconductor quantum dot solids using nonradiative energy transfer
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate quantum efficiency (QE) enhancement via recycling of trapped excitons in energy-gradient of quantum dot solids using nonradiative energy transfer. The maximum QE increase of 17% is achieved when the donor-acceptor ratio is 1:1.

articleTitle: Understanding optical activity and EIT-analogous in optical metamaterials with an analytical multipole analysis
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe the different optical responses of geometrically related metamaterials with an analytical method based on multipoles. Metamaterials affecting the polarization eigenstates or mimicking EIT-like phenomena can be understood and explained on simple analytical grounds.

articleTitle: Modes in fiber random laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the results of the experimental and theoretical studies of the random laser based on an Er/Ge co-doped single-mode fiber with randomly spaced Bragg gratings.

articleTitle: Secure key distribution over a 200km long link employing a novel ultra-long fiber lasers (UFL) scheme
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate secure key distribution over a 200 km long link employing a novel ultralong fiber laser, enabling bit exchange at 0.5 kbps. Excellent immunity for both spectral and temporal eavesdropping strategies is demonstrated experimentally.

articleTitle: Single-cycle light pulses from a compact Er:fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a setup based entirely on compact Er:fiber technology which synthesizes pulses of a duration of 4.3 fs. This value corresponds to a single cycle of light in the telecom wavelength region.

articleTitle: Novel method for simulating refractive index distributions of EO materials with electrostrictive distortions
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a novel method for simulating distributed refractive index modulations for materials with the second-order electro-optic effect. The theory assimilates calculations of strains caused by the electrostrictive effect.

articleTitle: Frequency down-conversion of single photons into the telecom band
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a practical implementation for single-photon down conversion based on difference frequency generation by a nonlinear crystal. A theoretical model is presented, where the quantum noise sources, relevant to the process, are identified.

articleTitle: Optical performance monitoring at 640Gb/s based on slow light on a chip
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate residual dispersion and OSNR monitoring from 40Gb/s to 640Gb/s via slow-light enhanced optical THG in dispersion engineered 2D silicon photonic crystal waveguides.

articleTitle: High resolution 3-D laser direct-write patterning
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Resolution Augmentation through Photo-Induced Deactivation (RAPID) lithography makes possible the creation of features that far smaller than the wavelength of light employed. We will present some of the latest advances in RAPID lithography.

articleTitle: Double trap optical tweezers as a tool for direct studying of single red blood cell aggregation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Double optical tweezers is suggested for studying red blood cell aggregation. Quantitative measurements of interaction forces between a pair of RBC are performed. Comparative analysis of aggregation for healthy and pathological blood samples is shown.

articleTitle: Demonstration of unconditional quantum erasing for continuous variables
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate “undoing” quantum non-demolition gates by quantum erasing. In one-way quantum computation, these operations remove unwanted nodes from cluster states. Experimentally one mode was removed from two-mode and four-mode cluster state, respectively.

articleTitle: Scientific highlights from operation of FLASH and new opportunities with LCLS
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: After a short description of the operation principle of linac driven free-electron lasers based on Self Amplified Spontaneous Emission (SASE) the performance of the world's first X-ray FELs, FLASH at DESY in Hamburg and LCLS at SLAC in Stanford, will be presented. Research at FELs is currently focused on understanding the interaction of extremely intense X-ray pulses with matter. Examples of early science include studies of high field physics in atoms, photo-dissociation of molecules and photo-ionization of clusters, as well as investigation of damage issues and materials in extreme conditions. First successful steps towards single particle imaging with atomic resolution have been performed. For an overview see.

articleTitle: Optical absorption enhancement in silicon nanowire and nanohole arrays for photovoltaic application
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We simulate the optical properties of silicon nanowire and nanohole arrays using the transfer matrix method. For optimized parameters, the structures are more absorptive than an optimal single-layer AR-coated thin film.

articleTitle: Net parametric gain in a high index doped silica waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate C-band subpicosecond wavelength conversion over > 100 nm, exploiting four wave mixing in a high index doped silica waveguide spiral of 45 cm, showing a +16.5 dB net gain for a 40 W peak pump power.

articleTitle: Textron's J-HPSSL 100 kW ThinZag® laser program
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A new approach (ThinZag<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup>) for scaling Nd:YAG solid-state slab lasers to high power levels is described. Using an innovative optical configuration, thin slabs of solid-state gain material are immersed in a flowing cooling fluid, resulting in improved thermal management. Measurements at the ~1 kW level were conducted to compare Nd:YAG ceramic with Nd:YAG crystalline slabs. The ceramic slabs demonstrated comparable laser output power relative to the more standard crystalline slabs and demonstrated better optical properties, which result in improved medium uniformity. Performance results from our nominally 5 kW and 15 kW modules are also presented. The 15 kW modules represent basic building blocks for the Joint High Power Solid State 100 kW Laser (J-HPSSL) currently being designed and developed by Textron Defense Systems. Recent measurements of three nominally 15 kW modules operating as a single aperture power oscillator where outputs to 30 kW with beam quality of 3.3 XDL were measured are also included. The reported powers were for operation below maximum pump rate of the device.

articleTitle: Computer-generated holograms written directly on a silicon surface including 3D and rainbow effects
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A femtosecond laser has been used to write computer-generated holograms directly on a silicon surface with a resolution of up to 28 kpixels/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. 3D and rainbow effects in off-axis holograms have been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Low-parasitics 1.55 µm VCSELs with modulation bandwidths beyond 17 GHz
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present 1.55 μm BTJ Short-Cavity VCSELs with modulation bandwidths in excess of 17 GHz. As shown by impedance measurements and impedance modeling, this excellent performance can be attributed to an improved parasitic roll-off frequency of 23 GHz.

articleTitle: Observing photonic de Broglie waves without the NOON state
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the observation of the photonic de Broglie wave for a pair of photons, generated by spontaneous parametric down-conversion, that are not photon number-path entangled. The experimental and theoretical results suggest that the photonic de Broglie wave is, in fact, not related to the entanglement of the photons, rather it is related to the indistinguishable pathways established by the measurement scheme.

articleTitle: Infinite at every frequency: the photonic density of states in (meta)materials with hyperbolic dispersion and related phenomena
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that (meta)materials with hyperbolic dispersion exhibit a broad bandwidth singularity in the photonic density of states. As opposed to an isolated singularity found in other physical systems, with the finite density of states in its vicinity for the systems with hyperbolic dispersion the photonic density of states diverges at every frequency over a finite bandwidth. This behavior leads to a dramatic change in a variety of phenomena, from spontaneous emission to light propagation and scattering.

articleTitle: Silicon nanophotonic mid-infrared optical parametric amplifier with 25 dB gain
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a broadband silicon mid-infrared optical parametric amplifier operating near λ = 2200 nm. The amplifier exhibits a maximum gain as large as 25 dB, and net off-chip gain greater than 13 dB.

articleTitle: Surface enhanced raman scattering (SERS) on-an-optofluidic chip using roof collapse method
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Here we demonstrate a SERS optofluidic device using a nanochannel fabrication method developed by our group. This device consists of nanochannels and a SU-8 waveguide. As a test, we demonstrate the detection of SERS-active Rhodamine6G.

articleTitle: Single-sideband modulation of vector signals based on an injection-locked DFB laser in 60-GHz RoF systems
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate vector signals transmission over 60-GHz RoF systems using single-sideband modulation based on an injection-locked DFB laser. Both 1-Gb/s QPSK and 1.2-Gb/s 16QAM transmission over 50-km SSMF are realized successfully.

articleTitle: New organic nonlinear optical crystal BDAS-TP for terahertz applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Bis[4-dimethylamino-N-methyl-4-stilbazolium] terephthanate (BDAS-TP) was newly designed as an organic nonlinear optical material. Broadband terahertz pulses have been generated in the single crystal by optical rectification of 70 fs pulses from erbium doped fiber laser operating at 1560 nm.

articleTitle: Internal quadratic stark effect results in color hue variations in fluorescent proteins with the same chromophore structure
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Genetically-encoded fluorescent proteins are widely used for bio-imaging. We employ two-photon absorption spectroscopy to show that their different hues can be explained by quadratic Stark effect due to variations of electric field within the protein.

articleTitle: Femtosecond x-ray powder diffraction
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Transient electronic charge density maps with 30 picometer spatial and 100 femtosecond temporal resolution gained from x-ray powder diffraction experiments unravel for the first time a concerted electron and proton transfer in hydrogen-bonded (NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> crystals.

articleTitle: Beam combining in multi-core, holey fiber lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Multiple-core fibers offer the possibility of creating fiber lasers with enlarged effective core diameter, while simultaneously controlling mode shape and quality. A review is presented of the basic theory used for design, and examples presented of such lasers operating in Q-switched mode. Examples of active, non-interacting, and passive multiple-core fibers are also presented.

articleTitle: First fully stabilized frequency comb from a SESAM-modelocked 1.5-µm solid-state oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A diode-pumped 170-fs, 110-mW Er:Yb:glass-laser generates an octave-spanning supercontinuum without amplification in an optimized PM-HNLF. The CEO frequency is self-referenced and stabilized by feedback on the diode current. Cavity length control stabilizes the repetition rate.

articleTitle: Non-invasive study of domain boundary in periodically poled ferroelectrics using ultrahigh resolution optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ultrahigh-resolution and polarization-sensitive optical coherence tomography was used to examine the domain boundary of periodically poled lithium niobate (PPLN). A 3D image of antiparallel domains in PPLN crystal was characterized with a sub-micron axial resolution.

articleTitle: Difference frequency generation of THz waves inside a high-finesse ring-cavity OPO pumped by a fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We produce tunable (1.3-3THz) narrow-band THz-wave output with >130μW average power in periodically-inverted GaAs inside a near-degenerate type-0 PPLN OPO containing thin YAG etalon for spectral control, synchronously pumped by a 1064-nm 10-ps Yb-fiber laser.

articleTitle: Coherent optical memory with GHz bandwidth
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the coherent storage and retrieval of sub-nanosecond low-intensity light pulses with spectral bandwidths exceeding 1 GHz in cesium vapor, using the novel, far off-resonant two-photon Raman memory protocol.

articleTitle: Control of nano-scale plasmon in time and space using pulse shaped femtosecond laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate spatio-temporal control of local plasmon on Au nano-rods with different aspect ratios irradiated by pulse shaped femtosecond laser. This technique could form a novel nano-scale reaction field.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporally resolved plasma effect on two-color laser pumped terahertz generation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Spatiotemporally resolved measurements reveal how a plasma affects the terahertz generation from photoionized air in two-color optical fields.

articleTitle: MPSK modulation by optical injection locked VCSEL
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical phase modulator based on OIL-VCSEL is investigated for the first time. Simulation shows a directly modulated OIL-VCSEL can function as a key component in QPSK or 8PSK transmitters. Preliminary phase-shift-keying characteristic is demonstrated experimentally.

articleTitle: Intense terahertz generation based on the photo-Dember effect
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a new scheme for generating THz radiation based on the photo-Dember effect in lateral geometry. By micro-structuring a semiconductor surface we achieve strongly enhanced THz emission comparable to high-efficiency externally biased photoconductive emitters.

PACS Terms: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Monolithical integration of UV-induced optical polymer waveguides for fluorescence applications in biological sciences
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: UV-induced optical polymer waveguides and microfluidic channels were integrated on a single polymer chip as a platform for fluorescence excitation of biological samples. Fluorescence excitation could be demonstrated for labeled phospholipids and for stained cells.

articleTitle: Phase-controlled photonic quantum circuits in laser written integrated optics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a direct UV-written integrated photonic circuit with on-chip phase control through a thermo-optic phase shifter. An arbitrary beam splitter and a two-photon N00N state are demonstrated with high visibility interference.

articleTitle: Phase locking an array of fiber amplifiers onto a remote object
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Experiments demonstrating a novel technique that coherently combines an array of beams and automatically corrects for turbulence in the beam path are presented. This technique is insensitive to near field backscattering from aerosols and particulates.

articleTitle: Thin film silicon solar cell fabricated at 100°C by high density plasma for flexible photovoltaic application
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Record fabrication temperature, 100°C, of a single junction amorphous Si solar cell was demonstrated by a high-density plasma method. Present solar cell revealed conversion efficiency of 7.4% at 200°C (4.1% at 135°C).

articleTitle: Optimal experiment design for minimal tomography
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Given an experimental set-up and a fixed number of measurements, how should one take data in order to optimally reconstruct the state of a quantum system? We show how to calculate the optimal design explicitly.

articleTitle: Scatterer induced mode splitting in active microcavities
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Scattering induced mode splitting in microcavities with gain medium is detected directly using heterodyne technique without wavelength scan around resonant modes. Optical gain helps resolve small mode splittings, which might be missed in passive microcavities.

articleTitle: Heralded single photon partial coherence
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical spatial coherence, characterizing correlations between optical fields at distinct points, plays a key role in the understanding of classical and quantum phenomena. Recent decades' technological advances, such as powerful lasers and fast, efficient photon counters enabled the study of nonclassical optical fields. Here, we describe single photon partial coherence, providing a theoretical model from quantum coherence theory and experimental observation. In particular, we make clear the role of quantum birth-zones for SPDC sources. These birth-zones are the quantum analog of classical emitters; they characterize the heralded single photon's coherence properties. We make the first observation of the predicted inversion of the single photon degree of coherence.

articleTitle: Atmospheric delivery of a microwave clock using an optical frequency comb
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Atmospheric delivery of a microwave clock using an optical frequency comb is tested over 60 m. Phase noise measurement shows a picosecond-scale rms timing jitter under various weather conditions. A strong amplitude-phase correlation is observed.

articleTitle: Super-uniform target illumination for laser fusion as a self-organizing system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a new algorithm to give an optimum direct-drive beam configuration for super-uniform illumination. It is obtained as a self-organizing system by solving N-body charged particle simulation, applicable for an arbitrary number of beams.

articleTitle: Optical frequency stability measurement based on an Etalon reference
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An optical frequency stability measurement setup based on a Fabry-Perot Etalon reference is presented that results in measurements with ~1.4 kHz optical frequency resolution at update rates of 90 Hz.

articleTitle: Inverted polymer solar cells with paired metal oxide modifications through solution processing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A pair of solution-processed metal oxides is introduced near the electrodes to improve the inverted polymer solar cells. With the paired metal oxides, the conversion efficiency is notably enhanced to above 5%.

articleTitle: Enhanced second harmonic generation in plasmonic nanocavities
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate significantly enhanced second harmonic generation using nanoengineered plasmonic nanocavities of core-shell structures (BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/Au). An enhancement factor of over 500 is measured in the second harmonic scattering efficiency compared to the bare core.

articleTitle: Temporal phase manipulation by phase-sensitive parametric amplification
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the results of a numerical model and proof-of-principle experiment for temporal phase control using phase-sensitive parametric amplification. Under certain conditions, temporal phase amplification can be achieved in this process.

articleTitle: Tailored state preparation for solid-state quantum memory
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report progress in implementing a quantum memory scheme in Pr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>, including experimental and theoretical results using spectral hole-burning to generate narrow absorbing features and implement narrow spectral filtering.

articleTitle: Novel growth and device concepts for high-efficiency InGaN quantum wells light-emitting diodes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The growths and characteristics of staggered InGaN quantum wells (QWs) and type-II InGaN-GaNAs QWs are presented for high-efficiency green-emitting light-emitting diodes (LEDs). Approaches for enhancing internal-quantum-efficiency, light-extraction-efficiency, and efficiency-droop in nitride LEDs are discussed.

articleTitle: Spontaneous phase anti-correlations in Raman optical frequency comb generation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We theoretically investigate and experimentally demonstrate the spontaneous phase anti-correlation between Stokes and anti-Stokes sidebands in Raman frequency comb generation. This anti-correlation suggests a new way to stabilize the comb and synthesize sub-femtosecond pulse trains.

articleTitle: Negative refraction in indefinite permittivity medium
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present theoretical calculations and experimental results demonstrating the negative refraction in indefinite permittivity medium based on SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-SiC-SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> multi-layer structure. Also the enhancement of higher order Fourier harmonics has been experimentally shown.

articleTitle: Advanced length metrology with pulse trains' destructive interference by a femtosecond optical frequency comb
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We proposed the use of a femtosecond optical frequency comb for length measurement based on pulse trains' destructive interference. The theoretical derivation shows that the present technique offers a significantly different approach to length measurement. Preliminary experiment results of the destructive interference with different pairs of pulse trains show the possibility of the proposal method.

articleTitle: Effects of the substrate on the optical properties of plasmonic subwavelength apertures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: It is shown that the optical properties of metallic nano-apertures on dielectric substrates exhibit dramatically different behaviors than apertures immersed in dielectrics and scale with refractive index more complicatedly than predicted by analytical models.

articleTitle: Complete characterization of weak-homodyne photon-number-resolving detectors: Applications to non-classical photonic state reconstructions
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel detector combining phase sensitivity and photon-number resolution is experimentally characterized by measuring its positive-operator-value measurement set. Direct application to tomographic reconstruction of heralded single-photon states is presented.

articleTitle: Tunable nonlinear time response of nanocomposites by doping CdTeS quantum dots
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Tunable nonlinear time response of nano-Ag:polymer nanocomposite is realized by doping CdTeS quantum dots. Response time is quickened through doping. An ultrafast response time of 14.5 ps is achieved at a doping concentration of 27%.

articleTitle: Fast low-cost FIR filter processed ECDM labels for optical label switching
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A code-label recognition time of less than 500ps is demonstrated using low-cost FIR-filters. The electronically-processed label provides a control signal from an auto-correlated label. Error-free electronic code-label switching of an optical 10Gb/s signal is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Hadamard multiplexed fluorescence molecular tomography: Theory and numerical studies
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Inspired by Hadamard multiplexing technique, a method is proposed to improve noise robustness and minimize estimation error in fluorescence molecular tomography (FMT). Theoretical results are validated by numerical studies of 2D simulated FMT data.

articleTitle: Versatile excitation of localized surface plasmon polaritons via spatially modulated polarized focus
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We proposed a method to generate a versatile localized surface plasmon with the capability of beam steering and shaping by using collinear Kretchmann configuration in conjunction with spatially inhomogeneous polarized beam.

articleTitle: Optical properties of nitrogen-vacancy centers created near a diamond surface
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study the optical properties of NV centers created near the diamond surface by nitrogen implantation and annealing and present a method to convert neutral NV centers to the desired negatively charged state.

articleTitle: Mammalian cell sorting using ∞FACS
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: K562 mammalian cells are sorted using a highly integrated microfabricated fluorescence-activated cell sorter (∝FACS). The sample cells are purified with an enrichment factor of 230 at a high throughput (>1,000 cells/sec).

articleTitle: Brillouin scattering property in highly nonlinear photonic crystal fiber with hybrid-core structure
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Brillouin scattering property of a highly nonlinear photonic crystal fiber with hybrid-core structure is studied. It is shown that there exist five Brillouin resonance peaks in two groups. These peaks have similarly linear dispersion characteristics and their effective acoustic velocities increase monotonically by the order of the peaks. The acousto-optic overlapping efficiency in the fiber is experimentally measured to be ~50-%. Temperature and strain dependences of the first resonance peak are also investigated.

articleTitle: Displacement controlled photon number resolving detector for coherent state discrimination
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The presented probabilistic scheme for discrimination of optical coherent states consists of an optimized displacement followed by postselection of a photon number resolving measurement. The scheme outperforms the homodyne receiver in theory and experiment.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of Airy-Bessel 3D linear light bullets
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time a versatile class of Airy-Bessel linear light bullets. The main lobe of the Airy-Bessel wave packet was sustained for many dispersion and diffraction lengths of propagation.

articleTitle: Time-resolved study of polyimide film absorbing layers for laser-induced forward transfer
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this work, we use time-resolved imaging to study the laser-induced formation of a sealed blister on a thin polyimide film absorbing layer which is used to mechanically eject donor material during laser-induced forward transfer.

articleTitle: Linewidth narrowing and Purcell enhancement in photonic crystal cavities on an Er-doped silicon nitride platform
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Light emission from Er-doped amorphous silicon nitride coupled to photonic crystal resonators is studied. The results demonstrate Purcell enhanced Er absorption and linewidth narrowing of the cavity resonance with increasing pump power.

articleTitle: Phase-locking of a 2.7 terahertz quantum cascade laser to a femtosecond mode-locked Er-fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the phase-locking of a 2.7Terahertz Quantum Cascade Laser to the repetition rate of a commercial Er-doped fiber-fs-laser. We observe a linewidth of the beatnote signal with a signal-to-noise of 80dB in 1Hz bandwidth.

articleTitle: Integrated optical input interface for single-flux-quantum circuit buffer memory
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed an optical input module for single-flux-quantum (SFQ) circuit to achieve high-speed buffer memory in the optical packet switch. We succeeded in demonstrating SFQ pulse generation by optical pulse input with 100-ps width.

PACS Terms: (060.1810) Buffers, couplers, routers, switches, and multiplexers

articleTitle: Attosecond electron bunches from laser wakefield accelerators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Femtosecond electron bunches with ultra-relativistic energies were recently generated by laser wakefield accelerators. Here we predict that such accelerators can generate stable attosecond bunches, due to betatron phase mixing within a femtosecond electron bunch.

articleTitle: Reduction of thermal dephasing by tight elliptical focusing perpendicular to walk-off plane leading to improved fourth harmonic generation in β-BaB2O4
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Thermal dephasing due to two-photon absorption-induced linear absorption is reduced by minimizing second- and fourth-harmonic beam overlap through tight elliptical focusing perpendicular to the walk-off plane, leading to multi-watt, high-repetition rate ultraviolet generation in BBO.

articleTitle: Optical arbitrary waveform generation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Advances in technology for optical arbitrary waveform generation will be described. Combs spanning two octaves, from 500nm to 2μm, based on GHz modelocked Ti:sapphire and erbium-fiber lasers, have been carrier-envelope stabilized and frequency referenced.

articleTitle: Nanofiber optical interfaces for laser-cooled atoms
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this work we present results on the use of optical nanofibers of subwavelength diameter as interfaces for probing and manipulating laser-cooled rubidium atoms. In particular, we concentrate on photon counts emitted through the nanofiber.

articleTitle: A compact, tunable, and highly-efficient continuous-wave intracavity optical-parametric oscillator by use of periodically poled MgO-doped LiNbO3 oscillating at 4.7 µm
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed a continuous-wave intracavity optical-parametric oscillator consisting of tandem diode-pumped Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> and periodically poled MgO-doped LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>: An idler output of 40 mW has been obtained with the wavelengths tunable from 4.50 to 4.77 μm.

articleTitle: Analysis on the control of nonlinear light collapse in magneto-optical Kerr media
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a novel approach to the nonlinear optical collapse control in magneto-optical Kerr media. A suitable and essential interplay between magnetically-induced birefringences is fully described via a superposition of the Cotton-Mouton and Faraday effects.

articleTitle: Control of linear dichroism in metamaterial-twisted nematics structure via photo-isomerization
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Linear dichroism in metamaterial-twisted nematics structure of nano meta surface is controlled via photoisomerization process. Azo twisted nematic cell structure enables the switching on-off of meta-induced resonance by trans-cis-trans isomerization when irradiated by UV light.

articleTitle: Supermode dispersion of strongly coupled silicon-on-insulator waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report measurement of the group index dispersion of the supermodes of a three channel array of strongly coupled silicon-on-insulator waveguides, and compare results with numerical simulations. We observe strong coupling-induced dispersion.

articleTitle: 90ps tunable true-time delay line based on photonic crystals
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A photonic crystal waveguide delay line is reported with 90ps of tunable delay over a 20GHz bandwidth. This corresponds to a maximum phase shift of 600°. The true-time delay characteristics are evidenced using a vector network analyzer.

articleTitle: Terahertz absorption in non-polar rotator crystals
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We characterize the phase behavior of linear n-alkanes with n > 22, using terahertz spectroscopy. We observe enhanced absorption in the quasi-ordered rotator phase, the first report of disorder-induced THz absorption in a rotator crystal.

articleTitle: Electron structure of non-equilibrium warm dense copper
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Evolution of superheated electron hole plasma in the warm dense copper is investigated using time resolved x-ray absorption technique. Experimental data indicate a strong electron-phonon non-equilibrium state and it is described with two-temperature model.

articleTitle: Large enhancement of two-photon absorption in semiconductors using highly non-degenerate photons
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We performed frequency non-degenerate pump-probe experiments in several direct-gap semiconductors using femtosecond and picosecond pulses. Tuning the long wavelength photons in the IR region, we observed a 125-fold enhancement of the two-photon absorption coefficient.

articleTitle: Xray-induced multiple core vacancies in impulsively aligned molecules
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We observe a rich angular spectrum resulting from the Auger decay of a single K-shell vacancy but an apparent angle independence for the decay of a double core vacancy “localized” to a single atom.

articleTitle: Ultrashort pulse delivery in hollow-core photonic bandgap Fiber at 540nm
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the transmission and compression of ultrashort pulses with a wavelength of 540 nm in hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber. We have observed pulses as short as 115 fs after 1m of fiber.

articleTitle: Near-diffraction-limited supercontinuum generation in a cladding-pumped nonlinear fiber converter
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Through nonlinear scattering including stimulated Raman scattering and beam cleanup, a pulsed multimode pump beam is converted into a nearly diffraction-limited supercontinuum extending from 1 to 2 μm in a passive cladding-pumped nonlinear fiber converter.

articleTitle: Two-photon polymerization of dielectric-loaded surface plasmon-polariton nanowaveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Dielectric-loaded surface plasmon-polariton nanowaveguides on the gold film are fabricated by two-photon polymerization with femtosecond laser pulses. The leakage radiation microscopy shows that they are single-mode with strong mode confinement at 830 nm.

articleTitle: Color-selective quantum dot photodetection through plasmonic integration
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a color-selective photodetection scheme through integration of Au nanoparticles with CdSe/ZnS quantum dot photodetectors. Preliminary experimental results confirm enhancement of photodetector external quantum efficiency at wavelengths near the plasmonic resonance of Au nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Proton-implanted 850-nm photonic crystal vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers with improved performance
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Proton-implanted 850-nm photonic crystal vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers are fabricated and characterized. Strong and more stable index guiding is introduced, resulting in planar lasers with generally decreased threshold current and increased slope efficiency.

articleTitle: Ultrafast X-ray-pump, laser-probe spectroscopy at LCLS
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first pump-probe spectra using 1 keV pulses from LCLS to excite N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in delayed coincidence with 800 nm laser pulses. The delay between pump and probe was controlled to within 50 fsec.

articleTitle: Optical crosstalk in a silicon nanowaveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We characterize optical crosstalk and the associated bit-error rate degradation in silicon nanowaveguides. Results indicate that crosstalk decreases with increasing modulation frequency, which we attribute to free-carrier lifetime in the nanowaveguides.

articleTitle: Plasmonic sensor based on perfect absorption
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a novel concept to plasmonic sensing. Specifically, we demonstrate a perfect narrow-band plasmonic absorber, which allows for the extremely sensitive detection of the concentration change of glucose solution at a fixed frequency.

articleTitle: Ultrafast optical pulse compression on a chip
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first integrated optical pulse compressor based on nonlinear chirp capable of operating on a sub-picosecond time scale. The device is based on an integrated 45cm long, high index doped silica glass waveguide.

articleTitle: Acousto-optically tunable extended cavity diode laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this new architecture of extended cavity diode laser, broadband tunability is provided by an acousto-optical tunable filter with a longitudinal interaction. The laser offers single mode operation, >100 nm accordability, and two-wavelength operation capability.

articleTitle: Observation of nonlinear wavelength conversion processes of high order harmonics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We observe nonlinear wavelength conversion processes of high harmonics for the first time. The energies of the generated photons are up-converted and momenta of them are narrowly-distributed.

articleTitle: Optically patterned liquid crystal devices for high-resolution beam shaping
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Achromatic laser-beam shapers employing spatially varying twisted nematic liquid crystals (LC's) have been demonstrated for high-peak-power applications. The LC molecular orientation was achieved through photolithographic patterning of an alignment layer using polarized UV light.

articleTitle: Sub-50 fs diode-pumped Yb∶YCOB laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Passive mode locking of the self-frequency doubling Yb:Ca<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>YO(BO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> pumped by a two-section distributed Bragg-reflector tapered-diode-laser is demonstrated. Pulses as short as 49 fs at 1050 nm are achieved for the E//Z polarization.

PACS Terms: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Simulation of three-fold symmetric photonic crystal structures on top of GaN LEDs
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A 3-fold symmetric photonic-crystal grating is simulated using improved FDTD-model. Transmission gratings are optimized. Then, the best cases are simulated in GaN-LED models. The maximum extraction efficiency improvement is 40× greater compared to conventional LEDs.

articleTitle: Towards high energy 10 fs laser pulse via regenerative pulse shaping
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated the use of regenerative pulse shaping approach to obtain ultrashort pulses with at the output of titanium: sapphire laser system. This scheme can be scaled to higher output energy and sub 10fs pulses.

articleTitle: Zero-dispersion wavelength decreasing tellurite microstructured fiber for wide and flattened supercontinuum generation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate wide and flattened supercontinuum generation in zero-dispersion wavelength decreasing tellurite microstructured fibers fabricated by using the tapering method.
