Using a pump laser diode on a 51-μm-core fiber, 2.2 μW of collimated broadband output power was obtained. The coherence length is 1.38 μm.

articleTitle: Photonic metamaterials go three-dimensional
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We review recent experimental progress on three-dimensional photonic metamaterial structures made by direct-laser-writing technology.

articleTitle: Near-field cavity optomechanics with nanomechanical oscillators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use evanescent near-fields of high-Q optical microresonators to extend cavity-optomechanical coupling to nanomechanical oscillators. Pure radiation pressure coupling to SiN nanomechanical strings is demonstrated. Dynamical backaction allows creating laser-like nanomechanical oscillation at nanowatt threshold.

articleTitle: Observation of terahertz frequency comb by fiber-based, asynchronous-optical-sampling THz-TDS
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed a fiber-based, asynchronous-optical-sampling THz-TDS system by combination of mode-locked Er-fiber lasers and photoconductive antennas. Detail structure of the THz comb was clearly observed with a spectral resolution of 5.6 MHz.

articleTitle: Quantum spread spectrum communication
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that spectral teleportation can coherently dilate the spectral probability amplitude of a single photon. In preserving the encoded quantum information, this variant of teleportation subsequently enables a form of quantum spread spectrum communication.

articleTitle: Low-power and high-speed operation of InGaAsP/InP photonic crystal nanocavity laser using wavelength-sized buried heterostructure
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe the room temperature CW operation of an ultra-small buried heterostructure photonic crystal laser. The threshold power is only 1.5 μW, the fiber output power is 0.44 μW, and the 3-dB modulation speed is 5.5 GHz.

articleTitle: THz nonlinearity of water observed with intense THz pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We reveal THz nonlinearity of liquid water using intense monocycle THz pulse. Single THz pulse response and THz pump-probe spectroscopy show the breaking and recovering of hydrogen bonding network in water molecules.

articleTitle: Enhanced guided-to-radiation mode conversion in electro-optic annealed proton-exchanged PPLN waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a TM-guided to TE-radiation mode converter in electro-optic (EO) annealed proton-exchanged, 23.6-μm-period PPLN waveguides at 1550-nm band. Over 80%/cm mode-conversion efficiency was obtained with this device at 28°C with ~8 V/μm EO field.

articleTitle: Development of an 10−14 ultra high contrast laser system using high energy XPW filtering scheme
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed a 4 mJ, 60 nm bandwidth and 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-14</sup> contrast Laser system. We used the most energetic 1mJ-XPW signal ever produced to seed a standard CPA Laser.

articleTitle: Development of tunable terahertz wire lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a novel tuning mechanism based on a “wire-laser” with subwavelength transverse dimensions(w<;<;λ). By manipulating the waveguided mode propagating outside the cavity, frequency tuning of ~137 GHz (3.6%) is demonstrated from a single-laser device at ~3.8 THz.

articleTitle: Intracycle interference in above-threshold ionization
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Above-threshold ionization spectra consist of intra- and intercycle interferences of electron trajectories. The former is imprinted as a modulation envelope of discrete peaks formed by the latter. This modulation is clearly seen in the wavelength-dependence.

articleTitle: Woodpile photonic crystals with a complete bandgap reaching telecom wavelengths
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By using direct laser writing into a novel commercially available photoresist, silicon-double-inversion, and tempering of the resulting structures, we realize woodpile photonic crystals with a complete bandgap near 1.55 μm wavelength.

articleTitle: 1500-nm InP diode lasers optimized for use at 77K demonstrate 73% conversion efficiency
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The power conversion efficiency of cryogenically-cooled InP diode lasers is limited by excess electrical voltage caused by carrier freeze-out. A laser design which specifically mitigates this effect demonstrates peak efficiency of 73% at 77 K.

articleTitle: Integrated temperature compensated Bragg grating refractometer - benefiting from birefringence
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: UV written planar Bragg grating sensors have been shown to form effective refractometers. Here we show that by using the birefringence of an integrated waveguide a temperature insensitive Bragg grating refractometer can be realised.

articleTitle: A design of a long monolithic cavity without unequal restoring forces
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A design of high-finesse optical cavity (L = 30cm) with vibration immunity is proposed. The cavity monolithically includes supporting parts and a base plate, avoiding unequal restoring forces to predict the response against horizontal vibrations.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal nanobeam cavities and their applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Wavelength-scale and high-Q photonic crystal nanobeam resonators, made in Si, III-Vs, and Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, and their applications in reconfigurable photonics, optoelectronics, biochemical sensing and quantum information processing are presented.

articleTitle: 1.38 W tunable high-power narrow-linewidth external-cavity tapered amplifier at 670 nm
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A diffraction-limited narrow-linewidth diode laser system based on a tapered amplifier in external cavity is demonstrated. 1.38 W output power is obtained. The laser system is tunable from 659 to 675 nm.

articleTitle: GaAs deep-center stimulated-emission at 1.5µm
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Room-temperature stimulated-emission, optical gains larger than known significant losses, and single-pass laser action from GaAs deep-centers are demonstrated at low electrical injection in cw mode at 1.3-1.5 μm. Fast hole capture maintains the population inversion.

articleTitle: Absorber and gain dynamics in dilute nitride mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a comparison between the high-speed gain and absorber dynamics of dilute nitride laser structures utilising GaAs or GaAsN barrier layers. The inclusion of dilute nitride barriers greatly reduces the absorber recovery time. The wafers were processed into two-section monolithic mode-locked lasers generating 2-5 ps pulses at 40 GHz.

articleTitle: A spin phase gate based on optically generated geometric phases in a self-assembled quantum dot
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the use of optically generated geometric phases to modify the phase of one of the spin states of an electron confined in an InAs quantum dot, effectively executing a spin phase gate.

articleTitle: Quantum-mechanical inelastic collisions of wannier-mott excitons
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Systematic measurements of the temperature dependence of the two-body collision-induced loss of dark paraexcitons in Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O show a diverging cross section at low temperatures. Scattering problems between excitons in general require quantum-mechanical treatments.

articleTitle: Enhanced surface plasmon coupling effect with a metal/SiO2/GaN structure for further improving the emission efficiency of a light-emitting diode
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Further enhancement of the efficiency of an InGaN/GaN quantum well (QW) light-emitting diode (LED) through QW coupling with surface plasmons generated on Ag nano-gratings by inserting a SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> layer between semiconductor and metal is demonstrated.

articleTitle: “Laser fusion for laser jocks: Basic principles and laser applications meeting a grand challenge”
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Controlled nuclear fusion has long been sought as a global energy source and ignition of a laser fusion target will soon be realized. Fundamentals and requirements for this ultimate laser application will be presented.

articleTitle: Silicon microring modulator with integrated heater and temperature sensor for thermal control
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The first demonstration of a silicon microring modulator with both an integrated resistive heater and diode-based temperature sensor is shown. The temperature-sensor exhibits a linear response for more than an 85°C external temperature range.

articleTitle: Low loss broadband transmission in optimized core-shape Kagome hollow-core PCF
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A Kagome-lattice hollow-core photonic crystal fiber with a hypocycloid-shaped core enhances the coupling-inhibition between the core- and cladding-modes, thus providing an optical attenuation <250dB/km. This rivals the state-of-the-art photonic bandgap hollow-core fibers is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Low-power high-speed silicon microdisk modulators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel silicon microdisk modulator with “error-free” ~3 femtojoule/bit modulation at 12.5Gbs has been demonstrated. Modulation with a 1 volt swing allows for compatibility with current and future digital logic CMOS electronics.

articleTitle: Plasmonically-enhanced localization of light into photoconductive antennas
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present plasmonically-enhanced photoconductive antenna arrays and experimentally demonstrate enhanced light localization into device dimensions less than one-tenth of the wavelength. We present the fabrication and characterization of the device.

articleTitle: Ultra-wide-range multi-rate DPSK laser communications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a scalable high-sensitivity approach for achieving multi-rate DPSK using a single transmitter and fixed-interferometer-receiver design. Near-theoretical real-time performance is demonstrated over static and fading channels at rates from 2.4Mbps to 2.5Gbps.

articleTitle: Self-configuring athermal tunable DS-DBR laser for passive optical networks
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a self-tuning athermal laser suitable for PON applications. The cooler-less laser operates up to 70°C with a wavelength accuracy of better than 0.1nm over a 36nm range using an open loop control circuit.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s operation of monolithic all-optical set-reset Flip-Flop based on semiconductor ring laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A monolithic semiconductor ring laser is operated as an all-optical Flip-Flop triggered by 4ps optical pulses. Bit-Error-Rate measurements of Set-Reset switchings under the injection of a Pseudo-Random-Bit-Sequence at 5 and 10 Gb/s have been performed.

articleTitle: Photonic integrated circuits for high-speed communications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We review demonstrated complex monolithic photonic integrated circuits (PICs) designed for high-speed fiber-optic communication systems. We focus on PICs that deliver or receive advanced modulation formats.

articleTitle: Low-power CMOS-driven transmitters and receivers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Multimode optical transmitters and receivers are demonstrated with record low power consumptions and at data rates up to 20 Gb/s using 90-nm CMOS analog integrated circuits and GaAs-based VCSELs and photodiodes.

articleTitle: Low cross-talk design of multi-core fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Multicore fibers have exciting potential, motivating design of low-crosstalk fibers. Bend-induced shifts in coupling resonances play a crucial role in modeling cross-talk even for the extremely gentle bends expected for buried fiber.

articleTitle: Microwave photonics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Microwave photonics is the use of photonic techniques for the generation, transmission, processing and reception of signals having spectral components at microwave frequencies. This tutorial reviews the technologies used and gives applications examples.

articleTitle: Dispersion-compensation-free, long-reach OCDMA-PON system with passive remote node at arbitrary position using single multi-port encoder/decoder
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose flexible, long-reach OCDMA-PON system, which deploys a remote node with single multi-port E/D. 10 Gbps, 4-user, OCDMA transmission both up- and down-link are experimentally demonstrated over 59 km SSMF without inline dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Broadband CMOS-compatible silicon photonic electro-optic switch for photonic networks-on-chip
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Error-free switching of up to 40-Gb/s data using a silicon photonic microring resonator electro-optic switch is demonstrated for the first time, with bit-error-rate and power penalty characterizations firmly establishing its feasibility for high-performance photonic networks-on-chip.

articleTitle: A surface plasmon polariton absorption modulator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A new compact electrically controlled surface plasmon polariton (SPP) absorption modulator operating at communication wavelengths is introduced. The modulator is controlled by changing the free carrier density and thereby the propagation loss of the SPP.

articleTitle: 235-ring coupled-resonator optical waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Silicon microring coupled-resonator optical waveguides (CROWs) with up to 235 unit cells are fabricated and measured. These are the longest CROW structures made, and both amplitude and group delay variation measurements are reported.

articleTitle: Broadband silicon photonic switch integrated with CMOS drive electronics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A CMOS driver and broadband silicon photonic switch are co-designed and wire-bond packaged. The integrated switch demonstrates less than 2.1-ns transition times, better than 15-dB extinction, and 5.9-mW total power consumption.

articleTitle: Subpicosecond 200GHz soliton laser based on a C-MOS compatible integrated microring resonator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a subpicosecond, 200 GHz-repetition rate, passively mode-locked laser based on high-harmonic four-wave mixing in an integrated CMOS-compatible high-Q nonlinear ring resonator.

articleTitle: 850 nm VCSELs for up to 40 Gbit/s short reach data links
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report near-temperature-insensitive, highly linear oxide-confined directly modulated 850 nm-range VCSEL chips and fiber-coupled subassemblies operating up to 40 Gbit/s at <; 10 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with a rise-time <; 10 ps at up to 100°C.

articleTitle: All-optical switch involving Fano resonance in ultrasmall photonic crystal nanocavities
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a Fano scheme consisting of ultrasmall photonic crystal nanocavities, and observe the asymmetric transmission spectrum. All-optical switching with a 1 fJ pump energy and an 18 ps time window is also successfully estimated.

articleTitle: Generation of highly stable microwave signals based on regenerative fiber mode locking laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Microwave signal generation based on regenerative fiber mode-locked laser is proposed. The excellent stability proved by noise performance at X-band is guaranteed at ultra-high frequencies (above W band) where electronic generators strongly degrade.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 10.7-Gb/s transmission in 50-km PON with uncooled free-running 1550-nm VCSEL
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: First-known demonstration of an uncooled, free-running 1550 nm VCSEL at 10.7 Gb/s over 50 km PON uplink with 35 km SMF and 15 km inverse dispersion fiber, achieving 24 dB margin for 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−9</sup> BER.

articleTitle: Darker than black: radiation-absorbing metamaterial
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Taking advantage of the broadband “super-singularity” in the density of states of hyperbolic metamaterials, we develop a new approach to radiation-absorbing systems and present an experimental realization of this concept.

articleTitle: High power 1060 nm ridge waveguide lasers with low-index quantum barriers for narrow divergence angle
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Combining low-index quantum-barriers with thick (8.6 μm) waveguide in a multi-QW 1060-nm epi-structure enabled a vertical divergence of <; 9°. 30 W broad-area and 0.8 W single-transverse-mode operation ridge-waveguide devices are demonstrated using these vertical designs.

articleTitle: Quantum noise limited and entanglement-assisted magnetometry
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a radio frequency atomic magnetometer with sub-femtoTesla/√(Hz) sensitivity, mainly limited by projection noise of atoms. Furthermore, we demonstrate that Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen entanglement of atoms enhances the sensitivity to broadband magnetic fields.

articleTitle: 3D stand-up metamaterials with a purely magnetic resonance at terahertz frequencies
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 3D stand-up metamaterial with purely magnetic resonance at THz frequencies was demonstrated and characterized. The successful design, fabrication and characterization of 3D metamaterials provides a new pathway for implementing novel electromagnetic properties at terahertz frequencies.

articleTitle: Controlling fluorescence resonance energy transfer (FRET) by optical confinement in a λ/2-microresonator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: FRET plays an important role in light-induced processes in life sciences, e.g. energy transfer in light harvesting complexes. We present a method to tune the energy transfer from donor to acceptor in an optical microresonator.

articleTitle: Evanescent excitation of plasmonic nanodisks using hybrid guided wave silicon nitride structures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a hybrid scheme in which light is coupled into gold nanodisks from a silicon nitride waveguide or travelling wave resonator. Large field enhancements in the vicinity of the nanodisk resonator can be achieved.

articleTitle: Slow-light silicon Mach-Zehnder modulator based-on cascaded ring resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Slow-light Mach-Zehnder modulator on SOI substrate is developed, which utilizes cascaded ring resonators in all-pass filter configuration. A fabricated device shows seven-fold enhancement in modulation efficiency, compared with a conventional modulator.

articleTitle: Forward error correction (FEC) in optical communication
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Error-control coding is becoming increasingly important, in combination with advanced modulation methods, for improving the spectral efficiency of optical communication systems. This tutorial reviews fundamental limits on and promising practical architectures for modern FEC methods.

articleTitle: Superradiant emission from a tapered quantum-dot semiconductor diode emitter
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Superradiant emission pulses from a quantum-dot tapered device are generated on demand at repetition rates of up to 5 MHz. The pulses have durations as short as 320 fs at a wavelength of 1270 nm.

articleTitle: Large tunable delay of an RF photonic signal with 130 GHz bandwidth using silicon microresonators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a tunable-delay of 154ps of a 130GHz bandwidth RF signal using silicon microresonators. To delay such high bandwidth without distortion, we delay an equivalent signal with a much smaller bandwidth (20GHz single sideband) while preserving the original signal's phase.

articleTitle: A tunable optical channelizing filter using silicon coupled ring resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a wavelength-tunable optical channelizing filter with a high extinction ratio (50 dB), a narrow bandwidth (2.4 GHz), and a large free spectral range (50 GHz) using high-order coupled silicon rings.

articleTitle: Femtosecond operation and random quasi-phase-matched self-doubling of ceramic Cr:ZnSe laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A 100-fs Cr:ZnSe laser, based on a ceramic active medium, generates 100 mW at 215 MHz repetition rate around 2450 nm. Co-propagating second-harmonic pulse at 1225 nm is simultaneously generated due to random quasi-phase-matching process.

articleTitle: Integration of nano-photonic devices for CMOS chip-to-chip optical I/O
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This paper describes an optical interconnect solution based on a monolithic photonic CMOS architecture. A photonic CMOS process enables higher bandwidth and lower energy-per-bit for chip-to-chip optical I/O through integration of electro-optical polymer based modulators, silicon nitride waveguides and polycrystalline germanium (Ge) photodetectors in a CMOS logic process. Experimental results for both the photonic CMOS ring resonator modulators and Ge detectors demonstrate 40 Gb/s performance.

articleTitle: Carrierless amplitude and phase modulation for low-cost, high-spectral-efficiency optical datacommunication links
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Carrierless amplitude and phase modulation for next-generation datacommunication links is considered for the first time. Low-cost implementation of a high-spectral-efficiency 10 Gb/s channel is demonstrated as a route to links at 40 Gb/s and beyond.

articleTitle: Sub-Rayleigh imaging via N-photon detection
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate resolution enhancement beyond the Rayleigh diffraction limit using an N-photon detection strategy that is implemented with a single-photon imager. Experimental results are in good agreement with theory proposed by Giovannetti et al. [1].

articleTitle: Efficient lithium niobate waveguide for wide-dynamic-range wavelength conversion
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report an accurate measurement of χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup> nonlinear optical effects and wide wavelength-conversion dynamic range of 50 dB in lithium niobate waveguide. Linear responses of DF power to pump and signal light are also obtained.

articleTitle: Stable and wavelength-tunable high-speed short pulse generation from a rational harmonic mode-locked short-cavity fiber laser using a bismuth-based erbium-doped fiber and a bismuth-based nonlinear fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a rational harmonic mode-locked short-cavity laser employing a bismuth-oxide-based erbium-doped fiber and a bismuth-oxide-based highly nonlinear fiber. Stable short pulses up to 40 GHz are obtained over the wavelength tuning range covering the CL-band.

articleTitle: More than 1000-nm-wide Mid-IR frequency comb based on divide-by-2 optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We implement a new approach for creating broadband mid-infrared frequency combs via degenerate divide-by-2 optical parametric oscillator. It was pumped by a 1560-nm femtosecond Er-fiber laser and produced > 1000-nm-wide frequency comb centered at 3.1μm.

articleTitle: Multi-heterodyne characterization of multi-gigahertz spaced optical frequency comb sources
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Mixing products between frequency combs with detuned repetition rates are used to characterize multi-gigahertz spaced optical frequency combs generated from mode-locked semiconductor lasers. Time domain RF waveform measurements show effective sampling of the optical waveform.

articleTitle: High-index-contrast single output teardrop laser fabricated via oxygen-enhanced non-selective oxidation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A high-index-contrast single output teardrop laser fabricated via oxygen-enhanced non-selective wet oxidation is demonstrated. The device offers a low (55 mA) threshold and high (138 mW) output power from a single, uncoated output facet.

articleTitle: Novel inverse-tone High Contrast Grating reflector
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a new type of subwavelength grating, which provides ultrahigh reflectivity when embedded in a high refractive index medium. It is therefore an ideal candidate to replace the bulky bottom DBR reflectors in VCSELs.

articleTitle: Tunable high speed silicon microring modulator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a 12.5 Gbps silicon micro-ring modulator achieved by carrier depletion in a lateral pn diode. Tunability of the resonant wavelength is accomplished by means of a microheater, with an efficiency of 2.36 mW/nm.

articleTitle: All-fiber phase-locked multi-core photonic crystal fiber laser with fill-factor enhancement and high efficiency
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report large-mode-area Yb-doped 6-core photonic crystal fiber laser in in-phase supermode operation. A monolithic Talbot device, enhancing the fill-factor in fiber and central-lobe fraction in the far-field profile, was demonstrated with 84% slope efficiency.

articleTitle: Current status of the HERACLES, a millijoule level, multi kHz, few-cycle, and CEP stabilized OPCPA system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A cryogenic-cooling free, few-cycle, carrier-envelope-phase stabilized OPCPA designed to operate at repetition rates as high as 25 kHz with millijoule level energy is presented. Motivation, design issues and current state of the system are reported.

articleTitle: Cryogenic optical characterization of nonlinear polymers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a second-order electro-optic coefficient r<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">33</sub> of 155±5 pm/V at a telecommunication wavelength of 1550 nm from nonlinear poled polymer thin films at a cryogenic temperature of ~4.2 Kelvin using a reflection ellipsometry technique.

articleTitle: Internal quantum efficiency measurement in InGaN/GaN UV LEDs with patterned sapphire substrate by photoluminescence and electroluminescence method
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Internal quantum efficiency (IQE) of InGaN-based ultraviolet light emitting diodes (LED) grown on patterned sapphire substrate (PSS) and flat sapphire were measured by photoluminescence and electroluminescence methods. The IQE improvement of PSS LED is significant.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal defects with increased surface area for improved refractive index sensing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photonic crystal cavities with tunable surface area via multiple-hole defects were investigated for increased resonance wavelength shifts upon exposure to variable-index analytes. Sensitivity was improved by 10% compared to simulated solid L3 cavities.

articleTitle: Monolithic silicon photonic crystal fiber tip sensor for refractive index and temperature sensing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that monolithic 2-dimensional silicon photonic crystals confined to the facet of single-mode optical fibers are capable of determining refractive index and temperature of a sample simultaneously from reflectivity measured at two different wavelengths.

articleTitle: Nonlinear nanocomposites for three-dimensional photonic crystals using two-photon polymerization
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed a novel nanocomposite consisting of an organic-inorganic hybrid polymer modified with PbS quantum dots. The uniformally dispersed nanocomposite has high third-order nonlinearity and has been proven to be suitable for photonic crystal fabrication.

articleTitle: Rare-earth doped optical fiber fabrication using novel gas phase deposition technique
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a highly versatile gas phase technique for making ytterbium doped silica fibers. Initial results generated 200W output power with a slope efficiency of 72%.

articleTitle: Photonic devices in low-temperature laser-crystallized deposited silicon
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate integrated optical devices in deposited silicon crystallized at room temperature for 3D photonic integration. These devices can enable electro-optic switching and modulation on low-temperature substrates such as glass, plastic, and post-back-end CMOS wafers.

articleTitle: All-optical swicthing by optical Kerr effect in AlGaAs photonic crystal slab waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have succeeded all-optical Mach-Zehnder type switch by optical Kerr effect around 1550nm in AlGaAs photonic crystal slab waveguide. We also studied nonlinear refractive index n'<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in this waveguide.

articleTitle: Coherent beam combining of fiber amplifiers and solid-state lasers, including the use of diffractive optical elements
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Two significant coherent combining solid state laser systems will be described. One approach uses a fiber optic amplifier array and the other uses 7 tiled slab amplifier chains. The first of these demonstrated very high efficiency and near perfect beam quality. The 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> of these approaches reached a world record 105 kW of power CW.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave solid-state polymer laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Stable, continuous-wave laser emission near 1060 nm for a period of at least 2 h was demonstrated in polymer channel waveguides doped with a Nd-complex. Lasing was also achieved on the 878-nm, quasi-three-level transition.

articleTitle: A novel method of pump and idler signal generation for non-degenerate FWM based phase sensitive amplification
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a novel scheme for generating pump and idler optical waves phase aligned to an input signal carrier for phase sensitive amplification.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation and comparison of DPSK CoWDM systems based on odd/even and array configurations
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A practical implementation of a 31.99Gbit/s DPSK CoWDM system using a 3-modulator array is compared to a 2-modulator odd/even configuration in terms of receiver sensitivity and phase influence on the crosstalk between the sub-carriers.

articleTitle: Opto-fluidic characterization of nonlinear-optical waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Opto-fluidic technique demonstrated non-destructive characterization of nonlinear optical waveguide by modifying effective index of optical mode. Nonuniformity of phase matching wavelength, degradation factor of NLO performance, is revealed in a waveguide wavelength converter.

articleTitle: Third harmonic generation in uniform fibre nanotapers via intermodal coupling
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Third harmonic generation in fibre nanotapers by intermodal coupling is experimentally characterized. UV radiation is generated from a pulsed 1064 nm laser in a 3 cm taper of 492 nm diameter.

articleTitle: High precision calibration of spectrographs in astronomy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An Yb-fiber frequency comb was developed and employed to calibrate an astronomical spectrograph. The repeatability was photon noise limited at 300kHz. Absolute accuracy was improved by a factor of 20 compared to traditional calibration sources.

articleTitle: 10Gb/s error free transmission through micro-structured multimode polymer optical fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time 10Gb/s error-free transmission through two differently micro-structured-multimode polymer fibers. Results show excellent transmission characteristics for these fibers and demonstrate that micro-structuring can significantly improve the bandwidth of multimode-polymer fibers.

articleTitle: Generation of 65-fs ultrashort pulses at 1030-nm center wavelength directly from Kerr-lens mode-locked Yb∶YAG laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ultrashort pulse oscillation of 65-fs was obtained directly from a laser-diode pumped Kerr-lens mode-locked Yb:YAG laser with an intracavity nonlinear medium. The pulse-width is shorter than the fourier transform limit by the fluorescence of Yb:YAG.

articleTitle: 1 GHz femtosecond erbium-doped fiber lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Saturable Bragg reflector (SBR) mode-locked Er-doped fiber lasers around 1550nm with a repetition rate of 1GHz are demonstrated. Key steps to obtain stable, femtosecond pulses by avoiding thermal damage of the SBR are discussed.

articleTitle: Dual wavelength gain guided broad area semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A monolithically integrated dual wavelength semiconductor laser for optical heterodyning is presented. We present a novel laser design which employs surface etched DBR gratings in order to obtain lasing at very narrow line widths.

articleTitle: High-Rate quantum key distribution with superconducting nanowire single photon detectors
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the potential for 1.85 Mbit/s secure key rates over 101 km of fiber, >100 times faster than previously demonstrated, using the differential phase shift quantum key distribution protocol and superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors.

articleTitle: Measurement of solder ball height and shape defects using a visible supercontinuum based line scan interferometer
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We identify shape defects on ~300 μm high solder balls by measuring the 3D profile over +/-20 degrees down the ball surface. A broadband line scan interferometer enables measurement of ball height with 125 nm axial resolution.

articleTitle: Numerical and experimental investigation for a resonant optothermoacoustic sensor
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A theoretical study of a resonant optothermoacoustic sensor employing a laser source and a quartz tuning fork receiver validates experimental results showing that the source should be positioned near the base of the receiver.

articleTitle: Adaptive optical phase estimation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally performed adaptive phase estimation using time-symmetric quantum smoothing for a stochastically varying phase on continuous wave coherent beam. We demonstrate better accuracy than conventional methods.

articleTitle: Photo darkening of ytterbium fiber lasers and amplifiers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photo darkening (PD) of ytterbium co-doped silica fibers in lasers and amplifiers is experimentally investigated and a numeric model for PD is proposed. Relaxation to well-defined equilibrium state of core PD is observed both for unseeded amplifier and high power fiber laser operation, depending on the Yb inversion and output power flux.

articleTitle: Observation of soliton pulse compression in photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate soliton-effect pulse compression in mm-long photonic crystal waveguides resulting from strong anomalous dispersion and self-phase modulation. Compression from 3ps to 580fs, at low pulse energies(∼10pJ), is measured via autocorrelation.

articleTitle: Nonlinear frequency generation of high-power polarisation vortices in optical fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We exploit stimulated-Raman-scattering to generate polarisation-vortices over 3-Stokes-shifts (40-THz) with a specially-designed optical fiber. This illustrates the possibility of generating these beams, of immense recent interest, at any wavelength that nonlinear processes in glass allow.

articleTitle: Automatic recognition of diverse 3-D objects and analysis of large urban scenes using ground and aerial LIDAR sensors
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe a learning-based 3D object recognition pipeline developed under the DARPA URGENT program for analyzing a large LIDAR dataset collected by both airborne and ground platforms for an extended urban area. Our approach utilizes a novel strip-based cueing approach that incorporates the properties and context of urban objects. Strip-based cueing segments potential objects and assigns them to appropriate classification stages. Our learning-based recognition pipeline successfully recognized 17 3D object classes in LIDAR data collected in and over Ottawa, Canada with high efficiency and average accuracy of 70%.

articleTitle: Plasmonic aerogel doped with gold nanoparticles
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed a new technique to incorporate gold nanoparticles into silica aerogel without aggregation. Such a doped “plasmonic” aerogel can be used for nonlinear optical experiments and plasmonic sensing.

articleTitle: Nonlinear disorder mapping via three wave mixing in poled Lithium Tantalate
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce and test a simple approach for the characterization of domain distribution in bulk quadratic ferroelectric crystals, such as periodically poled Lithium Tantalate with random mark-to space ratio.

articleTitle: Optical carrier regeneration for wavelength reusable multicarrier distributed OADM network
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate optical carrier regeneration for wavelength reuse in a multicarrier distributed OADM network. It is possible to achieve a high-quality regenerated signal even though the employed data signal for wavelength reuse is drastically degraded.

articleTitle: Digital noise-tolerant silicon nanophotonic switch
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Error-free switching performance of a digital electro-optic silicon switch based on multi-stage Mach-Zehnder lattice is demonstrated. Robust crosstalk levels of lower than -15dB are obtained for drive-voltage noise levels exceeding 300mV while maintaining error-free operation.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of dynamic properties of high speed SOA with a tunnel injection structure
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We provide numerically simulated dynamic properties of a SOA with a tunnel-injection structure considering tunneling current and biased potential. As result, the tunneling injection SOA has potential of 40 Gbit/s or more high-speed operation.

articleTitle: Mid-IR frequency comb upconversion spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a mid-infrared frequency comb generated via differency frequency mixing of a Yb femtosecond fiber laser. After passing through a methane gas sample, the MIR comb is upconverted and dispersed onto a CCD for detection.

articleTitle: Nanoporous polymer liquid core waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate liquid core waveguides defined by UV to enable selective water infiltration in nanoporous polymers, creating an effective refractive index shift Δn=0.13. The mode confinement and propagation loss in these waveguides are presented.

articleTitle: Silicon-carbide-based two-dimensional photonic crystal nanocavities
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the first silicon-carbide-based photonic crystal nanocavities operated at a wide range of 500~1400 nm. Furthermore, we show that two-photon absorption in the cavity is completely inhibited even at ultra-high-energy light (~1550 nm) input.

articleTitle: Ultra-fast integrated all-optical integrator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the experimental demonstration of ultra-high speed temporal integration of optical complex waveforms by using an integrated and CMOS compatible micro-ring resonator. The device offers an unprecedented processing speed > 400 GHz.

articleTitle: Generation of compressed optical pulses beyond 160 GHz based on two injection-locked CW lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Two CW signals separated by either 160GHz or 200GHz are phase locked to each other and combined together forming a highly stable pulsed seed for a nonlinear compressor based on four-wave mixing in fibre.

articleTitle: In-plane MEMS tunable Gires-Tournois interferometers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present MEMS tunable Gires-Tournois interferometers (GTIs) based on deeply etched Bragg reflectors. The broad reflection bandwidth (~100 nm) of the Bragg reflectors allows operation over almost the whole C and L bands with a single cavity, while the in-plane configuration allows the design of a wide range of cavity length (i.e. free spectral range). Applications such as fast tunable dispersion compensation in optical fiber networks are expected.

articleTitle: 1500-km transmission of 100-Gb/s coherent PM-QPSK with 10 cascaded 50-GHz wavelength selective switches
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally penalty-free transmission of 127-Gb/s coherent PM-QPSK signals through 10 cascaded 50-GHz commercial WSS over 1500-km SMF. Simulation results show that more than 40 cascades of such 50-GHz liquid-crystal based WSS is feasible.

articleTitle: Attosecond resolution timing jitter characterization of diode pumped femtosecond Cr:LiSAF lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Two diode pumped Cr:LiSAF lasers are synchronized using a balanced nonlinear optical cross correlator. An integrated timing jitter of less than 156 as in the 10 kHz to 10 MHz range is measured.

articleTitle: 25 Gbps direct modulation in 1.3-µm InAs/GaAs high-density quantum dot lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The modulation characteristics of 1.3-µm InAs/GaAs high-density quantum-dot lasers is presented. The eight-stacked high-density quantum-dot layers provided high net modal gain of 46 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>. Fabricated Fabry-Perot lasers showed the 25-Gbps direct modulation.

articleTitle: Ultrafast, single-shot phase and amplitude measurement via a temporal imaging approach
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate single-shot measurement of the phase and amplitude of an ultrafast waveform using time-magnification and heterodyning with simple external clock synchronization.

articleTitle: Design of low-loss arrayed waveguide gratings for applications in integrated Raman spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An integrated low-loss arrayed waveguide grating is designed for Raman spectroscopy of the human skin. The device layout targets spectral analysis of Raman-scattered light for in vivo determination of water concentration in the stratum corneum.

articleTitle: Eleven-channel second-order silicon microring-resonator filterbank with tunable channel spacing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A wide-band eleven-channel second-order filterbank fabricated on an SOI platform is demonstrated with tunable channel spacing and 20 GHz single-channel bandwidths. The tuning efficiency is ~28 μW/GHz/ring.

articleTitle: 1.3-GHz, 20-W, femtosecond chirped-pulse amplifier system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated a 1.3-GHz, Yb:KYW Kerr-lens mode-locked oscillator and a chirped-pulse amplifier system by using a double-clad Yb-doped fiber. The pulse duration of 180 fs was obtained with the average power of 20 W.

articleTitle: High-intensity bessel-gauss beam enhancement cavities
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An enhancement cavity design with significant intensity gain from the mirror surfaces to the focus and larger than millimeter sized apertures in the cavity mirrors is presented. A continuous-wave version of the cavity is demonstrated.

articleTitle: High-harmonic generation in strongly driven bulk periodic solid
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on high-order harmonic generation from bulk zinc-oxide driven by a strong mid-infrared laser pulse. The harmonic spectra extend well above the band-gap and scales non-perturbatively with the laser intensity.

articleTitle: Nanosecond pulse amplification in a higher-order mode erbium-doped fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The nonlinear properties of a nanosecond pulse in a higher-order-mode, Er-doped-fiber amplifier with 2440 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> effective area are compared to a conventional 880 μm2 area fiber. Both 1480 nm pump and 1554 nm signal propagate in the LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">09</sub> mode.

articleTitle: Integrated device with three mutually coupled DFB lasers for tunable, narrow linewidth, mm-wave signal generation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An integrated monolithic device where two DFB lasers are phase-locked via mutual injection, assisted by a Four-Wave-Mixing process that takes place in an auxiliary DFB, generates a spectrally pure tunable mm-wave signal.

articleTitle: Enhanced sensitivity in optofluidic photonic crystal slab biosensors
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Guided resonances in photonic crystal slabs exhibit important qualities for sensing applications. We demonstrate, through simulation and experiment, enhanced sensitivity and differences in properties between TE- and TM-like guided resonances in biosensing.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum generation in tapered fibres embedded in silica aerogel
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate spectral broadening in tapered optical fibres embedded in silica aerogel. The aerogel provides protection to the taper without noticeably affecting the refractive and dispersive properties or power handling.

articleTitle: High spatial resolution distributed fiber sensor using Raman scattering in single-mode fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a distributed fiber temperature sensor based on Raman scattering in single-mode fiber. Using low-timing jitter superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors, we are able to achieve spatial resolution as fine as 1 cm.

articleTitle: 100-nm internal gain bandwidth in Er:Yb-doped phospho-tellurite waveguides written by femtosecond laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Waveguides were femtosecond laser-written in Er:Yb-doped phospho-tellurite glass yielding internal gain across an unprecedented 100-nm bandwidth covering the whole C+L communications bands. The waveguide modes were highly confined, showing promise for improved photonic integration.

articleTitle: 1 Hz operation of a gain-saturated 10.9 nm table-top laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a gain-saturated 10.9 nm table-top soft x-ray laser operating at 1 Hz repetition rate. With an average power of 1 mW and pulse energy up to ~2 mJ this laser extends a shorter wavelength the ability to conduct table-top laser experiments.

articleTitle: Observation of intrinsic spin Hall effect in semiconductors
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The intrinsic spin Hall effect is observed in undoped GaAs quantum-well samples by temporally resolving the current generation process in the ballistic regime, where the extrinsic spin Hall effect is absent.

PACS Terms: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Ultrafast temporal phase detection using thick nonlinear crystals
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated that second-harmonic generation yield due to a thick nonlinear crystal is sensitive to temporal phase of ultrashort pulses, which could be useful in temporal chirp monitoring and ultrafast coherent communications.

articleTitle: THz field detection of the coherent synchrotron radiation produced by laser bunch slicing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Electric field of coherent synchrotron radiation produced by laser bunch slicing at a storage ring has been measured for the first time. A 24 m-long fiber was used to deliver the probe for electro-optic sampling.

articleTitle: Gain recovery in columnar quantum dot SOA at 1550 nm
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the experimental characterization of the gain recovery of a columnar-quantum-dot SOA (CQD-SOA) at 1550 nm. We find a three-step recovery process that allows 85% gain recovery in 10 ps and 100% in 30 ps.

articleTitle: Bismuth-doped fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We will discuss the luminescence, gain and lasing properties of Bi-doped fibers of different core composition. Bi-doped fiber amplifiers operating in the wavelength range 1300-1500 nm with peak gain >20dB are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Si-Ge surface-normal asymmetric Fabry-Perot electroabsorption modulator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The strong electroabsorption modulation possible using the quantum-confined Stark effect in Ge/SiGe quantum wells provides the working mechanism for efficient, CMOS-compatible photonic integrated modulators. We describe such a device employing a surface-normal asymmetric Fabry-Perot design.

articleTitle: Multi-wavelength femtosecond pump-probe characterization of 1550 nm InAs/InP quantum dash optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first multi wavelength, ultra fast pump probe characterization of an inhomogeneous broadened, nanostructure gain media. We identify different physical mechanisms that govern the dynamics at the different energies.

articleTitle: Temperature-dependent coherently controlled photocurrent generation in epitaxial graphene
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study the electron-temperature dependence of optically injected coherently controlled ballistic currents in epitaxial graphene by near field THz detection in cryostat and optical pre-pulse excitation of background hot carriers.

articleTitle: Effect of gain-dependent phase shift for all-optical tunable Mach-Zehnder interferometers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A differential gain-dependent phase shift between the core- and cladding-mode can be efficiently and all-optically tuned by a cw 975 nm pump light for Mach-Zehnder interferometers using successive abrupt fiber tapers on a 1.2-cm-long Er/Yb-codoped fiber.

articleTitle: Two photon emission, entanglement and gain from semiconductors at room temperature
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The first observation of two-photon emission from semiconductors and its applications are presented theoretically and experimentally. Entanglement sources are proposed and two-photon gain is measured in electrically-pumped devices at room temperature, promising giant pulse generation.

articleTitle: Line-by-line control towards 10-THz repetition rate arbitrary optical waveform generation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the line-by-line control of 10-THz frequency spacing Raman sidebands produced through an adiabatic Raman process. We finely control the spectral phase of the sidebands to the target flat-relative-spectral phase.

articleTitle: Enhancement of transmission by optimization of crystal structure of silicon-core optical fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Silicon-core optical fibers were fabricated by the “rod-in-tube” method. Optical losses were reduced to the level of 11-12 dB/cm in a wavelength range of 1.5-6.7 μm owing to a post-drawing treatment similar to zone melting.

articleTitle: High-energy femtosecond fiber lasers based on dissipative solitons
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Short-pulse fiber lasers based on dissipative-soliton formation offer major performance and practical advantages over prior fiber lasers. Recent developments will be reviewed.

articleTitle: Detection and sizing of single nanoparticles by mode splitting in an optical microresonator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate detection and sizing of single nanoparticles down to 30 nm by monitoring the mode splitting induced by a nanoparticle in an ultra-high quality factor (UHQ) microtoroid. Theory and methods are discussed.

articleTitle: Deterministic design of ultrahigh Q and small mode volume photonic crystal nanobeam cavity
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A deterministic design of an ultrahigh Q, subwavelength mode volume, photonic crystal nanobeam cavity, operating at the target frequency, is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. Nonlinear bistability is observed in such nanobeam cavities fabricated in Si at very low pump powers.

articleTitle: Isolated attosecond pulses generated directly from a femtosecond chirped pulse amplifier
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using a generalized version of double optical gating, we produced single isolated attosecond pulses with 2 mJ, 25 fs driving lasers. Through attosecond streaking, we characterized isolated 160 attosecond pulses with 170 pJ pulse energy.

articleTitle: Diamond Raman lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We summarize our recent research in Raman lasers based on undoped single crystal diamond. Highly efficient visible external cavity lasers operating in nanosecond and picosecond regimes are reported.

articleTitle: Ppb standoff detection of nitric oxide in air
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate standoff detection of NO in air with ppb resolution. The weakly ionized plasma produced by picosecond UV laser pulses via REMPI is detected remotely by a microwave scattering technique.

articleTitle: Picosecond fiber MOPA pumped supercontinuum source with 39 W output power
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report picosecond fiber MOPA pumped supercontinuum source with 39 W output, spanning at least 0.4-1.75 μm with high and relatively uniform spectral power density of ~31.7 mW/nm corresponding to peak power density of ~12.5 W/nm in 20 ps pulse.

articleTitle: Influence of index depressions in active large pitch fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The analysis of the influence of a core index depression on the higher-order mode discrimination and the beam quality of the fundamental mode in different designs of active large pitch photonic crystal fibers is discussed.

articleTitle: Direct observations of UV extraordinary optical transmission and localized field enhancement through nanoslits
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The UV extraordinary optical transmission through nanoslit structures in the far-field and localized field enhancement in the near-field are both directly observed. Numerical modeling results are also presented, showing good agreement with the experiment results.

articleTitle: High repetition rate, tunable femtosecond Yb-fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using only a short piece of gain fiber, a 570 MHz Yb-fiber oscillator was set up and mode-locked via NPE, assisted by spectral filtering. Tuning the filter enables changing both center wavelength or optical bandwidth.

articleTitle: Pulsed and continuous-wave squeezed vacuum in a rubidium vapor
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present studies on the generation of continuous-wave and pulsed squeezed vacuum via nonlinear polarization rotation in a rubidium vapor, with a value of -1.4 dB (- 2.0 corrected, continuous-wave) and -1.0 dB (-1.4 corrected, pulsed).

articleTitle: Nano-coupling and enhancement in plasmonic conical needle
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Efficient coupling and power concentration of radially-polarized light in conical plasmonic needle is presented. Needle length dependent resonances are calculated. Radial plasmonic DBR with needle as defect was fabricated for NSOM and nonlinear conversion experiments.

articleTitle: The evolution of photoinduced photonic crystal cavities during writing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present results showing the formation and evolution of a photonic crystal cavity during writing by selective optical exposure in a photosensitive chalcogenide photonic crystal. Q-factors of up to 125,000 were obtained in these cavities.

articleTitle: One-way extraordinary transmission and nonreciprocal plasmons
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We predict that the engineered spoof surface plasmons supported by structured conductors in magneto-optical environment may exhibit nonreciprocal dispersion. We suggest the geometries where this property results in nonreciprocal optical response observed as one-way extraordinary optical transmission.

articleTitle: Actively stabilised quantum key distribution operating continuously at 1 Mbit/s
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the continuous operation of an actively stabilised gigahertz clocked quantum key distribution (QKD) system, with an average secure key rate of 1 Mbit/s over a distance of 50 km.

articleTitle: Nonlinear spatio-temporal dynamics of optically-injected three-section tunable DBR lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The travelling-wave method was used to investigate nonlinear spatio-temporal dynamics of a tunable laser under both weak and strong external optical injection. The results suggest effective methods of controlling laser dynamics in network applications.

articleTitle: Radio over free space optical link using a directly modulated two-electrode high power tapered laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The analog modulation performance of a high-power two-electrode tapered laser is investigated. A 25dB dynamic range for 2.4GHz 802.11g signals is achieved with a 26dB loss budget, showing a >1km free space range is possible.

articleTitle: 420 fs pulses from an ultrafast laser inscribed waveguide laser utilizing a carbon nanotube saturable absorber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the generation of 420 fs pulses of 1.56 μm light from a mode-locked ultrafast laser inscribed Er-doped waveguide laser. Passive mode-locking was achieved using a carbon nanotube saturable absorber.

articleTitle: Ultrahigh resolution optical coherence tomography via Ce3+:YAG double-clad crystal fiber source
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel light source, emitted from 10-µm-core Ce<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:YAG double-clad crystal fiber, was applied on optical coherence tomography with 1.5-µm axial resolution in air. The 3-dimensional stroma of fish cornea was mapped as an in-vivo demonstration.

articleTitle: Efficiency droop in GaInN solid-state-lighting devices
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The efficiency droop in GaInN light-emitting diodes (LEDs) is an impediment for the introduction of solid-state lighting technology. The origin of the droop will be discussed along with measures that mitigate the droop.

articleTitle: Efficiency enhancement InGaP/GaAs dual-junction solar cell by Broad-band and Omnidirectional Antireflection Nanorod Arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 10% efficiency enhancement of the solar cell by Broad-band and Omnidirectional Antireflection Nanorod Arrays was demonstrated. The enhanced efficiency attributed to increased light entry and optical path in both the top cell and bottom cell.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional optical transformer - highly efficient nanofocusing device
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using electron-beam-induced deposition and focused-ion-beam milling, we have fabricated and demonstrated a nanofocusing optical transformer with a 3-dimensionally tapered tip. At the tip, the light is confined to 13-by-80-nm area with intensity enhancement exceeding 1500.

articleTitle: Integrated 2 GHz femtosecond laser based on a planar Er-doped lightwave circuit
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An integrated passively mode-locked 2-GHz waveguide laser generating 285-fs pulses is demonstrated. It is based on a 500-MHz repetition rate laser integrated together with a pulse interleaver on a 45×50 mm silica waveguide chip.

articleTitle: GauSsian Minimum Shift Keying for spectrally efficient and dispersion tolerant optical communications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Gaussian Minimum Shift Keying (GMSK) is a spectrally efficient phase modulation based on the gaussian shaping of the transmitted phase. We simulate GMSK dispersion tolerance at 40 Gbps and measure back-to-back BER at 2.5 Gbps.

articleTitle: Hot particle solitons: Self-trapped beams based on thermophoresis in complex fluids
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that strong coupling between light and nanoparticle suspensions, mediated by negative thermophoresis and heat diffusion, gives rise to self-trapping of optical beams.

articleTitle: Generation of stable sub-10 fs pulses at 400 nm in a hollow fiber used for UV pump-probe experiment
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Stable sub-10fs pulses at 400nm were obtained using a beam pointing stabilizer before the hollow fiber compressor system. By using the obtained pulse, we observed the C-H vibration mode of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub> at 2955cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> in real-time.

articleTitle: Temperature compensated sub-metre spatial resolution distributed strain sensor
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Temperature compensated strain sensor measurements are demonstrated with strain resolution of 86uε and spatial resolution of 26cms, utilising temperature dependence of spontaneous Raman scattering for temperature compensated sub-metre spatial resolution Brillouin frequency based strain sensor.

articleTitle: Determining carrier-envelope offset frequencies of passively synchronized mode-locked Yb-fiber and Er-fiber lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Simultaneous determination of both carrier-envelope offset (CEO) frequencies of passively synchronized mode-locked Yb-fiber and Er-fiber lasers has been demonstrated by measuring the heterodyne beats between the Yb-fiber laser and the self-referenced Er-fiber laser combs around 1050 nm.

articleTitle: Stabilizing the carrier-envelope phase of a 30 fs, 1 kHz, 6 mJ Ti: sapphire regenerative amplifier
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Carrier-envelope phase stabilization of a two-stage chirped pulse amplifier laser system with regenerative amplification as the preamplifier is demonstrated with a 90 mrad rms error for a locking period of 4.5 h.

articleTitle: Self-organization of second order NLO activity in chromophore-doped (cyano phenylene sulfide) polymers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report second order NLO activity in chromophore-doped poly (cyano phenylene sulfide), transparent ferroelectric polymer, induced without conventional poling procedure. Non-centrosymmetric structures were self-organized just by sandwiching pair of electrodes with different surface energies.

articleTitle: Subfemtosecond-drift microwave signal synthesis from femtosecond mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A 10-GHz microwave signal is synthesized from a 200-MHz mode-locked Er-fiber laser using a delay-locked loop with relative timing jitter of 2.4-fs (rms) [0.1Hz-1MHz] and timing drift of 0.84-fs (rms) [0.035mHz-1Hz].

articleTitle: Generation of tunable, ultrashort pulses in the near-IR with an OPA system based on BIBO
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using a two stage, white-light seeded, collinear, femtosecond optical parametric amplifier based on BIBO crystals, sub-30-fs signal pulses tunable across the whole spectral range of 1150-1600 nm with energies exceeding 80-μJ are generated.

articleTitle: Limitations to the power output and efficiency of mid-Infrared quantum cascade lasers imposed by transport
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use a density-matrix framework to evaluate the wallplug efficiency of mid-infrared quantum cascade lasers. We assess the limitations to maximum current and internal efficiency, imposed by injection coupling and current leakage, respectively.

articleTitle: Loss and spectral measurements of porous and non-porous subwavelength THz fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present experimental verification of the transmission spectra and low propagation loss (α ≤ 0.02cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) of porous and non-porous subwavelength THz fibers. Porosity creates broader single-mode transmission peaks shifted to higher frequencies.

articleTitle: Coherent control of wavefunctions in 2D Fourier transform optical spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the advantage of coherent control technique in 2D Fourier transform optical spectroscopy on atomic model system. By spectrally shaping individual pulses, we selectively turn on and off target couplings.

articleTitle: Stacked 2D photonic crystal reflectance filters fabricated by nanoreplica molding for improving optical density and angular tolerance
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Nanoreplica molding enables stacking of multiple 2D photonic crystals on a large area plastic substrate to improve optical density and angular tolerance of the resulting narrowband optical limiting filter, used for laser eye/sensor protection.

articleTitle: Direct measurement of electron loss rate in air
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present direct local measurements of electron attachment and recombination rates in atmospheric air. Using a microwave scattering based resonantly enhanced multi-photon ionization scheme we monitor the electron density dynamics with nanosecond resolution.

articleTitle: Micro- and nano- scale system manufacturing using ultrafast lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Microsystems perform sophisticated tasks in miniaturized volumes. Shaping or analyzing light signals, mixing ultra-small volumes of chemicals, sensing mechanical signals, manipulating micro-objects, sequencing bio-molecules are common operations that can be done by these tiny machines. To further advance the field, there is a growing interest for integrated manufacturing platform where optics, fluid handling capabilities or micro-mechanical elements can be combined.

articleTitle: Electromagnetically induced transparency in cesium vapor with a single photon probe beam
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An experimental setup designed to store light pulses inside a cesium vapor cell by employing electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) is described. Probe laser pulses containing ~ 10 photons per pulse are delayed through the EIT effect.

articleTitle: Slow light without electromagnetically-induced transparency: the double-Fano resonance approach
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A new approach to slowing light in plasmonic structures is proposed. We utilize the phenomenon of double-Fano resonance. Specific implementations of such structures based on plasmonic antennas are presented, various applications are outlined.

articleTitle: Hollow-core high-Q micro-cavities in three-dimensional photonic crystals
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Hollow-core micro-cavities with quality factors up to 70,000 are designed in a 3D photonic crystal with only nine structural layers. A six-layer structure with hollow cavities in the 4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> layer has been fabricated.

articleTitle: Oblique airy wavepackets in bidispersive optical media
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that a new class of skewed, non-spreading Airy wavepackets is possible in optical bidispersive systems. Their obliquity is found to have a profound effect on their spatiotemporal acceleration dynamics. Pertinent examples are provided.

articleTitle: Laser oscillator coupling via gain gratings to achieve frequency stable operation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate numerically the feasibility of gain gratings to realize frequency stable coupling of a Q-switched loop resonator to a master oscillator. The model enables the prediction of spectral properties of the laser system.

articleTitle: Characterization of solar cells with high spatial resolution
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Characterization techniques based on measuring the photocurrent of a solar cell under local illumination are introduced. Experiments on test structures and numerical simulations proof the applicability and reliability under realistic conditions and show technical limits.

articleTitle: Twisted chains of resonant nanoparticles: Polarization control, waveguidance, and radiation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Linear arrays of resonant nanoparticles that are sequentially rotated about the array axis display interesting polarization sensitive optical properties. Such “twisted” arrays support two transverse modes with distinct waveguidance and radiation properties.

articleTitle: A terahertz two-wire waveguide with low bending loss
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally and numerically study the propagation of terahertz radiation on a two-wire waveguide. We find that this structure exhibits much lower bending losses than a single wire waveguide.

articleTitle: Statistical hypothesis testing for super-resolution localization imaging at high speed
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We predict a 6-to-15-fold increase in the imaging speed of super-resolution photo-activated localization microscopy using a novel algorithm for estimation of the number of multiple molecules activated simultaneously within a diffraction-limited area.

articleTitle: Super-resolution of images using incoherent light
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a method for reconstructing images beyond the numerical aperture of the imaging system using incoherent light. Our approach can be used for reconstructing sub-wavelength information through measurements taken in the optical far-field.

articleTitle: Observation of Bohmian trajectories of a single photon using weak measurements
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use weak measurements to carry out the first direct observation of the trajectories followed by single photons in a two-slit interferometer. The measured trajectories correspond to those predicted by Bohmian mechanics.

articleTitle: Active plasmon tuning of metal-elastomer nanostructures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Surface plasmon metal-elastomer nanostructures are actively tuned by stretching mechanically-tuneable elastomeric films. Tuneable plasmonic resonances and unusual inter-particle coupling are experimentally demonstrated. Such structures are highly suitable for developing optimal Raman and fluorescence sensors.

articleTitle: 4% conversion of sub-µJ near-IR pulses to deep UV in fundamental mode of Ar-filled PCF
