publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report extreme self-compression of sub-μJ 30 fs pulses at 800 nm in Ar-filled hollow-core PCF, resulting in 4% conversion to deep UV light in the fundamental guided mode, pressure-tunable from 220-270 nm.

articleTitle: Second-order nonlinear optical effects of spin currents
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show by symmetry analysis and microscopic calculation that a pure spin current has sizable second-order nonlinear optical effects. Thus spin currents can be studied by standard nonlinear optical spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Parametric gain shaping in doubly resonant OPOs: theory, experiment and future applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate spectral shaping of the parametric gain in a double-pass doubly resonant OPO. The experimental demonstration is made possible by our specific OPO design that enables the precise control of the backward relative phase.

articleTitle: Image contrast enhancement of optical coherence tomography with Au nanorod-induced localized surface plasmon resonance
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Image contrast enhancement of optical coherence tomography is demonstrated by diffusing Au nanorods into pig adipose for generating localized surface plasmon (LSP) resonance, which is confirmed by comparing with the case of no LSP excitation.

articleTitle: Single-mode emission from Si nanocrystal embedded Si-rich SiOx film with photonic crystal resonant cavity
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A photonic crystal resonator incorporated Si-rich SiOx film with buried Si nanocrystals showing room-temperature single-mode emission at 639 nm is demonstrated with spectral linewidth of 1 nm and threshold pumping intensity of 50.3 kW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Efficient and robust energy transfer network in quantum dot mixtures via optical near-fields interactions
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We theoretically and experimentally investigate an optimal mixture of different-sized quantum dots so that energy transfers via near-field interactions are efficiently induced. We also demonstrate the near-field interaction network provides robustness to tolerate system errors.

articleTitle: Microfluidic SERS using a 3-dimensional porous monolith as a SERS-active solid phase in a microchannel
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: To improve the sensitivity of microfluidic SERS, we constructed an in-situ photopolymerized monolith in a microchannel with embedded silver nanoclusters. Rhodamine-6G was detected easily after passing only 400 fmoles of analyte through the microchannel.

articleTitle: Suppression of harmonic and intermodulation distortion for SCM-WDM RoF systems based on the spectral slicing of optical broadband sources
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This paper presents the experimental evaluation of harmonic and intermodulation distortions in a SCM-WDM RoF scheme based on spectral slicing of an optical broadband source. The insertion of a Mach-Zehnder interferometer suppresses significantly nonlinear terms.

articleTitle: High-speed coupling-modulated lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and demonstrate laser modulation at rates greatly exceeding the relaxation resonance frequency by modulating the output coupler. An erbium fiber laser is modulated at over 10000 times its relaxation resonance frequency.

articleTitle: Force-mediated parametric generation in nano-optomechanical structures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a novel scheme for freely engineering phase matching, enabling efficient parametric generation at arbitrary frequencies in mechanically compliant nano-optomechanical structures.

articleTitle: Full-duplex CATV/ROF transport system with colorless remodulation scheme
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A full-duplex CATV/Radio-over-fiber (ROF) transport system employing a phase modulator as wavelength reuse and remodulation schemes is proposed and demonstrated. Good performances were achieved for downstream and upstream over a 20-km transmission.

articleTitle: Simply measuring the temporal electric field of very complex ultrashort pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using a low-resolution spectrometer, we developed a technique for measuring relatively long and complex ultrashort pulses. It is a spectral-interferometry variation, which we used to measure pulses up to 105 ps with 34 fs resolution.

articleTitle: On-chip beam-steering photonic-crystal lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a novel concept to create beam-steering lasers using photonic crystals. The lasers that we have developed indeed emit beams over a range of directions. The maximum beam steering angle is ∼±30°.

articleTitle: Generation of sub-20 fs deep-ultraviolet pulses using broadband chirped-pulse four-wave mixing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Sub-20 fs deep-ultraviolet pulses were generated without a pulse compressor. Our approach allows one to compensate pulse broadening in air and glass appropriately and has a possibility of generating sub-7 fs pulses for ultrafast spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Terahertz time domain spectroscopy of phonon-depopulation based quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A 3.1THz phonon depopulation-based quantum-cascade-laser is investigated using terahertz time domain spectroscopy. A gain of 25cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> and absorption features due to the lower laser level being populated from a parasitic electronic channel are highlighted.

articleTitle: 2.4 µm dual-comb spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A proof-of-principle experiment of mid-infrared frequency comb Fourier transform spectroscopy is carried out with two interfering Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>:ZnSe femtosecond oscillators, emitting around 2400 nm. Spectra of acetylene are measured within 10 μs with 12 GHz resolution.

articleTitle: Experimental observation of photonic bandgaps in hyperuniform disordered material
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first experimental demonstration of photonic bandgaps (PBGs) in 2D hyperuniform disordered materials and show that is possible to obtain isotropic, disordered, photonic materials of arbitrary size with complete PBGs.

articleTitle: On-chip spectrophotometry for bioanalysis using nanophotonic devices
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measure optical absorption from color-producing enzymatic reactions for biochemical antigen detection using a microscale optofluidic device. The microring cavity can detect absorbance with high sensitivity while requiring only nanoliter volumes of reagants.

articleTitle: Wavelength-beam-combined quantum-cascade-laser array for remote spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate transmission spectroscopy between a monostatic transceiver based on a wavelength-beam-combined quantum-cascade-laser array and a retroreflector placed at 35 meters.

articleTitle: 30-fs 1.6 mJ pulses at a kHz repetition rate from a Single stage DPSS Yb amplifier
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 200-fs 2.5-mJ pulses from a cw-diode-pumped Yb:CaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> MOPA are spectrally broadened in Ar and recompressed to 30 fs at 980 nm using a prism pair. Multi-millijoule 12-fs pulses are feasible upon higher-order spectral phase correction.

articleTitle: Gas ionization induced post-compression of high energy and super-intense femtosecond pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: From a 40 fs - 70 mJ terawatt Ti:sapphire laser, compression of pulses down to 11.4 fs (FWHM) with a total output energy of 13.7 mJ is achieved through rapid ionization of helium.

articleTitle: Spatially chirped pulses for high aspect ratio micromachining by femtosecond laser ablation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that spatially chirped femtosecond laser pulses overcome previous limitations for the machining of high-aspect ratio features with low numerical aperture beams in optically transparent materials.

articleTitle: Direct measurement of laser-induced electron tunneling
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measure momentum distribution of tunneled electrons in femtosecond circular polarized light. We find that the electron momentum distribution perpendicular to the laser field depends on the field strength and is independent of the wavelength.

articleTitle: Switcheable strong-coupling microcavities of inorganic-organic perovskite natural quantum wells
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Room-temperature strong-coupling has been observed with large Rabi splitting of upto 202meV when layered inorganic-organic multiple quantum wells (IO-MQWs), are embedded in low-Q microcavities. Incorporating exciton-switching hybrid further allows active control of the strong-coupling parameters.

articleTitle: Wide field-of-view lensless imaging of caenorhabditis Elegans on a chip
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Wide field-of-view lensfree on-chip imaging of C. Elegans samples is demonstrated using incoherent lensless in-line holography. Digital reconstruction of these lensless holograms rapidly creates the C. Elegans images over a field-of-view of > 24 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Spectral phase clamping in waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report spectral phase clamping of femtosecond pulses propagating in a waveguide array. The waveguide sets the spectral phase of the output pulses to a fixed value, regardless of the input chirp.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared emission of quantum-dash-based quantum cascade laser structures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed two mid-infrared quantum cascade laser structures based on InAs quantum dashes embedded either in AlInGaAs lattice-matched to InP or in tensile-strained AlInAs. Both devices emit between 7 and 11 μm.

articleTitle: Ultrafast broadband mid-infrared pump, terahertz probe spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a novel ultrafast optical system capable of directly pumping low energy excitations in complex materials and probing the photoinduced changes in their properties with terahertz pulses, benchmarked through mid-infrared-pump, THz-probe measurements on InSb.

articleTitle: Method and algorithm for all-fiber coherent combining through refractive index control in Yb-doped fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report all-fiber coherent combining technique utilizing refractive index control in Yb-doped fibers. Algorithm based on the two-level population inversion model is shown to support servo loop service suitable for combining of 50-100 fiber amplifiers.

articleTitle: Plasmonic solar cells with broadband absorption enhancements
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A combined computational and experimental study optimizing plasmon-enhanced absorption in Si thin film solar cells presented. A model system consisting of a 2-dimensional periodic /aperiodic arrays of Ag nanostructures on a silica coated Si film supported by a silica substrate is used in the simulations. We develop basic design rules for the realization of broadband absorption enhancements for such structures, by simultaneously taking advantage of 1) the high near-fields surrounding the nanostructures close to their surface plasmon resonance frequency and 2) the effective coupling to waveguide modes supported by the Si film through an optimization of the array properties.

articleTitle: Carbon-nanotube mode-locked Cr:YAG laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Transmissive single-walled carbon nanotube saturable absorbers were used for passive mode-locking of a Cr:YAG laser, delivering tunable sub-100-fs pulses around 1.5 μm with output powers up to 110 mW at 84.6 MHz.

articleTitle: Second harmonic optical vortex generation in air
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate second harmonic vortex generation in atmospheric pressure air using tightly focused femtosecond laser beam. The average second harmonic power is two orders of magnitude higher compared to previous reports.

articleTitle: Sub-watts 355 nm generation with 2nd- and 3rd-order-QPM PPMgSLT
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 0.7 watts 355nm laser is achieved from 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup>-order-QPM PPMgSLT by sum-frequency generation of fundamental and second-harmonic of pulsed Nd: YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser. 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup>-order-QPM PPMgSLT is successfully fabricated, which promises 355 nm generation of sub-watts order.

articleTitle: Optimum coverage for perfect transmission in 2-dimensional metallic arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate optimum coverage in the enhanced transmission of terahertz radiation through 2-dimensional metallic arrays of square holes with different periodicity changing along the direction perpendicular to the incident polarization.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal dynamics of ionizing filaments in air
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use time-domain Spatially and Spectrally Resolved Interferometry (SSRI) to measure the intensity and phase of filaments. The optical power of self-focusing pulses is shown to be consistent with defocusing due to ionization.

articleTitle: THz fiber-based swept-source imaging radar
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an all-THz fiber-based swept-source imaging radar system. Our experiment shows that this radar can be used in real time to nondestructively detect and locate the concealed living objects with high stability and sensitivity.

articleTitle: High power diode pumped 2 µm laser operation of Tm:Lu2O3
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first diode pumped laser operation of thulium-doped lutetia in the 2 μm wavelength range. Output powers of more than 40 W and slope efficiencies of up to 42% with respect to the incident pump power were achieved at room temperature.

articleTitle: Broadly tunable narrowband pump pulses for Femtosecond Stimulated Raman Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using spectral compression by second-harmonic generation we generate pulses with 10÷15 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> linewidth, multi-μJ energy and broad tunability from 330 to 510 nm. This source is ideally suited as Raman pump for Stimulated Raman Scattering.

articleTitle: Enhancing contrast of point images using coherent states and photon-number-resolving detectors
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We map the transverse profile of light beams using photon-number-resolving detectors, and observe compression of beam profiles for higher detected photon-number, enabling contrast enhancement between two Airy disk beams at the Rayleigh limit.

articleTitle: Realization of multilayer Si/SiO2 super-high N.A. GRIN lens on Si-waveguide coupling to single-mode optical fibre
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Vertical optical mode-size transformation from 260nm-thick Si-nanowaveguide to 10~12μm matching the single-mode-fibre-core has been demonstrated using compact multilayer Si/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> asymmetric GRIN lens (length:~24μm). GRIN lens to single-mode-fibre practical coupling loss of -3.45 dB was achieved.

articleTitle: Continuously-tunable optical delay line using PLC-based optical FIR filter
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate continuously-tunable optical delay using an optical FIR filter consisting of discrete time-delay elements. A 16-tap PLC-based FIR filter having a 10-ps unit time delay enables tunable delay in the range of ± 25 ps.

articleTitle: Growths of ultra high density InGaN-based quantum dots on self-assembled diblock copolymer nanopatterns
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Selective area growths of highly-uniform InGaN quantum dots (QDs) on dielectric nanopatterns defined by self-assembled diblock copolymer were demonstrated with ultra-high QDs density of 8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>, which represents the highest QDs density reported for nitride-based QDs.

articleTitle: Ultrafast coherent control of spin waves with intense terahertz magnetic transients
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Intense terahertz transients coherently control magnon oscillations in antiferromagnetic NiO. The magnetic component of the light field directly couples to the spins via Zeeman interaction. 8-fs probe pulses sample the ultrafast dynamics via Faraday rotation.

articleTitle: Weak value measurement with an incoherent measuring device
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In the Aharonov-Albert-Vaidman (AAV) weak measurement, it is assumed that the measuring device or the pointer is in a quantum mechanical pure state. In reality, however, it is often not the case. In this paper, we generalize the AAV weak measurement scheme to include more generalized situations in which the measuring device is in a mixed state. We also report an optical implementation of the weak value measurement in which the incoherent pointer is realized with the pseudo-thermal light. The theoretical and experimental results show that the measuring device under the influence of partial decoherence could still be used for amplified detection of minute physical changes and are applicable for implementing the weak value measurement for massive particles.

articleTitle: 120 W average power from a mode-locked Yb∶Lu2O3 thin disk laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a mode-locked Yb:Lu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> thin disk laser with an average power of 120 W setting a new record for mode-locked laser oscillators. The laser generates 796-fs pulses with an energy of 2.1 μJ.

articleTitle: Nanophosphors based on CdSe/ZnS and CdSe/SiO2 colloidal quantum dots for daylight-quality white LEDs
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Properly mixed combination of CdSe/ZnS and CdSe/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> colloidal quantum dots of different sizes is suggested as a nanophosphor material to be combined with blue InGaN/GaN LEDs for well-balanced color content of white light emission.

articleTitle: High-power narrow-band pulsed Tm-doped silica fiber lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Pulsed Tm-doped fiber lasers operated at 1910 nm are demonstrated with average power of 120W and emission linewidth of 0.8 nm. The pulsed width is about 50 ns at repetition rate of 50 kHz.

articleTitle: Fiber Bragg Grating-based architectures for reconfigurable services in in-building networks
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Architectures for dynamic reconfiguration of wavelength services are presented in this paper. The approaches are based on Fiber Bragg Gratings (FBG) and optical switching. In particular, the proposed architectures fit for large in-building networks.

articleTitle: Octave-spanning Ti:sapphire laser locked to carrier-envelope-offset frequency zero
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a Ti:sapphire based pulse train stabilized to carrier-envelope-offset frequency zero using an extended self-referencing technique. The excellent CEP lock is verified by recording the spectral interference of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sup> pulses in a second f-to-2f-interferometer.

articleTitle: PbSe quantum dots liquid-core fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A liquid-core fiber has been experimentally investigated by inserting PbSe/toluene solution media in the hollow-core of a capillary waveguide. Upon pumping by a 532 nm-CW laser, a good amplified stimulated emission in 1290 nm band was obtained.

articleTitle: Ultrafast all-optical temporal differentiation in integrated Silicon-on-Insulator Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the theoretical and experimental demonstration of an all-optical temporal differentiator based on π-phase-shifted Bragg gratings fabricated in Silicon-on-Insulator waveguides. All-optical processing of sub-picosecond pulses was performed.

articleTitle: Linearization of ultra-broadband optical chirps for precision length metrology
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate precise active linearization of ultra-broadband (>5 THz) laser frequency sweeps using a self-heterodyne technique. Frequency errors less than 170 kHz relative to linearity were observed enabling very high resolution ranging over large distances.

articleTitle: 167 W, 1178 nm ytterbium-doped photonic bandgap fiber amplifier with power scalability
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have generated 167 W of output power at 1178 nm using an ytterbium-doped photonic bandgap fiber. Distributed spectral filtering efficiently suppresses amplified spontaneous emission at shorter wavelengths and enables power scalable amplification at 1178 nm.

articleTitle: In situ monitoring of two-photon polymerization using broadband CARS microscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a method for monitoring in situ TPP using broadband CARS microscopy. Since both fabrication and imaging are performed using the same experimental setup, characterization of polymeric microstructures with structural information is attained rapidly.

articleTitle: Demonstration of unconditional one-way quantum computations
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate unconditional one-way quantum computation experiments using a linear cluster state of four entangled optical modes. Our results provide a first demonstration of the fundamental components for one-way quantum computation with continuous variables.

articleTitle: Time-resolved microscopic imaging of laser-induced material modifications in optical materials
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on time-resolved imaging of material response to localized laser energy deposition in the bulk of optical materials. The key processes include shockwave formation, crack propagation, formation of residual stress fields, and transient absorption.

articleTitle: New concepts in nanoplasmonics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The field of plasmonics is currently at the exciting stage of a move from passive structures to hybrid assemblies with active functions. This tutorial will provide an overview of current trends in this development.

articleTitle: Broadband sum-frequency generation in AlGaAs Bragg reflection waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Efficient continuous-wave sum-frequency generation with a bandwidth exceeding 60 nm was obtained in AlGaAs Bragg-reflection waveguide for type-II nonlinear interaction. Normalized conversion efficiency of 317 %W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> was estimated in a device with 2.2 mm length.

articleTitle: Spectral Wavefront Optical Reconstruction by Diffraction
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a new concept of spectrally-resolved wavefront characterization, particular useful for high-harmonic and soft X-ray radiation. It is based on an analysis of radiation diffracted from a slit scanned in front of flat-field spectrometer.

articleTitle: Tunable intracavity up-converted optical parameteric oscillator by cascaded adiadbatic sum frequency generation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate efficient tunable up-conversion by cascading optical oscillation and wide-band adiabatic sum frequency generation in a single nonlinear crystal, yielding red light tunable over a 6.2nm wavelength band.

articleTitle: Shear ordering in polymer photonic crystals
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Time-resolved scattering spectra of flowing polymer-based colloidal opals are presented. Broadband spectra reflecting dynamic structural changes during a shear-ordering process reveal four distinct regimes of crystal growth and decay identified under different flow conditions.

articleTitle: Frequency verniers of Ti:sapphire laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By precisely controlling the comb laser repetition rate, we resolved a dark state of exceptionally narrow linewidth (5.6 Hz) in cesium gas buffered by neon atoms. We theoretically interpreted our experimental data and pointed out that this narrow resonance potentially can not only be used to enhance the frequency discrimination of microwave clock to sub-10-Hz level, but also to transport a well-stabilized clock signal optically via Ethernet, referring to the same atomic ensemble. Together with 822-nm and 884-nm cesium two-photon-stabilized diode lasers, we established a set of optical frequency verniers for a Ti:sapphire comb laser.

articleTitle: Towards interfacing dissimilar quantum systems
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on an experimental implementation of an interface between quantum dots (QD) and parametric downconversion (PDC). We present a PDC source compatible with QD emission and our efforts to demonstrate such compatibility.

articleTitle: Direct phase detection technique using an injection-locked VCSEL
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A technique for direct detection of the phase of optical signals using an injection-locked VCSEL is presented. Conversion of the phase modulation to modulation of the voltage across the VCSEL is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Chirp effects in high-order harmonics generated from solid surface
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study the effect of pump laser chirp as a method to increase the efficiency of high-order harmonic generation from solid surfaces. Harmonics have been generated using a 40 fs, 800 nm, 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup> Wcm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> pump laser with Al targets. This study provides evidence that HHG is critically dependent on the frequency component of the femtosecond pump laser.

articleTitle: Novel nanowire cavity using cut-off mode reflector
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Free-standing nanowire-cavities, having a low index contrast with their substrate, typically have low Q-factors because of the lack of reflective bottom mirrors. A novel method facilitating a high-reflection bottom mirror using cut-off mode is presented.

articleTitle: Plasma waveguide arrays from filament interaction in air
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the formation of 1D and 2D plasma waveguide arrays induced by the strong interactions of non-collinearly femtosecond-pulse-induced filaments in air. The periodic self-channeling is evidenced by the direct observation of the filament coalescence.

articleTitle: Resonator micro-optic gyroscope based on the double phase modulation technique
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Double phase modulation technique is presented to relax the accuracy of the modulation index. A bias stability of 3.14×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> rad/s is demonstrated in a resonator micro-optic gyro with the silica waveguide ring length of 7.9 cm.

articleTitle: Confined excitons with ultrafast radiative decay time less than 100 fs enabling survival at room temperature
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Temperature dependence of degenerate four-wave mixing signal in high-quality CuCl thin films was investigated. We observed the signal of modes with large radiative width at high temperatures due to ultrafast radiative decay faster than dephasing.

articleTitle: Optically generated electric fields by lithium niobate nanowires
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that lithium niobate nanowires generate electric fields under 514 nm continuous wave laser illumination. Birefringent media are used to visualize the generated fields in a microfluidic channel. Input laser polarization dependence is shown.

articleTitle: Endoscope lens with dual field of view and resolution for multiphoton imaging
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated the optical “zooming” capability of an endoscope lens for multiphoton imaging by using a novel multifocal objective lens design. Multiphoton images with dual field of view and resolution were recorded.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser induced vortex anisotropy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Anisotropic bubble chain structures are produced by ultrashort pulse laser irradiation in silica glass. Vortex anisotropy is observed in the irradiated volume.

articleTitle: Observation of quasi-ballistic heat transport at nano-interfaces using coherent soft X-ray beams
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We make the first observation and quantitative measurement of quasi-ballistic thermal transport from a nanoscale heat source, finding a significant decrease in energy transport away from the hotspot compared with diffusive thermal transport predictions.

articleTitle: THz source based on external cavity enhanced difference frequency generation by using monolithic single-frequency pulsed fiber lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a resonant cavity approach to enhance narrow band THz radiation. Two nanosecond laser pulses in a cavity interact with a nonlinear crystal to produce 7-fold enhancement of THz power compared to single-pass orientation.

articleTitle: Solid state quantum memories for quantum repeaters
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Quantum memories are necessary for the implementation of quantum networks and repeaters. Recent progress towards photonic quantum storage in solid state atomic ensembles using photon echo techniques will be presented.

articleTitle: Optimizing RZ 40-Gbit/s fiber transmission system performance when utilizing SOA-MZI λ-converters
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We characterize and experimentally demonstrate the effect of negative chirp produced by SOA-MZI DXPM-based wavelength convertor at 40-Gb/s 33% RZ in a 80-km dispersion-compensated SMF link. >2-dB performance improvement is achieved by adding positive residual dispersion of +30ps/nm.

articleTitle: All optical wavelength conversion in an integrated ring resonator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first system penalty measurements for all-optical wavelength conversion via four wave mixing in an integrated, CMOS compatible, ring resonator, obtaining <; 0.3 dB system penalty at 2.5Gb/s for ~22dBm average pump power.

articleTitle: Measuring the modes of optical fibers using S2 imaging
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Multiple higher-order-modes propagating simultaneously in large-mode-area optical fibers are measured and their relative power levels quantified using spatially and spectrally resolved imaging.

articleTitle: An anisotropic metamaterial leaky waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a leaky optical waveguide achieved with a uniaxially anisotropic metamaterial that supports both forward and backward leaky waves. The backward leaky nature is exploited in a sub-diffraction imaging system.

articleTitle: Optical coatings for MEMS devices
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) devices pose unique constraints for optical coatings. This paper discusses issues unique to coating MEMS devices and describes design changes necessary to coat a deformable mirror with 99.9% reflective dielectric coatings at 532 nm.

articleTitle: Entangled photon polarimetry
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We construct an entangled photon polarimeter capable of displaying an evolving quantum state in real time. We use it to record a 3 frame-per-second live video of a two-photon state's transition from separability to entanglement.

articleTitle: Multimode graded-index fluorine-doped fibers for harsh environments fabricated by MCVD-method
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Multimode graded-index fluorine-doped fibers with a record (for the MCVD method) value of the refractive index difference of -0.0115 (NA~0.185) were fabricated and tested at high temperature (up to 300°C) in hydrogen atmosphere (50 atm).

articleTitle: Performance of serial time-encoded amplified microscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Serial time-encoded amplified microscopy (STEAM) is a new high-sensitivity ultrafast real-time imaging modality. Here we describe an analysis of its spatial resolution, frame rate, and detection sensitivity.

articleTitle: Coupling a quantum dot to an open microcavity
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Single InAs semiconductor quantum dots were coupled to a microcavity consisting of a semiconductor Bragg reflector below the quantum dot layer, and an external micromirror fabricated at the tip of a single mode fiber.

articleTitle: Nonlinear wave control and rainbows in complex gyroelectric structures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A fascinating review of nonlinear waves in metamaterials is presented with an emphasis upon complex waveguides. Many opportunities exist for elegant control such as the capture of rainbows and an exciting deployment of magnetooptic environments.

articleTitle: Carrier to envelope offset coupling via Multiple Quantum Wells
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Multiple Quantum Well saturable absorbers in a mode-locked laser induce a coupling of the differential carrier to envelope offset of two intracavity pulse trains, coupling that can be eliminated by designing a non-resonant periodic structure.

articleTitle: Generating energetic few-cycle pulses at 800 nm using soliton compression with type 0 cascaded quadratic interaction in lithium niobate
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that ultra-short few-cycle pulses can be generated through soliton compression of energetic femtosecond pulses from a Ti:Sapphire regenerative amplifier. The compression relies on cascaded type 0 second-harmonic generation in mm-length lithium niobate crystals.

articleTitle: Parametric investigation of isotropic fishnet metamaterials in terahertz regime
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The magnetic and surface plasmon resonances in isotropic fishnet metamaterials with left-handed band in terahertz regime were studied experimentally and by simulation. An LC-circuit model has been adapted to describe the magnetic resonance as a function of the device geometry.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic field enhancement in realistic transition metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate the effect of anomalous field enhancement in lossy optical transition metamaterials and provide guidelines for optimizing the profile of the transition layer for maximum enhancement in these structures.

articleTitle: Single-sweep production of complex 3D-waveguide devices produced by adaptive femtosecond laser writing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the simultaneous creation of multiple waveguides in different depths in fused silica. A combination of beam shaping with femtosecond laser writing is used to write two waveguides with changing separation and depth.

articleTitle: Plasmon hybridization enhances the transient absorption signal of a single nanoparticle
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A tiny variation of a single metal nanoparticle's dielectric properties has only a weak influence on the light field. We demonstrate, using antenna concepts, how plasmon hybridization helps to increase the particle's influence.

articleTitle: Second-harmonic spectroscopy on split-ring-resonator arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By tuning the fundamental wavelength in second-harmonic-generation experiments on split-ring resonator arrays, we further test assignments based on previous single-frequency experiments. We find resonances that are slightly red-shifted with respect to the linear transmittance minimum.

articleTitle: Vertically stacked surface-emitting laser diodes array for high-brightness application
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Vertically stacked array is based on grating coupled surface emitting laser diodes with monolithically integrated wavelength control element. Advanced performance of individual emitters allows exploiting spatial and spectral beam combining to achieve high brightness sources.

articleTitle: Extraordinary low transmission of a metamaterial for application in lithography
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present experiments on a metamaterial made from an ultrathin (<; 40 nm) metal film. It exhibits extraordinary low transmission due to an antenna resonance and may form building blocks of future lithographic masks.

articleTitle: Highly efficient, broadband Cherenkov radiation in photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The dependence of Cherenkov radiation on pump pulse parameters is investigated. Based on this effect a tunable, highly efficient (>40%), broadband (>50 nm), green-orange light source is demonstrated with a threshold energy less than 100 pJ.

articleTitle: Multi-gigahertz photon counting using InGaAs APDs
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate multi-gigahertz photon-counting at 1550nm using self-differencing In-GaAs APDs. The quantum efficiency is characterized as 23.5% at an after-pulse probability of 4.84%. The device will further increase the bit-rate for fiber quantum key distribution.

articleTitle: White phasematching noise: Random duty-cycle errors in quasi-phase-matching devices
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Random duty-cycle errors in quasi-phase-matching gratings result in a phasematching pedestal, enhancing the efficiency of non-phasematched parasitic processes and thereby limiting device performance in many applications. We find good agreement between analytical modeling and experiments.

articleTitle: An all-fiber optical Faraday mirror
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An all-fiber optical Faraday mirror is demonstrated. It consists of a fiber Faraday rotator (56-wt% terbium-doped fiber) and a fiber Bragg grating. The polarization state of the reflected light is rotated 89°±2°.

articleTitle: First experimental studies of the resonant optothermoacoustic detection technique
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel technique for detecting optical absorption in gases is demonstrated. The technique called resonant optothermoacoustic detection (ROTADE) is based on energy transfer from the optical beam area to a mechanical oscillator via molecular diffusion.

articleTitle: Two photon counting: theory and experiment
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Two-photon counting distributions of different optical sources are experimentally studied using third-order optical nonlinearity in a GaAs detector. Semiclassical as well as quantum theories are presented in order to explain our results.

articleTitle: 24 nm wavelength tunable high duty-cycle, self-starting figure-eight fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The operation of a 24 nm wavelength tunable self-starting, passively harmonic modelocked, figure-eight laser is experimentally demonstrated. Stable pulses with near half dutycycle are produced at repetition rates of up to 2.72 GHz at 1550 nm wavelength.

articleTitle: Broadband optical parametric generation in periodically poled stoichiometric LiTaO3
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally investigate parametric downconversion approaching zero group velocity dispersion in Mg-doped stoichiometric LiTaO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>. Pumping in the 820-842 nm range yields a 14 THz gain bandwidth with signal (idler) wavelengths around 1.23 μm (2.66 μm).

articleTitle: Photon-number-counting with an InGaAs/InP avalanche photodiode by optical self-balancing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Infrared photon-number-resolving detection was achieved with an InGaAs/InP avalanche avalanche photodiode by using optical self-balancing technique to cancel the spike noise. A photon-number-resolving detection was achieved with the detection efficiency as high as 36%.

articleTitle: Automated supercontinuum pulse compression from ultrafast fiber lasers using MIIPS
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report precise characterization and compensation of high-order phase distortions of a supercontinuum generated by ultrafast fiber lasers. By using multiphoton intrapulse interference phase scan (MIIPS) technique, the pulses are compressed to 12.8 fs (within 0.1% of the transform-limited value) automatically in less than thirty seconds.

articleTitle: Highly stable diode-laser pumped, idler resonant CW OPO based on MgO∶PPLN
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a diode laser pumped continuous wave, pump enhanced idler-resonant optical parametric oscillator. Cavity stabilization by a Pound-Drever-Hall scheme using direct modulation of the diode laser enables long-time frequency and amplitude stable output.

articleTitle: Comparison of forward and backward SHG images using Fourier transform-second-harmonic generation imaging
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We compare the forward and backward SHG images for porcine tendon, sclera, and ear cartilage using Fourier transform-second-harmonic generation microscopy. The preferred orientation and peaks in the magnitude spectrum are used as metrics for comparison.

articleTitle: Incident beam shape effects on thick-film laser induced forward transfer
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use finite element modeling to investigate the effects of incident beam shape on stress and temperature evolution in the dynamic release layer during thick-film laser-induced forward transfer. Emphasis is on Gaussian versus donut-shaped beams.

articleTitle: Photonic structure based acceleration of non-relativistic electrons - simulations and proof-of-concept experiment
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show simulation results of the acceleration of electrons passing close by a transmission grating that is illuminated with Titanium:sapphire femtosecond laser pulses. With 27-keV electrons and a single grating we obtain gradients as high as 100 MeV/m in a distance of 30 nm away from the grating. We show optimization results of the grating geometry, discuss parameter ranges, and infer that a proof-of-concept experiment is worthwhile. We are setting up an experiment and present first results in the talk.

articleTitle: A new insight on laser threshold in devices operating at nanoscale
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We will present a further understanding of the threshold transition in lasers operating at nanoscale, by measuring the threshold transition from a quantum, statistical and dynamical points of view at room temperature and telecommunication wavelengths.

articleTitle: Locking lasers to RF in an ultrafast FEL
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using a novel, phase-stabilized RF-over-fiber scheme, we transmit 3GHz over 300m with 27fs RMS error in 250kHz bandwidth over 12 hours, and phase lock a laser to enable ultrafast pump-probe experiments.

articleTitle: Terahertz dielectric and magnetic response near magnetic phase transition in a hexagonal multiferroic YMnO3
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Time-domain THz spectroscopy is used to extract simultaneously dielectric and magnetic properties of hexagonal YMnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>. A magnon in antiferromagnetic phase and possible electromagnon in paramagnetic phase were first observed.

articleTitle: Characterization of Bragg gratings in Al2O3 waveguides fabricated by focused ion beam milling and laser interference lithography
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical grating cavities in Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> channel waveguides were successfully defined by focused ion beam milling and laser interference lithography. Both methods are shown to be suitable for realizing resonant structures for on-chip waveguide lasers.

articleTitle: Measurement of terahertz pulses using Electronically Controlled Optical Sampling (ECOPS)
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate generation and detection of single-cycle terahertz pulses using Electronically Controlled Optical Sampling (ECOPS). This technique is similar to asynchronous optical sampling (ASOPS), but is better suited for lower repetition-rate lasers.

articleTitle: Nonclassical nature of nonlocal dispersion cancellation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Shapiro recently suggested that nonlocal dispersion cancellation is essentially classical in nature. It is shown that his classical model gives identical dispersion in two beams of light and is not analogous to nonlocal dispersion cancellation.

articleTitle: Enhanced chemical and biological sensor based on liquid crystal using a bias electric field
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: With a suitable bias electrical field, the sensitivity, response speed and signal strength of LC based optical sensor can be improved greatly. The field can enhance the optical anisotropy of LC sensing for binding event.

articleTitle: Validation of the parallel three-dimensional solver for analysis of optical plasmonic bi-periodic multilayer nanostructures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Fundamentals of the three-dimensional spatial harmonic analysis (SHA) approach are reviewed, and the advantages of a fast-converging formulation versus the initial formulation are emphasized with examples using periodic plasmonic nanostructures.

articleTitle: A rapid inspection of atomic interference using superfluorescent picosecond pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The conventional method to measure atomic interference is usually based on incoherent processes which can be scaled by nano or microseconds. However, atomic interference may be studied in association with coherent process such as superfluorescence. Producing superfluorescent picosecond pulses in <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb vapor pumped by ~100 fs laser pulses, we report an observation of quantum beat due to D-lines. The relative delay of the superfluorescent pulses is measured by the streak camera with picosecond time resolution, as a function of time interval between input pulses, which also enables us to study atomic interference.

articleTitle: Chromatic dispersion in tightly curved silicon waveguides and ring resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We numerically analyze chromatic dispersion in tightly curved strip and slot waveguides with high index contrast. Zero-dispersion-wavelength may have a shift over 220 nm when bending radius is reduced to a few microns.

articleTitle: Direct temporal shaping of high energy picosecond UV pulses with a UV AOPDF device
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate arbitrary shaped UV picosecond pulses with energies up to 50 □J at 272 nm. Temporal shaping is performed by a UV AOPDF allowing direct amplitude and spectral phase control.

articleTitle: Squeezed light for gravitational wave detection
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The sensitivity of laser-interferometric gravitational wave detectors can be improved with squeezed light. The first squeezed-light laser aiming for a permanent operation in such a detector has now been accomplished and characterized.

articleTitle: A picosecond optical parametric oscillator synchronously pumped by an amplified gain-switched laser diode
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a picosecond optical parametric oscillator synchronously pumped by a fiber-amplified gain-switched laser diode. Up to 7.3W at 1.54μm and 3.1W at 3.4μm is obtained at pulse repetition rates between 114.8 and 918.4MHz.

articleTitle: SHA modeling of gold gratings for oblique light incidence
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use spatial harmonic analysis (SHA) to model gold double-strip gratings under obliquely incident light. The simulation results are compared to experimentally measured values and excellent matches are achieved.

articleTitle: Label-free measurement of DNA oligomer binding using a highly-sensitive photonic crystal biosensor
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: With a highly sensitive one dimensional photonic crystal biosensor, we have demonstrated quantitative real-time label-free detection of DNA oligomers, including binding to protein, concentration detection limits, and base-mismatched hybridization.

articleTitle: Time-resolved observation of energy deposition in fused silica by utrashort laser pulses in single and cumulative regime
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: When femtosecond laser pulses are focused in the bulk of transparent materials (glasses), deposition of energy on a restricted volume can occur owing to the non linear character of the laser matter interaction. As a consequence, the possibility to generate micrometer-sized structural modifications arises. Those local changes are often associated with a minute variation in the refractive index which, when positive, enables the fabrication of light guiding components in three dimensions through simple laser translation. Although the first corresponding experimental demonstration approaches fifteen years of age, the complete picture of the dynamics and the processes leading to the local refractive index changes has still to be drawn to reach an optimal control of the laser-induced modification process. In this report, the laser-dielectric interaction is followed on an ultrashort time scale with the help of a unique time-resolved side-imaging technique allowing for absorption and phase contrast detection. Experimental observation of an absorptive electronic cloud in the first moments of the interaction along with the launch of a pressure wave after a few ns is reported. These physical objects are shown to be reliable indicators of the success of the energy transfer to the lattice which largely depends on the pulse temporal envelope.

articleTitle: Stabilization of quantum-dot mode-locked lasers via optical injection
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Waveform instability is theoretically found in quantum-dot mode-locked laser simulations using experimentally obtained device dynamical parameters. Stabilization via optical injection is numerically and experimentally shown.

articleTitle: Local capacitor model for plasmonic electric field enhancement
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the local capacitor model that enables a simple, yet accurate description of lightning rod effect in nanoplasmonics. The λ-zone capacitance is proposed and applied to predict strongly induced electric field near metal edges.

articleTitle: Waveguide integrated plasmonic devices
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We theoretically study the properties of the waveguide integrated plasmonic nano-antennas. The device consists of a plasmonic nano-antenna coupled to a slot waveguide. We show that the proposed device can be used to enhance the spontaneous emission rate from an emitter by three orders of magnitude. Moreover, we demonstrate that the plasmonic nano-antenna efficiently couples to the dielectric waveguide. Finally, it is possible to efficiently deliver the excitation by use of the proposed device.

articleTitle: Polarization diffraction grating produced by femtosecond laser nanostructuring in glass
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate polarization sensitive diffractive optical element fabrication by femtosecond direct writing in the bulk of silica glass. Modulation of the anisotropic properties is produced by controlling light-induced self-assembled nano-gratings.

articleTitle: 100°C, 25 Gbit/s direct modulation of 1.3 µm surface emitting laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The uncooled 25-Gbit/s direct modulation of a 1.3-μm horizontal-cavity surface-emitting laser was demonstrated. A fabricated laser, which is directly mountable on a high-frequency coplanar line, exhibited 25-Gbit/s eye openings up to 100°C.

articleTitle: Observation of the condensation of classical waves
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a theoretical, numerical and experimental study of condensation of classical optical waves. The condensation of observed directly, as a function of nonlinearity and wave kinetic energy, in a self-defocusing photorefractive crystal.

articleTitle: Second harmonic generation in gallium phosphide photonic crystal nanocavities with ultralow CW pump power
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using photonic crystal nanocavities fabricated in the semiconductor gallium phosphide, we demonstrate second harmonic generation with input continuous wave powers of nanowatts (at 1550 nm).

articleTitle: Hybrid nanophotonic components integrating plasmonic and photonic nanowires
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the direct coupling of plasmonic and photonic nanowires via subwavelength-scale near-field interaction. Hybrid nanophotonic components, including splitters and micro-ring cavities, are fabricated out of coupled Ag and ZnO nanowires in a complementary scheme.

articleTitle: Improved emission properties of polymer photonic crystal lasers by introducing a phase-shift
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Introducing a phase-shift in nanoimprinted polymer dye lasers is shown to increase the probability of single mode lasing from 19% to 99%. Low-index lasers with only one longitudinal mode are thus superior to band-edge lasers.

articleTitle: High power fiber lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This tutorial discusses the recent rapid progress of high-power fiber sources, selected state-of-the-art devices in different regimes of operation, the technology, limits to further progress, and possible routes forward.

articleTitle: GaAs/AlGaAs colliding pulse mode-locked lasers with non-absorbing mirrors
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use quantum well intermixing to monolithically integrate non-absorbing mirrors in 3.7mm long GaAs/AlGaAs colliding-pulse mode-locked lasers and improve their output power by 40% by increasing the threshold for catastrophic optical mirror damage.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal characterization of single-order high harmonic pulses separated by pulse-front-tilt compensator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Extreme ultraviolet single-order harmonic pulses, separated by a pulse-front-tilt compensator, were spatially and temporally characterized to have a spot size of 58 μm at focus and a pulse duration of 47 fs.

articleTitle: Asymmetric transmission of linearly polarized light through low symmetry metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Based on a systematic analysis of the symmetry properties of metamaterial unit cells, we show experimentally and theoretically that asymmetric transmission for linearly polarized, visible light can be observed for suitably designed unit cells.

articleTitle: Metamaterial reflector for hollow-core infrared fiber design
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The metal-wire based metamaterial is found to be able to reflect TM-polarized light with a higher efficiency compared to plain metal. The prospect of such medium for designing a hollow-core infrared fiber is investigated.

articleTitle: Power scaling of directly pumped Nd∶GdVO4 laser using grown-together composite crystal
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Power scaling of end-pumped Nd:GdVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser was realized by directly pumping and grown-together crystal. A maximum CW output power of 46.0W with M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> <; 1.1 was obtained. Effective A-O Q-switch operations were also reported.

articleTitle: Enhanced sensitivity using liquid crystals for optical fiber-based localized surface plasmon resonance sensor
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Subwavelength gold nanoparticles array were fabricated on optical fibers tip with sensitivity of 195nm/RIU has been demonstrated. Nemetic liquid crystal has been used for enhancing sensitivity of LSPR-based detection of binding events.

articleTitle: High speed axial scanning in a temporal focusing setup with piezo bimorph mirror dispersion tuning
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Remote axial scans of mouse tissue are taken at high speed in a temporal focusing setup. A piezo bimorph mirror is used for tunable dispersion, capable of ±2.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> fs<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of GDD and 100 Hz modulation.

articleTitle: Numerical investigations on femtosecond supercontinuum generation with feedback
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Femtosecond supercontinuum systems with feedback show nonlinear dynamical behaviors like period multiplication, limit cycle and chaos. By numerical simulations we show that the stability changes and bistabilities occur in the transition regions between different dynamics.

articleTitle: FDTD simulation of semiconductor plasmonic nano-ring laser at 1550nm based on realistic semiconductor gain model
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We discuss the regime where nano-ring laser is feasible in which the absorption loss in metal is compensated by semiconductor gain. A nanometre-scale electrically pumped ring laser design is simulated using multi-level multi-electron FDTD model.

articleTitle: Starting dynamics in normal-dispersion mode-locked fiber lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Self-starting of mode-locking in normal-dispersion Yb fiber lasers is studied experimentally and theoretically. Starting can be initiated by quantum noise or relaxation oscillations, and is much faster than in soliton lasers.

articleTitle: Control of electron dynamics of doubly excited states from isolated attosecond pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The lifetime of the 2s2p autoionization state in helium was measured with attosecond pulses by modifying the doubly excited state with an infrared laser. Control of the electron dynamics was also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Single-photon detection in THz and its application
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photon-counting semiconductor photo-detectors, in a wavelength range from the long-wavelength infrared through sub-millimeter waves, are described, along with several applications in the photonjcounting imaging and in superr-wavelength near field microscopy.

articleTitle: Electrically pumped supermode Si/InGaAsP hybrid lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Supermode Si/InGaAsP hybrid lasers with a varying-width Si waveguide have been fabricated and shown to be superior to those lasers with a uniform-width Si waveguide. Edge emission images demonstrate mode evolution.

articleTitle: Measurement of the FSR of a high finesse etalon with 2.5 kHz accuracy using a narrow-linewidth frequency swept laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Measurement of the FSR of an etalon having finesse of 1000 with 7 digits of accuracy or 2.5 kHz. A modified PDH technique is used in conjunction with a frequency swept, narrow-linewidth CW laser.

articleTitle: Bidirectional mode-locked fiber ring laser using passively controlled threshold gating
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An innovative technique to achieve bidirectional mode-locking of a fiber ring laser is demonstrated using two amplitude modulators passively driven by a signal regenerated from the laser's own 5.1MHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Growth evolution and time-resolved photoluminescence studies of III-nitride light-emitting diodes grown by abbreviated growth mode on patterned AGOG substrate
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Abbreviated growth mode of InGaN-based light-emitting diodes on nano-patterned sapphire leads to reduction in dislocation density and non-radiative recombination rate, and 37% increase in internal quantum efficiency.

articleTitle: Picosecond 10 µm pulse amplification in isotopic CO2 active medium
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using isotopically enriched carbon dioxide in a CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser amplifier we eliminated the splitting of a picosecond pulse during amplification that usually results from modulations in the periodical spectrum caused by the rotational line structure.

articleTitle: Fiber-based, soliton-tuned femtosecond optical source mid infrared spectral region
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A fiber-based compact source of mid-infrared ultrafast laser pulses is presented. A polarization-maintaining fiber amplifier provides the pump pulses, while the signal pulses are derived from the same source by soliton self-frequency shifting in the same fiber. Noise and jitter of the fiber pulses are characterized.

articleTitle: Octave-spanning tunable frequency combs on a chip
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate direct full-octave spanning frequency comb generation via four-wave mixing in continuous wave laser pumped microresonators for the first time. The generated comb lines are fully tunable over more than one free spectral range.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional coherent x-ray diffractive imaging from a single view
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that high numerical aperture coherent diffractive imaging enables three-dimensional imaging from a single exposure angle under certain conditions. We demonstrate this technique, called ankylography, with simulations and experiment from a tabletop soft-x-ray laser.

articleTitle: Witnessing effective entanglement over 2km of optical fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a continuous-variable QKD system using heterodyne detection. We experimentally determine channel characteristics and compare them to bounds of our entanglement criterion. For the first time, the local oscillator is considered in this verification.

articleTitle: Modeling of a 10GHz SiGe HBT EO modulator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The modeling of an EO modulator based on SiGe Heterojunction Bipolar Transistor is presented. The device exhibits 10GHz switching speed with a π-phase shift length of 74µm. The total propagation loss is less than 4dB.

articleTitle: New modality of type-I second order nonlinear interaction in bulk AlGaAs Bragg reflection waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Type-I TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ω</sub>→TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2ω</sub> phase-matching in isotropic [001]-grown AlGaAs Bragg reflection waveguide is reported. This nonlinear process coexists with type-I TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ω</sub>→TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2ω</sub> and type-II TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ω</sub>+TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ω</sub>→TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2ω</sub> interactions within a spectral window of 17 nm.

articleTitle: Laser-assisted chemical vapor deposition of silicon nano-layers in air-hole microstructure fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This paper presents a laser-assisted chemical vapor deposition of silicon thin film and silicon thin film long-period gratings inside a two-hole fiber and photonic crystal fiber with hollow cores.

articleTitle: Grey-track resistant periodically poled Rb-doped KTiOPO4 for blue-light generation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present periodic poling of Rb-doped KTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>. The crystal is used to obtain blue radiation at 398 nm with an efficiency of 30% and a peak intensity of 2 MW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> without grey-tracking.

articleTitle: Compression of ultra-high power laser pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present easy-scalable pulse recompression method based on spectral broadening due to self phase modulation in bulk medium. Our experiment demonstrates a possibility of compression of high-energy pulses above 1J from 30 to 14 fs.

articleTitle: 375 kW peak power sub-nanosecond passively Q-switched ytterbium doped fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a passively Q-switched ytterbium doped fiber laser with Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:YAG and stimulated Brillouin backscattering. Linearly polarized output with ~ 375 kW peak power and pulse duration as short as 490 ps have been obtained.

articleTitle: Generation and self-trapping of optical propelling beams
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We generate optical beams with rotating intensity blades, namely “optical propellers”, by employing Moiré technique. Such rotating beams are controlled by SLM without mechanical movement or phase-sensitive interference. Self-trapping of propelling beams is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Thickness and refractive index measurement of a wafer based on the optical comb
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We suggested and demonstrated a novel method that can determine the thickness and refractive index of a wafer at the same time in a single measurement by using the optical comb. The thickness and refractive index of a wafer can be separated simply from optical thickness by using the various phase information obtained in spectral domain. For the feasibility test, the thickness and refractive index of a double side polished wafer were measured.

articleTitle: Observation of coherent magnons in an antiferromagnet nickel oxide
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optically induced magnetization, whose relaxation time is of the order of a hundred picoseconds, and coherent oscillations of magnons in terahertz region were observed in an antiferromagnet NiO by polarization spectroscopy with the pump-probe technique.

articleTitle: Terahertz sources based on difference-frequency generation near exit facets in dual-wavelength mid-infrared quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report novel quantum cascade laser sources based on difference-frequency generation in nonlinear sections localized near exit facets. This new approach allows for infrared-to-terahertz conversion efficiencies above 1mW/W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Experimentally, devices operating at 4THz are discussed.

articleTitle: C2H2 gas laser inside hollow-core photonic crystal fiber based on population inversion
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Lasing from population inversion is demonstrated from gas contained in a hollow-core kagome structured photonic crystal fiber. Laser pulses in the mid-IR (3.1-3.2 μm) were generated by optically pumping at λ ~ 1.5 μm.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal dynamics of cross-polarized wave generation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use Spatially and Spectrally Resolved Interferometry (SSRI) to investigate cross-polarized wave (XPW) generation. We find that the XPW pulse is √3 smaller than the input in the spatiotemporal domain regardless of input chirp.

articleTitle: Optical resolution enhancement with phase-sensitive preamplification
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate enhanced resolution in image detection by phase-sensitive preamplification. In one-versus-two-target experiment we distinguish otherwise unresolved images with higher probability after such amplification than is possible without amplification.

articleTitle: Tunable broadband optical delay using phase modulation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novle tunable broadband optical delay scheme using phase modulation is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. A 2ps Gaussian pulse is frequency-chirped, phase-modulated by a ramp signal and delayed up to 9 times of pulse width.

articleTitle: All-optical computing circuits based on bacteriorhodopsin protein coated microcavity switches
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present designs of all-optical MUX/DEMUX and half-adder/subtractor circuits based on switching of an infrared laser beam at 1310 nm in bacteriorhodopsin protein coated silica microsphere using low power (<;200 μW) pump beams.

articleTitle: Efficient, high-power, 16-GHz, picosecond optical parametric oscillator pumped by an 81-MHz fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the generation of 16-GHz repetition-rate picosecond pulses in an optical parametric oscillator synchronously pumped by an 81-MHz Yb fiber laser, providing 650 mW of average power tunable over 1.45-1.75 μm.

articleTitle: Surface-enhanced Raman scattering of semiconducting quantum dots on nanostructured plasmonic surfaces
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Nanostructured gold surfaces with localised surface plasmon resonances are shown to produce surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) of sub-monolayers of semiconducting quantum dots. These results pave the way for quantum dots use as markers.

articleTitle: Self-formation and synchronization of emitters in broad area lasers in external cavities
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using a new model for dynamic simulation of broad area diode lasers with external cavities we find self formation of synchronized emitters for a broad area laser in a V-shaped external cavity. The results are compared to stripe array diode lasers.

articleTitle: Ytterbium-doped low-NA P-Al-silicate large-mode-area fiber for high power applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
