abstract: We demonstrate an efficient, ytterbium-doped low-NA fiber with core glass containing high levels of Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> in silica host that shows low-photodarkening and generated 175 W of continuous-wave output power with 80% laser efficiency.

articleTitle: Long distance FBG sensor interrogation using 1.3 µm FDML wavelength swept laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a high-speed long distance FBG sensor interrogation using 1.3 μm FDML wavelength-swept laser. The static strain and dynamic strain response for long distance FBG interrogation system is achieved. The FDML laser could be operated if the scanning frequency of the Fabry-Perot tunable-filter matches with the fundamental frequency of the laser cavity.

articleTitle: Subpicosecond fiber optical parametric chirped pulse amplifier based on highly-nonlinear fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a fiber optical parametric chirped pulse amplifier. A 750-fs signal is stretched to 40 ps, amplified with a gain of 30 dB through parametric process and then compressed to 808 fs.

articleTitle: Filamentation in air at 1550nm
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report air filamentation by a 1550 nm subpicosecond pulse. During filamentation, the continuum generated was less than expected. A large amount of third harmonic was also generated.

articleTitle: Preserving quantum coherence using optimized open-loop control techniques
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe experimental and theoretical studies of open-loop quantum control techniques known as dynamical decoupling (DD) for the suppression of decoherence-induced errors in quantum systems. Our experiments on trapped atomic ion qubits demonstrate that it is possible to optimize the construction of DD sequences for a given noise power spectral density. Studies of novel sequences derived analytically or through numerical optimization - while maintaining fixed control resources - demonstrate large gains in our ability to preserve quantum coherence in arbitrary noise environments.

articleTitle: Comparisons between linear and nonlinear localized waves in semiconductor lasers within a surface photonic crystal structure
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report experimental observations of cavity solitons in a surface-photonic-crystal-structured Vertical Cavity Surface Emission Laser by using the near-field scanning optical microscope. Comparisons between linear and nonlinear localized modes, i.e. Defect modes and cavity solitons, are illustrated experimentally and numerically. A general method to generate and control self-organized cavity solitons is demonstrated without using a holding beam.

articleTitle: Fluorescence microscopy on a 2D photonic crystal transparent in the visible
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on dye fluorescence enhancement (10-fold) with high spatial confinement (100nm-deep, 1μm-wide) on a photonic crystal (PhC) through resonant excitation of photonic modes. These features make the PhC an excellent substrate for fluorescence microscopy.

articleTitle: Direct backward third harmonic generation in nanostructures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We theoretically and experimentally demonstrated that direct backward third harmonic generation (THG) waves can be comparable in magnitude with forward THG waves in nanostructures, such as ZnO thin films and nanoparticles of CdSe and Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>.

articleTitle: Grating-induced surface plasmon-polaritons for enhancing photon absorption in organic photovoltaic devices
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a grating electrode that launches laterally propagating surface plasmon-polaritons along the active layers of organic photovoltaic devices. The resulting standing wave effectively increases the device thickness and enhances the photon absorption by 19.8%.

articleTitle: Visualizing invisibility: Photorealistic depictions of optical cloaks and other instruments in natural environments
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Visually stunning animations and images of invisibility devices and perfect imaging instruments will be presented. The ability to see the effects of dispersion, polarization dependence, and loss on performance aids the design of realistic devices.

articleTitle: Light extraction enhancement of a light-emitting diode by fabricating surface gratings around the mesa with patterned photoelectrochemical wet etching
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The >43% enhancement of light extraction by fabricating a surface grating structure around the mesa of a light-emitting diode with an approach combining photoelectrochemical wet etching and phase mask interferometry is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Nonperturbative excitonic interaction with intense THz pulses in ZnSe/ZnMgSSe multiple quantum wells
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The excitonic interaction in ZnSe/ZnMgSSe multiple quantum wells with intense terahertz pulses (~70 kV/cm) has been studied. Our results show a dynamical Stark effect on the excitonic absorption with a subpicosecond response time.

articleTitle: Tunable Infrared laser femtosecond source and novel pulse clean technique
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel tunable phase-stabilized infrared femtosecond source was developed with CEP stabilization and >1mJ pulse energy. Based on the laser source, a novel pulse clean technique is developed, and the 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sup> contrast ratio is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Enhanced nonlinear generation in DC-induced three wave mixing versus four wave mixing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A comparison is made between DC-induced three wave mixing and four wave mixing processes. Enhanced nonlinear generation terms offer significant advantages for the DC-induced process across a wide range of pulse widths despite dispersion disadvantages.

articleTitle: Chip-scale integrated tuning of slow-light in all-optical multi-EIT analogue in photonic crystal cavities
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the integrated chip-scale tuning of multiple photonic crystal cavities. The optimized implementation allows for large tuning (20 K/mW), with deterministic resonance control towards all-optical analogue to electromagnetically-induced-transparency on-chip.

articleTitle: Evanescent-wave cavity enhanced spectroscopy as a tool in label-free biosensing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A variety of evanescent-wave cavity-enhanced techniques is used in studying interfacial kinetics as well as the performance of anti-biofouling coatings, demonstrating the potential of these techniques in label-free biosensing.

articleTitle: Broadband Purcell effect in hyperbolic metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a new approach to the broadband Purcell effect based on metamaterials with hyperbolic dispersion. Highly directional emission and dramatic reduction in spontaneous-emission lifetime due to the singularity in density-of-states leads to many interesting applications.

articleTitle: Rapid droplet mixing using Light-Actuated Digital Microfluidics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the rapid droplet mixing ability of the Light-Actuated Digital Microfluidics device. A 3×3 array of droplets with 9 different reagent mixing ratios have been successfully generated using a digital light projector.

articleTitle: Transient optical response of quantum well excitons to intense few-cycle terahertz pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Interaction of strong few-cycle THz pulses with QW excitons produces pronounced nonlinear optical transients. With THz radiation tuned near the 1s-to-2p intraexciton transition, the exciton resonances exhibit Rabi sidebands revealing the 2p-dephasing time.

articleTitle: Naturally phase matched second harmonic generation in a whispering gallery mode resonator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We observed conversion efficiencies of 9% at 30 μW pump power in LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, as well as self-limiting effects at high powers. The continuous-wave pump at a wavelength of 1064 nm and the second-harmonic feature Q > 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup>.

articleTitle: Optical Coherence Tomography imaging of stenotic aortic valve samples
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Aortic valve samples, classified into normal, mild, moderate and severe fibrous calcific tissue based on Raman Spectroscopy, were analyzed with Optical Coherence Tomography. Results point OCT as a powerful diagnostic tool for aortic valve stenosis.

articleTitle: Passive building blocks for plasmonics nanocircuits with three-dimensional slot waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the analysis and optimization of several basic elements for three-dimensional plasmonic slot waveguides. These elements are key building blocks for efficient routing of light that can be used in on-chip optical links.

articleTitle: Quantum optical networks with trapped ions
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Trapped atomic ion quantum memories can be locally entangled via the Coulomb interaction and remotely entangled based on probabilistic photonic interfaces. Both versions are presented, highlighting their features and drawbacks when applied to quantum computing and quantum communication protocols.

articleTitle: Recent advances in fiber optic parametric amplifiers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This paper discusses recent developments which have led to dramatic improvements in the performance of optical parametric amplifiers, utilising both highly nonlinear fibers and photonic crystal fibers.

articleTitle: On-chip radio-frequency arbitrary waveform generation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A completely on-chip solution for radio-frequency arbitrary waveform generation (RFAWG) is proposed with silicon add-drop microring resonators and tunable all-pass microring delay lines. Preliminary results are shown for the pulse shaping effect.

articleTitle: Resonant infra-red pulsed laser ablation of polymers with single picosecond pulses generated by an optical parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have used a mid-IR optical parametric amplifier for single pulse ablation of polystyrene via resonant infra-red pulsed laser ablation.

articleTitle: Recent progress on high-speed and tunable VCSELs in the 1.3 to 2.6µm wavelength range
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Recent developments on InP- and GaSb-based high-speed and tunable singlemode VCSELs in the 1.3-2.6 μm wavelength range are presented. The relevant laser parameters are discussed and several applications in communications and trace-gas-sensing are illustrated.

articleTitle: Real-time high-sensitivity sensing of liquid films in microfluidic channels with optofluidic microresonators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate integrated optical ring resonators as time-resolved sensors with 3.2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> refractive index unit sensitivity embedded in microfluidic channels. Furthermore, we report the chip-scale detection of segmented flow with different liquid-film thicknesses and capillary numbers.

articleTitle: Imaging of corneal incisions by second- and third-harmonic generation microscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Second and Third harmonic imaging were investigated to observe a corneal flap created by an ophthalmic knife or a microkeratome as it can be processed during a LASIK surgery.

articleTitle: Controlling the anti-crossing between localized surface plasmons and surface plasmon polaritons
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study a structure consisting of a gold disk array, an SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> spacer, and a gold film. We study the effect of spacer thickness on the anti-crossing between localized plasmons and surface plasmon polaritons.

articleTitle: Bi-anisotropy of optical metamagnetics studied with spectroscopic ellipsometry
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Sub-wavelength gratings of paired Ag strips are measured and analyzed using spectroscopic ellipsometry, and show significant angular dependence of the electric and magnetic resonance properties, along with evidence of bi-anisotropy.

articleTitle: Demonstration of the optical microbubble resonator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We create silica microbubbles along a microcapillary with the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser heating and demonstrate the first optical microbubble resonator. It has 370 micron diameter, 2 micron wall thickness, and Q-factor exceeding 5·10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>.

articleTitle: An electrically driven entangled light source
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate electrically-driven entangled photon generation using a semiconductor quantum dot embedded in a light emitting diode structure. The entanglement is shown to be of sufficient fidelity for applications such as quantum key distribution.

articleTitle: Yb optical lattice clock at NMIJ, AIST
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed a one-dimensional optical lattice clock using a fermionic isotope of ytterbium (171Yb). The absolute frequency of the 1S0 - 3P0 clock transition in 171Yb is determined with respect to the SI second.

articleTitle: High energy 13.9 nm table-top soft X-ray laser operating at 2.5 Hz repetition rate
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have demonstrated table-top generation of λ = 13.9 nm laser pulses with 7 μJ energy at 2.5 Hz repetition rate from nickel-like ions in a laser-created plasma that will enable new applications of coherent soft x-ray light on a table-top.

articleTitle: Optical trap assisted nanopatterning for structured surfaces
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate the use of optical trap assisted nanopatterning for creating nanoscale features on surfaces with pre-existing topography. Uniform patterns over silicon and polyimide surfaces with several micrometer deep grooves are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Performance of a pulsed tunable nonlinear-optical coherent ultraviolet light source, verified by sub-Doppler two-photon spectroscopy of krypton
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A minimal-chirp nanosecond-pulsed nonlinear-optical system generates tunable coherent ultraviolet light at ~212.5 nm. Its frequency stability and optical bandwidth are verified by means of novel sub-Doppler coherent heterodyne-assisted two-photon spectroscopy of krypton.

articleTitle: Lasing oscillation in a three-dimensional photonic crystal nanocavity with quantum dots
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We successfully demonstrated lasing oscillation in a three-dimensional photonic crystal nanocavity with quantum dots. Increasing the number of stacked layers enhanced a cavity quality factor, leading to a significant reduction in the lasing threshold.

articleTitle: High-power, broadband, continuous-wave, mid-infrared optical parametric oscillator based on MgO:PPLN
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a broadband, high-power, fiber-laser-pumped, continuous-wave optical parametric oscillator for mid-infrared by exploiting extended phase-matching properties of MgO:PPLN. Total powers of 11.3W, with 5.3W broadband mid-infrared idler in excellent beam quality are generated.

articleTitle: Large area high efficiency broad bandwidth 800 nm dielectric gratings for high energy laser pulse compression
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have demonstrated broad bandwidth large area (229 mm × 114 mm) multilayer dielectric diffraction gratings for the efficient compression of high energy 800 nm laser pulses at high average power.

articleTitle: Terahertz amplifier based on gain switching in a quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A terahertz quantum cascade laser and an integrated Auston-switch are coupled to perform ultrafast gain switching. The resulting non-equilibrium gain is not clamped above laser threshold and large amplification of input terahertz pulses is demonstrated.

articleTitle: HOMO signature in high order harmonics driven in N2O and CO2 by a few-cycle 1.5µm parametric source
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High order harmonics driven by an ultrafast IR parametric source were generated in aligned N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O and CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>; the experimental results are numerically reproduced taking into account the HOMO structure.

articleTitle: Generation of sub-20fs pulses from an all-fiber carbon nanotube mode-locked laser system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a simple all-fiber femtosecond laser system based on carbon nanotube saturable absorber that was capable of generating 17-fs pulses with optical spectrum extending from 1000 nm to 1750 nm.

articleTitle: Loophole-free Bell inequality test via preselected macro-qubit entanglement
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present optical macro-entanglement beamsplitter-based preselection as a tool for loophole-free Bell test. Applied to experimentally feasible macro-qubits removes inefficiency of detection and dark counts. It constitutes novel polarization entanglement type.

articleTitle: Soliton collision induced dispersive wave generation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show numerically in the context of supercontinuum generation in the long pulse regime that soliton collisions can lead to the generation of rare, extreme-amplitude dispersive waves with enhanced spectral shift.

articleTitle: Investigation of symmetries of second-order nonlinear susceptibility tensor based on THz generation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that THz generation can be a sensitive technique for investigating symmetries of second-order nonlinear susceptibility tensor.

articleTitle: 1180 nm linearly-polarized fiber laser with high slope efficiency employing low-loss ytterbium-doped polarization maintaining solid photonic bandgap fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A linearly-polarized fiber laser operating at 1180 nm was demonstrated using a low-loss ytterbium-doped polarization maintaining solid photonic bandgap fiber. A slope efficiency of 30% was achieved.

articleTitle: Fourier transform spectrometers utilizing mid-infrared Quantum Cascade Lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Fabry-Perot Quantum Cascade Lasers can be used in conjunction with a FTIR spectrometer to perform spectroscopic experiments that require orders of magnitude more photons than what is achievable with a thermal illumination source. Three proof-of-concept experiments will be discussed.

articleTitle: Focusing light in a curved-space
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use transformation optics to demonstrate focusing of light. The lenses are designed and fabricated on silicon with dimensions ranging from 20 μm × 20 μm to 5.0 μm × 5.0 μm. The numerical and experimental results show the focusing of light over a broad wavelength range, from 1.15 μm to 1.60 μm.

articleTitle: 400 kHz beam scanning using KTa1-xNbxO3 crystals
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The frequency characteristics of the beam scanning with KTa<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>Nb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> crystals are described. The scanning angle remains in the same up to 400 kHz. Our proposed new scanning model supports this high-speed beam scanning.

articleTitle: Laser scanning holographic fabrication of large area photonic crystal templates
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Laser scanning of diffractive optics is introduced for flexible holographic fabrication of three-dimensional photonic crystal templates that facilitate seamless stitching of large-area crystals with spectral bandgap tuning, chirping, apodization and novel integration approaches for optofluidics.

articleTitle: Coherent spectroscopy of single GaAs quantum dots
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on Rabi oscillations in the ground state exciton transition of a single GaAs/AlGaAs quantum dot measured by a reflective, ultrafast pump-probe technique using only far field microscopic techniques.

PACS Terms: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Parametric results of the AlGaInAs quantum-well saturable absorber for use as a passive Q-switch
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have successfully designed, built and operated a microlaser based on a AlGaInAs multiple quantum well (MQW) semiconductor saturable absorber (SESA). Optical characterization of the semiconductor absorber, as well as, the microlaser output is presented.

articleTitle: Laser produced plasma light sources for EUV lithography
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the latest results on high-power extreme-ultraviolet (EUV) light sources for lithography. This includes operation of high-power pulsed CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> lasers, high repetition-rate Sn droplet targets, and collection of EUV light using multilayer-coated optics.

articleTitle: Room temperature sub-wavelength plasmon laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report plasmon lasers with optical confinement of 1/20th wavelength operating at room temperature. The strong confinement and efficient feedback arising from plasmonic total internal reflection enhance the spontaneous emission rate up to 20 times.

articleTitle: Generation of sub-150-fs, 100 nJ pulses from a low-cost cavity-dumped Cr:LiSAF laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a low-cost, cavity dumped Cr:LiSAF laser, generating 135-fs pulses at 825 nm, with 105 nJ pulse energies and ~0.78 MW of peak power at 10 kHz, using only 600 mW of pump power.

articleTitle: Demonstration of fully spatially coherent soft X-ray high harmonic beams in the water window
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We generate fully spatially coherent soft x-ray beams in the water window region of the spectrum using phase matched high harmonic upconversion of a 2 μm driving laser.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional optical metamaterials and nanoantennas: Chirality, coupling, and sensing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We review the properties of optical 3-dimensional metamaterials and analyze their coupling properties as well as chirality and sensing applications.

articleTitle: Volume Bragg gratings for spectral beam combining
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Basics and last results in spectral beam combining by volume Bragg gratings recorded in photo-thermo-refractive glass based on their high efficiency, narrow spectral selectivity and high tolerance to high power laser radiation are presented.

articleTitle: Electromagnetically induced transparency in a terahertz metamaterial
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a metamaterial that mimics electromagnetically induced transparency at terahertz frequencies. This is achieved by independently exciting two resonances in which their coupling to the radiation field, and their resonance linewidths, differ strongly.

articleTitle: The National Ignition Campaign on NIF
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This talk will describe progress in the experiments campaign on the National Ignition Facility (NIF) that has the goal of igniting and burning DT fuel through Inertial Confinement Fusion utilizing the world's largest laser.

articleTitle: Multi-granularity waveband- and wavelength-path network
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Future enhancements in optical path layer enabling technologies are highlighted. The role of waveband paths in creating the next generation transport network is discussed. Some state-of-the-art key enabling technologies are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Generation of 63-nJ pulses from a fiber oscillator mode-locked by nanotubes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We mode-lock a fiber oscillator with cavity length of ~1500m using nanotubes, achieving 1.55ps pulses with pulse energy up to 63nJ at 134KHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Technology, manufacturing and applications associated with the commercialization of systems based on quantum cascade gain media and lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Extraordinary progress has been made to advance the performance and manufacturability of quantum cascade (“qc”) materials. This progress has driven many to adopt and evolve this technology for a broad array of applications in the mid-infrared. In this talk, we will describe some of the key technology and manufacturing issues for commercializing quantum cascade laser (QCL) products. We will also discuss some of the applications that commercial QCL products can address.

articleTitle: Management of thermal effects in high average power pulsed optical parametric oscillators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on experimental investigation and modelling of thermal effects in high-power pulsed OPOs. A significant improvement of the conversion efficiency is demonstrated when a proper temperature gradient is applied to the nonlinear crystal.

articleTitle: Long-term, long-distance, all-optical synchronization of ultrafast fiber lasers at the quantum limit
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate quantum limited timing jitter performance of ultrafast fiber lasers and long distance (320 meter) synchronization of similar lasers over 168 hours with 5 femtosecons rms precision, at the quantum noise limit.

articleTitle: Advanced packaging of high-power Slab-Coupled Optical Waveguide laser and amplifier arrays for coherent beam combining
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Individually addressable GaAs-based 9XX-nm Slab-Coupled Optical Waveguide (SCOW) laser and amplifier arrays have been demonstrated in a modular 2-D stacked architecture. Approximately 20 W of coherently-combined power was obtained from two optically stacked amplifier modules.

articleTitle: Anomalous optical force fields around high-contrast subwavelength nanowaveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that anomalous-even repulsive-force fields can be induced around high-contrast optical nanowaveguides. Interestingly the longitudinal scattering force attains a maximum value even within regions where the Poynting vector is negative.

articleTitle: Synthesis of phase-locked counter-phase modulated pumps for SBS-suppressed fiber parametric amplifiers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a new all-optical technique for the generation of two optical pumps with oppositely varying carrier phases for mitigating SBS in parametric amplifiers without phase-dither transfer from pumps to signal.

articleTitle: Optical micromechanical amplification and damping in a waveguide microcavity
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate resonant amplification and damping in an integrated micromechanical resonator coupled to a waveguide Fabry-Perot microcavity. By varying the laser power and wavelength, the effective mechanical Q-factor (Q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> = 2.5 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>) is varied from 9.8 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> to 4.9 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>.

articleTitle: Multiwavelength High Contrast Grating VCSEL array with 200nm spectral range
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a new multi-wavelength High Contrast Grating VCSEL array, with an ultrabroad spectral range. The simple fabrication flow of this array is fully epitaxy compatible and requires no extra steps beyond a single-VCSEL process.

articleTitle: Single crystalline GaAs nanoneedles grown on 46% lattice-mismatched sapphire with bright luminescence
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Catalyst-free GaAs nanoneedles are grown on a c-plane sapphire substrate at 400°C using MOCVD. Despite of an extremely large lattice mismatch of 46%, the nanoneedles show single wurtzite-phase and bright room-temperature photoluminescence with narrow linewidths.

articleTitle: Local oscillator linewidth limitation on 16 QAM coherent optical transmission system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We studied the LO linewidth limitation for a 16-QAM WDM coherent system. The simulation shows that the linewidth should be less than 500 KHz for ≥ 100 Gb/s over 300 km dispersion managed fiber link.

articleTitle: Large enhancement of wavelength conversion in silicon nanowaveguides via free-carrier removal
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an increase of nearly 10 dB in the efficiency of broadband wavelength conversion via four-wave mixing in silicon nanowaveguides by incorporating a p-i-n structure and applying modest voltages to remove the free carriers.

articleTitle: Distributed feedback laser diodes emitting at 894 nm suitable for atomic clock applications fabricated using nanoimprint lithography
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The paper describes the fabrication of high-efficiency distributed feedback laser diodes operating at 894 nm. Regrowth-free fabrication of high aspect-ratio surface-gratings patterned using nanoimprint lithography enabled a 40 dB side-mode-suppression-ratio over a wide temperature range.

articleTitle: Two-color two-dimensional terahertz spectroscopy on intersubband transitions of coupled quantum wells
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Fully phase-resolved 2D intersubband spectroscopy reveals an ultrafast coherent charge transport between coupled quantum wells. A resonance between two excited quantum well subbands and the LO phonon leads to a transfer within 350 fs.

articleTitle: Reliability and performance of pseudomorphic ultraviolet light emitting diodes on bulk aluminum nitride substrates
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The development of pseudomorphic layers on low dislocation density AlN substrates is leading to improvements in reliability and performance of devices operating in the UVC range.

articleTitle: Non-contact surface roughness measurement of crankshaft journals using a super-continuum laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measure the RMS roughness of crankshaft journals from 0.05-0.13microns at a 45degree angle of incidence and 70cm standoff distance. The system is used to detect and sort journals not polished to specifications.

articleTitle: Difference frequency generation in domain-disordered quasi-phase matching semiconductor waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Idler wavelengths in the L- and U-bands were produced from a C-band signal and short-wave infrared pump by three-wave mixing in quasi-phase-matched semiconductor superlattice waveguides. Development of superlattice lasers demonstrates compatibility for monolithic integration.

articleTitle: Effects of nanodots on surface plasmons and electric field enhancement in nano-pillar antenna array
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study the effects of nanodots on surface plasmons and field enhancement in nano-pillar antenna array (NPA). The NPA's nanodots have slight effect on surface plasmon resonance wavelength, but increase field enhancement by two orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: Advances in photonic quantum information science
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Quantum technologies based on photons will likely require integrated optics architectures for improved performance, miniaturization and scalability. We demonstrate high-fidelity silica-on-silicon integrated optical realizations of key quantum photonic circuits and the first integrated quantum algorithm.

articleTitle: Nonperiodic optical superlattice optimized by genetic algorithm for engineered multiwavelength conversion
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate engineered multiwavelength conversion using nonperiodic optical superlattice optimized by genetic algorithm with two target functions. This scheme has better spectral shape fidelity and ~15% higher conversion efficiency compared to aperiodic optical superlattice.

articleTitle: Gain competition in multicolor quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigated dual-color mid-infrared quantum cascade lasers. We found that due to gain competition mid-infrared modes tend to start lasing in higher order lateral modes. The mid-infrared mode with the lower threshold current reduces population inversion for the second laser with the higher threshold current due to stimulated emission. A theoretical model describing this effect was developed, which is important for future device optimization.

articleTitle: High efficiency harmonic generation in LiNbO3 membranes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We reveal simultaneous phase- and group-velocity matching for frequency doubling of ultra-short pulses at telecom wavelengths in LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> membranes. Furthermore, we predict complete phase-matched cascaded third-harmonic generation for optimised membrane thickness.

articleTitle: Fiber-laser-pumped Ti:sapphire Laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first operation of a Ti:sapphire laser pumped by fiber laser. Using a high-power, cw, frequency-doubled Yb-fiber source at 532nm, continuous-wave operation over 806-970nm with output power >1.1W in TEM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub> spatial beam is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Comparison of plasma-effect in different InP-based VCSELs
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The FM amplitude/phase responses of InP-based VCSELs at 1.5 μm, 1.8 μm and 2.3 μm are presented and compared. The plasma effect is clearly observed although at 2.3 μm it is significantly lower. This interesting result is discussed.

articleTitle: Coherent perfect absorbers: Time-reversed lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An arbitrary body or aggregate can be made perfectly absorbing at discrete frequencies, if a precise amount of dissipation is added under specific conditions of coherent monochromatic illumination. This effect arises from the interaction of optical absorption and wave interference, and corresponds to moving a zero of the S-matrix onto the real wavevector axis. It is thus the time-reversed process of lasing at threshold. The effect may be demonstrated in a Si slab illuminated in the 500 - 900 nm range. Coherent perfect absorbers form a novel class of linear optical elements-absorptive interferometers-which may be useful for controlled optical energy transfer.

articleTitle: Dynamics of an Erbium Mid-IR laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A room temperature 4.5μm laser is reported in Er:KPb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Cl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> crystals using 0.8μm diode excitation. Long fluorescent lifetimes lead to important ETU and ESA processes. The impact of these excitation channels on laser performance is assessed.

articleTitle: 2.5Gbps two-user OCDMA system based on time domain spectral phase encoding and Variable-Bandwidth Spectrum Shaper decoding
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A 2.5Gbps two-user OCDMA transmission over 34km fiber with 8-chip, 20GHz/chip optical code pattern based on proposed time domain spectral phase encoding (SPE) and Variable-Bandwidth Spectrum Shaper (VBS) has been experimentally demonstrated with BER<;10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>.

articleTitle: Two-photon interference from separate quantum dots
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use strain to tune into resonance two different, remote quantum dots and show that the emitted photons will produce Hong-Ou-Mandel interference.

articleTitle: Demonstration of frequency-detuning compensation in a coupled-resonator device for efficient four-wave-mixing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A coupled-resonator device is proposed and experimentally demonstrated in silicon-on-insulator platform in which frequency-detuning of its traveling-wave modes can be dynamically tuned using integrated micro-heaters. Zero frequency-detuning for efficient four-wave-mixing is achieved using <;1 mW.

articleTitle: Antireflection and light trapping of periodic subwavelength surface structures formed by colloidal monolayer spheres lithography on thin film solar cells
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Solar cell efficiency enhancement by gradient periodic TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> nanoislands formed with the facilitation of polystyrene-spheres was studied. The enhancement mechanism was categorized by antireflection and light-trapping and achieves 72% relative increase of short-circuit current density.

articleTitle: Strain field manipulation in ultrafast laser inscribed nonlinear BiB3O6 optical waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Type I phase matching is demonstrated in an ultrafast laser inscribed BiB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> optical waveguide. A novel technique was implemented to achieve good spatial overlap of the horizontally and vertically polarized modes in “strain-field” type waveguides.

articleTitle: Strong circular dichroism from twisted split-ring-resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate chiral photonic metamaterials composed of stacked layers of twisted split-ring-resonators. Our design allows for strong circular dichroism of up to 33% at optical frequencies. The experiments are in good agreement with theory.

articleTitle: Coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering microscopy based on a compact two-color Er:fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A widely tunable picosecond Er:fiber laser system enables fast and turn-key CARS microscopy. The tuning range gives access to vibrational resonances between 1150 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> and 3800 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> with high spectral resolution of 10 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: Optical forces between a high-Q micro-disk resonator and an integrated waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate enhanced gradient optical force between a high-Q micro-disk resonator and a waveguide. We find that the total optical force is composed of contributions from the cavity backaction, the reactive and evanescent coupling.

articleTitle: Long term stable, high power 3 µm fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the longest stable laser emission at 3.8 W over 65 hours in a Er-doped fluoride fiber laser at 2.936 μm. The slope efficiency was 24% with respect to the launched pump power.

articleTitle: Characterization of extended width optical dipole antennas
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical dipole antennas with varying length and width are fabricated using e-beam lithography. Antennas with wider width are shown to exhibit stronger scattering while preserving the same resonance frequency.

articleTitle: Ultrasound detection using low beat frequency distributed Bragg reflector Er-doped fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Dual-polarization distributed Bragg reflector fiber laser (26 mm length) in Er-doped fiber with beat-frequency of ~20 MHz (significantly lower than ~1 GHz reported earlier) that is capable of detecting 16 MHz ultrasound has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Blind FROG pulse characterization for quantitative differential multiphoton microscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Quantitative multiphoton microscopy requires knowledge of the spatio-temporal characteristics of the excitation electric field. With a unique multifocal system, we completely characterize the excitation intensity at the full numerical aperture of the excitation objective.

articleTitle: Frequency offset estimation using a Kalman filter in coherent optical phase-shift keying systems
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a novel frequency offset estimator by using canonical Kalman filter in coherent optical phase-shift keying systems. Simulation results show that it can quickly search for the frequency offset and approach the performance of an ideal frequency offset estimator.

articleTitle: High gain broadband amplification of ultraviolet pulses using optical parametric chirped pulse amplifier
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a high gain amplification of broadband ultraviolet femtosecond pulses in an optical parametric chirped pulse amplifier. Amplification of 0.5·10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> was achieved, with the pulse energy of 30μJ and duration of 24fs.

articleTitle: Carbon nanotube photonics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We review our studies on passively mode-locked fiber lasers and nonlinear optical devices using carbon nanotube (CNT). CNT-based devices offer several key advantages such as: ultra-fast response, robustness, tunability of wavelength, and compatibility to fibers.

articleTitle: Limitations of noise figure in InGaAsP quantum-well semiconductor optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first quantitative investigation of noise figure degradation in InGaAsP quantum-well semiconductor optical amplifiers at high bias. We compare two experimental measurements of population inversion factor for a 1.5-μm slab-coupled optical-waveguide amplifier (SCOWA).

articleTitle: Optical coherence-domain reflectometry by use of optical frequency comb
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel optical coherence domain reflectometry (OCDR) by use of an optical frequency comb source is proposed and demonstrated with high spatial resolution (<;10 cm), large dynamic range (>45 dB), and short measurement time (≤10 s).

articleTitle: Isotope selective trapping of singly and doubly charged Yb ions in an RF trap
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have successfully trapped singly and doubly ionized Ytterbium in a linear RF quadrupole trap. Ionization was accomplished with both photoionization and electron beam ionization. Co-trapping of Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> and Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> was confirmed through electronic detection.

articleTitle: Metal optics as a circuit problem: Revealing the possibility of an optical voltage transformer
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A simple circuit model is used to derive the fundamental electromagnetic properties of metals in the optical regime. The model reveals the possibility of an optical voltage transformer capable of matching large impedances at the nanoscale.

articleTitle: Ultrashort pulse generation from cw beam by trapped pulse amplification in birefringent fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 248 pJ and 322 fs ultrashort pulse was generated from cw beam using pulse trapping and Raman amplification by ultrashort soliton pulse in birefringent fibers. The physical mechanism and characteristics were also analyzed numerically.

articleTitle: THz generation from monoclinic centrosymmetric gate crystals pumped across bandgap due to carrier unidirectional diffusion
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have observed unique polarization and azimuth-angle characteristics of THz waves, generated from anisotropic monoclinic GaTe when pump photon energy is below and above its bandgap, due to carrier unidirectional diffusion.

PACS Terms: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Sensing by metal cylinders compressing THz surface waves
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Terahertz surface waves propagating on dielectric coated metal sheets are investigated. With respect to sensor applications the interaction of the guided THz wave and closely approaching coated metallic cylinders is discussed. Unexpected coupling efficiencies are obtained.

articleTitle: Broadband, low-dispersion, mid-infrared metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Broad-bandwidth, low-dispersion, optical metamaterials are desired. Reflection measurements show that, by using multiple-metamaterial semiconductor stacks of varying thickness and doping, bandwidth is improved by 47% over a single-stack mid-infrared metamaterial, and dispersion appears reduced.

articleTitle: Generation of cerenkov radiation at 850 nm in higher-order-mode fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate Cerenkov radiation generation in a higher-order-mode fiber with anomalous dispersion from approximately 700 to 800 nm. Cerenkov radiation at 850 nm with 0.6 nJ pulse energy is generated with 60% power conversion efficiency.

articleTitle: Laser cooling of a semiconductor load to 165 K
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate cooling of a 2 micron thick GaAs/InGaP double-heterostructure to 165 K by means of an optical refrigerator. Cooler is comprised of Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped YLF crystal, pumped by 9 Watt near E4-E5 Stark manifold transition

articleTitle: Dual-pumping scheme for high-energy femtosecond Er-doped fiber laser at 1.6 µm
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first microjoule-class sub-picosecond erbium-doped fiber laser at 1600 nm, and demonstrate the generation of 2.2 μJ, 650 fs pulses at 100 kHz. Dual-pumping schemes at 980 and/or 1550 nm are investigated.

articleTitle: Rate equation analysis of quantum dot population in InAs/GaAs laser structures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using a rate equation model we quantitatively reproduce experimental results showing the transition from random to thermal population across the whole temperature range and measure the impact on laser operation.

articleTitle: Phase-sensitive motility contrast imaging of tumor response to drugs
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce phase-sensitive motility contrast imaging and present high-contrast time-course measurements of cytoskeletal anticancer drug effects on dynamic motion inside tumor spheroids obtained by digital holographic optical coherence imaging.

articleTitle: Observation of polariton dispersions for ZnO microcavities in strong couple regime
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Characteristics of ZnO-based MCs with vacuum Rabi splitting of 72 meV are demonstrated. It is found that only the LPBs can be observed in ZnO MCs since the Rabi splitting pushes UPBs into scattering absorption.

articleTitle: Spatially resolved, polarized photoluminescence from wurtzite InGaAs/GaAs nanoneedles
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We spatially resolve photoluminescence from wurtzite InGaAs/GaAs core-shell nanoneedles and characterize their nonuniform quantum well emission. Polarization measurements reveal anisotropy behavior that is reminiscent of GaN and other wurtzite materials.

articleTitle: A 500 km optical fiber link with six remotely controlled optical amplifiers for frequency comparison between MPQ and PTB
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the status of the optical link project between PTB and MPQ and present the to our knowledge first frequency transfer using urban fiber networks over a distance of about 500 km length.

articleTitle: Rapid fabrication of silver nanowires through photoreduction from silver nitride in anodic aluminum oxide template
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This study reports on a new photoreduction approach for growing dense and continuous silver nanowires from an anodic aluminum oxide (AAO) template. Silver nanoparticles are first reduced then merged to form nanowires in the AAO pores from dried silver nitride by laser irradiation. The morphology and composition of the grown nanostructures are characterized and the detailed photochemical growth mechanism is addressed. This method is rapid, low-cost, local reduction and can be executed in the ambient environment.

articleTitle: Q-switching a fiber laser with an electrically controlled microstructured fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A monolithic fiber laser incorporating an electrically driven microstructured fiber is Q-switched exploiting nanosecond polarization rotation and multi-pass amplification. All components are in-fiber, simplifying fabrication and improving robustness.

articleTitle: Laser imaging inside engines for advanced direct injection gasoline engine development
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Imaging techniques (laser Mie scattering, particle image velocimetry, spectrally-resolved spark and combustion luminosity, and laser induced fluorescence) with high repetition rate lasers and multiple CMOS cameras allow fuel injection, fuel/air mixing, ignition, and combustion to be followed within one engine cycle. This aids the design of advanced gasoline direct injection engines by avoiding intermittent poor burning engine cycles. Improvements in tunable uv high repetition rate lasers would expand the range of possible in-cylinder experiments.

articleTitle: Resonant transmission and effective medium response of subwavelength H and H-fractal apertures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The transmission of infrared light through subwavelength H-shaped aperture arrays in gold is measured. To increase the resonant wavelength relative to the aperture size, H-fractal aperture arrays and their effective medium parameters are investigated.

articleTitle: Observation of collisional narrowing in an ensemble of cold atoms
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study the coherence dynamics of optically trapped <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb atoms. We observe a decrease of the dephasing rate for an increasing elastic collision rate, and show that it depends only on the phase space density.

articleTitle: Frequency-Domain Streak Camera for ultrafast imaging of evolving light-velocity objects
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the extension of Frequency-Domain Holography to a Frequency-Domain Streak Camera capable of capturing the evolution of refractive index structures propagating at luminal speeds. Possibility of extension to Frequency-Domain Tomography is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Disentangling carbon nanotubes of broadland sub-100 fs optical switching
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Controlling bundling and curl of carbon nanotubes permits ultrafast optical switching, which was demonstrated in a >500 nm near-infrated band by femtosecond mode-locking of three bulk lasers using one and the same saturable absorber.

articleTitle: Dynamic monitoring of the heart beating behaviors of drosophila with optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The dynamic behaviors of heart beating of drosophilae, including abnormal drosophilae of mutant genes and high-temperature culture, and normal drosophilae with different fixing techniques for observation, are monitored with a swept-source optical coherence tomography system.

articleTitle: Ultrafast graphene photodetector
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate ultrafast transistor-based photodetectors made from single- and few-layer graphene. The photoresponse does not degrade for optical intensity modulations up to 40 GHz, and further analysis suggests that the intrinsic bandwidth may exceed 500 GHz.

articleTitle: Ultra-sensitive infrared spectroscopy of proteins with collective excitations of nanoplasmonic arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Short interaction lengths limit the application of infrared absorption spectroscopy to the study monolayer thickness films. We employ periodic infrared antenna arrays to obtain 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>-10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> enhancement of protein absorption signals corresponding to zepto-mole sensitivity.

articleTitle: Beam reformatting and combining of high-power laser diode stacks
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Custom beam correction phase-plates developed for conserving brightness for diode laser bars in beam shaping/combining now provide multiple optical functions in one component, for new approaches to spatial, wavelength and coherent combining of arrays.

articleTitle: Ultrafast electron dynamics in a Pb/Cu(111) quantum-well system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Time- and angle-resolved two-photon photoemission has been used to investigate hot-electron lifetimes in Pb/Cu(111). Our findings suggest that the peculiar electronic structure of quantum-well systems can be used to tune ultrafast dynamical properties in metals.

articleTitle: Efficient single-pass second harmonic generation of a continuous wave Nd:YVO4 - laser at 1342 nm using MgO:PPLN
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report efficient second harmonic generation of 20.5 W continuous wave laser radiation at 1342 nm using MgO:PPLN. A second harmonic power of 9.5 W in a diffraction limited beam was reached, giving an efficiency of 46%.

articleTitle: A pulsed THz imaging system with a line focus and a balanced 1-D detection scheme with two industrial CCD line cameras
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a pulsed terahertz imaging system with a line focus intended to speed up measurements. A balanced 1-D detection scheme working with two industrial line cameras is used. The instrumental characteristics are determined.

articleTitle: Ultrafast, chipscale, optically-gated optical sampler
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a novel single-shot optical recorder capable of picosecond-scale resolution across hundreds of ps of record length. The concept is a hybrid between cross-correlators and Mach-Zehnder-gated samplers, with advantages over both techniques.

articleTitle: A semiconductor device for surface-plasmon generation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a compact semiconductor laser device for generation and launching of surface plasmon into a passive waveguide at room temperature. Surface-plasmons are generated electrically at a single frequency using a distributed-feedback quantum cascade laser in the mid-infrared wavelengths, they are then launched in a passive metal strip and detected using an aperture-less near field scanning optical microscope.

articleTitle: Passive synchronization between a 131-W mode-locked nanosecond Yb-doped fiber laser and a femtosecond Ti:sapphire laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a passive synchronization between a high power nanosecond fiber laser and a femtosecond Ti:sapphire laser with a cavity-length mismatch tolerance up to 8 cm and a timing jitter of 13 ps.

articleTitle: Quantum process tomography by direct characterization of quantum dynamics using hyperentangled photons
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first experimental results using photons entangled in multiple degrees of freedom to efficiently characterize various preserving single-photon processes by Direct Characterization of Quantum Dynamics (DCQD), with the fewest possible number of measurements.

articleTitle: Generation of 5-fs pulses tunable from 400 to 120 nm by kagome-lattice hollow-core PCF
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We predict the generation of isolated UV/VUV 5-fs pulses from Ti:sapphire laser pulses during spectral broadening in argon-filled kagome-cladding PCF. The spectral position of the pulse can be easily tuned by changing the pressure.

articleTitle: Long-term reliable phase-locked seed source for Yb-fiber-based chirped pulse amplification
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We constructed a composite fiber-based femtosecond laser by combining Er- and Yb-doped fibers to achieve superb long-term stability along with high pump-to-signal conversion.

articleTitle: Optical trapping with real-time feedback using planar silicon micro-ring resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate optical trapping with micro-ring resonators. Tuning the incident wavelength enables controlled trapping and release of particles. The resonance frequency red-shift upon trapping enables monitoring of the particle physical properties.

articleTitle: Bismuth-oxide-based ytterbium-doped double-clad fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ytterbium-doped bismuth-oxide-based double-clad fiber was fabricated. The absorbance of a core was 1430 dB/m. Fiber lasers were demonstrated with a resonator of a FBG and a splicing point with a high refractive index glass.

articleTitle: Ultra-long-lived molecular coherence in hydrogen filled hollow-core photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A delayed probe-pump technique shows the persistence of molecular coherence of rotational Raman resonance in hydrogen-filled hollow-core photonic crystal fiber over a time-scale ∼42 times longer than the dephasing time.

articleTitle: Trace gas detection with frequency comb Fourier transform spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Dual-comb Fourier transform spectroscopy with cavity enhancement holds much promise for trace gas sensing. Broadband high resolution spectra of ammonia around 1.0 μm are recorded within 18 μs and a noise-equivalent-absorption of 1 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-½</sup>.

articleTitle: Optofluidic microchip with integrated 780-nm VCSEL arrays for biomedical and chemical sensing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the compact integration of high-power 780-nm VCSEL arrays with a microfluidic channel to create an optofluidic microchip. Characterization of the microchip using a near-infrared fluorescent dye yields a detection limit of 10 μM.

articleTitle: Soft X-ray laser pumped by a joule-class, all-diode-pumped laser system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The first soft x-ray laser pumped by laser diodes is reported. Lasing was achieved on the 18.9 nm line of nickel-like molybdenum pumping with a Yb:YAG chirped pulse amplification system with 1 J energy.

articleTitle: 3D optical Yagi-Uda nanoantenna array
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We fabricated three-dimensional arrays of optical Yagi-Uda nano-antennas. Due to the high directivity of the array structure the incoming light is received efficiently at the resonant wavelength in the near-infrared (around λ = 1.3 μm).

articleTitle: Sellmeier and thermo-optic dispersion formulas for CsTiOAsO4
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The high-accuracy Sellmeier equations for CsTiOAsO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> that reproduce correctly the type-2 SHG and SFG in the 0.4121-1.5915 μm range and the 90° phase-matched optical parametric oscillation in the 0.7337-2.4793 μm range are presented together with the thermo-optic dispersion formula.

articleTitle: Dual-wavelength pumped 1.550µm high-power optical parametric chirped-pulse amplifier system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A 1.550 μm OPCPA utilizing a dual wavelength pumping scheme has been constructed. The system incorporates LBO and KTA for the first and second-stage amplifiers. Peak powers >310GW (60mJ, 180fs) at 10Hz have been achieved.

articleTitle: High repetition rate cavity-dumped Yb∶KYW femtosecond oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An Yb:KYW oscillator has been cavity-dumped at 4.58 MHz, obtaining pulses as short as 264-fs and energies as high as 250 nJ. Up to 1.8 μJ and 234-fs have been achieved at 0.56 MHz.

articleTitle: Lithographic and oxide-free vertical cavity surface emitting laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: All-epitaxial oxide-free vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers (VCSELs) are demonstrated. 4-μm-diameter VCSEL is shown with threshold current of 350 μA, slope efficiency of 0.77 W/A, wall-plug efficiency of 21% and output power of 6.3 mW.

articleTitle: Photocurrent spectroscopy and luminescence of GaN/AlN quantum discs in GaN nanowires
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present optical studies of carrier confinement in GaN/AlN quantum discs in nanowires and their application to photodetection on the nanoscale. Single-nanowire UV photodetector relying on carrier generation in quantum discs is demonstrated.

articleTitle: 40-W, CW, cavity-enhanced second-harmonic generation with kHz linewidth of an injection-locked Nd:YAG Laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated a 40-W, CW, cavity-enhanced second-harmonic generation (SHG) with kHz linewidth of an injection-locked Nd:YAG laser. The nonlinear characteristics of LiB<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> were measured with a single-pass configuration to design a SHG cavity.

articleTitle: Coherent raman microscopy with a fiber-format femtosecond laser oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel highly simplified architecture for Coherent Raman Scattering microscopy (CARS and SRS) is demonstrated, where multiple tunable narrowband picosecond pulses are generated by spectral compression of femtosecond pulses emitted by a compact Er-fiber oscillator.

articleTitle: Investigating non-radiative energy transfer in quantum-dot-based white light emitting diodes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We fabricated an InGaN based nanorod LED structure with colloidal quantum-dot (QD) phosphors deposited in between the nanorods, creating side-wall coupling between QD phosphors and InGaN multiple-quantum-well (MQW) emitters. Time-resolved photoluminescence measurements for nanorod structures with and without colloidal QD coating were performed to study the direct MQW-to-QD non-radiative energy transfer.

articleTitle: Generation of time-bin entangled photon pairs using cascaded second order nonlinearity in single periodically-poled lithium niobate waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a simple scheme to generate time-bin entangled photon pairs based on cascaded second-order nonlinear processes in a single periodically-poled lithium niobate waveguide. We successfully observed two-photon interference fringes up to 97% visibilities.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable photonics from microfluidic waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Here we report the development of adaptive photonics using optofluidic waveguides. This work demonstrates the ability to couple light from a liquid-core waveguide to solid-core waveguides taking advantage of both photonic modalities while facilitating reconfigurability.

articleTitle: A fiber-optic nerve stimulation probe integrated with a precise common-path optical coherence tomography distance sensor
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have demonstrated a simple and effective common-path optical coherence tomography guided fiber probe for optical nerve stimulation which improves the spatial precision and safety of stimulation laser power delivery.

articleTitle: Fingerprinting Ovalbumin - Simulant of protein toxins in extremely-wide frequency range
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have identified ten new absorption peaks in the unexplored spectral range of 3600-7000 wave numbers and two new peaks in 15-120 wave numbers from Ovalbumin being regarded as a simulant of protein toxins.

articleTitle: Production of 3ps multi-terawatt pulses in a CO2 laser system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 15TW picosecond 10μm laser pulses are obtained at the UCLA Neptune Laboratory achieving record CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser power. This peak power opens unique opportunities for applications in high-field experiments in the mid-IR range.

articleTitle: Optical probing and actuation of microwave frequency phononic crystal resonators without clamping losses
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate microwave frequency mechanical modes of optomechanical crystals having arbitrarily small clamping losses. The optomechanical crystals are connected to the substrate via a phononic bandgap structure, simultaneously isolating and rigidly supporting the optomechanical resonator.

articleTitle: Using hyperentangled photons to prepare bound entanglement
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an experimental setup to prepare the bound-entangled Smolin state using hyperentangled photons produced by spontaneous parametric down-conversion. We can verify the state produced using quantum state tomography and “unlocking” of entanglement.

articleTitle: Extraordinary transmission in the UV range from sub-wavelength slits on semiconductors
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Accessing the part of the spectrum where semiconductors behave like metals leads to extraordinary transmission in the UV regime and enhanced nonlinear plasmonic phenomena in the UV and soft X-ray wavelengths.

PACS Terms: (240.3695) Linear and nonlinear light scattering from surfaces

articleTitle: Square lattice photonic crystal point-shifted D0 nanocavity with lowest-order whispering-gallery mode
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a square photonic crystal point-shifted nanocavity, which sustains an ultra-small lowest-order whispering-gallery mode. Lasing actions with low threshold of 160 μW and changed polarization due to a nearby nano-particle are observed.

articleTitle: Laser-induced periodic nanostructures on ZnO surfaces with a patterned beam in water environment
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Periodic surface structures were induced in ZnO in water with a focused femtosecond laser beam working in Fresnel region. A circular diffraction pattern transferred into the material is superimposed by sub-200 nm features.

articleTitle: Flexible photonic crystal defect lasers on a polydimethylsiloxane polymer substrate
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated a flexible photonic crystal defect laser on a polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) polymer substrate. The curvature dependences of lasing power and threshold were also characterized by bending the photonic crystal cavity at different bending curvatures.

articleTitle: High-amplitude THz and GHz strain waves, generated by ultrafast screening of piezoelectric fields in InGaN/GaN multiple quantum wells
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Screening of large built-in piezoelectric fields in InGaN/GaN quantum wells leads to high-amplitude acoustic emission. We will compare acoustic emission by quantum wells with different thicknesses with photoluminescence; indicating screening.

articleTitle: In-line chemical sensing device with C-type fiber and photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We fabricated the in-line chemical sensing device with novel `C-type' with only cleaving/splicing process, which supplemented the previous devices' drawbacks. The great potential of this device was also confirmed through acetylene gas sensing experiment.

articleTitle: Adiabatic couplers in SOI waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Adiabatic 3-dB couplers based on highly confined silicon waveguides are studied and experimentally demonstrated. The couplers are inherently broadband and insensitive to fabrication imperfections, which enables reliable photonic circuits.

articleTitle: Sub two-cycle pulse compression at 1.8 µm with bulk material
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A simple scheme for generating 0.4 mJ 11.5 fs pulses at 1.8 μm is presented. Optical parametric amplified pulses were spectrally broadened in a hollow-core fiber and subsequently compressed by utilizing linear propagation through bulk material.

articleTitle: Single crystal diamond photonic crystal nanocavity: Fabrication and Initial Characterization
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a photonic crystal high-Q nanocavity realized on a single crystal diamond membrane produced by ion implantation. The cavity is patterned by Focused-Ion-Beam milling. The micro-photoluminescence exhibits Q ≈ 500 at λ = 612 nm and clear polarization dependence.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of sparse sub-wavelength images
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use compressed sensing to demonstrate theoretically the reconstruction of sub-wavelength features from measured far-field, and provide experimental proof-of-concept. The methods can be applied to non-optical microscopes, provided the information is sparse.

articleTitle: High power 55 watts CW Raman fiber-gas-laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, a Raman fiber-gas-laser with 55 W output power by coupling 85 W of a high-power fiber-laser in a H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-filled hollow-core-photonic-crystal-fiber. The laser characteristics include pure Stokes output and high mode quality.

articleTitle: Micro- and nanostructure induced birefringence in phosphate glass fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that microstructures inside the cladding of phosphate fiber as well as sub-wavelength nanostructures inside the fiber core can introduce birefringence in phosphate glass fiber components.
