articleTitle: Nonlinear transmission, scattering and optical limiting studies of graphene dispersions
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Employing high-yield production of graphene by liquid-phase exfoliation, a series of dispersions with large populations of graphene single and few layers was prepared. Nonlinear optical properties of these graphene dispersions were studied using the open aperture Z-scan technique at 532 nm and 1064 nm. The graphene dispersions exhibit broadband nonlinear scattering induced optical limiting.

articleTitle: Intrinsic laser-induced damage in bulk transparent dielectrics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Our results from experiments on laser-induced damage in transparent dielectrics are incompatible with the well-known avalanche ionization model. The mechanism of damage may involve a collective response of the dielectric, such as “dielectric-metal” phase transition.

articleTitle: Symmetry-breaking of bound states in the continuum
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first experimental observation of bound states in the continuum in optics, and how the bound state transforms into a leaky mode as symmetry is reduced.

articleTitle: Intense and stable high-order harmonics from carbon using the plasma harmonic method
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study high-order harmonic generation from plasma that are created from bulk carbon target. We obtained high-order harmonic energy in the multi-microjoule range for the 11th to the 17th harmonic. By analysing the target morphology and the plasma composition, we conclude that the intense harmonics from this bulk carbon target have the same origin as those from nanoparticles target.

articleTitle: Electrically pumped photonic crystal nanocavities using a laterally doped p-i-n junction
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ion implantation doping is used to define a laterally doped p-i-n junction to electrically pump a gallium arsenide photonic crystal nanocavity with indium arsenide quantum dots. Cavity coupled electroluminescence is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Dynamic magnetic manipulation of color/shape encoded magnetic microparticles for bio-assay applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Rapid separation and 3D reaction-2D reading of color and shape encoded magnetic microparticles are demonstrated using 1D chain structure of magnetic nanoparticles involved in the microparticle. Also single material based simple particle fabrication method is presented.

articleTitle: Optical and structural properties of Zirconium doped lithium niobate crystals
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a careful investigation of the optical properties of Zr-doped lithium-niobate crystals. We also investigate in detail the threshold concentration for Zr-doping, by means of three different optical measurement techniques.

articleTitle: THz generation from highly-lossy second-order nonlinear medium at polariton resonance in transverse-pumping geometry
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that transverse-pumping geometry can be exploited for THz generation when a second-order nonlinear medium is highly lossy at its polariton resonance. High conversion efficiencies can be achieved via such a novel configuration.

articleTitle: Observation of very large THz electro-optic response in (Cd,Mn)Te single crystals
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Large electro-optic Pockels effect is observed in (Cd,Mn)Te single crystals in response to THz pulses, presenting voltage sensitivity ten times greater than at MHz frequencies. We demonstrate that the discrepancy is due to free-carrier screening.

articleTitle: Fusion energy: Laser systems required to harness the power of the sun
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Laser systems deployed in Inertial Fusion Energy power plants will usher in space qualified laser engineering and materials on a massive scale. Understanding subsystem efficiencies and component Mean Time Between Failure (MTBF) are critical for success.

articleTitle: Time-domain observation of Rabi flopping in a laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report direct time-domain observation of Rabi flopping in an operating semiconductor quantum cascade laser.

PACS Terms: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Trapping and stretching of single cells in an optofluidic chip fabricated by a femtosecond laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a monolithic chip able to perform single-cell mechanical analyses without physical contact and with high reproducibility. The chip is based on a fused silica glass substrate and it is fabricated by fs-laser micromachining.

articleTitle: Optically-driven fast and widely wavelength-swept fiber laser based on dispersion tuning
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate optically-driven fast and wide wavelength-swept laser based on dispersion tuning via cross gain modulation of the SOA. We achieved the tuning range of 87.9 nm and the tuning rate of 200 kHz.

articleTitle: Novel micro-heater structure for low-power and fast photonic reconfiguration
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel microheater structure integrated over small microdisks in silicon-on-insulator is proposed with less than 100 nanosecond reconfiguration time using pulsed-excitation. Power consumption of the devices are shown to be 40% less than conventional microheaters.

articleTitle: Plasmonic solar cells with broadband absorption enhancements
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A combined computational and experimental study optimizing plasmon-enhanced absorption in Si thin film solar cells presented. A model system consisting of a 2-dimensional periodic /aperiodic arrays of Ag nanostructures on a silica coated Si film supported by a silica substrate is used in the simulations. We develop basic design rules for the realization of broadband absorption enhancements for such structures, by simultaneously taking advantage of 1) the high near-fields surrounding the nanostructures close to their surface plasmon resonance frequency and 2) the effective coupling to waveguide modes supported by the Si film through an optimization of the array properties.

articleTitle: Three-photon/two-photon resonance enhancement of third harmonic generation in human oxyhemoglobin and deoxyhemoglobin
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated that the spectroscopic enhancement of third harmonic generation (THG) of human oxyhemoglobin and deoxyhemoglobin in the 1200-1300 nm region agreed with the absorption spectra and was dominated by three-photon/two-photon resonance.

articleTitle: Metal-lined capillaries for efficient Raman gas sensing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We mathematically and experimentally examine the use of reflective silver-lined capillary waveguides that support a large number of EH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1n</sub> modes to efficiently collect Raman Stokes scattering from gaseous samples.

articleTitle: Signed chromatic dispersion monitoring for DPSK signal based on delay-tap sampling
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated a signed chromatic dispersion (CD) monitoring method for NRZ-DPSK signals based on delay-tap sampling technique. The monitoring range can reach from -425 ps/nm to 425 ps/nm and the monitoring sensitivity is ±8 ps/nm.

articleTitle: Probing heavy-hole and light-hole excitonic beats in a GaAs quantum well with phase-locked Raman pulse pairs
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Transient pump-probe studies using phase-locked Raman pulse pairs as the pump reveal a new interpretation for the heavy-hole and light-hole excitonic beats in transient differential transmission of a GaAs quantum well.

articleTitle: High-energy, high-efficiency second-harmonic generation from a Nd-doped laser with high-quality CsB3O5 crystal
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Frequency doubling of high-energy Nd-doped laser emission yields harmonically converted laser energy (532-nm) of 1.2-J with 60 % conversion efficiency using a high optical quality top-seeded solution growth CsB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> crystal.

articleTitle: Simultaneous triple-waveband, 10-Gbps transmission in 1-µm, C-, and L-wavebands over a 5.4-km long holey fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Simultaneous triple-waveband, 10-Gbps error-free photonic transport with clear eye-openings are demonstrated in the 1-μm, C-, and L-wavebands by using an ultra-broadband photonic transport system comprising a single and long holey fiber transmission line.

articleTitle: Quantum interference of tunably indistinguishable photons from remote organic molecules
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate two-photon interference using two remote organic molecules as bright solid-state sources of indistinguishable photons. By varying the transition frequency and spectral width of one molecule, we explore the effect of photon distinguishability.

articleTitle: Highly anisotropic decay rate of single quantum dots in photonic crystal membranes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have measured the variation of the spontaneous emission rate with polarization for self-assembled single quantum dots in two-dimensional photonic crystal membranes, and obtained a maximum anisotropy factor of 6 between the decay rates of the two nondegenerate bright states.

articleTitle: The physics of a dissipative optomechanical coupling
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We analyze theoretically a novel cavity electromechanical system where a mechanical resonator modulates the damping rate of a driven cavity. Destructive quantum noise interference allows ground state cooling even in the unresolved sideband regime.

articleTitle: Light tunneling in multi-layered photonic-plasmonic nanostructures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photonic and plasmonic interactions in multi-layered plasmonic crystals, formed by coupling nanohole-nanoparticle arrays, are investigated. The hybrid structure exhibits extraordinary optical transmission as in single layer nanohole arrays and supports Fabry-Perot mode with improved sensitivity.

articleTitle: Self-diffraction SPIDER
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using microjoule supercontinuum pulses, two novel SPIDER variants based on the χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup>-process of self-diffraction are experimentally demonstrated for the first time. The upshift variant appears particularly interesting for ultraviolet femtosecond pulse characterization.

articleTitle: Fiber-coupled waveguides for strong resonant interactions with single semiconductor quantum dots
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate fiber-coupled waveguides engineered for efficient interaction with single semiconductor quantum dots, with calculated fluorescence collection > 70 % and ≈ 15 dB transmission contrast upon resonant excitation. Characterization of passive waveguides and preliminary photoluminescence measurements are presented.

articleTitle: Structurally reconfigurable metamaterials at terahertz frequencies
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate structurally reconfigurable metamaterials with a marked tunability of both electric and magnetic responses at terahertz frequencies where artificial “atoms” reorient within unit cells in response to an external stimulus.

articleTitle: Narrow-line all-fiber bismuth ring laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A narrow-line continuous-wave bismuth-doped all-fiber laser, with 10 mW output power in a 4 GHz linewidth is demonstrated. We use a narrow-band FBG and fiber-integrated Fabry-Perot filters to achieve a factor of 20 mode suppression.

articleTitle: Effective generation of triplet states and singlet oxygen by sulfur-containing squaraines: Experimental and theoretical study
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Efficiency of singlet oxygen generation is investigated for a series of new sulfur-containing squaraines molecules. Experimental results, in agreement with quantum calculations, show both large triplet quantum yield and quantum yield of singlet oxygen generation.

articleTitle: Optothermal manipulation of colloidal microparticles
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated trapping of 6-μm polystyrene microparticles over a 253-μm range using a trapping power of ~ 7 mW at 1550 nm. The observed particle levitation and segregation offer a longe-range energy-efficient manipulation mechanism.

articleTitle: Compensation of group delay with tunable slow/fast light form-birefringent metamaterial structures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the compensation of slow light by tunable slow/fast light structure made of form-birefringent metamaterial structures. Employing full compensation, the slow light structure can effectively be made to disappear over a significant frequency range.

articleTitle: 12.5Gbps PSK signal detection using 200MHz detector with dual heterodyne mixing method
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Novel method for relative phase measurement between optical longitudinal modes has been proposed and named as “dual heterodyne mixing method”. It was applied for 12.5GBps BPSK signal sensing by 200MHz low-speed receiver.

articleTitle: Noise-insensitive self-referencing interferometer for carrierenvelope offset frequency stabilization of a Ti:sapphire laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel design of f:2f self-referencing interferometer employing Wollaston prisms for group-delay dispersion compensation exhibits up to 15 dB reduction in phase noise in specific frequency bands compared to a Michelson interferometer arrangement.

articleTitle: Single-prism/grating pulse compressor
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce an ultrashort-laser-pulse compressor that uses a single prism and a single grating. It is compact and automatically aligned for distortion-free output, and it compensates for significant material dispersion up to third order.

articleTitle: Photofragmentation approaches for the detection of polyatomic molecules
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We review three photofragmentation detection approaches, describing the detection of (1) vapor-phase mercuric chloride by photofragment emission, (2) vapor-phase nitro-containing compounds by photofragmentation-ionization, and (3) surface-bound organophosphonate compounds by photofragmentation-laser-induced fluorescence.

articleTitle: Coherent electro-optical detection of nanosecond THz pulses from a parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We successfully realized electro-optical detection of nanosecond THz pulses based on a THz optical parametric oscillator. A maximum dynamic range of ~30 dB/ Hz is achieved in the electro-optical measurements.

articleTitle: Light evolution in optical lattices with second-order inter-site coupling
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the experimental realization of zigzag waveguide lattices, where second-order coupling influences linear and nonlinear light evolution. Band structure deformation and changes in soliton thresholds are analyzed depending on higher-order coupling.

articleTitle: Theory for direct frequency comb spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a theory for the interaction of multi-level atoms with well-stabilized pulse trains, which is general enough to take into account arbitrarily-shaped frequency combs. It is applied to the excitation of rubidium-87 atoms.

articleTitle: Coexistence of scalar dissipative solitons along different polarization axes in a highly birefringent fiber laser with SESAM
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Coexistence of scalar dissipative solitons along the two orthogonally polarized directions of a fiber laser is observed. Due to the large cavity birefringence, the dissipative solitons along different polarization axes have different group velocities.

articleTitle: Direct observation of two-photon gain in semiconductors
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first observation of two-photon gain in solids, specifically in electrically-pumped room-temperature semiconductor devices. Structures optimized to enhance the nonlinear two-photon interaction and reduce parasitic effects yielded gain in excellent agreement with theory.

PACS Terms: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Ultrahigh-Q silicon-on-insulator one dimensional mode-gap nanocavity
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We reveal that a Si-wire-compatible SOI one-dimensional photonic crystal nanocavity can have a numerical Q as high as 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> with a modal volume of less than 1 (λ/n)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. An experimental Q of 360,000 is observed.

articleTitle: Compact VCSEL-based CO2 and H2O sensor with inherent wavelength calibration for safety and air-quality applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A compact CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O laser spectroscopy sensor based on cost-efficient vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers for safety and air-quality applications is presented. It implements inherent wavelength calibration to achieve self-monitored and calibration-free operation during sensor lifetime.

articleTitle: Self-induced transparency modelocking with saturable nonlinearity and group velocity dispersion
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The limits that saturable nonlinearity and group velocity dispersion impose on self-induced transparency modelocking are explored. Stable modelocked pulses exist within limiting values, but their durations and intensities change.

articleTitle: Quantum kinetics of transport and gain in quantum cascade lasers: Looking for the essential principles of design
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The complex interplay by tunneling and scattering in quantum cascade lasers is analyzed with nonequilibrium Green's functions. Data for a recently proposed simple structure based on only two wells per period is presented. This simple structure allows to visualize the relevance of the tunneling resonance very clearly. It is argued that a QCL design needs at least three levels per period, thus further simplifications of the design are not likely to occur for THz lasers. Finally the similarities and differences between quantum cascade lasers and superlattices are addressed.

articleTitle: Characterizing a qutrit directly with symmetric informationally complete (SIC) POVMs
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Imagine ... a world without density matrices! A scheme to perform arbitrary POVMs is proposed and a SIC-POVM is implemented on a qutrit. The Quantum Law of Total Probability is verified.

articleTitle: 1.3 µm mode-locked disk laser with wafer fused gain chip and SESAM
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a wafer fused mode-locked optically-pumped semiconductor disk laser operating at 1.3 μm spectral range. Both the gain mirror and the SESAM incorporate InP-based active region wafer fused with GaAs/AlGaAs distributed Bragg reflector.

articleTitle: Multimodal optical coherence tomography and fluorescence lifetime imaging system for simultaneous anatomical and biochemical imaging of biological tissue
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed a multimodal optical system for simultaneous optical coherence tomography (OCT) and fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy (FLIM), and demonstrate its capability for high-speed co-registered micro-anatomical and biochemical tissue imaging.

articleTitle: Ultrafast hot electron relaxation in a metal nanostructure detected by femtosecond-SNOM
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ultrahigh spatiotemporal resolved pump-probe signal on a metal nanostructure is detected by femtosecond-SNOM. By using two-color pump-probe configuration, ultrafast hot electron transportation is clearly observed on a time scale of a few hundred femtoseconds.

articleTitle: 3.2 µm single spatial mode diode lasers operating at room temperature
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ridge waveguide type-I quantum-well GaSb-based diode lasers, with active regions utilizing InGaAsSb/AlInGaAsSb quantum wells, have been demonstrated to operate at temperatures as high as 40°C with 1 mW of power at wavelengths above 3.2 μm.

articleTitle: Relay-assisted free-space quantum-key distribution with partial phase compensation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study the effect of partial phase compensation on a free-space relay-assisted quantum-key distribution system. Our analytical results demonstrate that the relay-assisted system outperforms the direct transmission even with partial phase compensation.

articleTitle: Silicon-based plasmonic waveguides interfaced to silicon photonic platform
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A silicon-based plasmonic waveguide is designed, fabricated and characterized. A propagation distance of 2.00μm at λ=1550nm was measured and the coupling efficiency to the silicon-on-insulator platform was 38.0%. Scans of telecommunication wavelengths are presented.

articleTitle: Fast and accurate comb-based spectral analysis of a frequency agile CW laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The time-resolved frequency spectrum of a frequency agile CW laser is measured with a 300 μs update rate and 3 kHz resolution/accuracy over a 28 nm wavelength range with a coherent dual comb setup.

articleTitle: Low-threshold, single-frequency distributed-feedback waveguide laser in Al2O3∶Er3+ on silicon
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications

authors.preferredName: H. A. G. M van Wolferen

abstract: Single-frequency distributed-feedback lasing with 165 μW output power at 1538.8 nm is realized in Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3:</sub>Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> waveguides fabricated on silicon wafers. Distributed feedback is provided by a surface relief Bragg grating fabricated with laser interference lithography.

articleTitle: Cooling atoms with a moving one-way barrier
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the use of a moving optical one-way barrier for cooling a collection of atoms, and how sensitive this method is to varying experimental parameters.

articleTitle: Fluorescence background suppression in Raman spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Raman spectroscopy provides a non-invasive method to study biological samples. We demonstrate the powerful capabilities of our novel Raman modulation technique to detect weak Raman signals hidden by a strong fluorescent background.

articleTitle: Challenges to making high power solid state lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This is a tutorial exploring some of the key engineering issues that have been and must be addressed to construct solid state lasers in the 100 kW, CW class with good beam quality. Both slab and fiber approaches are considered. In both cases some form of beam combining is also required, and two promising beam combining approaches are considered.

articleTitle: Hole shape effect of photonic crystals on the guided resonance modes in GaN-based ultra-thin film-transferred light-emitting diodes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The guided resonance mode affected the different hole shapes of photonic crystals in GaN ultra-thin film-transferred light-emitting diodes. The ellipse-hole PhC extracted a fewer modes than the regular PhC due to the lattice symmetry break.

articleTitle: Explosions of clusters in intense X-Ray pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Cluster explosion in ultrashort intense X-ray laser fields have been studied in first experiments at the LCLS with time-of flight techniques. Ion charge states and kinetic energy spectra indicate hydrodynamic and Coulombic plasma expansion contributions.

articleTitle: High-Gain KY(WO4)2∶Yb3+ planar waveguide laser at the zero-phonon line
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: When pumping at a short wavelength of 932 nm, the high gain obtained at the 981-nm zero-phonon line of a KY(WO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>:Gd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>, Lu<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>, Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> planar waveguide resulted in efficient laser emission in an open cavity configuration.

articleTitle: Ultrafast mid-infrared intra-excitonic response of individualized single-walled carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report ultrafast mid-infrared studies of individualized semiconducting carbon nanotubes. Transient spectra of (6,5) and (7,5) nanotubes evidence photoinduced absorption around 200 meV, associated with intra-excitonic transitions that reflect quasi-1D exciton correlations and dynamics.

articleTitle: Concentration of phase-information
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a probabilistic scheme capable of increasing the phase information of weak coherent states by addition of thermal noise and subsequent photon-counting based postselection. We present experimental and theoretical results.

articleTitle: Power scaling of a 78 MHz-repetition rate femtosecond enhancement cavity
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the cavity enhancement of a 78MHz, 200fs ytterbium-fiber laser system. Constant enhancement up to a record intra-cavity average power of 18kW has been observed. Beyond the linear regime, 40kW have been achieved.

articleTitle: Design of the 10 PW OPCPA facility for the Vulcan laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the progress made in developing 10PW OPCPA facility for the Vulcan laser to produce pulses with focused intensities >10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">23</sup> Wcm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>. This power level will be delivered by generating pulses with >300J in 30fs. These pulses will be delivered to two target areas: in one target area they will be combined with the existing Vulcan Petawatt beamline and a new target area will be created for high intensity interactions.

articleTitle: Plasmonic back structures designed for efficiency enhancement of thin film solar cells
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Metallic back structures with one-dimensional periodic nanoridges attached to thin-film amorphous silicon (a-Si) solar cell are proposed to enhance the cell efficiency in a wide near-IR range.

articleTitle: All-fiber-integrated nonlinear chirped-pulse amplifier with microjoule energy at 1 MHz
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report 57kW of peak power, 4µJ of energy and nonlinear shift of ∼22π at 1MHz repetition rate, the highest from an all-fiber-integrated amplifier, limited by Raman amplification. Numerical simulations provide good agreement with experiments.

articleTitle: Spectral studies of optical coherence in DNA-encapsulated silver clusters
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Novel emitters consisting of silver nanoclusters that are bound to single-stranded DNA show great promise as accurately positioned single photon sources that can interact coherently. Here, we present first results of a spectroscopic study.

articleTitle: Gain statistics of a fiber optical parametric amplifier with a temporally incoherent pump
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an experimental investigation into the statistics of the gain fluctuations of a fiber optical parametric amplifier pumped with a temporally incoherent pump. These statistics are shown to be a strong function of signal detuning.

articleTitle: Ultrabroadband optical parametric chirped pulse amplifier system for single-cycle waveform synthesis
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate synchronized few-cycle 800-nm and 2-µm pulse trains seeded from a single Ti:sapphire oscillator, able to generate scalable, high-energy pulses lasting less than a single electric-field cycle. Such pulses are attractive for high-field physics.

articleTitle: Bloch-polaritons in multiple-quantum-well photonic crystal structures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Here we report the observation of Bloch-polaritons in a GaAs/AlGaAs multiple-quantum-well structure. We observe three polariton states formed by the coherent interaction between light- and heavy-hole excitonic-lattices, and Bloch waves of the background photonic crystal.

articleTitle: Performances of all-optical wavelength conversion by means of nonlinear polarization rotation in an SOA for WLAN systems using RoF technologies
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report an all-optical wavelength conversion for WLAN systems using radio-over-fiber technologies. We investigate the performances and successfully achieve high conversion performances in the operating wavelength range of 60 nm.

articleTitle: Nanodevices based on plasmonics for few/single molecule detection
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Different plasmonic based devices are fabricated using novel micro and nanofabrication techniques for single molecule detection: Self-similar Ag-nanosphere based plasmonic devices, device comprising tapered nanolens and photonic crystal cavity and, finally, Si micropillars based superhydrobhobic surface.

articleTitle: Lithographically fabricated optical antennas with sub-10nm gaps formed by a sacrifical layer
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We lithographically fabricate arrays of optical antennas with ~6nm gaps. The enhancement factor from surface-enhanced Raman scattering measurement is ~5 times larger than the same structure with ~18nm gaps.

articleTitle: Recent advances in cavity ring-down spectroscopy and application to medical breath analysis
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A major goal of medicine is to catch disease early with methods that are non-invasive, sensitive, and highly specific. Optical breath analysis is a growing field that provides exactly this type of diagnosis. This paper/tutorial will present an overview of recent results, trends, key technologies, and directions for this field. Specific highlights will include extremely sensitive tunable laser-based cavity ring-down and broadband cavity ring-down methods.

articleTitle: Continuously tunable, high-energy mid-infrared optical-parametric oscillation by angular tuning of PPMgLN with tilted QPM structures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Continuously tunable mid-infrared OPO with output energy of several mJ around 3 μm range could be realized by angular tuning of large-aperture PPMgLN device with tilted QPM structures.

articleTitle: Electro-optical tunable time delay and advance in silicon microring resonator-based notch filters
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report electro-optical tunable time delay/advance using silicon microring resonator-based notch filters. We demonstrated tunable time delay/advance of ~30 ps / ~70 ps at a single wavelength upon a voltage change of 10 mV.

articleTitle: Molecular water accumulation on silica measured with picometer height resolution
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We observed water film accumulation on silica surfaces to 1 picometer resolution using optical land-contrast (LC) interferometry. The land-contrast approach is non-destructive and allows real-time measurement of thickness variation of small molecular films.

articleTitle: Effective suppression of in localization and piezoelectric field in InGaN multi quantum-wells by growth on nano scale pyramidal facets
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have grown multi quantum wells (MQWs) with a peak wavelength of 570 nm on nano scale GaN hexagonal pyramid structures with facets formed by (11-22) planes by selective metal organic vapor phase epitaxy (MOVPE). The height, the bottom diameter and the pitch of the pyramid are 350 nm, 300 nm, and 500 nm, respectively. Photoluminescence (PL) measurements from 10 to 300 K show monotonic decrease in emission peak energy of the MQW with temperature increase without showing the typical S-shaped curve caused by In localization. Power dependent PL shows no noticeable blue shift cased by piezoelectric field screening effect. With a comparative study with MQWs on micro size pyramids, we find that elastic strain relaxation by nano size of the structure is responsible to the uniform In distribution and reduced piezoelectric field in addition to the semipolar growth plane.

articleTitle: Manipulating nano-scale light fields with the Asymmetric Bowtie nano-Colorsorter
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a class of devices called Asymmetric Bowtie nano-Colorsorters. These devices have specifically engineered symmetries enabling them to capture, confine, spectrally filter and steer optical fields while maintaining nanoscale field distributions.

articleTitle: Slow light birefringence in liquid crystal light valves
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By performing two-beam coupling experiments in a liquid crystal light-valve, we show that when slow-light occurs in anisotropic media a large difference of the group index result for orthogonal polarization states of the input pulse.

articleTitle: High-power splice-free ytterbium fiber laser based on femtosecond-written fiber Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the operation of a splice-free ytterbium fiber laser emitting 65 W at 1072 nm based on a pair of FBGs written directly in the active fiber using 400 nm femtosecond pulses and a phase-mask.

articleTitle: 75 W Yb-fiber laser frequency comb
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on an Yb-fiber frequency comb based on linear chirped pulse amplification delivering 120 fs pulses at 75 W compressed average power at a repetition rate of 154 MHz. Coherent phase locking of the self-referenced comb is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Multi-channel superconducting nanowire single photon detector system with high detection efficiency
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a development of a multi-channel superconducting nanowire single photon detector system, which showed the high detection efficiency over 10% at 100 Hz dark count rate and the wavelength of 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Breaking of Dirac dynamics due to nonlinear interactions
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study nonlinear dynamics of electromagnetic waves in honeycomb photonic lattices, and find that nonlinearity breaks the effective Dirac equation. Furthermore, we show that the nonlinearity cannot be described simply by the nonlinear Dirac equation.

articleTitle: Experimental probing of photonic density of states in hyperbolic metamaterial
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In the metamaterial with hyperbolic dispersion, we have observed six-fold reduction of the emission life-time of dye deposited onto the metamaterial's surface.

articleTitle: A free-hand surface tracking and motion compensation microsurgical tool system based on common-path optical coherence tomography distance sensor
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed and tested a compact free-hand microsurgical tool-concept based on CP-OCT distance-sensor and 1-D actuation, which is capable of tracking the surface of surgical target tissue and compensating tool-tissue relative-motion with micrometer resolution.

articleTitle: Cavity quantum electrodynamics in the Anderson-localized regime
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally measure, by means of time-resolved photoluminescence spectroscopy, a 15-fold enhancement of the spontaneous emission decay rate of single semiconductor quantum dots coupled to disorder-induced Anderson-localized modes with efficiencies reaching 94%.

articleTitle: Visible harmonic generation in CMOS-compatible integrated photonic devices
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We observe continuous-wave second- and third-harmonic generation in silicon nitride ring resonators pumped in the C-band. The enhancement of the ring allows pump powers as low as 3 mW to generate detectable outputs.

articleTitle: Pulse compression dynamics in synchronously pumped continuous wave mode-locked Raman oscillators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a numerical model that explains the pulse compression dynamics occurring in synchronously-pumped Raman oscillators based on transient Stimulated Raman Scattering equations. Excellent agreement is found between our theoretical results and the experimental data.

articleTitle: Characterization of a-plane green light-emitting diodes using nanorod lateral overgrowth
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have demonstrated nanorod lateral overgrowth to reduce dislocation density in a-plane GaN. Subsequently, we grow green a-plane light-emitting diodes using nanorod lateral overgrowth. Output power of 0.5 mW was measured at 20 mA.

articleTitle: Diode-pumped passively Q-switched Nd∶YAG/Cr4+∶YAG micro-laser controlled by volume Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A high-peak power, passively Q-switched Nd:YAG/Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:YAG micro-laser with a volume Bragg gratings optical element as output coupler was realized. The influence of temperature on the laser pulse energy and wavelength of emission was investigated.

articleTitle: An all-fiber source for multiplex coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a simple all-fiber coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering (CARS) source capable of multiplex operation out to detunings in excess of 2500 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. The CARS spectra of several molecules are measured with this system.

articleTitle: A femtosecond multi-terahertz view of the phonon and quasiparticle dynamics in superconducting YBa2Cu3O7-δ
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We probe the mid-infrared conductivity of YBa<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7-δ</sub> parallel and perpendicular to the CuO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> planes after 12-fs optical excitation. Quasiparticle excitations and specific lattice modes are traced simultaneously during the photoinduced non-thermal transition to the normal state. The condensate is completely destroyed within 150 fs, while characteristic phonon resonances undergo a blue-shift on distinctly slower times of up to 0.9 ps. The results indicate selective electron-phonon coupling and strong lattice anharmonicities.

articleTitle: Transmission and reflection properties of terahertz fractal metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use THz time-domain spectroscopy to investigate transmission and reflection properties of metallic fractal metamaterial structures. We observe loss of free-space energy at certain resonance frequencies, indicating excitation of surface modes of the metamaterial.

articleTitle: Asymmetric Autler-Townes effect in THz-driven Quantum wells: Beyond the three state and rotating wave approximations
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Quantum wells driven by THz radiation near an intersubband resonance exhibit a power dependent asymmetry in the excitonic Autler-Townes doublet. Experimental observations and non-perturbative simulations indicate strong driving induces a redshift of the intersubband energy.

articleTitle: Analysis of coupled vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Coupling properties of vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser (VCSEL) arrays are analyzed using a new stochastic coupled mode theory. Comparisons between theory and experiment reveal important details about the coupling and coherence of VCSEL arrays.

articleTitle: Automated suppression of polarization-fluctuation in resonator fiber optic gyro with twin 90° polarization-axis rotated splices
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Automated suppression of polarization-fluctuation in a fiber optic gyro made of a polarization-maintaining fiber (PMF) resonator with twin 90° polarization-axis rotated splices is experimentally demonstrated. The y-axis polarized component in the output of the resonator is detected to generate the feedback signal to adjust the length difference of the two fiber segments between the two 90° polarization-axis rotated splicing points. When the length difference becomes a half of the beat-length of the PMF, only one eigen state of polarization is excited linearly polarized in x-axis direction, ensuring the suppression of polarization-fluctuation induced bias drift.

articleTitle: Digital in-line holography with the Iterative Shadowgraphic Method
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A recently derived iterative scheme for phase revival based on shadowgraphy is tested on experimental data. We show that the algorithm can reconstruct the phase profile accurately, thus enabling in-line digital holography applications.

articleTitle: Tailoring of chirp in colliding pulse mode-locked diode laser generating 267 fs pulses after compression
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Collision point and relative intensities of pulses in a passively mode-locked laser were optimized to generate a strong and almost linear chirp. We achieved 267 fs pulses with 661 W peak power using only quadratic phase compression.

articleTitle: Highly-sensitive measurements of changes in density and refractive index of air using fiber laser polarization mode beating techniques
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a highly-sensitive fiber optic sensor for measuring changes in the refractive index of air. This technique provides an accurate method for monitoring refractive index, density and pressure of gases in an intra-cavity vessel.

articleTitle: Spin Hall effect of light in GaAs and Silicon observed via nonlinear optics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Transverse displacements of the circularly polarized components of a light beam non-normally incident on GaAs and Silicon are spatially resolved. The imaging relies on pump-probing of two-photon absorption and optically induced free carrier absorption.

articleTitle: A 10 GHz opto-electronic oscillator at 1.1 µm using a gain-switched InGaAs VCSEL and a photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a self-starting opto-electronic oscillator operating at 1.1 μm using a gain-switched VCSEL and a single-mode photonic crystal fiber. A 10-GHz 11.5-ps optical pulse with a timing jitter of 0.9 ps was successfully generated.

articleTitle: Measuring and characterizing quantum states and processes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: I will give an introductory overview of current experimental techniques used to characterize the density matrix of a system and the quantum process describing a device, with emphasis on applications in quantum optics.

articleTitle: Effect of optical feedback on 17-GHz quantum dash based mode locked lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The effect of optical feedback is investigated for a quantum-dash-based passive mode-locked laser. We observe a drastic reduction of the radio frequency spectrum linewidth even beyond the onset of coherence collapse.

articleTitle: Recent progress in high efficiency InGaN LEDs
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: InGaN LED efficiency depends significantly on current density, emission wavelength and junction temperature. Phosphor-converted blue LEDs are still more efficient than RGB multi-LED solutions despite inevitable Stokes losses: 104 lm/W at 350 mA have been demonstrated for a warm-white (T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</sub> = 2950 K) phosphor-converted blue InGaN LED with 1 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> chip size.

articleTitle: Integrated optoelectronics for neural stimulation and recording in freely moving animals
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Specific classes of neural cells in the mammalian brain can be rendered visible light sensitive by genetic means. We combine the new `optogenetics' neural stimulation with simultaneous electrical recording from neural microcircuits in freely moving rats in an integrated cortically implanted optoelectronic microarray device. This enables both `write-in' and `read-out' of neural information in behaving animals.

articleTitle: Development of two-layer integrated phase masks for three-dimensional photonic crystal template fabrication
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this paper, we report the development of an integrated two-layer phase mask for five-beam holographic fabrication of three-dimensional photonic crystal templates.

articleTitle: Transformation-optical cavities for subwavelength confinement of light
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use transformation optics to design an optical cavity that allows for the subwavelength confinement of light. Our cavity combines a deep subwavelength mode volume with the absence of intrinsic (bending) losses.

articleTitle: Investigation on mode coupling and bending loss characteristics of terahertz air-core pipe waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the magnificent flexibility of the terahertz air-core pipe waveguides. By measuring waveguide attenuation spectra, we found that the pipe waveguides can be easily butt coupled with high coupling efficiency and low bending loss.

articleTitle: Observation of ArF laser induced structural defects in highly transparent synthetic silica glass
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Sensitive in-situ measurement systems for differential absorption and photoluminescence were developed to evaluate E' center, ODC(II), and NBOHC. The change of their concentrations by ArF irradiation were successfully observed in highly transparent synthetic silica glass.

articleTitle: Design and experimental demonstration of optical resonators for nanotweezing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Resonant silicon photonics has recently enabled the direct optical tweezing of nano-objects on chip. Here we present a comprehensive evaluation of different resonator designs and demonstrate one with a stiffness of 22.3 pN nm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: Experimental observation of the trapped rainbow
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the experimental demonstration of the broadband "trapped rainbow" in the visible range using an adiabatically tapered waveguide. Being a distinct case of the slow light phenomenon, this effect can enhanced light-matter interactions.

articleTitle: High pulse-energy atmospheric aerosol lidar at 1.5-microns wavelength: Opportunities for innovation from a meteorologist's perspective
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Laser and optical engineering challenges and recent progress in the area of high pulse-energy direct-detection atmospheric lidar near 1.5 microns wavelength are described.

articleTitle: High performance visible semiconductor lasers operating at 630 nm
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 630 nm single mode lasers with a V-profile layer incorporated within the waveguide core exhibit reduced fast axis divergence (19° FWHM) while maintaining a low threshold current (30 mA), making them ideal for display applications.

articleTitle: Dual frequency combs at 3.4 µm with subhertz residual linewidths
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Two coherent 1.5 μm frequency combs are transferred to 3.4 μm by difference-frequency generation with a 1064 nm cw laser. From a multi-heterodyne measurement, the residual linewidth between the comb teeth is resolution-limited at 200 mHz. Work of the U.S. government, not subject to copyright.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal fiber based dissipative soliton laser for multi-Watt femtosecond mode-locking
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on photonic crystal fiber based scaling of the mode-area of a dissipative soliton laser. The laser delivers 142 nJ chirped pulses with 12 W average power, dechirping to 105 fs after extra-cavity compression.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser ablation rates of dielectric materials: Experiments and modeling
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Short-pulse laser ablation of dielectrics is modeled using multiple-rate equations for the electronic excitation combined with optical propagation. The model is compared to single-shot experiments on well-defined single-crystal samples.

articleTitle: Self-organized nonadiabatic optical near-field assisted sputtering for repairing surface scratches on Al2O3 ceramic substrate
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The scratches on the surface of Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> ceramics were repaired by optical near-field assisted sputtering with laser irradiation of 473-nm wavelength in a self-organized manner. Their average depth decreased from 3.2 nm to 0.79 nm.

articleTitle: High nonlinearity and high transmittance optical Bi2O3-B2O3-TeO2 glass
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed a novel Bi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-TeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> glass system. This glass shows excellent high transmittance even near the absorption edge ~400 nm, nevertheless its high refractive index and high optical nonlinearity.

articleTitle: 160-Gb/s NRZ-DQPSK signal generation using a thin-LiNbO3-substrate modulator with a ridge-type optical waveguide structure
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 160-Gb/s NRZ-DQPSK modulation is demonstrated with a thin-LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-substrate modulator. Using this substrate with a ridge-type waveguide structure can help realize an extension of a bandwidth and a decrease of a half-wave voltage of the modulator.

articleTitle: Unidirectional semiconductor ring lasers integrated with semiconductor optical isolators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have fabricated unidirectional semiconductor ring lasers integrated with semiconductor optical isolators for magnetically reconfigurable all optical signal processing. The fabricated device showed lasing intensity modulation by reversing the direction of optical isolator.

articleTitle: Generalized spatiotemporal quasi phase matching
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We develop a description of nonlinear optics where quasi-phase-matching of both momentum and energy mismatch can be implemented by employing both spatial and temporal modulations. This generalized quasi-phase-matching technique could allow unique applications.

articleTitle: Thin-film lasers embedded in passively aligned SU-8 waveguides on SiO2/Si
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A thin film GaAs based edge emitting laser is bonded to silicon, with one facet embedded in a passively aligned polymer waveguide. J<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sub> = 260 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at λ=1002.5 nm is achieved for this integrated system.

articleTitle: Efficient cryo-cooled 2.7-µm Er3+-doped Y2O3 ceramic laser diode-pumped at 974 nm
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Reported here is the first cryogenically-cooled diode-pumped performance of Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> laser based on 4 I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11/2</sub> ⇒ 4 I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13/2</sub> transitions. Pump-limited CW power of over 1.6 W at ~2.7 μm was achieved with the 27.5% slope efficiency.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional dynamic localization of light
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the first experimental observation of two-dimensional dynamic localization of light. We demonstrate suppression of beam diffraction in femtosecond laser-written modulated waveguide arrays of hexagonal and zig-zag geometries.

articleTitle: Extreme tuning of microphotonic structures using optical forces
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show evidence of extreme tuning of micro-photonic resonances (31.4 nm) using optical gradient forces. We estimate the static mechanical displacements to be as large as 60 nm using mW level optical powers.

articleTitle: Radiative decay engineering of direct bandgap emission in silver ion-implanted polarized Silicon quantum dots
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Si nanocrystal (NC) in SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> matrix normally exhibit quasi-direct interband transitions due to band mixing of direct and indirect gaps in a nanoscale environment. Compared to direct bandgap III–V or II–VI semiconductor nano-particles, the radiative recombination coefficient of Si is rather low at room temperature B ≈ 1e–14 cc/s. Therefore, even considering the defect mediated recombination and Auger assisted non-radiative transitions to be suppressed due to spatial localization of carriers in Si nanoparticles, the electron-hole recombination lifetime is observed to be in the range of ms to microsecond. Ion implantation provides a route for synthesis of Silicon based nanocrystals for VLSI compatible nanophotonic emitters.

articleTitle: Intermediate infrared raman lasing and four-wave mixing in crystalline whispering gallery mode resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate nonlinear frequency conversion in an ultra high-Q CaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> whispering gallery mode resonator with finesse exceeding 1 million. Raman lasing and four-wave mixing in the intermediate infrared spectral region is reported.

articleTitle: Self-pulsing in on-chip Er-doped microcavity lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We characterize self-pulsing in erbium-doped microtoroidal lasers fabricated from solgel silica layer deposited on a silicon wafer. Effects of pump and taper-cavity coupling on peak power, period and width of laser pulses are investigated experimentally.

articleTitle: Micro-luminescence and micro-Raman mapping of ultrafast laser inscribed Yb:KGd(WO4)2 and Yb:KY(WO4)2 channel waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Micro-luminescence and micro-Raman mapping has been performed on ultrafast laser inscribed channel Yb:KGd(WO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and Yb:KY(WO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> waveguides. Correlation can be seen between guiding regions and shifts in micro-luminescence and micro-Raman peaks when compared to the bulk.

articleTitle: Broadband astro-combs and the impact of nonlinear spectral broadening on sidemode suppression
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and analyze an approach to generating broadband astro-combs with 1 cm/s (~10 kHz) calibration accuracy on astrophysical spectrographs. Implementation of these astro-combs requires a side-mode suppression of 60 dB before nonlinear spectral broadening.

articleTitle: Two-photon absorption in single crystals of cyanine-like dye
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the two-photon absorption spectrum of single crystals of an asymmetric cyanine-like dye in comparison to its spectrum in solution. The 2PA peak magnitude is comparable to bulk semiconductors of similar absorption edge.

articleTitle: Large signal analysis of AlGaInAs/InP laser transistor
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A large signal analysis of a laser transistor based on AlGaInAs/InP long wavelength material system is carried out. Better eye diagrams over 40-Gbps modulation speed are obtained in laser transistors than that in laser diodes.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared picosecond laser source with high average output power exceeding 1 W at 4.5 µm
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The generation of tunable mid-infrared picosecond laser radiation in the spectral range from 3-5μm by nonlinear frequency conversion in PPLN is reported. More than 3W output power at 3μm and 1.1W at 4.5μm were achieved.

articleTitle: Self-induced temporal and spectral polarization changes in silicon nanowire waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show through numerical simulations that optical pulses in silicon waveguides can undergo significant self-induced changes in their polarization state. These changes are mediated mostly by free-carrier dispersion and depend on waveguide dimensions.

articleTitle: 10GHz pulsed Er-Yb fiber laser using an optically deposited Carbon-Nanotube film in a fiber mirror
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We achieve 9.73GHz pulsed operation in a short cavity fiber Fabry-Pérot lasers using a heavily doped Er-Yb fiber and a saturable absorber consisting of a Carbon Nanotube film optically deposited into a highly reflective mirror.

articleTitle: Experimental quantum averaging of squeezed quadratures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an averaging process, corresponding to the harmonic-mean, that average quantum noise sources better than the basic arithmetic-mean strategy. Using simple linear optics, homodyne detection and feedforward, and it is tested on squeezed states.

articleTitle: High power fiber amplifier for Advanced Virgo
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present preliminary results to characterize a 100 W laser amplifier. These measurements (the laser frequency and power stability, the beam geometry) show that the system fits the future generation of gravitational waves antennas requirements.

articleTitle: Error-free all-optical demultiplexing at 160Gb/s via FWM in a silicon nanowire
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical time division demultiplexing from 160Gb/s to 10Gb/s in the C-band, based on four-wave mixing (FWM) in a silicon nanowire. We achieve error-free operation with a system penalty of ~3.9dB at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> BER.

articleTitle: Frequency translation of single-photon states by four-wave mixing in a photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study the effect of frequency translation of single-photon states in optical fiber through use of the Bragg scattering four-wave mixing process. Preliminary evidence shows that this goal has been achieved.

articleTitle: Second and third harmonics generation in tellurite microstructured fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the second and third harmonics generation in tellurite microstructured fibers pumped by a 1557 nm femtosecond fiber laser.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared supercontinuum generation in lead-bismuth-gallium oxide glass photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Supercontinuum generation from visible up to 2.8 μm is demonstrated in a highly nonlinear heavy metal oxide glass photonic crystal fiber. Numerical modelling suggests that the supercontinuum can be extended to 4 μm.

articleTitle: Diode-pumped Nd:YAG self-adaptive resonator with a high gain amplifier operating at 100 Hz
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A small intensity gain length product as high as 5.5 is demonstrated in a diode-pumped ceramic Nd:YAG amplifier. This module allows to realize a self-adaptive laser resonator operating at 100Hz and delivering 100mJ, 20ns pulses.

articleTitle: Self-phase modulation based optical regeneration of 10 Gb/s, 1.8 ps RZ signal using carbon nanotube device
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the observation of self-phase modulation generated in a carbon-nanotube-deposited fiber device. SPM-based optical regeneration of a distorted 10-Gb/s return-to-zero signal is demonstrated and a negative power penalty is obtained in bit-error-rate measurements.

articleTitle: Resonant delocalization of light in engineered Bloch waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study the propagation of light in Bloch waveguide arrays exhibiting periodic coupling. Intriguing wavepacket revival patterns as well as beating Bloch oscillations are demonstrated. A new resonant delocalization phase transition is also predicted.

articleTitle: Phase front design with metallic pillar arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate numerically the ability to design a phase front using an array of metallic pillars. We show that in such structures, the local phase delay upon transmission can be tuned by local geometry.

articleTitle: Passive mode-locking of diode-pumped Tm:GdLiF4 laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the first demonstration of passive mode-locking laser operation of a diode-pumped Tm:GdLiF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> crystal. Pulse trains with 20-ps duration, average power of ~100 mW, and repetition rate of 75 MHz are obtained.

articleTitle: Intracavity MEMS lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Intracavity low-cost scanning MEMS micromirrors are used to control the output beam of Nd:based lasers. Successful Q-switching resulted in pulse durations of 200ns.

articleTitle: Gigahertz circular polarization oscillations in spin-polarized vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We analyze ultrafast circular polarization oscillations in a commercial vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser after spin injection at room temperature. The circular polarization exhibits faster dynamics than the intensity and longer persistence than the spin relaxation time.

articleTitle: Rotational stochastic resonance
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the concept of stochastic resonance in optically induced rotations and discuss its applications for optimizing the effects of optical torques on small anisotropic particles and optically bound systems of particles.

PACS Terms: 000.5490 Probability theory, stochastic processes, and statistics

articleTitle: Ultrafast silicon-organic hybrid (SOH) photonics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate ultrafast optical signal processing up to bitrates of 170 Gbit/s. Silicon-on-insulator waveguides are defined by CMOS technology. In addition, an organic cladding pro-vides either X<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup> or X<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>-nonlinearities that are not impaired by two-photon absorption. With a proper waveguide design, the influence of two-photon absorption in silicon is greatly reduced.

articleTitle: Nanoparticle manipulation with optical forces from surface plasmon polaritons on gold stripes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate enhanced propulsion of polystyrene and gold particles by surface plasmon polaritons on gold stripes. The largest propulsion velocity enhancement, relative to total internal reflection, is measured to be 5 for polystyrene particles.

articleTitle: Distributed light sensing with convex potential fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a photoconductive fiber that supports decaying and convex electrical potential profiles capable of localizing a point of illumination, and propose a scheme to perform distributed optical sensing.

articleTitle: Thermochromic polymer opals
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Highly unusual thermochromic properties of large-scale shear-ordered photonic crystals are demonstrated. A simple theoretical model of the temperature dependence of this resonant Bragg scattering based structural colour is developed.

articleTitle: Fundamental bounds and performance tests for the storage or transmission of quantum light
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We derive benchmarks for the quantum storage or transmission of light which are optimal while requiring minimal experimental resources. Quantitative statements on quantum device performance are derived by extending the method using entanglement measures.

articleTitle: A bidirectionally tunable optical timing module using stimulated Brillouin scattering
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a tunable module for delaying or advancing optical pulses using stimulated Brillouin scattering. A fractional advancement and delay of 0.31 and 0.82, respectively, have been achieved for 6.5 ns Gaussian pulses.

articleTitle: Sound, light and particles in photonic crystal fibres
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Keeping light tightly guided, over metre-long distances, in both nanoscale solid glass cores and hollow cores allows enhanced and highly reproducible control of linear and nonlinear interactions between light, acoustic vibrations and trapped particles.

articleTitle: Ultrafast laser inscribed Nd-doped silicate glass waveguide laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report laser oscillation from waveguides inscribed in Nd-doped silicate glass. Laser action was observed at 1062nm for a pump of 808nm, with a slope efficiency of 15.0% and maximum output power of 7.5mW.

articleTitle: Femtosecond dispersion measurements of 1.3 µm quantum dot semiconductor optical amplifier
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Spectral interferometry is used to measure the dispersion of a quantum dot semiconductor optical amplifier under various injection current values in the wavelength range of 1200 to 1340 nm, spanning ground and first excited state.

articleTitle: Mechanism and potential applications of THz air photonics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present experimental and theoretical investigations on the THz wave generation and detection using ambient air or selected gases as the THz emitter and sensor, as well as the potential applications of THz air photonics.

articleTitle: Characterization and optimization of a femtosecond laser by Self-Referenced Spectral Interferometry
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an extended version of the Self-Referenced Spectral Interferometry technique allowing for both spectral phase and intensity retrieval from a single-shot interferogram. Feedback to an AOPDF was performed to demonstrate the measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: Solid-state ring laser gyro with similar level of performance as its Helium-Neon counterpart
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Thanks to fast vibration of its gain medium, a solid-state ring laser gyro is shown to have a frequency behaviour similar to Helium-Neon commercial products, with potentially equivalent level of angular random walk.

articleTitle: Large-scale array of miniaturized microdonut resonators for high resolution on-chip spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 84-channel, high resolution (<;0.6 nm) integrated near-infrared spectrometer is demonstrated using large-scale arrays of microdonut resonators. Miniaturized microresonators (radius <; 25 μm) with high intrinsic Q (> 25,000) enable on-chip spectroscopy with low insertion loss.

articleTitle: Resolution of the THz vibrational modes of TRIS (hydroxymethyl) aminomethane (TRIS) using waveguide THz-TDS
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High resolution THz vibrational spectrum of TRIS is measured using waveguide THz-TDS. 12 highly resolved spectral features for the dropcast film and 11 features for sublimated film are observed at 13.6K.

articleTitle: Short wavelength InP based quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the development of strain compensated InGaAs/AlAs(Sb)/InP quantum cascade lasers emitting in the wavelength range of 3.3-3.8μm with high peak optical power (up to 17W at 300K), and high temperature operation (up to 400K).

articleTitle: Speckle noise suppression by unbalanced nulling interferometer and adaptive optics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We carried out a laboratory experiment of a pre-optical system for a stellar coronagraph to suppress stellar speckle noise for direct detection of exo-planets. It consists of an unbalanced nulling interferometer (UNI) and phase and amplitude correction (PAC) system. We observed that a speckle level in the focal plane was successfully suppressed (from 1.8 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> to 2.9 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>) by the virtual wavefront correction of lambda/(100 × 7.0) rms in the UNI-PAC system.

articleTitle: Efficient coupler between silicon and polymer waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and efficient optical coupler between sub-micron sized silicon waveguides on chip and multi-micron wide polymer waveguides on board. We show low coupling loss <; 0.4 dB with high tolerance to misalignment.

articleTitle: Transverse and longitudinal optical forces of self-alignment in waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
