abstract: We demonstrate novel transverse and longitudinal optical forces that facilitate self-alignment between two parts of a waveguide broken by an offset and a gap. We analyze two-dimensional configurations and extend the discussion to three-dimensional systems.

PACS Terms: (350.4855) Other areas of optics, Optical tweezers or optical manipulation

articleTitle: Effect of inhomogeneously broadened linewidth on the phase recovery of quantum-dot semiconductor optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We numerically demonstrate the phase recovery of quantum-dot (QD) semiconductor optical amplifiers becoming slower at larger inhomogeneous broadening linewidths, caused by the enhanced contribution from the slow carrier recovery of the QD carrier reservoirs.

articleTitle: Evidence of constructive interference of THz waves emitted by randomly-distributed InN nanoantennas
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that THz radiation beams generated by an array of the randomly-distributed InN nanopyramids can be used to enhance the THz output power by two orders of magnitude due to strong constructive interference.

articleTitle: Terahertz anti-resonant reflecting hollow waveguide sensor
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A hollow-core anti-resonant reflecting terahertz waveguide is first demonstrated for refractive index sensing. Various dangerous vapors and micro-molecular-layer with 1%-concentration variation (corresponds to 0.01-index-variation) have been successfully identified. The sensitivity could reach up to 7.17×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>nm/RIU.

articleTitle: Gain saturation in 60-fs mode-locked semiconductor laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A passively mode-locked optically-pumped InGaAs/GaAs quantum well laser with an intracavity semiconductor saturable absorber mirror emits sub-100-fs pulses. Pulse energy declines steeply as pulse duration is reduced below 100 fs due to gain saturation.

articleTitle: Distributed feedback laser biosensor incorporating a titanium dioxide nanorod surface
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A 6.6× enhancement in surface sensitivity of DFB laser biosensors is demonstrated by a device incorporating a porous titanium dioxide nanorod layer on the sensor surface, while a Q-factor of over 25, 000 is maintained.

articleTitle: Fast parallel fabrication of three-dimensional photonic crystals using the dynamic laser printing technique
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Parallel femtosecond laser fabrication of three-dimensional photonic crystals using the dynamic laser printing technique is demonstrated. Combining a spatial light modulator with a versatile direct laser writing setup, the dynamic laser printing system is able to produce two-dimensional spot arrays in a single shot. High quality three-dimensional polymeric photonic crystals with 90% void uniformity and 60% suppression in transmission were generated. This technique dramatically reduces the fabrication time by two orders of magnitude, compared with the direct laser writing technique.

articleTitle: Tunable blue astro-comb
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed a tunable, visible frequency comb near 420nm with 22GHz mode spacing and 20nm spectral width, which is able to calibrate astronomical spectrographs to search Earth-like exoplanets orbiting around stars similar to the Sun.

articleTitle: Self-assembled femtoliter-scale structures in a hollow optical fiber for optofluidic applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose self-assembled femtoliter-fluid formation depending on temperature in a hollow optical fiber (HOF) by the unsophisticated flame brushing technology. Three kind of structures are generated, also we see the optical property.

articleTitle: Atom bunching with ultracold metastable helium
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measure the second order correlation function for metastable helium atoms released from an ultracold trap source and observe bunching between thermal atoms. When correlations between Bose-Einstein condensed atoms are measured no bunching is observed.

articleTitle: High-resolution, multi-wavelength fluorescent DNA analysis in an optofluidic chip
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Implementing capillary electrophoresis with high base-pair resolution and integrated multi-wavelength excitation in an optofluidic chip, we separate simultaneously sets of end-labeled DNA fragments from independent human genomic segments, relevant for diagnosing breast cancer and anemia.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional rhombicuboctahedral photonic quasicrystals
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Studies on three-dimensional quasicrystals have been restricted to the icosahedral class so far. We rationally construct the blueprint of a novel, namely the rhombicuboctahedral class. Corresponding polymer microstructures are characterized by visible-light Laue diffraction experiments.

articleTitle: A 12.5 GHz-spaced optical frequency comb spanning >400 nm for astronomical spectrograph calibration
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A 12.5 GHz-spaced optical frequency comb spanning 1380 nm to 1820 nm is generated via filtering and nonlinearly broadening a 250 MHz-spaced comb. Sidemode suppression from 1380 nm to 1630 nm has been measured.

articleTitle: Microwave photonic phase shifter based on tunable silicon-on-insulator microring resonator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a microwave photonic phase shifter based on an electrically tunable silicon-on-insulator microring resonator. A continuously tunable phase shift of up to 315° at a microwave frequency of 15GHz is obtained.

articleTitle: Filamentation of femtosecond laser pulses: Basic principles and applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The physical effects leading to filament formation of intense femtosecond laser pulses propagating in air will be introduced. Recent developments and potential applications of filamentation will be described.

articleTitle: Efficient intracavity frequency doubling of an Yb-doped fiber laser using an internal resonant enhancement cavity
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe a simple approach for efficient generation of visible light in high-power continuous-wave fiber lasers via second harmonic generation in an internal resonant cavity. Preliminary results for a cladding-pumped Yb fiber laser are presented.

articleTitle: Temporal coupled-mode theory for the Fano resonance in light scattering and its applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a temporal coupled-mode theory for the Fano resonance in light scattering by individual obstacle. As an application, we design a structure that exhibits strong absorption and weak scattering properties at the same frequency.

articleTitle: Using laser spectroscopy to study the non-maxwellian statistics of trapped ions
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Trapped ions cooled by a buffer gas can form an extended diffuse cloud dominated by power-law tails, rather than the Gaussian expected by Maxwell-Boltzmann statistics, as described in PRL 102, 063001 (2009).

articleTitle: Gaussian to Lorentzian beam profile convertor based on conical refraction
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We employ conical refraction crystal for one-step conversion of an incident beam with Gaussian transverse intensity profile to a beam of Lorentzian profile with less divergence in free space than the original Gaussian beam.

articleTitle: Optical parametric amplification of a distributed feedback quantum cascade laser in orientation-patterned GaAs
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an optical parametric amplifier in orientation-patterned GaAs amplifying the emission of a quantum cascade laser with a distributed feedback structure. We report a gain as high as 53dB in good agreement with theory.

articleTitle: GaAs nanowire/PEDOT:PSS hybrid solar cells
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A new type of hybrid solar cells based on a heterojunction between PEDOT:PSS and vertically-aligned n-type GaAs nanowire arrays is investigated. Such solar cells exhibit a power conversion efficiency of 3.46 %.

articleTitle: OPO based Off-Axis Integrated Cavity Output Spectroscopy for rapid chemical sensing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We presented rapid and sensitive trace gas detector based on a high power and fast scanning cw OPO in combination with Off-Axis Integrated Cavity Output Spectroscopy. A detection limit of 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1/2</sup> was obtained.

articleTitle: High-energy femtosecond pulses from a dissipative soliton fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the generation of high-energy femtosecond pulses from an ytterbium-doped photonic crystal fiber oscillator. Sub-150 fs pulses are obtained at low-cavity dispersion. By increasing the normal cavity dispersion, pulse energy exceeds 100 nJ.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of waveguide sensor based on cascaded-microring resonators with vernier effect
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An optical sensor based on two cascaded microring resonators is fabricated in silicon-on-insulator waveguide. A Q-factor of 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> is measured and the increase of refractive index sensitivity by using Vernier effect is investigated experimentally.

articleTitle: Disorder-enhanced transport in photonic quasi-crystals: Anderson localization and delocalization
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally that disorder enhances transport of waves in Penrose-type photonic quasicrystals. Increasing disorder gives rise to a transition from “bumpy ride” to diffusive transport.

articleTitle: Linewidth enhancement factor effects on modulation response of isolator-free injection-locked semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: It was recently discovered that the relaxation oscillation frequency of a semiconductor laser may be increased with injection-locking. Here we demonstrate nontrivial effects of linewidth enhancement factor on modulation response of isolator-free injection-locked semiconductor lasers.

articleTitle: Woodpile photonic crystal nanocavity in GaAs
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High-precision three-dimensional woodpile photonic crystal nanocavities with 40 × 55 × 2.25 unit cells are fabricated in GaAs wafer for 1.55 μm wavelength with the two-directional etching method in a simple two-patterning process.

articleTitle: Observation of interference between bright- and dark-polariton peaks
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally investigate atom-cavity transmission spectra with three-level atoms inside an optical cavity. At large cavity frequency detuning, the bright- and dark-polariton three-peak structure becomes asymmetric and the peaks can merge together to create interference.

articleTitle: Counterfeit money detection by intrinsic fluorescence lifetime
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Genuine U.S. Federal Reserve Notes have a consistent, two-component intrinsic fluorescence lifetime. We used scanning two-photon laser excitation and the time-correlated single photon counting method to identify three different types of counterfeit U.S. paper money.

articleTitle: Triggered single photon emission from a diamond nanowire antenna
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe room temperature CW and pulsed spectroscopic studies of a high-flux source of single photons based on the fluorescence of an individual Nitrogen-Vacancy color center in a diamond nanowire antenna.

articleTitle: 11W broad area 976nm DFB lasers with 58% efficiency
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optimized 976 nm DFB lasers have peak power conversion efficiency of 58%, peak power of 11 W, linewidth of ~0.4 nm and vertical far-field FWHM 28°. A comparison with Fabry-Pérot lasers to the same design is presented.

articleTitle: Low temperature near-field scanning optical microscopy of IR and THz surface-plasmon quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first scattering type near-field scanning optical microscope operating at low temperature. This instrument is ideal to study infrared and terahertz QCLs combined with metallic photonic crystal resonators and surface plasmon waveguides.

articleTitle: A compound mirror incorporating a fast-light medium for gravitational wave detection with high sensitivity, broadband signal recycling
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe the concept of a compound mirror for incorporating the white light cavity effect into the existing design for the Advanced LIGO interferometer for gravitational wave detection, resulting in much higher sensitivity and bandwidth.

articleTitle: Multiphoton coherence domain molecular imaging
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed a novel high-resolution molecular imaging technique, Pump-Probe Optical Coherence Microscopy, based on the fusion of Pump-Probe spectroscopy and Optical Coherence Microscopy and demonstrated it on fixed human skin containing a nodular melanoma.

articleTitle: Self-organized nanophotonic signal transmission device
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed a self-assembly method for alignment of ZnO quantum dots (QDs) into a straight line. The polarization dependence of photoluminescence intensity revealed the signal transmission via an optical near-field along the QD chain.

articleTitle: Improved on-shot focal-spot diagnosis on the OMEGA EP short-pulse Laser System
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Diagnosis of the on-target focal spot using the current OMEGA EP diagnostics is challenging due to differential piston uncertainty and calibration errors. Performance was improved by retrieving phase information from far-field images using numerical optimization.

articleTitle: Bandstructure engineering with a two-dimensional patterned quantum dot lattice
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A semiconductor laser with active layer consisting of a patterned quantum dot lattice demonstrates evidence of miniband formation resulting from inter-dot coupling. Excited state lasing is thought to result from a phonon bottleneck-like effect.

articleTitle: Few-cycle OPCPA system with more than 1 µJ at 143 kHz
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An OPCPA system delivering 8.8 fs pulses with 1.3 μJ of energy at 143 kHz repetition rate is presented. Pump and seed for the parametric amplification are simultaneously generated by a broadband Ti:sapphire oscillator.

articleTitle: Temperature-dependent coupling of GaAs quantum well and interfacial quantum dots studied with optical 2D fourier-transform spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical 2D Fourier-transform spectra reveal time and temperature dependent relaxation from GaAs quantum well states into the interfacial quantum dot ensemble. We attribute the increased rate of relaxation at higher temperature to stimulated phonon emission.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband spectral-shifted pulse pair generation by amplitude modulation for single attosecond pulse characterization using the SPIDER method
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ultra-broadband amplitude modulation for spectral-shifted pulse pair generation is realized by a liquid-crystal spatial light modulator. The results indicate that it's a promising way for single attosecond pulse characterization by the conventional SPIDER method.

articleTitle: Interband cascade lasers for wavelength specific applications in the 3–4 µm spectral range
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Interband cascade lasers (ICLs) are considered to be a very promising candidate for covering the mid-infrared wavelength range between 3 μm and 4 μm with just one type of semiconductor laser. Our contribution strengthens this thesis in terms of electro-optical results obtained from broad area and ridge waveguide ICL devices. A set of six ICLs with varied widths of the optically active InAs QWs shows emission from 2.97 μm to 4.16 μm without further changes to the underlying layout. Accompanied by photoluminescence measurements and theoretical calculations, a tuning rate of 0.55 μm per monolayer InAs and a linear temperature dependence of 1.88 nm/K from 150 K up to room temperature could be derived. The presented ICL results provide the means for device fabrication with high yield for applications dependent on a specific target wavelength.

articleTitle: Quantitative imaging of molecular order in lipid membranes using two-photon fluorescence polarimetry
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Complex molecular orders in heterogeneous Giant Unilamellar Vesicle as well as cell membranes are investigated using polarization resolved two-photon fluorescence microscopy. This method provides local structural information that cannot be achievable using traditional anisotropy measurements.

articleTitle: Plasmonic waves to electrical current conversion for integrated plasmonic-electronic circuits
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel ultra-compact THz-bandwidth plasmon-to-electron converter is reported for hybrid plasmon-electron integrated circuits. 20% of the optical power from plasmonic waveguide can be converted to photocurrent via a nanoscale active volume of 50×50×130nm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>.

articleTitle: Nanostructured semipolar LEDs for solid-state lighting
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We analyzed the electrical characteristics of nanostructured semipolar InGaN light-emitting diodes and showed that they exhibited superior optical and electrical properties to the polar light-emitting diodes. A large scale fabrication strategy is proposed.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional chiral photonic superlattices
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study the chiral optical properties of three-dimensional photonic superlattices composed of polymeric helices in various spatial checkerboard-like configurations. We fabricate and characterize four arrangements of circular-spiral photonic crystals with different relative phase and handedness.

articleTitle: Highly efficient Yb∶YAG channel waveguide laser with 1.7 W output power fabricated by fs-laser writing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Stress induced channel waveguides were written in crystalline Yb (7%):YAG with fs-laser pulses. Pumped by an OPS-laser at 969 nm laser oscillation with up to 1.76 W output power was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Emitter of continues-wave, ultra coherent, extreme ultraviolet radiation that is driven by low-power laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose emitter of high-order harmonics that is driven by a low-power continues-wave laser. The driving field is enhanced within a micro-resonator and further focused into sub-wavelength hot-spots by plasmonic nano-particles that are located near its surface.

articleTitle: Narrow-band degenerate optical parametric oscillator in periodically poled MgO∶LiNbO3 with a volume Bragg grating output coupler
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a narrow-band (<;0.7nm) optical parametric oscillator operating at degeneracy. By using a volume Bragg grating a signal power of 1.7W with a slope efficiency of 31.8% and good beam quality was achieved.

articleTitle: Frequency upconversion in periodically-poled LiNbO3 capable of achieving single-photon sensitivities for detections at 1.27 µm and 1.57 µm
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have demonstrated that frequency upconversion in periodically-poled LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> is capable of reaching single-photon sensitivities for detections at 1.27 μm and 1.57 μm at room temperature.

articleTitle: Magnification of photonic crystal fluorescence enhancement via tm resonance excitation and TE resonance extraction on a dielectric nanorod surface
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that a 1D photonic crystal surface incorporating a nanorod-structured layer reveals a 588-fold enhancement in fluorescence intensity through the use of resonance-enhanced excitation of Cy5 and resonance-enhanced extraction of Cy5 emission.

articleTitle: Chalcogenide nanowire waveguides with a nonlinear parameter 150,000 W−1km−1
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report dispersion-engineered nanowire waveguides fabricated in Ge<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11.5</sub>As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">24</sub>Se<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">54.5</sub> chalcogenide glass with a nonlinear parameter γ>150,000W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: Homogeneous linewidth temperature dependence of interfacial GaAs quantum dots studied with optical 2D Fourier-transform spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical 2D Fourier-transform spectroscopy extracts the temperature-dependent homogeneous lineshape of an ensemble of interfacial quantum dots. The asymmetric lineshape reveals that confinement and excitation-induced dephasing compete with strong exciton-phonon interactions, which dominate at higher temperature.

articleTitle: On the origin of negative dispersion contributions in filamentary propagation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally show that the windows frequently used for filament cells have a decisive influence on nonlinear pulse shaping, determining the group-delay-dispersion of the self-compressed pulses.

articleTitle: pH/ion sensitive nanoprobes with optical tweezers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present fluorescence-based pH/ion nanosensors, positioned and manipulated using holographic optical tweezers, with simultaneous fluorescence read-out, within a microfluidic device and within a biological cell.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated quad Mach-Zehnder IQ modulator for optical 16-QAM generation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 16-QAM transmitter using a monolithically-integrated quad Mach-Zehnder in-phase/quadrature (QMZ-IQ) modulator with binary driving electronics.

articleTitle: Characterization of saturable absorption of E11 and E22 transitions of carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We characterize the saturable absorption properties of the E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> and E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">22</sub> transitions of the same highly-purified film of single-wall carbon-nanotubes, and compare the results in terms of modulation-depth, saturation-intensity and mode-locked fiber laser performance.

articleTitle: Improving plasmonic nanoantennas
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Improvements in energy damage threshold of gold nanoantennas were studied using stabilizing dielectric films. Annealed nanoantennas show a stronger plasmonic resonance, but have a decreased damage threshold.

articleTitle: ZnO scintillator improved temporal response for XFEL timing observation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A hydrothermal method-grown, Fe-doped ZnO crystal, was excited by the XFEL prototype at Spring-8 facility. The scintillation signal exhibited <;10-ps rise time and <;100-ps decay time; making it the fastest scintillator for XFEL timing studies.

articleTitle: Mesa-structured InGaAs/InAlAs photoconductive antennas for THz time domain systems operated at 1.5 µm
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Mesa-structuring of InGaAs/InAlAs photoconductive layers has been employed for improving THz antennas. The developed devices are evaluated in a time domain spectrometer operating at 1.5 μm wavelengths. Order-of-magnitude improvements versus planar antennas are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Integrated polarization converters for mid-infrared applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Two types of integrated polarization converters for mid-infrared operation were designed and fabricated, utilizing Ti-diffused LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> waveguides. Narrowband and broadband converters with maximum conversion efficiencies of 79% and 92% at 2 microns are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Broadband coherent anti-stokes Raman scattering spectroscopy using a quasi-supercontinuum light source
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Broadband coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering spectroscopy was performed successfully for the first time using a quasi-supercontinuum light source in the wavelength range from 0.85 to 1.1 micrometer generated from a photonic crystal fiber.

articleTitle: Terahertz plasmon-induced dipole emission from a Schottky barrier
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on terahertz modulation of a Schottky interface. An amplitude increase of ~12% is observed for terahertz pulses transmitted through dense ensembles of metallic microparticles containing a surface structure of Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>O/Au.

articleTitle: Scalable cylindrical metallo-dielectric metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a new approach for scalable manufacturing of Metamaterials fabricated through floating and rolling-up of flexible metallodielectric stacks. Such structures have unusual nonlinear optical properties and potential superlensing applications.

articleTitle: Surface energy transport following relativistic laser-solid interaction
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: After a ~1-micron Al target spot is excited at 3e18 W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, a delayed probe detects isotropic surface heating out to 12 μm radius. Analysis shows runaway electrons and strong magnetic fields govern fs surface heating.

articleTitle: Large core acetylene-filled photonic microcells made by tapering the hollow-core fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We fabricated low insertion loss and large core (40-70 μm) kagomé lattice acetylene-filled photonic microcells by tapering the large outer diameter kagomé fibers and splicing their reduced ends to a single mode fiber.

articleTitle: 83% net efficiency in generating 700 mW of cw blue by IR diode laser doubling with PPKTP
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on high efficiency resonant doubling at 486nm using periodically poled KTP. A stable blue power of 700 ± 5 mW was obtained using the 840 mW output power of a FBG stabilized PM fiber coupled IR semiconductor laser. This gives an overall conversion efficiency of 83%. To obtain this result, all losses in the system were carefully studied and minimized.

articleTitle: Photonic Band Gap materials: Light control at will
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Abstract form only given.Photonic Band Gap (PBG) materials are artificial, periodic, dielectrics that enable engineering of the most fundamental properties of electromagnetic waves. These include the laws of refraction, diffraction, and spontaneous emission of light. Unlike traditional semiconductors that rely on the propagation of electrons through an atomic lattice, PBG materials execute their novel functions through selective trapping or "localization of light". This is a fundamentally new and largely unexplored property of Maxwell's equations. This is also of practical importance for all optical communications, information processing, efficient lighting, and solar energy trapping. PBG materials are capable of trapping light on sub-wavelength scales without absorption loss in three-dimensions. This enables virtually complete control of the flow of light on microscopic scales in a 3D optical chip as well as very strong coupling of light to matter where desired. By further engineering the electromagnetic density of states within the chip it is possible to realize unprecedented coherent optical control of the quantum state of resonant atoms or quantum dots. This defines a fundamentally new regime for quantum optics. I discuss consequences of light trapping in classical and quantum electrodynamics. I also discuss the challenges and requirements for materials fabrication to realize these remarkable effects.

articleTitle: High harmonic generation from solid targets at high repetition rate
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Harmonics up to the 15<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> order are produced from solid targets using 3 mJ, 30 fs pulses focused to a spot size of 1.7 μm and 3 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Combined conversion efficiency to the highest harmonics is > 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>.

articleTitle: Heralded, pure-state single-photon source based on a KTP waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that with simple spectral filtering, the Schmidt number for the transmitted photon-pairs (with 90% transmittance) which are produced via type-II parametric down-conversion in a KTP waveguide equals to unity to within 0.2%.

articleTitle: Enhanced soliton self-frequency shift and white-light CW supercontinuum generation in germanosilicate-core PCFs
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We numerically investigate the mechanisms responsible for the enhancement of the soliton self-frequency-shift effect in germanoscilicate-core photonic crystal fibers. A direct consequence leads to the first experimental demonstration of a powerful white-light continuous-wave supercontinuum.

articleTitle: Strongly enhanced backward second-harmonic generation with slow light in a two-dimensional photonic crystal
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We obtain greatly enhanced conversion efficiencies of backward second-harmonic generation by exploiting small group velocities at phase match in a two-dimensional quadratically nonlinear photonic crystal. The efficiencies obtained from a modal approach are rigorously confirmed.

articleTitle: Continuous-variable quantum erasure correcting code
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a continuous variable quantum erasure-correcting code, which protects coherent states of light against complete erasure. The scheme encodes two coherent states into a bi-party entangled state, and the resulting 4-mode code is conveyed through 4 independent channels that randomly erases the signal. We show experimentally that the transmitted state can be corrected by performing a syndrome measurement followed by a corrective transformation.

articleTitle: Optical parametric oscillation in a high-index doped silica glass micro-ring resonator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a CMOS-compatible, integrated optical parametric oscillator in a high-index doped silica glass ring resonator. We obtain lasing with wavelength spacings from 200 GHz to > 6 THz, with a threshold as low as 54 mW.

articleTitle: Reversible tuning of photonic crystal cavities using photochromic films
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate reversible tuning of photonic-crystal cavity resonance by 2.7 nm using a photochromic film of spiropyran. Exposure of spiropyran to ultraviolet light redshifts the cavity resonance that can be reversed by exposure to visible light.

articleTitle: Propagation dynamics of controllable cross-talk in double-ladder system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We theoretically and experimentally investigate the propagation dynamics and controllability of cross-talk between two probes in a double-ladder system via interplay of χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(1)</sup> and χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup> processes.

articleTitle: Q-switching of Pr3+-doped LiYF4 visible lasers pumped by a high-power GaN diode laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Q-switching of a Pr:LiYF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser at three visible wavelenghths pumped by a high-power GaN laser diode is demonstrated. The highest laser peak power of 79 W with a pulsewidth of 50 ns is obtained for 639 nm at 7.7 kHz.

articleTitle: Noise and stability in giant-chirp oscillators mode-locked with a nanotube-based saturable absorber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We compare experimental results showing stable dissipative-soliton solutions exist in mode-locked lasers with ultra-large normal dispersion (as large as 21.5 ps<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), with both the analytic framework provided by Haus' master-equation and full numerical simulations.

articleTitle: 55%-efficient, 13-W, single-pass SHG of a CW Yb-fiber laser in a double-crystal scheme
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a 13-W, single-frequency, cw green source at 532nm in a TEM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub> spatial profile based on simple single-pass SHG of a fiber laser with conversion efficiency as high as 55% using a double-crystal scheme.

articleTitle: Multicasting of 40 Gb/s NRZ-OOK data into 24 RZ copies using a single pump and supercontinuum generation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate multicasting of 40 Gb/s NRZ-OOK data into 24 RZ copies using a single pump and supercontinuum generation. The NRZ signal is optically sampled and a supercontinuum is generated using the sampled signal. An average ~1.6 dB power penalty is achieved for 24 channels at a BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>.

articleTitle: Optimizing nano-patterned metal films for Use as transparent electrodes in optoelectronic devices
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We optimize the optical properties of nano-patterned metallic films for use as transparent conductive electrodes in optoelectronic devices by performing a constant-sheet-resistance transformation. Our design principles apply to both one- and two-dimensionally patterned films.

articleTitle: Fiber-based spectroscopy of 1.55 µm PbS quantum dots coupled to Si microcavities
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use a fiber-taper waveguide to measure the transmission, photoluminescence, photo-darkening, and lifetime from a low density of near-infrared PbS quantum dots integrated with silicon photonic crystal cavities, microdisks, and the taper itself.

articleTitle: Concentration of terahertz radiation through tapered circular subwavelength apertures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the concentration of broadband terahertz radiation through conically tapered subwavelength apertures. Concomitantly, there is a reduction of the THz group velocity for the transmitted pulse. We describe the underlying principle behind this phenomenon.

articleTitle: Generation of 5-fs, 5-mJ pulse using hollow-fiber pulse compression at 1 kHz
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have demonstrated the generation of 5 fs, 5 mJ pulses at 1kHz repetition rate using a pulse compression technique in a hollow fiber with a pressure gradient.

articleTitle: Terahertz emission from optical fiber tip and near-field microscope applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We devised and demonstrated terahertz emission from an optical fiber tip coated with InAs thin film illuminated by guided laser field and achieved λ/20 sub-wavelength imaging in an InAs-based transmissive near-field laser emission THz microscope.

articleTitle: Optical lattice clocks toward 10–17 uncertainty
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The concept and recent progress of optical lattice clocks are reviewed. With the clock uncertainty of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-17</sup> in perspective, we discuss new challenges in optical lattice clocks and possible applications of such highly accurate and stable atomic clocks.

articleTitle: Hybridization of the negative index response by resonant coupling to a dipole absorber inside a metamaterial
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a resonant coupling and hybridization between the structural resonance in the permeability of a fishnet and a material resonance in the dielectric spacer layer. Experimental data shows a good agreement with theory.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable, multi-section quantum dot mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The optical characterization and applications of quantum dot mode-locked lasers constructed using a reconfigurable, unit-cell approach are discussed including diverse waveform generation, optical to RF signal conversion, and optimal laser layout design.

articleTitle: Femtosecond quantum optics with single-electron systems
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Few-fermion dynamics in a single CdSe/ZnSe quantum dot after resonant excitation is investigated via femtosecond transmission spectroscopy. Optimized coupling via dielectric microcavities and plasmonic nanoantennas is discussed leading towards ultrafast nonlinear optics with single photons.

PACS Terms: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Suppression of collisional decoherence in optically trapped atomic ensemble by bang-bang dynamical decoupling
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We employ dynamical decoupling techniques to suppress the decoherence induced by elastic collisions in optically trapped <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb atoms. Coherence times exceeding 3 sec in a dense ensemble are demonstrated for an arbitrary initial state.

articleTitle: Wavelength-tunable mid-infrared 3-µm-waveband light source with 805/1064-nm differential frequency generation in effective intracavity system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A wavelength-tunable mid-infrared 3-μm-waveband light source with an effective intracavity system is successfully demonstrated. Its advantages include wide wavelength-tunable range (> 85 nm), high emission intensity, simple controllability, and small footprint.

articleTitle: Extreme-value statistics in supercontinuum generation by cascaded stimulated Raman scattering
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Statistical fluctuations in cascaded stimulated Raman spectra are studied. The statistical distribution of shot-to-shot spectral variations evolves from a quasi-Gaussian to a long-tailed extreme-value distribution for Stokes orders at a large separation from the pump.

articleTitle: Modulation-frequency encoding/decoding for parallel detection in biophotonic sensing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Fluorescence from different emitters (labeled biomolecules) with distinct absorption wavelengths is encoded by uniquely modulating each excitation beam. Detection by an ultrasensitive, albeit color-blind photomultiplier and subsequent Fourier analysis reveals the origin of each signal.

articleTitle: Optical response of silica microcavities in gaseous and superfluid Helium-4
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the dynamic optical response of silica microcavities in a <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>He environment. Dispersive properties of silica and external detection of a superfluid sound are characterized, due to accurate temperature tuning of the cryodevice.

articleTitle: High-order resonant modes in an antenna coupled terahertz 2D plasmonic detector
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate excitation of terahertz 2D plasmons in a grating-gated transistor at the vertex of a broadband antenna. This functions as a plasmonic crystal, with modes associated with both the grating period and channel length.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional invisibility-cloaking structure at optical frequencies
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We realize a three-dimensional invisibility-cloaking structure operating at optical frequencies. We employ a woodpile photonic crystal in the long-wavelength limit with tailored polymer filling fraction to hide a bump in a gold reflector.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Semiconductor Laser Tracking Frequency distance Gauge
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present results from the Semiconductor-Laser Tracking Frequency distance Gauge having Allan deviation of 5 pm. The simple and rugged SL-TFG will achieve sub-pm accuracy. It is required for space-based astronomical instruments and gravitational experiments.

articleTitle: Novel fiber optical inclinometer based on a concatenated fused taper and tilted fiber Bragg grating
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A fiber optical inclinometer based on cladding mode re-coupling mechanism is demonstrated by using a nonadiabatic taper cascaded with a weakly tilted fiber Bragg grating. The sensitivity is optimized for different ranges of angle.

articleTitle: An 87Sr lattice clock
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An optical lattice clock based on <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Sr <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> is developed. The width of the spectrum is currently limited to be 1 kHz due to stray magnetic field. The obtained absolute frequency agreed with the CIPM recommendation.

articleTitle: 1-ns reconfiguration direct space-to-time pulse shaping
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this paper we demonstrate high-speed direct space-to-time pulse shaping with waveform reconfigurations down to 1ns. Our pulse shaper implementation incorporates a modified arrayed-waveguide grating structure and an array of optoelectronic reflection modulators.

articleTitle: Phase transition of discrete quadratic solitons
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We predict theoretically and observe experimentally an abrupt power-controlled transition from unstaggered to staggered second harmonic phase profiles of discrete solitons with linear second harmonic coupling in periodically poled waveguide arrays.

articleTitle: Optical technique for porosity detection inside valve body spool bores down to 5 mm diameter
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We inspect inner surfaces of valve body spool bores down to 5 mm diameter for porosity defects, using an optical probe with ~50 μm lateral resolution. The probe can also distinguish porosity from bump-type defects.

articleTitle: Intersubband thermophotovoltaic detectors
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High-efficiency multiple-junction detectors for thermophotovoltaic energy conversion are designed based on the series combination of different quantum cascade structures. Numerical simulations indicate that these devices can outperform existing interband solutions.

articleTitle: Low dispersion silicon Slot waveguides for frequency comb generation with equally spaced spectral lines
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A silicon slotted ring resonator with flattened dispersion in the cavity is proposed to produce uniform spectral lines in on-chip frequency comb generations. Standard deviation of the free spectral range is improved by 250 times as compared to a strip waveguide in the same size.

articleTitle: Microcavity plasmonics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce the new concept of microcavity plasmonics: A cut-wire pair is strongly coupled to photonic modes in a microcavity. Large anticrossings of the symmetric and antisymmetric plasmon modes and the cavity modes are observed.

articleTitle: Self-starting octave-spanning Ti:sapphire laser pumped by an Yb:KLu(WO4)2 thin-disk oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an octave-spanning Ti:sapphire laser quasi-synchronously pumped by a frequency-doubled Yb:KLu(WO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> thin-disk oscillator. The system features a self-starting behavior and can be stabilized with respect to its carrier-envelope-offset phase.

articleTitle: Implementation of atom-photon interfaces for quantum networking
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present two schemes for interfacing and manipulating individual atoms: One involves an array of dipole-traps using a spatial light modulator. The other implements cavity-based single photon generation combined with photon storage.

articleTitle: Theory of mechanical displacement measurement using a multiple cavity mode transducer
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an optomechanical displacement transducer that relies on three cavity modes parametrically coupled to a mechanical oscillator and whose frequency spacing matches the mechanical resonance frequency. The additional resonances allow us to reach the standard quantum limit at a substantially lower input power (compared to the case of only one resonance), as both sensitivity and quantum backaction are enhanced.

articleTitle: Enhanced coherence of weakly coupled lasers due to amplitude nonlinear dynamics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A theoretical model characterizing the coherence and phase properties of two weakly coupled lasers is presented. Our calculations show how amplitude dynamics of non-phase locked lasers may enhance coherence by nearly an order of magnitude.

articleTitle: Octave-spanning supercontinuum generation for an Er-doped fiber laser frequency comb at a 1 GHz repetition rate
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed a 1 GHz Er-doped femtosecond fiber laser system providing 2 nJ pulses at ~100 fs durations and demonstrated octave-spanning supercontinuum generation from 1 μm - 2.4 μm that is suitable for 1f-2f stabilizing the frequency comb.

articleTitle: Cascaded third harmonic generation in random media
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study nonlinear frequency generation in media with random ferroelectric domain structure. We show that randomness enables one to realize broadband third harmonic generation via cascading of two second order quasi-phase matched nonlinear processes. We investigate spatial and polarization properties of the emitted waves and find them to be in agreement with theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: Competition between a cw laser and a frequency comb interacting with a Rb vapor
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate the transmission of a cw laser interacting with rubidium vapor and a frequency comb. The results reveal various regimes of competition and the importance of optical pumping and power broadening of the lasers.

articleTitle: Multi-watt operation of a Nd∶YVO4 microchip laser incorporating a synthetic diamond heat spreader
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Output powers in excess of 2W are reported for a microchip laser including diamond. These compare to 0.3W without diamond for the same configuration. Approaches to simultaneously scaling of brightness are discussed.

articleTitle: Ultrafast optical response and transient population inversion of photoexcited Ge/SiGe quantum wells
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The ultrafast carrier dynamics of Ge/SiGe quantum wells on Si substrate are investigated by pump-probe spectroscopy. Pronounced nonequilibrium effects in the relaxation dynamics and transient gain are observed and analyzed using a microscopic many-body theory.

articleTitle: Compact ultrafast laser enabled by distortion free pulse stretching and compression by chirped volume holographic gratings
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a method to correct the spatial distortion resulting from temporally stretching/compressing optical pulses with a chirped volume holographic grating that enables the practical realization of ultra-compact and efficient chirped pulse amplification laser systems.

articleTitle: Planar terahertz waveguides based on periodically dimpled metal films
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate planar plasmonic THz waveguides based on dimpled metal films. The propagation properties of the guided modes depend upon the geometrical parameters of the dimples and can be broadly engineered.

articleTitle: Optical manipulation of microbeads in an integrated optofluidic device
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate optical manipulation of 1-μm-sized polystyrene beads in a silicon-based integrated optofluidic device. The relative velocity of the optically driven microbeads is ~14.2 μm/s and ~3.5 μm/s using 0.7-μm and 0.5-μm-thick silicon nitride waveguides.

articleTitle: Laser fabrication of 1D micro-optical components by localized vaporization and bumping
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A new approach for fabrication of sub-millimetre width cylindrical mirrors in fused silica by localized CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> vaporization and bumping is presented. Formation of reversed bumps and their removal by annealing is also investigated here.

articleTitle: A weak value inequality as a test for local realism
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We derive a weak value inequality for a particle pair that should be satisfied under specific assumptions of local realism. Any correlated quantum particle pair can produce unbounded violations of this inequality.

articleTitle: Waveguide biosensor with integrated photodetector array for tuberculosis serology
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The first label-free LEAC biosensor immunoassay demonstration is reported. CMOS chips with integrated photoconductor arrays detected 150 kDa tuberculosis related antibodies and 18 kDa protein antigens. The limit of detection for thickness change was 120 pm.

articleTitle: Hollow core fiber with an octave spanning bandgap
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that amongst all known lattices, a triangular arrangement of interconnected resonators generates the widest possible out-of-plane bandgap. A photonic bandgap fiber with an octave spanning transmission range is presented for the first time.

articleTitle: Intracavity Phase Interferometry for magnetic field sensing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Application of a phase to frequency conversion is demonstrated to measure small magnetic fields with a sensitivity of 10nT corresponding to a polarization rotation of 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>rad.

articleTitle: High resolution measurement of sodium fluorescein distribution in doped live corneal tissue
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Two-photon fluorescence was used for the first time to measure sodium fluorescein distribution in live corneal tissue. The diffusion depth was determined to be 350 µm under study conditions with 11µm axial resolution.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum generation in an integrated high-index glass spiral waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A supercontinuum spectrum of more than 300 nm is obtained at 1550 nm and 1290 nm using doped-silica glass, 45 cm long, integrated spiral waveguides. Different dynamics near two distinct zero dispersion wavelengths are observed and explained theoretically.

articleTitle: High quality electron beams from a laser wakefield accelerator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Very stable, high quality electron beams (current ~ 10 kA, energy spread <; 1%, emittance ~ 1π mm mrad) have been generated in a laser-plasma accelerator driven by 25 TW femtosecond laser pulses.

articleTitle: Ultra-high reflectivity hollow core PCF microcell using a tapered micro-mirror
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ultra-high reflectivity is achieved at the end-face of a hollow-core PCF via the insertion and fusion of a metal-coated tapered single-mode-fiber to the core of the hollow fiber. Saturable absorption is demonstrated using this device.

articleTitle: III-Nitride UV emitters and their applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: III-Nitride UV light emitting diodes (LEDs) have an enormous applications potential for air & water purification, food disinfection, polymer curing and bio-medical instrumentation. However the growth and processing of these devices is very challenging due to the high Al-fraction AlGaN layers needed for deep UV emission. Since early 2000, our research group has developed III-N deep UV LEDs (emission wavelength <; 300 nm) over sapphire substrates. The key to our success was the use of a new pulsed epitaxy procedure and new device designs to mitigate junction heating issues. In this paper we will review the progress to date which has led to large area deep UV LED lamps with cw-powers approaching 100 mW.

articleTitle: Keyword index
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Presents an index of the articles published in the conference.

articleTitle: Postdeadline session I
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Provides a schedule of conference events and a listing of which papers were presented in each session.

articleTitle: Author index
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The author index contains an entry for each author and coauthor included in the proceedings record.

articleTitle: Table of contents
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: ultrafast dynamics, ultrafast measurements, pulse fiber sources, lattice clocks, EUV generation, VCSEL, THz detection, quasi phasematching materials, laser surface structuring, passive resonators, active resonators, spectroscopic sensing, pulse measurement, nonsilica fiber, frequency combs, waveguides, laser nanostructuring, microring resonator optical processing, RF processing, cavity-enhanced sensing, photovoltaics, advanced beam shaping, laser processing, nonlinear optics, pulse measurement, pulse propagation, detectors, all-optical switching, fiber sources, short pulse lasers, THz domain spectroscopy, pulse shaping, quantum emitter photonic devices, photo-darkening, speciality fibers, modelocked lasers, THz ultrafast generation, solid-state lighting, laser structuring, optical materials, supercontinuum generation, pulse synthesis, chemical sensing, biological sensing, medical sensing, high power fiber lasers, optofluidics, 3-5 semiconductor lasers, THz metamaterials, beam shaping, and beam switching.

articleTitle: PMD and OSNR insensitive 40-Gb/s OOK/DPSK chromatic dispersion monitoring using a delay-line interferometer and a <10-GHz photodetector
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a chromatic dispersion monitoring technique utilizing a delay-line interferometer and a <;10-GHz photodetector for 40-Gb/s OOK/DPSK. Spectral shift of RF dip changing with up to 560-ps/nm-CD is measured insensitive to 23-ps-DGD and <;15-dB-OSNR.

articleTitle: High-power thermoelectrically-cooled and uncooled mid-wave infrared quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High-performance, room-temperature quantum cascade lasers emitting at a wavelength of 4.6 µm are reported. 7-mm-long chips with optimized-reflectivity facet coatings produced a continuous-wave output power of 2.9 W at 293 K for thermoelectrically cooled devices mounted on AlN submounts and a continuous-wave output power in excess of 1 W for uncooled devices.

articleTitle: All-order polarization mode dispersion (PMD) compensation in 10Gbit/s×2 Pol-Mux system via hyperfine resolution optical pulse shaper
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Employing an optical pulse shaper with 1.6 GHz/pixel resolution, we experimentally demonstrate optical compensation of all-order polarization mode dispersion with >40 ps mean differential group delay in a 10 Gbit/s×2 Pol-Mux system.

articleTitle: Optofluidic dispersion engineering of photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use optofluidic infiltration to precisely and reversibly engineer the dispersion of a photonic crystal defect waveguide post-fabrication. The amount of fluid infiltrated into the photonic crystal microstructure strongly influences the waveguide dispersion.

articleTitle: Scaling law of high harmonics generated in the two-color infrared laser field
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We theoretically investigate and demonstrate a two-color scheme mixed by an infrared and fundamental (800 nm) laser pulses to enhance the harmonic yield and soften the wavelength dependence.

articleTitle: Detection of first order phase transitions using direct UV written integrated optical planar Bragg gratings intrinsically defined within a silica micro-cantilever
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A phase transition sensor is demonstrated using direct UV written Bragg gratings intrinsically defined within a mechanically resonating silica micro-cantilever. Fabrication is uniquely achieved through a combination of micro-machining and direct UV writing.

articleTitle: High-energy, picosecond, cryogenic Yb∶YAG chirped-pulse amplifier at kHz repetition rates for OPCPA pumping
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the development of a 50-mJ-class ∼10-ps chirped-pulse amplifier at kHz repetition rates using cryogenic Yb∶YAG regenerative and multi-pass amplifiers. The system is well suited as pump laser for kHz high-average-power ultra-broadband OPCPAs.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of computer reconfigurable multimode entanglement
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Quantum protocols require multiple entangled modes. We demonstrate a set of tools that generate, manipulate and detect multimode entanglement within a single beam of light. This new method is flexible and computer controlled.

articleTitle: DPSK receiver with feedforward control to mitigate in-band crosstalk and ASE noise
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a scheme that suppresses degradation induced by in-band crosstalk and amplified spontaneous emission (ASE) noise in differential phase shift keying signal, using feedforward control. Though in-band crosstalk in wavelength division multiplexing networks or ASE from optical amplifiers degrades system performance, we can suppress the degradation using the feedforward control.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal nanobeam lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate room temperature photonic crystal lasers based on high-Q nanobeam cavities. L-L curve shows the lasing threshold of ~0.6mW and the spontaneous emission factor larger than 0.3.

articleTitle: Eliminating spatiotemporal distortions from angular dispersion in noncollinear optical parametric amplifiers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Spatiotemporal aberrations from megahertz-repetition-rate noncollinear optical parametric amplifiers are characterized using spatially resolved spectral interferometry. Pulse-front tilt is eliminated by optimizing the signal's angular gain spectrum, increasing the intensity at focus.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical properties of layered multi-metal nanostructures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the temporal and spectral dynamics of the nonlinear optical response of transparent Ag/Au multi-metal layers and Fabry-Perot resonators with 10× enhancement compared with Ag and with comparable transparency in the visible.

articleTitle: Beam steering of mid-infrared light with active plasmonic structures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate beaming of coherent mid-infrared radiation through subwavelength slits flanked by periodic grooves at a metal/semiconductor interface. Steering angle is controlled by tuning either the incident-light wavelength or the optical properties of the semiconductor.

articleTitle: Operation of a 1∶8-THz quantum-cascade laser above 160 K
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The maximum operating temperature of previously reported terahertz quantum-cascade lasers (QCLs) has empirically been limited to a value of ~ ħω/k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">B</sub>. Here, we report a new design scheme for terahertz QCLs and achieve 163-K operation for a 1.8-THz QCL, which is a factor of 1.9 larger than ħω/k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">B</sub>.

articleTitle: Quantum-opto-mechanics in the strong coupling regime
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have recently demonstrated strong coupling between light and a micromechanical system. This provides a new level of quantum optical control over mechanics by accessing interactions beyond the rotating wave approximation.

articleTitle: >25× reduction in the effective nonlinear coefficient over a 100-nm wavelength range using vertically-slotted silicon waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Vertically-slotted waveguides are used to achieve low nonlinearity. Compared with strip waveguide, it demonstrates a >25× reduction in the nonlinear coefficient for a 100-nm wavelength range.

articleTitle: Analytical technique for determining the size of subwavelength focal spots in far field
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We develop a technique for determining the size of subwavelength focal spots without near-field microscopy, based on carefully designed gratings that convert the subwavelength information into propagating waves, far-field measurements, and computer post-processing.

articleTitle: Fluidic lens laparoscopic zoom camera for minimally invasive surgery
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed a miniaturized laparoscopic zoom camera that is 17 mm long, has >4X optical zoom, and works under 300 lux. This camera is suitable for advancing minimally invasive surgery. Demonstration surgery (cholecystectomy) was performed.

articleTitle: High-resolution spectroscopy using interleaved optical frequency comb
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose high-resolution spectroscopy based on the sweep of the interleaved optical frequency comb by an optical phase modulator. Fine spectrum of HCN gas has been successfully measured with 1 MHz resolution over 4 THz frequency range.

articleTitle: Design principle for low bending losses in all-solid photonic bandgap fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The structural dependence of factors which mainly affect a bending loss property is theoretically investigated in all-solid photonic bandgap fibers. A design principle for realizing a low bending loss is successfully figured out.

articleTitle: Femtosecond Bessel filaments for high aspect-ratio and taper-free micromachining of dielectrics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Femtosecond Bessel beams are demonstrated for high aspect ratio machining in the filamentation regime with water assistance. Taper-free microchannels and micro-trenches are demonstrated with aspect ratio up to 40 and diameters down to 2 μm.

articleTitle: An 88 fs fiber soliton laser at 1.56 µm using a quantum well saturable absorber with an ultrafast intersubband transition
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a 1.5 μm passively mode-locked fiber laser that uses an ultrafast intersubband transition (ISBT) in a quantum well as a saturable absorber. An 88 fs, 42 MHz soliton pulse was successfully generated.

articleTitle: Deep ultraviolet LEDs based on AlGaN alloys by plasma-assisted molecular beam epitaxy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the development of AlGaN-based deep UV LEDs by plasma-assisted molecular beam epitaxy, which at bare-die configuration have an output power of 1.3 mW at 200 mA and external quantum efficiency of 0.16%.

articleTitle: Flexible solar cells based on stacked crystalline semiconductor nanomembranes on plastic substrates
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report here experimental demonstration of flexible solar cells based on crystalline semiconductor nanomembranes (NMs) transferred onto flexible PET (polyethylene terephthalate) substrates. For 1 micrometer thick p-i-n InP NMs, we obtained an open circuit voltage of 0.68 V and power efficiency of 1.5% from the photovoltaic solar cells. The results agree very well with the anticipated thin film InP solar cell performance considering the low absorption in very thin InP NMs. The efficiency remains unchanged for bending radii greater than 42 mm. It drops to 50% of its original value at a bending radius of 32 mm. The results demonstrate a promising future for such a new type of cost effective flexible thin film solar cells, based on crystalline semiconductor membranes.

articleTitle: Electrostatic conveyer for excitons
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the realization of electrostatic conveyers for indirect excitons and observation of a dynamical localization-delocalization transition for the excitons in the conveyer with varying exciton density and amplitude of the conveyer potential.

articleTitle: Improvement on the luminescence efficiency, electroluminescence linewidth and transport properties of ZnCdSe/ZnCdMgSe Quantum Cascade structures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present electroluminescence from ZnCdSe/ZnCdMgSe Quantum Cascade structures, with 3 times higher luminescence efficiency, 30% narrower electroluminescence linewidths than our first demonstration. The measured turn-on voltage matches with the calculated value.

articleTitle: Controllable band-gap structure and mini-gap solitons in two-dimensional photonic superlattices
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the controllable band-gap structure and nonlinear localized states of light in two-dimensional photonic superlattices. Bright gap solitons and vortex solitons residing in an additional mini-gap due to the extra periodicity are presented.

articleTitle: Thermoelectric effect in quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A thermoelectric effect is observed in quantum cascade lasers and validated through thermal/electrical transport modeling. Choosing the proper polarity leads to an active core heat reduction of 9 K for a 7.5 kW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> thermal load.

articleTitle: Integrated MEMS tunable high quality factor optical cavity for optomechanical transduction
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a fully integrated optomechanical transducer achieving 580 ppm wavelength tuning of a high quality factor (Q = 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> - 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>) waveguide-coupled silicon microdisk by electrostatically actuating a dielectric membrane located in the evanescent field region above it.

articleTitle: Anomalous dispersion in plasmonic nanostructures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We studied plasmonic surface modes in irregular metal-dielectric interfaces not supporting waveguide modes. We found anomalous dispersion in the off-axis scattered emission whose origin is explained as enhanced backscattering mediated by plasmonic surface modes.

articleTitle: Photonic fiber for flexible sub-20-fs pulse delivery
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Delivery of sub-20-fs pulses with a spectrally flat phase through 80 cm chirped photonic crystal fiber with chirped-mirror precompensation is experimentally demonstrated. This sets a new record for fiber-based femtosecond pulse delivery.

articleTitle: Modelocking of a diode-laser-pumped Ti:sapphire laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Modelocking of a directly diode-laser-pumped Ti:sapphire laser is demonstrated. Near transform-limited pulses of 116fs duration are measured for an output power of 9mW under pumping at 452nm with a 1W gallium nitride diode laser.

articleTitle: Ordered fluidic self-assembly of 3D microparticles based on gray-scale optofluidic maskless lithography
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate ordered fluidic self-assembly of lithographically fabricated microparticles in microfluidic channels. Unique 3D shapes of the microparticles are fabricated by gray-scale optofluidic maskless lithography. We show these structures enhance orderness of the monolayer crystal.

articleTitle: Waveguide-integrated low-noise Germanium avalanche photodetector with 6dB sensitivity improvement
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A waveguide-integrated Germanium avalanche photodetector with 6dB sensitivity improvement and excess noise with k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub> ~ 0.1 was demonstrated while operating with 12dB gain at around 3V bias voltage. The photodetector was monolithically integrated into front-end CMOS.

articleTitle: Nano-optic of metamaterials by spatially resolved Electron Energy Loss Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an Electron Energy Loss Spectroscopy (EELS) study in a Scanning Transmission Electron Microscope (STEM) of individual Split-Ring Resonator (SRR). We show the possibility to map each plasmonic modes with a nanometric spatial resolution in the Near IR to UV spectral range.

articleTitle: Coherent writing and reading of quantum dots excitons' state by resonant two colors polarized laser pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use a resonant circularly polarized picosecond laser pulse to write a coherent superposition of exciton's states. We use a second, delayed circularly polarized pulse, tuned into the biexciton resonance to read the exciton's state.

articleTitle: Femtosecond spatiotemporal control with multiple knobs
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: For controlling non-resonant molecular fragmentation process, simultaneous effect of chirp and polarization of a femtosecond pulse is mutually independent. For multiphoton fluorescence microscopy and optical tweezers with high-repetition-rate lasers, inter-pulse separation and polarization is important.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave lasing of monoclinic Ho:KLu(WO4)2 under in-band excitation by a diode-pumped Tm:KLu(WO4)2 laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first cw Ho:KLuW laser operating at room temperature. It is resonantly pumped by a diode-pumped Tm:KLuW laser and emits at 2060 nm in E//N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub> polarization with a slope efficiency of 22%.
