PACS Terms: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Goos-Hänchen effect enhancement by surface electromagnetic waves in photonic crystals
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The Goos-Hänchen effect enhancement caused by surface electromagnetic waves excited in one-dimensional photonic crystals is directly observed using angular spectroscopy in Kretschmann-Raether configuration and far-field optical microscopy visualization.

articleTitle: Generation and frequency control of THz waves by nanoscale piezo-engineering
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a newly found terahertz generation, mediated via acoustic standing waves confined within GaN-based piezoelectric heterostructures and its spectral control by adapting the active layer thickness.

PACS Terms: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Optical parametric oscillators: A new generation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Progress in continuous-wave and ultrafast femtosecond optical parametric oscillators, covering spectral regions from 250 nm in the ultraviolet to 5 mm in the infrared, using novel design concepts and advanced laser pump sources is reviewed.

articleTitle: All-fiber Q-switched single-frequency Tm-doped laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an all-fiber Q-switched single-frequency laser oscillator operating in the eye-safe region at 1950nm, which is, to our best knowledge, the first demonstration of a Q-switched single-frequency fiber laser near 2μm.

articleTitle: Quantum optics with semiconductor quantum dots in microcavities
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: For quantum-dot-based microcavity lasers with large spontaneous emission coupling we compare results of a microscopic theory with recent experiments. Coherence properties and photon correlations are discussed and the single-emitter limited is studied.

articleTitle: Sub-nanosecond, 1-kHz, temperature-tuned, non-critical mid-IR OPO based on CdSiP2 crystal pumped at 1064 nm
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Temperature tuning (6.117-6.554 μm for the idler) and sub-nanosecond durations are demonstrated with a non-critical, 1064-nm pumped CdSiP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-OPO. At 1 kHz, the output idler energy of 24 μJ corresponds to an average power of 24 mW.

articleTitle: Nonlinear index measurement by intracavity interferometry
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Intracavity Phase Interferometry is applied to the measurement of nonlinear indices with a sensitivity and accuracy outperforming the z-scan. The sample is placed in a mode-locked laser cavity in which two pulses circulate independently.

articleTitle: Investigating the surface of nanoparticles by Second Harmonic Generation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate Second Harmonic Generation at the surface of nanoparticles both by modeling and experiment. We present an ab initio simulation method, which allows deducing surface properties as well as the nature of adsorbed molecules.

articleTitle: Improvements in photon number-resolving detection
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Visible light photon counters (VLPCs) enable efficient single-photon detection with photon number-resolving capability. In our system, we observe up to 5 simultaneous photons, with a detector signal pulse height distribution that matches theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: 105 W pico-second Nd∶YVO4 bounce amplifier system with a photorefractive phase conjugate mirror
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated 105 W pico-second output from a cascaded Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> amplifier laser system consisting of a Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> bounce amplifier with a photorefractive phase-conjugate mirror and a second diode-side-pumped Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> bounce power amplifier.

articleTitle: InGaAs/InP subwavelength grating filters for the mid-infrared
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate subwavelength resonant grating mirrors made from III-V semiconductor materials for the mid-infrared. We achieved a resonance wavelength at ~3μm which agrees very well with simulated data, and measured a spectral width of ~30nm.

articleTitle: Interaction of a single trapped ion with heralded single photons
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate single trapped ion-single photon interaction by the detection of quantum jumps, strongly correlated with the detection of the quantum-correlated heralding photon. This is a step towards controlling single-photon absorption and transferring photon-to-atom entanglement.

articleTitle: Photodarkening resistant Yb/Ce/Al silica 980 nm fiberlaser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A linearly polarized fiber laser emitting at 979 nm with an output power of 2 W is presented. By using a photodarkening-resistant Yb/Ce/Al-codoped silica fiber, degradation-free operation is achieved over several hours.

articleTitle: Performance scaling of ultrabroadband OPCPA with conformal pulse profiles
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Employing closed-form solutions derived for the pump-depletion regime of parametric amplification, we show that application of conformal profile theory to ultrabroadband OPCPA can extend its efficiency, bandwidth, and peak-power capabilities by several hundred percent.

articleTitle: High energy density science with high peak power light sources
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High energy density (HED) science is a growing sub-field of plasma and condensed matter physics. I will examine how recent technological developments in high peak power, petawatt-class lasers and x-ray FELs have impacted research in HED physics.

articleTitle: High speed true random number generation using chaotic light
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using chaotic light, we propose a new method for true random number generation, which is promising, high speed, convenient and low cost. A prototype has been built up with a generation rate of 192 Mbits/s.

articleTitle: Dual-wavelength mode-locked Yb∶YAG ceramic laser in single cavity
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated a 380 fs dual-wavelength independently mode-locked Yb:YAG ceramic laser at 1033.6 and 1047.6 nm. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first dual-wavelength mode locking achieved in Yb-doped solid-state lasers.

articleTitle: Quantum teleportation and quantum information processing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Teleportation-based quantum information processing is reviewed.

articleTitle: Manipulation of form birefringence in isotropic material
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Form-birefringent nanostructure composed of the self-organized oxygen defects can be created by light pulses with a width of 70 fs. Such rewritable and directionally controllable nanostructures have evolved by lowering threshold for defect formation.

articleTitle: 30 Gb/s direct modulation of holey VCSELs with thermoelectric cooling
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a 25 Gb/s error-free operation of a directly modulated holey VCSEL, and the data rate can be extended to above 30 Gb/s when the VCSEL substrate temperature is stabilized by a thermoelectric cooler.

articleTitle: Observation of optical precursors with electromagnetically induced transparency
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We generate Sommerfeld-Brillouin precursors from a square-modulated laser pulse through a cold atomic ensemble with electromagnetically induced transparency. At a high optical depth, the precursor forerunner is clearly separated from the delayed main pulse.

articleTitle: Radiative decay engineering with hyperbolic metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the decrease in the spontaneous emission lifetime of dye molecules due to the enhanced photonic density of states (PDOS) of a hyperbolic metamaterial (HMM), opening the route to PDOS engineered HMM devices.

articleTitle: Domain inversion with 0.8µm period by Using a conductive AFM tip and its application to QPM-SHG devices
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this paper, we demonstrate a newly developed domain inversion technique using the improved AFM which is possible to scan a wide area through a conductive AFM tip, and also a thin LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> substrate called “a terrace substrate” using a dicing saw. Fine domain inversion period with less than 0.8μm is obtained. A novel SHG blue laser is also demonstrated using the terrace substrate and the extended AFM domain inversion technique.

articleTitle: Spectrally wide and high-power Er-Yb fiber amplifier for 40 Gb/s telecommunications applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A multimode Erbium-Ytterbium doped fiber can be advantageously used for DWDM channel amplification over an extended spectral band with respect to conventional designs. Bit error ratio at 40 Gb/s, gain and noise figure are provided.

articleTitle: Two-wave mixing in Nd3+ and Yb3+ doped laser materials
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A complete model of two-wave mixing in pumped Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> and Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> laser materials in presence of athermal refractive index grating is presented and compared with experimental results obtained in Nd:YAG. Application to beam-combining is investigated.

articleTitle: High-speed hand-held wide aperture time-domain terahertz imaging system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A hand-held, high-speed time-domain terahertz (TD-THz) reflection line-scanner for non-destructive examination (NDE) is described. The imager scans a line 150 mm wide and collects a TD-THz cross-sectional “B-scan” of the sub-surface structure at rates up to 15 Hz. By rolling the scanner over a surface, a 2D “C-Scan” image can be stitched together from the individual lines at a rate of 25-200 mm/s. The system >15 times faster than gantry imagers. The case is 8.7 in. wide, 12.5 in. long, and 7.9 in. high. The weight is approximately 7 lbs.

articleTitle: Incident-power-dependent extinction ratio of electroabsorption modulator integrated with distributed feedback lasers: Theory and experiment
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Incident-power-dependent extinction ratio of electroabsorption modulators is shown and theoretically investigated by using microscopic theory combined with heat-flux calculation. The phenomenon stems from voltage-dependent temperature rise and the calculated results agree well with the experiment.

articleTitle: Electrically tunable thermal-infrared metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that the resonance of a thermal-infrared metamaterial on a semiconductor substrate can be shifted by the substrate doping. We further study the electrical tuning of metamaterial resonance via finite integral time-domain simulation.

articleTitle: Ultra-high Q crystalline microresonators for cavity optomechanics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on optomechanical coupling in crystalline whispering-gallery-mode resonators possessing ultra-high optical (> 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sup>) and mechanical (> 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>) Q-factors. Microdiscs reveal high frequency mechanical radial modes (> 20 MHz) and unprecedented sideband factors (> 100).

articleTitle: From carrier dynamics inside fused silica to control of multiphoton-avalanche ionization for laser machining
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using pump-probe measurements, we characterize carrier decay time inside fused silica and measure deeply bound self-trapped excitons. With pump-probe delay, we also control free carrier injection and the subsequent avalanche process for laser machining applications.

PACS Terms: 320.7130 Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Refractive index sensing using slow light in photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a compact integrated refractive index sensor using slow light in photonic crystal waveguides (PCWs). The PCWs are used in a Mach-Zahnder interferometer configuration and operated close to the edge of the mode-gap to achieve a compact design and high sensitivity.

articleTitle: Second order coherence of parametric light determined by two photon absorption in a semiconductor
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use a modified Hanbury Brown-Twiss set-up based on two-photon absorption to study second-order coherence of parametric fluorescence at the femtosecond scale. Characterizations are made in the degenerate case and far away degeneracy.

articleTitle: Single AWG based clock extraction from WDM NRZDPSK signals with mixed bit-rates
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A simple and flexible simultaneous clock extraction for WDM NRZ-DPSK signals with mixed bit-rates from 10-to-40Gb/s is proposed and demonstrated using a single commercial AWG. Clock recovery can be easily achieved from the pre-processed signals.

articleTitle: Bismuth-doped fiber integrated ring laser mode-locked with a nanotube-based saturable absorber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate passive mode-locking of a bismuth-doped fiber laser using a single-wall nanotube-based saturable absorber. Stable operation in the all-normal dispersion and average soliton regime is obtained, with an all-fiber integrated format.

articleTitle: Observation of amplified stimulated terahertz emission in optically pumped epitaxial graphene heterostructures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally observed the fast relaxation and relatively slow recombination dynamics of photogenerated electrons/holes in an epitaxial graphene-on-Si heterostructure. The result is interpreted as an amplified stimulated THz emission and well supports the occurrence of negative dynamic conductivity in the terahertz spectral ranges.

articleTitle: Narrow linewidth DBR-RW lasers emitting near 1064 nm
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the realization of narrow linewidth high power distributed bragg reflector (DBR) lasers. For devices with a front facet reflectivity R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub> = 30% we obtain a minimum intrinsic linewidth of 12 kHz and a total linewidth of 147 kHz at an output power of 130 mW (measurement time = 100 μs). For R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub> = 1% we report an an intrinsic linewidth of less than 100 kHz and a total linewidth of 1202 kHz at an output power of 1 W.

articleTitle: A Raman-type optical frequency comb adiabatically generated in an enhancement cavity
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate efficient generation of a Raman-type optical-frequency-comb by employing adiabatic-Raman-excitation in an enhancement cavity. A broad frequency-comb spanning over 130-THz is realized with an excitation-power reduction exceeding three-orders of magnitude compared with a single-pass-configuration.

articleTitle: GaSb-based semiconductor disk lasers for the 2 – 3 µm wavelength range: Versatile lasers for high-power and narrow linewidth emission
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Highly efficient GaSb-based semiconductor-disk-lasers in the 1.9-2.8 μm range have been fabricated. They reach output powers >3W in CW-operation at room temperature . By using intracavity filters, single-frequency emission with a linewidth below 2.3 MHz was achieved.

articleTitle: Ultrastable atomic force microscopy using laser-based, active noise cancelation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We achieved a 100-fold improvement in tip-sample stability by stabilizing the tip and the sample in 3D using laser light back-scattered off the apex of an AFM tip and a reference mark in the sample.

articleTitle: Fiber-based frequency comb with mHz relative linewidth carrier-envelope-offset frequency
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We constructed a low-noise fiber frequency comb that provides a narrowed linewidth of less than 1.9 mHz by suppressing the random phase noise caused by the nonlinear self-phase-modulation and amplified-spontaneous-emission inside the Er-doped fiber amplifier.

articleTitle: OSNR monitoring using two fibre interferometers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Two Michelson fibre interferomters were used to measure the in-band OSNR of a noisy signal between 5 and 30 dB within ±0.5 dB without prior knowledge of the noise-free extinction ratio of the signal.

articleTitle: Magneto-optical cavity quantum electrodynamics effects in quantum dot micropillar systems
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on magneto-optical control of quantum dot micropillar systems in the strong coupling regime. Magneto-optical resonance tuning, magnetic field control of the oscillator strength and spin cQED-effects will be presented.

articleTitle: A tunnel injection quantum dot comb laser with wideband emission spectra and temperature stability
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A quantum dot comb laser with a 102 nm broad spectrum of emission and high temperature stability is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Carrier capture studies in InGaAs quantum posts
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The capture dynamics of photogenerated carriers in InGaAs quantum posts (QPs) are investigated. We demonstrate that QPs efficiently capture carriers from the surrounding host material within a few picoseconds, making them attractive for device applications.

articleTitle: Holographic patterning of semiconductor CdSe quantum dots in polymer for constructing photonic lattice structures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate holographic patterning of semiconductor CdSe quantum dots in photo-polymerizable monomer films for constructing cm-size transmission volume Bragg grating structures. Fluorescence and confocal Raman imaging confirm holographic assembly of CdSe quantum dots in the formed polymer. We observe the diffraction efficiency near 100% from the grating structure in the green with 0.34 vol.% CdSe quantum dots dispersed in multifunctional acrylate.

articleTitle: Time-domain modeling of metal-dielectric nanostructures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study second-order complex Padé approximants that give a systematic approach to time-domain modeling of dispersive dielectric functions including the classical Drude, Lorentz, Sellmeier and the critical points models. The approach is utilized to compare the frequency domain with time-domain simulations of local optical responses and transmission-reflection spectra for plasmonic nanostructures. Comparisons are made using auxiliary differential equations, recursive and piecewise linear recursive convolution formulations embedded in finite-difference, finite-volume, and finite-element time-domain solvers.

articleTitle: Aperiodic quasi-phase-matched gratings for efficient and broadband optical parametric chirped pulse amplification
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical parametric amplifiers using aperiodic quasi-phase-matched gratings offer wide amplification bandwidths and high efficiencies. Parasitic conversion processes and spatiotemporal distortions occur, and we discuss these effects and how they can be suppressed by grating design.

articleTitle: Particle size limits of optical trapping and deflection for sorting using diode laser bars
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We model and examine advantages and limitations of diode laser bar trapping for manipulating particles greater than 100 μm in diameter. This method overcomes limitations that prevent conventional point traps from effectively directing large particles.

articleTitle: The dark exciton in a quantum dot- a novel bright qubit with very long coherence time
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time that the quantum dot confined dark exciton is a natural, coherent and long-lived qubit. We optically “write” its spin state and successfully “read” its subsequent coherent evolution.

articleTitle: Photonic power delivery
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photonic Power delivery or “Power-over-fiber” is an emerging technology for powering without the need for electrical wiring. Suitable to power data communication devices, this proven technology could now enter FTTH and eliminate costly copper installations.

articleTitle: Novel concept of timing jitter reduction of a passively Q-switched microchip lasers using self-injection seeding
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an efficient and simple technique for reduction of timing jitter in passively Q-switched microchip-laser using self-injection seeding using an optical-fiber as a delay-line and reduce the jitter by several orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: Second harmonic generation from exfoliated graphitic films
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical SHG is observed from graphene, and few-layer graphite on an oxidized (001)Si substrate. The SHG signal from graphene is rotationally isotropic but shows 3-fold anisotropy from bi-layer graphene and graphite.

articleTitle: Ultrafast dual-band optical switching device with a negative-index metamaterial
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an ultrafast (600 fs) dual-band optical switching device using a negative-index metamaterial. A large switching ratio is achieved at both the fundamental (70%) and higher order coupling bands (20%) of the negative-index resonance.

articleTitle: Nonlinear phase contrast enhancement
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a simple method to detect small phase steps using propagation in Kerr media. In experiments, nonlinear diffraction in acetone produced high contrast signals for a π/80 phase mask.

PACS Terms: (190.1900) Diagnostic applications of nonlinear optics, devices

articleTitle: Single-molecule approaches for superresolution imaging, trapping, and nanophotonics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Single fluorescent molecules provide useful nanometer-sized absorbers and sources of light, which enable superresolution imaging, trapping, and nanometer-scale probing of optical fields in nanophotonic structures. Fundamentals of these effects will be described.

articleTitle: Hybrid solid/gas blue-green multiterawatt femtosecond laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The paper presents a visible (475 nm) multiterawatt femtosecond laser chain based on solid/gas technology, and composed of a Ti:Sapphire oscillator, an Optical Parametric Chirped Pulse Amplifier, a frequency converter, and a high-power XeF(C-A) amplifier.

articleTitle: Resonance enhanced large third order nonlinear optical response in slow light InGaP photonic-crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a large third order nonlinear response in an InGaP photonic crystal waveguide. The nonlinearity is enhanced by a resonance effect due to the waveguide end facet reflectivities and the large group index.

articleTitle: Reaction, diffusion and dissociation of excitons on carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photoexcitation of carbon nanotubes generates excitons which decay by exciton-exciton annihilation at sufficient density. We examine this decay under conditions of one, few and many excitons per nanotube. A classic 1D reaction-diffusion behaviour is observed, with decay limited by diffusion for t>3ps and by reaction for t<;3ps. At high densities the exciton population saturates, and by analysis of the rate equations we show that this is consistent with dissociation of excitons when their spacing is 1.3nm, close to the exciton length.

articleTitle: Terahertz microfluidic sensor based on a parallel-plate waveguide resonant cavity
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We fabricate a terahertz resonator suitable for microfluidic sensing by machining a groove into one plate of a parallel-plate-waveguide. We demonstrate a refractive-index sensitivity of 3.7 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> nm/refractive-index-unit, the highest ever reported in any frequency range.

articleTitle: Forward and 90-degree light scattering measurements in optofluidic flow cytometer
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A microfluidic flow cytometer for three-parameter light scatter measurements is demonstrated to distinguish between 4 sizes of polystyrene beads from 5-15 ∝ m. Light blocking and guiding elements are employed in this compact, integrated microfluidic chip.

articleTitle: Influence of surfactant on shape and oxidation of copper nanoparticles
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Influence of surfactant on shape and oxidation of copper nanoparticles synthesized by pulsed laser ablation in aqueous medium has been studied. The ablation of copper is done by using focused output of 1064 nm of pulsed Nd:YAG laser in 1mM concentration of CTAB and SDS. It is found that the nanostructures synthesized in CTAB have elongated shape having size range of 40 - 60 nm, while that of in SDS have ring shaped geometry with inner diameter in the range of 15-25 nm. CTAB induces more oxidation as compared to SDS with aging and causes conversion of Cu into Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O.

articleTitle: Nitinol machining rate dependence on pulse duration in the ultrafast laser regime
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We quantify machining rate dependence on pulse duration for Nitinol shape memory alloy near the critical pulse duration for athermal ablation. At fluence of 17 J/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, we show critical pulse duration is near 2.5 ps.

articleTitle: Phase noise measurement of mode locked lasers using guided wave PPKTP balanced cross correlators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Channel waveguides in PPKTP are used to demonstrate a guided wave balanced cross correlator in the telecom band. The device is used to measure the relative timing jitter between two 200 MHz fiber lasers.

articleTitle: Multi-mode continuous wave terahertz systems - quasi time domain spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present broadband terahertz spectroscopy systems based on continuous wave multi-mode laser diodes. By using commercial lasers with equidistant mode spacing we obtain signals similar to that of conventional time domain spectrometers.

articleTitle: Fiber laser based optical frequency comb system using fiber chirped pulse amplification technique
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Er-doped fiber laser optical frequency comb using fiber chirped pulse amplification technique was developed and f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ceo</sub> was locked stably. The longitudinal modes in generated supercontiuum were also examined by direct observation of beat signals.

articleTitle: CD insensitive PMD monitoring by using FBG notch filter in 57-Gbit/s D8PSK and 38-Gbit/s DQPSK systems
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A CD insensitive PMD monitoring scheme based on measuring RF power is demonstrated experimentally. By using a narrow band FBG notch filter, one of sideband is filtered out and the corresponding RF power can be used as CD insensitive PMD monitoring signal. It is experimentally shown that the proposed method is efficient on measuring the DGD values in 57-Gbit/s D8PSK and 38-Gbit/s DQPSK systems.

articleTitle: Asynchronous rational harmonic mode-locked Er-doped fiber soliton laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An asynchronous rational harmonic mode-locked fiber laser (ARHML) is demonstrated experimentally. Through the asynchronous mode-locking mechanism, the output pulse train has a wider optical spectrum and very uniform amplitudes with the un-wanted harmonic frequency components highly suppressed.

articleTitle: Ablation dynamics in burst-train femtosecond laser machining of high aspect ratio holes in glass
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Nanosecond time dynamics of laser generated filaments, plasma, and plume are followed in the high repetition rate domain of heat accumulation effects for excising deep high aspect ratio holes in glasses.

articleTitle: Plastic optical fiber with VCSEL sources: A statistical evaluation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first statistical evaluation of the calculated effective modal bandwidth and 10Gb/s ISI penalty of graded-index perfluorinated plastic optical fiber under VCSEL illumination, utilizing high temporal-resolution differential modal delay measurements.

articleTitle: Energy footprint and opportunities of ICT networks
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The access network currently dominates energy consumption, which has otherwise been contained benefiting by IC and optical advancements, despite the multi-year > 50% CAGR of traffic. Further network technology, architectural, and application opportunities exist.

articleTitle: InGaAs QW nanopillar light emitting diodes monolithically grown on a Si substrate
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Room-temperature operation of InGaAs/GaAs QW nanopillar light emitting diodes grown on a (111) Si substrate by low temperature MOCVD (400°C) and fabricated using conventional lithography and processing techniques are reported for the first time.

articleTitle: All-fiber carbon nanotube based mode-locked laser system for generation of stable fs frequency combs
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a simplified all-fiber octave spanning femtosecond laser system based on a tapered fiber carbon nanotube saturable absorber capable of generating a stabilized frequency comb structure.

articleTitle: Spatial resolution limitation by Rayleigh scattering-induced noise in Brillouin optical correlation-domain reflectometry
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We theoretically and experimentally show that the modulation amplitude of the laser frequency determining the spatial resolution of Brillouin optical correlation-domain reflectometry can exceed a half of the Brillouin frequency shift, which was the conventional limitation due to the Rayleigh scattering-induced noise.

articleTitle: Nonlinear phase-shift compensation by a nonlinear amplifying loop mirror
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The nonlinear amplifying loop mirror as a nonlinear phase-shift compensator for multilevel phase-encoded optical signals is considered. Simulations of a 20 Gb/s DQPSK transmission system showed a significant BER improvement for post-compensation.

articleTitle: Contrast measurements of kilojoule laser pulses at the OMEGA EP laser facility
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The OMEGA EP intensity contrast has been measured to be approximately 6 decades for kilojoule 10-ps pulses. The OPCPA front end is the primary source of the measured incoherent pedestal.

articleTitle: Cavity-optomechanics with microresonators at Helium-3 temperatures
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the optical and mechanical properties of toroidal optomechanical resonators thermalized to Helium-3 (600 mK) temperatures. Dramatic improvements of mechanical quality factors are reported and evidence for direct phonon absorption is presented.

articleTitle: Characterization of dynamic nonlinear absorption of carbon nanotube saturable absorber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Dynamic nonlinear absorption of composite-type single-wall carbon nanotube saturable absorbers is characterized using both femtosecond and picosecond pump pulses. Results are compared with numerical simulations based on two commonly used saturable absorber models.

articleTitle: Cavity enhanced on-chip spectrometer with sub-nm resolution
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel on-chip spectrometer device using combined functionalities of a micro-ring resonator and a planar diffraction grating is proposed and demonstrated. The spectrometer has a 2 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> footprint and exhibits 100 channels each with 0.05 nm FWHM.

articleTitle: Linewidth optimization of Fourier domain mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We theoretically and experimentally investigate the instantaneous linewidth of Fourier domain mode-locked lasers, yielding good agreement. Based on simulations, strategies are discussed to drastically reduce the laser linewidth.

articleTitle: Secure optical communications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe the state of physics-based secure optical communication systems. Practical issues associated with both key generation and high-speed physical-layer secure data transmissions are discussed.

articleTitle: Multiple-access optical chaos-based communications using optoelectronic systems
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this paper, we demonstrate the applicability of the OFDM multiple-access technique to optical chaos-based communications. We show that using an optoelectronic oscillator with multiple nonlinear delayed feedback loops, it is possible to transmit simultaneously multiple data streams with better spectral efficiency than a single stream.

articleTitle: Generation of spatiotemporal Bessel-Gauss beams
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Spatiotemporal Bessel-Gauss beams have been generated with a zero-dispersion pulse shaper that uses a reflective mask of annular shape. Such a setup acts as spacetime axicon.

articleTitle: A simple implementation of spectral shearing interferometry for self-referenced amplitude and phase characterization of optical frequency comb sources
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a simple scheme which uses only an intensity modulator and an OSA to achieve low-power (~100nW, 10aJ/pulse at 10GHz), self-referenced, amplitude and phase characterization of high repetition rate optical frequency comb sources.

articleTitle: Optimizing pump partial coherence for efficient modulation instability and supercontinuum generation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We consider the effect of variable pump source partial coherence on the gain of modulation instability and the subsequent efficiency of soliton formation and supercontinuum generation. Optimal regimes for continuous-wave supercontinuum generation are discussed.

articleTitle: Amplification of femtosecond pulses in large mode area photonic bandgap Bragg fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate amplification of femtosecond pulses in large mode area singlemode Yb-doped photonic bandgap Bragg fibers. 260 fs 5 μJ pulses are obtained at 100 kHz repetition rate (1 W of average power).

articleTitle: Single-mode Quantum Cascade lasers with a folded Fabry-Perot resonator waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate single mode operation of Quantum Cascade lasers employing a folded Fabry-Perot resonator waveguide design. Single mode emission is achieved with ~20dB side mode suppression up to ~400mA above threshold current in pulsed operation.

articleTitle: All-fiber all-normal dispersion laser with an in-fiber Lyot filter
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose use of a short PM-fiber section as birefringent medium to construct an all-fiber Lyot filter, with bandwidth adjustable through the PM-fiber length. An all-fiber all-normal-dispersion laser is demonstrated using standard components only.

articleTitle: Laser assisted microstructuring of amorphous silicon for microelectronics
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present experimental and theoretical work on excimer laser microstructuring of hydrogenated amorphous silicon (a-Si:H) films on molybdenum coated glass substrates, in the form of sharp and conical poly-Si spikes, for electron field emission applications.

articleTitle: Vernier frequency sampling - a new approach for broadband high-resolution spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a novel method for broadband spectroscopy. Due to the entanglement of two cavities within an optical parametric oscillator, frequency resolution and span are widely adjustable. The technique is applied to CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> remote sensing.

articleTitle: Microwave photonic filter based on optical comb and line-by-line optical pulse shaping
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate microwave photonic filters based on optical combs with large number of taps and more than 30-dB sidelobe suppression. We program and tune the filter's bandpass by utilizing line-by-line pulse shaping and optical delay.

articleTitle: Polarization dependent formalism of interferometric structures describing DPSK and DQPSK receivers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe a polarization dependent formalism for DPSK and DQPSK receivers and show that the combined effect of PDL and PDFS cannot be decoupled making the birefringence axes non-orthogonal and independent of PDL axes.

articleTitle: Mixed dimer double resonance substrates for surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Surface enhanced Raman spectroscopy is performed on mixed dimers, consisting of pairs of gold nanoparticles with different shapes and plasmon frequencies. These are termed double resonance substrates. The results are compared to double dimer geometry.

articleTitle: All-optical regenerative wavelength conversion based on a modified delayed interference signal wavelength converter
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: All-optical regenerative wavelength converter is proposed and demonstrated based on the delayed interference signal wavelength converter followed by a SOA. Signal quality can be improved by the regenerative amplification of the SOA.

articleTitle: All-optical quantization using a chalcogenide waveguide: Towards on-chip ultrahigh-bandwidth analog-to-digital conversion
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate 8-level all-optical quantization by broadening the pulse spectrum in a chalcogenide (As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>) waveguide, for 8 different power levels, and subsequently slicing the measured spectrum using an array of filters.

articleTitle: Highly sensitive strain and bending sensor based on a fiber Mach-Zehnder interferometer in photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose highly sensitive strain and bending sensor with very low temperature sensitivity based on in line Mach-Zehnder Interferometer in solid core large mode area photonic crystal fiber and experimentally investigated its novel characteristics.

articleTitle: Generation of energetic femtosecond green pulses based on an OPCPA - SFG scheme
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By applying the techniques of achromatic phase matching and chirp assisted group velocity matching, we demonstrate a broadband, high-contrast sum-frequency generation scheme between the signal and idler output of a high-power optical chirped pulse amplifier.

articleTitle: 8-channel 20 Gb/s non-return-to-zero signal regeneration
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate multi-channel NRZ signal regeneration with NRZ-RZ-NRZ regenerative format conversion, using a phase-modulator and two fiber MZIs. Q improvements for eight 20Gb/s channels and BER for two representative channels demonstrate regeneration is achieved simultaneously.

articleTitle: New approach to achieving a carrier-envelope phase-locked frequency comb with 25-GHz mode spacing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose an approach to achieving a carrier-envelope phase-locked frequency comb with 25-GHz mode spacing at 1.5 μm. We demonstrate octave-spanning supercontinuum generation with the widest mode spacing ever achieved using a CW laser diode.

articleTitle: Nonlinear plasmonics: From second-harmonic generation to spatial solitons
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study two major nonlinear effects in plasmonic structures: second-harmonic generation in metal-insulator-metal waveguides and self-focusing of plasmons propagating along an interface between metal and Kerr-type nonlinear dielectric with the formation of spatial plasmon-polariton solitons.

articleTitle: Chip-based optical interactions with Rubidium vapor
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate tightly confined interactions with Rb atoms on a chip of silicon nitride nanowires. Optical depths of 2 are observed, and absorption spectroscopy reveals strong effects of transit-time broadening and Van der Waals shifts.

articleTitle: Double-pass single stage short length Yb-doped rod type fibre chirped pulse amplifier system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this contribution, we report the generation of high energy, high temporal quality, ultrashort pulses from a single stage double-pass short length Ytterbium-doped rod type fibre chirped pulse amplification setup. The fibre used as gain medium is a 95-cm long rod type microstructured fibre with a 80 μm core diameter and 200 μm pump cladding diameter. The fiber amplifier is seeded by 3 nJ pulses stretched to 550 ps at a pulse repetition rate of 100 kHz. We demonstrate amplification and compression up to 200 μJ energy in 240 fs with good temporal quality leading to ~ 750 MW peak power.

articleTitle: Ytterbium doped nano-crystalline optical fiber for reduced photodarkening
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report suppression of photodarkening in Yb-doped nano-crystalline fibers in silica host. The photodarkening induced loss reduced by 20 times compared to Yb-doped aluminosilicate fibers. The laser efficiency of the nano-crystalline fiber was 79%.

articleTitle: Optical frequency-tunable Cs atomic clock with a mode-hop-free fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have successfully realized an optical frequency tunable Cs atomic clock with a mode-hop-free fiber laser. The optical frequency of the 9.1926 GHz clock was continuously tuned over 1 GHz without changing the clock frequency.

articleTitle: Towards fast femtosecond laser micromachining of glass, effect of deposited energy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the effect of deposited energy for micro-machining of fused silica using femtosecond laser irradiation followed by chemical etching.

articleTitle: An integrated optofluidic Bragg grating device to measure the dynamic composition of a fluid system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Strong transitional mixing effects were observed by a planar Bragg grating sensor within a microfluidic system. This property was used to develop an integrated optofluidic sensor for detection of the composition of mixed solvent systems.

articleTitle: Silicon RF MEMS based optical modulator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This paper reports on the co-fabrication of photonic whispering gallery mode disk resonators and RF MEMS radial contour mode resonators on the same SOI substrate. By mechanically coupling the MEMS and photonic resonators, we have demonstrated a silicon RF MEMS based optical modulator which can modulate light with wavelength 1560 nm at 288 MHz.

articleTitle: High dynamic range laser dispersion spectroscopy of saturated absorption lines
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A spectroscopic detection of molecular dispersion based on frequency-chirped laser is presented. Unlike non-linear direct absorption methods yielding line saturation, this method provides linear signal response and accuracy over a wide range of sample concentrations.

articleTitle: Challenges in design and testing of coherent receivers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Since coherent receivers are nearing mass production for communication, it is crucial to consider the approaches to their design and evaluation, with emphasis on testing for optical front end calibration and production pass/fail type testing.

articleTitle: Recent progress on terahertz quantum-cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Terahertz quantum-cascade lasers are based on intersubband optical transitions that could be “engineered”. Operation above 160 K has been demonstrated for frequencies ranging from 1.8-4.4 THz. This talk reviews their recent progress, design aspects and future challenges.

articleTitle: Phase-contrast CARS spectroscopy with rapid phase modulation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a novel method of phase-contrast CARS spectroscopy by using an optical bandpass filter and a mechanical modulator instead of a 4f pulse shaper used in previous studies. Our system has several advantages over the conventional one; the simplicity of the setup, a larger throughput, and the higher data rate of measurements. We use the known vibrational frequencies of chloroform to verify the efficacy of this method.

articleTitle: Finite time domain studies of plasmonic nano-structures across wide frequency ranges
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present analytic models describing the optical properties of the noble metals at frequencies from .5-7eV. With a single finite difference time domain calculation, these models enable a complete spectral description of plasmonic nano-structure properties.

articleTitle: Direct modulation and wavelength stabilization of high power slab-coupled optical waveguide lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A slab-coupled optical waveguide laser is wavelength stabilized with a fiber Bragg grating and characterized under a narrow pulse high repetition rate direct modulation scheme suitable for efficient pulse position modulation format optical communication systems.

articleTitle: Photonic analogue of Zitterbewegung and Klein tunneling in optical superlattices
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical analogues of Klein tunneling and Zitterbewegung for relativistic Dirac electrons are proposed for spatial beam propagation in binary waveguide superlattices.

articleTitle: Atmospheric transmission testing using a portable, tunable, high power thulium fiber laser system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A narrow linewidth thulium fiber laser is tuned from 1945 – 2090 nm to investigate atmospheric transmission at 1 km. Results confirm simulations with high transmission >2025 nm and strong atmospheric absorption <1960 nm.

articleTitle: Ultrafast integrated optical switching based on the protein bacteriorhodopsin
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The feasibility of a picosecond photonic switch based on light-induced reaction of the chromoprotein bacteriorhodopsin has been experimentally studied. A possible future utilization of this switch could support an all-optical data transfer at Tbit/s rate.

articleTitle: Narrow beam radiation from a CMOS compatible leaky wave optical antenna
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: CMOS compatible leaky wave optical antennas are proposed and analyzed for electronically controlled radiation pattern generation. Very directive far field radiation pattern (>15dB) is generated from a Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> leaky wave antenna with silicon periodic perturbations.

articleTitle: Fibers for next generation high spectral efficiency undersea cable systems
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The capacity demands for future undersea cable networks will push the industry to WDM spectral efficiencies in excess of 1-B/s/Hz. This will require significant progress in optical fibers and signal processing.

articleTitle: High-performance sensing with plasmonic nanorod metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an optical sensor based on plasmonic nanorod metamaterials. The sensor operates similar to well-established surface plasmon polariton sensors, but offers order-of-magnitude improvement over existing technology. Optical and biological applications are discussed.

articleTitle: Sub-50 fs time-domain spectroscopy using high-speed ASOPS
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an ultrafast time-domain spectrometer based on high-speed asynchronous optical sampling. A time resolution of 45-fs is obtained at kilohertz scan rates over a 1 ns time-delay window without mechanical moving parts.

articleTitle: Widely-tunable femtosecond operation of Cr:LiSAF lasers using broadband saturable Bragg reflectors
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe a low-cost diode-pumped Cr:LiSAF laser, mode-locked using a broadband saturable Bragg reflector. The laser produces continuously tunable sub-200-fs pulses from 800 nm to 905 nm.

articleTitle: Fabrication of high Q microdisk resonators using thermal nanoimprint lithography
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the fabrication of high Q microdisk resonators on an SOI platform using thermal nanoimprint lithography. The achieved Q factor is 60000 for 2 μm radius disks. Arrays of 32 resonators show uniform spectral response.

articleTitle: Picosecond synchronously pumped ZnGeP2 optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the continuous mode-locked operation of a picosecond, singly-resonant, synchronously-pumped optical parametric oscillator (SPOPO) based on ZGP. The ZGP SPOPO emits in the 4-6 μm range with signal power higher than 800 mW.

articleTitle: Increased field of view via nonlinear digital holography
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: All imaging systems have limitations to their field of view. Here, we experimentally demonstrate that wave mixing due to spatial nonlinearity can increase this parameter.

articleTitle: Optically controlled variable optical buffer for data packet storage in optical packet switching networks
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel solution for all optical packets buffering is proposed. Variable delays are performed by exploiting a fiber based re-circulating loop configuration. XGM in SOAs allows optical controlling of the packets storage time.

articleTitle: 25 W pico-second vortex output from a mixed-vanadate master laser and a Yb-doped fiber power amplifier
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A high-power pico-second vortex output from a mixed-vanadate master laser and a Yb-doped fiber amplifier system was demonstrated. An output power of 25.3 W was achieved, corresponding to a peak power of 37.4 kW.

articleTitle: Observation of four-wave mixing conversion efficiency and bandwidth in silicon photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present observations of slow-light enhanced four-wave mixing in silicon photonic crystal waveguides (11-dB enhancement in idler conversion efficiency), with a corresponding reduction in conversion bandwidth due to increased group velocity dispersion.

articleTitle: Time-frequency real-time imaging of ultrashort laser pulses with a single echelon mirror
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Time-frequency two-dimensional imaging of ultrashort laser pulses from 0.15 to 6 ps pulse duration has been successfully demonstrated in real-time, using a new autocorrelation scheme with a single echelon mirror.

articleTitle: Subwavelength silicon hybrid plasmonic waveguides and components
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Subwavelength hybrid plasmonic waveguides, s-bends and power splitters are demonstrated on an SOI platform. A long plasmonic waveguide propagation length of 40μm and highly efficient coupling to Si photonic waveguides were achieved using simple tapers.

articleTitle: Sensitive phonon detection in a spiderweb optomechanical resonator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report position-squared coupling six orders of magnitude larger than previously demonstrated, allowing measurement of as few as 652 phonons and presenting a practical route toward probing of single-phonon jumps and characterization of phonon statistics.

articleTitle: All-normal dispersion photonic crystal fiber for coherent supercontinuum generation
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe supercontinuum generation in a short photonic crystal fiber with all-normal group velocity dispersion. We observe a 200 nm broad self phase modulation spectrum, which is expected to have high temporal coherence.

articleTitle: Multiphoton modulation microscopy for high-speed deep biological imaging
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a novel line scanning multiphoton microscope with a single element detector, potentially allowing fast imaging deep into scattering tissue. Multiphoton biological imaging of ex vivo rat tendon using this technique is presented.

articleTitle: Adaptive optics for two-photon and harmonic generation microscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Specimen-induced aberrations frequently affect image quality in high-resolution microscopes. We apply adaptive optics to correct aberrations in two-photon fluorescence, and second and third harmonic microscopes. In particular, this is applied to imaging of mouse embryos.

articleTitle: Phase retrieval and the measurement of the complete spatiotemporal electric field of ultrashort pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The technique, SEA TADPOLE, measures the complete spatiotemporal intensity and phase of arbitrary ultrashort pulses, but device instability blurs the spatial component of the phase. We show that a simple phase-retrieval algorithm recovers it.

articleTitle: Widely tunable external cavity interband cascade laser for spectroscopic applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We performed spectroscopy of methane using a broadly tunable external cavity interband cascade laser (EC-ICL). A miniaturized EC-ICL design for field applications, with improved anti-reflection and high-reflection coatings and new EC tuning mechanism, is presented.

articleTitle: Towards the implementation of an organic inorganic laser for next generation optical applications
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Authors report simulations and experimental results on the engineering of a small molecule-on-silica based waveguide grating implementation for next generation optical lasing applications.

articleTitle: Uniformity of concentration factor and back focal length in molded polymer microlens arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An array of polymer microlenses, made of 32×32 individual elements spaced by a 50-∝m pitch, is used in connection to an array of 32×32 6-∝m diameter SPADs (Single Photon Avalanche Detector), with the aim of mitigating the loss in sensitivity due to the area fill-factor. The lens array is fabricated by polymer casting in a photoresist replica mold. Results about repeatability of concentration factor and back focal length are reported. At C= 35 and a focal length F=40 ∝m, the spread of concentration is <; 6%, and that of BFL is <;0.5 ∝m.

articleTitle: Integrated arrayed waveguide grating spectrometer for on-chip optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A silicon oxynitride based arrayed waveguide grating spectrometer was designed for on-chip spectral-domain optical coherence tomography systems. Transmission measurement results are promising for miniaturizing the current optical coherence tomography systems through integrated optics.

articleTitle: All-fiber, versatile picosecond time-lens light source and its application to Cerenkov radiation generation in higher order mode fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an all-fiber, 2-ps, 1063-nm source using time-lens compression of a continuous-wave laser, with variable repetition rates, pulse sequence, and alternating pulse amplitude. We demonstrate Cerenkov radiation in a higher-order-mode fiber using the source.

articleTitle: Telecom-band single photon switch
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a high-speed all-optical switch for use in quantum information processing. The demonstrated implementation is capable of operating on 1310-nm single photons. Its performance is characterized using polarization-entangled photon pairs.

articleTitle: Fully reconfigurable silicon photonic interleaver
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a fully reconfigurable 125 GHz flat passband silicon photonic interleaver with a box-like spectral response and 20 dB extinction ratio.

articleTitle: Optically injected quantum dash lasers at 1550nm employed as highly tunable photonic oscillators
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Experimental investigation of an optically-injected quantum-dash laser's operational map shows large regions of period-one operation. The enhanced and undamped relaxation oscillations of the period-one state are discussed as a building block for tunable photonic oscillators.

articleTitle: High performance add-drop filter tunable over large spectral range
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an error-free add-drop filter for a 10 Gbps signal, tunable over 16 nm. The structure consists of a series of ring resonators embedded between micro-heaters designed to ensure homogeneous temperature distribtion.

articleTitle: Long-wavelength BTJ-VCSEL with high-contrast grating
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: InP-based, long-wavelength buried tunnel junction (BTJ) VCSELs, emitting at 1.32 μm with a high-contrast grating (HCG) are demonstrated. This is the first HCG VCSEL presented emitting at long wavelengths. CW operation is demonstrated up to 18°C. The device with an aperture of 11 μm is highly single-mode. No second polarization mode can be identified in the spectrum.

articleTitle: Design of ultrahigh-Q photoinduced cavities in defect-free photonic crystal slabs
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that cavities with Q~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> can be designed in defect-free photonic crystals made of photosensitive material (chalcogenide). Since the high-Q mode can originate from an air-band, these cavities are ideal candidates for sensing applications.

articleTitle: Long-period fiber gratings for transverse mode conversion induced by the optical Kerr effect
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and demonstrate transverse mode conversion by an optically induced long-period fiber grating. A full mode conversion is shown in numerical simulations. Experimental results with a conversion efficiency of about 50% are firstly presented.

articleTitle: Low repetition rate high-energy fiber oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a passively mode-locked normal-dispersive fiber laser emitting pulses with a pulse energy of 41 nJ. The repetition rate of the oscillator was 2.09 MHz. The pulses could be dechirped to 1 ps.

articleTitle: Gain enhancement in hybrid fiber Raman/parametric amplifiers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We proposed a hybrid fiber Raman/parametric amplifier which can have significant gain enhancement over that of a Raman-assisted fiber optical parametric amplifier using the same length of fiber, Raman and parametric pump powers.

articleTitle: High power and widely tunable external cavity diode laser with a single-angled-facet laser chip
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High power external cavity diode lasers were developed in the wavelength region of 1µm by using single-angled facet laser diodes. 330mW output and 130nm tuning were achieved in the conventional Littman-Metcalf configuration.

articleTitle: Frequency-to-time assisted interferometry for polarization-diversified, single-shot, full-field waveform measurement
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A new polarization-diversified, real-time, single-shot interferometric measurement technique utilizing frequency-to-time mapping and four-quadrature digital coherent detection characterizes the amplitude and phase of optical waveforms with 700-ps record lengths, 560-GHz bandwidth and 40-MHz measurement update rates.

articleTitle: DSP-based crosstalk cancellation in WDM interconnects
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose DSP-based crosstalk cancellation in WDM optical interconnects, and investigate the performance of the scheme at 10.7 Gb/s through experimental implementation of a transmitter-based DSP algorithm and optical link simulations.

articleTitle: Terahertz resonance splitting via mutual coupling between parallel-plate waveguide cavities
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The inclusion of multiple resonant cavities in a terahertz TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>-mode parallel-plate waveguide induces splitting of the fundamental resonance due to coupling between the cavities. The resulting features have a higher Q-value than the original resonance.

articleTitle: Wavelength-locking of an ultra-collimated 49 element single-mode diode laser array by a distant VHG
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: VHG-locking of a 49 single mode emitter bar, combined with dual-axis correction/collimation for smile elimination and beam pointing improvement, gives 100% wavelength locking to 48 mm VHG-bar separation and an extended temperature range.

articleTitle: Generation of frequency-doubled 55 fs pulses from an Erbium fiber laser system
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the frequency doubling of an Erbium-doped master-oscillator power-amplifier system. The fundamental 72 fs pulses at a wavelength of 1.56 μm are frequency doubled to 780 nm and compressed in a Gires-Tournois-interferometer mirror pair to a duration of 55 fs with an average power of 172 mW with an efficiency of 48%. To our knowledge these are the shortest pulses ever reported from a frequency-doubled fiber-laser system.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum radiation for optical sensing
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Supercontinuum radiation offers numerous new possibilities for chemical sensing. This paper discusses novel developments in liquid and gas phase sensing applications as well as for microscopic imaging of biological samples with supercontinuum light.

articleTitle: In-situ solution doping technique for novel geometry rare-earth doped fiber fabrication
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the fabrication and characterization of an YDFL with a pedestal geometry fabricated using an in-situ solution doping process. The fiber has a unique non-stressed inner-cladding and exhibits good efficiency.

articleTitle: All-fiber-based frequency comb with an intra-cavity waveguide electro-optic modulator
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We develop an all-fiber-based frequency comb with an intra-cavity waveguide electro-optic modulator. A comb mode is successfully phase-locked to an optical reference. The servo bandwidth of repetition rate is approximately 400 kHz.

articleTitle: 154 kHz, ultra-low repetition rate, high-energy pulse, polarization maintaining, Er-doped fiber laser using single wall carbon nanotube polyimide film
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Long ring-cavity, all-polarization maintaining, Er-doped fiber laser using single wall carbon nanotube polyimide film was demonstrated. Output pulses with pulse energy of 0.7~2.6 nJ were obtained at ultra low repetition rate of 943~154 kHz.

articleTitle: Maximizing the supercontinuum bandwidth in As2S3 chalcogenide photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We simulate supercontinuum generation in an As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> chalcogenide photonic crystal fiber with a hexagonal structure, optimizing the fiber pitch and pulse duration with a 2.8 μm laser source in order to maximize the output bandwidth.

articleTitle: 130 nJ 77 fs dissipative soliton fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on ultrashort high-energy pulse generation from an all-normal-dispersion fiber oscillator. The watt-level laser directly emits chirped pulses with a duration of 1ps and 163nJ of pulse energy. These can be compressed to 77fs.

articleTitle: Linearly polarized, 135-nm bandwidth pulse generation in an erbium-doped fiber ring laser
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a linearly-polarized erbium-doped fiber laser generating 135-nm bandwidth pico-second pulses with excellent temporal and spectral stability. The pulse energy and width are readily reconfigurable via controlling the internal polarization state and pumping power.

articleTitle: Full phase matching of ultrafast coherent high harmonic x-rays at 0.5 keV
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By focusing a 2 μm driving laser into a multi-atmosphere pressure, gas-filled waveguide, we demonstrate full phase matching of high harmonic x-rays throughout the water window for the first time, at energies > 0.5 keV.

articleTitle: Efficient second harmonic generation in orientation patterned GaAs waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO/QELS: 2010 Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High SHG efficiency of 21%W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> was demonstrated in OPGaAs waveguides for the first time. The high efficiency is attributed to record low loss values of 1.5db/cm obtained in these waveguides.
